jobs.title: Security Engineer - Vulnerability & Exposure Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche is dedicated to protecting our networks, systems, applications, and users from constantly evolving cyber threats. As a Security Engineer within the Vulnerability & Exposure Management team, you will play a critical role in identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and reducing cybersecurity risks across Roche’s global environment.

This role goes beyond reviewing scanner outputs. You will help investigate critical vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, improve security tooling and automation capabilities, and partner with stakeholders globally to strengthen Roche’s security posture.

You will join a collaborative and highly technical cybersecurity team that values innovation, curiosity, continuous learning, and proactive risk reduction.

Your Opportunity
In this role, you will:

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities impacting Roche systems and applications

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities identified through security tools and external programs, including bug bounty initiatives

• Research emerging threats and assess exploitability against Roche’s attack surface

• Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application, and security teams to drive remediation activities

• Assess company systems and web applications using automated and manual testing approaches

• Engineer and enhance vulnerability scanning, detection, automation, and monitoring capabilities

• Contribute to security monitoring and incident response activities within a global environment

• Develop scripts, detection logic, templates, and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across vulnerability and exposure management processes

Who you are
You bring a strong cybersecurity foundation combined with analytical thinking, technical curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving complex security challenges.

You also bring:

• Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of professional experience in information security, with demonstrated experience triaging, analyzing, and escalating security vulnerabilities

• Strong understanding of web application, network, endpoint, and cloud security concepts, including vulnerability management or attack surface management within complex enterprise environments

• Hands-on scripting or programming experience using languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Node.js, with familiarity in security tooling, detection logic, automation, or custom scripting

• Experience validating vulnerabilities, assessing exploitability, and supporting security monitoring or incident response activities

• Ability to communicate technical risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, while balancing operational priorities and research initiatives

• Passion for cybersecurity, continuous learning, and emerging security trends, with exposure to open-source security projects or modern AI-assisted engineering workflows considered advantageous

• Professional fluency in English, with industry certifications related to offensive or application security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE) and enterprise cloud security experience viewed as strong assets

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mill

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il team Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR) di Roche è dedicato alla protezione delle nostre reti, sistemi, applicazioni e utenti dalle minacce informatiche in continua evoluzione. In qualità di ingegnere della sicurezza all'interno del team di gestione delle vulnerabilità e dell'esposizione, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nell'identificazione, valutazione, definizione delle priorità e riduzione dei rischi di sicurezza informatica nell'ambiente globale di Roche.

Questo ruolo va oltre la revisione degli output dello scanner. Aiuterai a indagare sulle vulnerabilità critiche, a valutare la possibilità di sfruttamento, a migliorare gli strumenti di sicurezza e le capacità di automazione e a collaborare con le parti interessate a livello globale per rafforzare la strategia di sicurezza di Roche.

Entrerai a far parte di un team di sicurezza informatica collaborativo e altamente tecnico che valorizza l'innovazione, la curiosità, l'apprendimento continuo e la riduzione proattiva del rischio.

La tua opportunità
In questo ruolo dovrai:

• Valutare, indagare e rispondere alle vulnerabilità critiche che influiscono sui sistemi e sulle applicazioni Roche

• Valutare e dare priorità alle vulnerabilità identificate attraverso strumenti di sicurezza e programmi esterni, comprese iniziative di bug bounty

• Ricercare le minacce emergenti e valutare la sfruttabilità rispetto alla superficie di attacco di Roche

• Collaborare con i team di infrastruttura, cloud, applicazioni e sicurezza per guidare le attività di riparazione

• Valutare i sistemi aziendali e le applicazioni web utilizzando approcci di test automatizzati e manuali

• Progettare e migliorare le funzionalità di scansione, rilevamento, automazione e monitoraggio delle vulnerabilità

• Contribuire al monitoraggio della sicurezza e alle attività di risposta agli incidenti in un ambiente globale

• Sviluppare script, logica di rilevamento, modelli e flussi di lavoro di automazione per migliorare l'efficienza operativa

• Supportare iniziative di miglioramento continuo nei processi di gestione delle vulnerabilità e dell'esposizione

Chi sei
Apporta una solida base di sicurezza informatica combinata con pensiero analitico, curiosità tecnica e un approccio proattivo per risolvere complesse sfide di sicurezza.

Porti anche:

• Laurea associata in un settore pertinente o oltre 5 anni di esperienza professionale nella sicurezza delle informazioni, con esperienza dimostrata nella valutazione, nell'analisi e nell'escalation delle vulnerabilità della sicurezza

• Ottima conoscenza dei concetti di sicurezza di applicazioni Web, reti, endpoint e cloud, inclusa la gestione delle vulnerabilità o la gestione delle superfici di attacco all'interno di ambienti aziendali complessi

• Esperienza pratica di scripting o programmazione utilizzando linguaggi come Python, JavaScript o Node.js, con familiarità con gli strumenti di sicurezza, la logica di rilevamento, l'automazione o lo scripting personalizzato

• Esperienza nella convalida delle vulnerabilità, nella valutazione della sfruttabilità e nel supporto del monitoraggio della sicurezza o delle attività di risposta agli incidenti

• Capacità di comunicare efficacemente i rischi tecnici sia alle parti interessate tecniche che a quelle non tecniche, bilanciando al tempo stesso le priorità operative e le iniziative di ricerca

• Passione per la sicurezza informatica, l'apprendimento continuo e le tendenze emergenti in materia di sicurezza, con l'esposizione a progetti di sicurezza open source o flussi di lavoro di ingegneria moderni assistiti dall'intelligenza artificiale considerati vantaggiosi

• Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, con certificazioni di settore relative alla sicurezza offensiva o delle applicazioni (ad es. OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE) ed esperienza nella sicurezza del cloud aziendale considerate risorse importanti

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si dedicano al progresso della scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi si traducono in oltre 26 milioni

Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Das Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR)-Team von Roche widmet sich dem Schutz unserer Netzwerke, Systeme, Anwendungen und Benutzer vor sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Cyber-Bedrohungen. Als Sicherheitsingenieur im Vulnerability & Exposure Management-Team spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Identifizierung, Bewertung, Priorisierung und Reduzierung von Cybersicherheitsrisiken in der globalen Umgebung von Roche.

Diese Rolle geht über die Überprüfung der Scannerausgaben hinaus. Sie helfen dabei, kritische Schwachstellen zu untersuchen, die Ausnutzbarkeit zu bewerten, Sicherheitstools und Automatisierungsfunktionen zu verbessern und mit Interessengruppen weltweit zusammenzuarbeiten, um die Sicherheitslage von Roche zu stärken.

• Entwickeln Sie Skripte, Erkennungslogik, Vorlagen und Automatisierungsworkflows, um die betriebliche Effizienz zu verbessern

Sie bringen außerdem mit:

• Associate Degree in einem relevanten Bereich oder mehr als 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Informationssicherheit, mit nachweislicher Erfahrung in der Einstufung, Analyse und Eskalation von Sicherheitslücken

Le poste
L'équipe Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR) de Roche se consacre à la protection de nos réseaux, systèmes, applications et utilisateurs contre les cybermenaces en constante évolution. En tant qu'ingénieur de sécurité au sein de l'équipe de gestion des vulnérabilités et des expositions, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'identification, l'évaluation, la priorisation et la réduction des risques de cybersécurité dans l'environnement mondial de Roche.

Ce rôle va au-delà de l’examen des résultats du scanner. Vous aiderez à enquêter sur les vulnérabilités critiques, à évaluer l’exploitabilité, à améliorer les outils de sécurité et les capacités d’automatisation, et à collaborer avec les parties prenantes du monde entier pour renforcer la posture de sécurité de Roche.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de cybersécurité collaborative et hautement technique qui valorise l'innovation, la curiosité, l'apprentissage continu et la réduction proactive des risques.

• Solide compréhension des concepts de sécurité des applications Web, des réseaux, des points de terminaison et du cloud, y compris la gestion des vulnérabilités ou la gestion des surfaces d'attaque dans des environnements d'entreprise complexes.

• Capacité à communiquer efficacement les risques techniques aux parties prenantes techniques et non techniques, tout en équilibrant les priorités opérationnelles et les initiatives de recherche.

The Position

The Network Security team secures Roche’s global connectivity through policy-driven, automated infrastructure. We design, build, and maintain enterprise solutions—including Internet Security, DDoS protection, VPNs, NAC, and Deep Packet Inspection—to mitigate risks across cloud and on-prem environments.

This is a temporary, fixed-term position

The Opportunity:

As a Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network, you will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle, global adoption, and engineering of our Network Access Control (NAC) and network segmentation systems. You will bridge the gap between high-level security policy and technical execution, leveraging automation to scale controls and advance our Zero Trust roadmap.

Key Responsibilities:

• NAC & Segmentation Engineering: Deploy and maintain Cisco ISE globally. Design endpoint profiling logic (IoT, Medical, Corporate), Dot1x/MAB workflows, and Cisco TrustSec (SGTs) for software-defined segmentation.

• Perimeter Security: Deploy and support Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) in high-availability (Active/Active and Active/Passive) configurations.

• Automation & Compliance: Manage security policies as code using automation workflows to eliminate manual friction. Implement automated network access policies based on device compliance.

• Operations & Visibility: Serve as the escalation lead for complex network security incidents, providing root-cause analysis and long-term architectural fixes. Build dashboards for real-time visibility into the connected landscape.

• Enablement: Design self-service tools that allow internal teams to autonomously consume network security controls.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent experience

• NAC Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and managing enterprise Cisco ISE deployments (TrustSec, Dot1x, MAB, and Profiling).

• Firewall Mastery: Proven experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Palo Alto NGFWs, including SSL decryption and threat prevention.

• Network & Security Foundations: Deep understanding of RADIUS, TACACS+, core routing/switching, and "Defense in Depth" architectures.

• Leadership & Collaboration: A self-starter capable of managing technical workstreams independently. Strong communication skills to mentor colleagues and build trust with cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• DevOps & Automation: Proficiency with Ansible, Terraform, GitHub (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and scripting (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) for API integrations.

• Advanced Networking: Solid foundation in L2/L3 enterprise networking, including routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) and switching (VLANs, VXLAN).

• Regulated Industry: Experience in Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare, or Finance.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

As an Omnichannel Customer Experience Partner, you will act as an expert in marketing, digital marketing, and strategy, while providing integrated systems thinking and leadership. Your responsibilities include developing, owning, and jointly implementing team outcomes with pod members, co-defining portfolio strategy, and leading or contributing to related work packages and initiatives.

In terms of Omnichannel capabilities, you are expected to serve as a powerful lever to deliver a seamless customer experience across face-to-face and digital channels, having demonstrated experience in creating and delivering Omnichannel campaigns that blend our “traditional” activities with digital touchpoints in an orchestrated way, with a focus on effective messaging, customer satisfaction, speed, and cost-effectiveness.

Although hired into a country affiliate, this role requires you to be part of an APAC collaboration, working across borders to realize and scale country outcomes by contributing to virtual, cross-border, cross-functional work package teams.

Roche expects all employees to hold high standards of compliance with both external and internal policies and regulations and actively participate in SHE initiatives within the Company.

• Contribute expertise in digital marketing and product strategy development to create a cohesive customer experience across all touchpoints.

• Lead comprehensive marketing efforts, including market analysis and market research that informs both traditional and digital channels.

PJP) e le parti interessate pertinenti per identificare e analizzare approfondimenti allineati ai risultati definiti dal team dell'area malattia, possedendo lo spazio relativo a EpicX e approfondimenti qualitativi e quantitativi rilevanti per ottimizzare l'esperienza complessiva del cliente.

Desarrollo profesional

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in oncology and hematology therapeutic areas as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in oncology/hematology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of oncology/hematology

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD in oncology/hematology, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice in oncology/hematology

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience in oncology/hematology

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research You have a very good understanding of oncology/hematology global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of non-oncology therapeutic areas (immunology, neurology, CVRM, ophthalmology)

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice; clinical expertise in immunology preferred

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience, early development experience in immunology preferred

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research sites, and interpreting early development clinical trial data

• You have a very good understanding of global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La position Dans le Centre d'excellence pour le développement précoce de la Chine (CED) de Roches, nous jouons un rôle crucial dans l'accélération du développement précoce mondial des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Nous sommes un partenaire stratégique des équipes mondiales de développement précoce de Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (PRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (GRED) et Pharmaceutical Product Development (PD) pour intégrer la Chine dans les programmes mondiaux de développement précoce. Ensemble, nous apportons rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. Cette position est située dans la fonction de science clinique de Roche Product Development China, la maison de la Chine ED CoE. Ce poste est dédié à diriger et à diriger des programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de la neurologie, du CVRM et de l'ophtalmologie en tant que chef de file clinique. L'opportunité Ce rôle aura l'occasion de façonner la stratégie mondiale de développement précoce et le PDC, de stimuler la conception novatrice d'essais de développement précoce, d'avoir des répercussions importantes sur l'efficacité et le succès de nos programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de la neurologie, du CVRM et de l'ophtalmologie, et de contribuer à l'écosystème d'innovation pour le développement de médicaments en Chine. Dans votre rôle, vous :
• Contribuer et influencer la stratégie mondiale en matière d'actifs et le développement rapide en tant que membre des équipes mondiales d'actifs
• Identifier de manière proactive les possibilités d'accélérer et d'optimiser le CDP mondial ED en tirant parti de l'expertise, de l'expérience, de la vitesse et de l'échelle en Chine
• Diriger l'équipe interfonctionnelle de la Chine pour évaluer les possibilités de la Chine de rejoindre les programmes mondiaux de DE ou les premiers essais de la Chine sur le plan stratégique, scientifique, réglementaire et opérationnel
• Favoriser la conception et la conduite d'essais innovants en partenariat étroit avec des experts fonctionnels mondiaux en développement précoce sur les premiers essais cliniques en Chine
• Être le moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques de DE en Chine
• Mobiliser scientifiquement les TAE chinois, les acteurs internes et externes de Roche
• Servir de point de contact scientifique avec les équipes mondiales de développement précoce des domaines thérapeutiques non oncologiques (immunologie, neurologie, CVRM, ophtalmologie)
• Mentor des directeurs médicaux juniors pour renforcer les capacités et les capacités du Conseil de l'Europe Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un MD ou d'un baccalauréat/maîtrise en médecine clinique avec au moins 3 ans de pratique clinique après l'obtention du diplôme; expertise clinique en immunologie préférée
• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et une expérience de développement précoce étendue, expérience de développement précoce en immunologie préférée
• Vous avez une expérience pratique du développement précoce du PDC, de la conception et du déroulement des essais cliniques de développement précoce, de l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires, de la collaboration avec les chercheurs et les sites de recherche clinique, et de l'interprétation des données des essais cliniques de développement précoce
• Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des lignes directrices et des règlements mondiaux en matière de développement, y compris le CDE, la FDA et l'EMEA
• Vous êtes un communicateur efficace : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais, avec la capacité de présenter des concepts complexes aux équipes interfonctionnelles mondiales, aux comités de gouvernance et aux principales parties prenantes de manière logique et succincte
• Vous êtes un grand joueur d'équipe; hautement collaborative, de bonnes aptitudes interpersonnelles et influentes, peut influencer sans autorité Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le glob

生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识，以身作则，带领团队业务在合规基石上稳健发展

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【募集職種】 Clinician Engagement Sales_九州エリア担当
　　　　　　（小・中型医療機器のソリューション営業・保守サポート）

【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、および開業医・クリニックに対し、中型医療機器（e411）および小型検査機器（Near Patient Care / POCT）の提案から導入後の保守点検まで、一貫した価値提供を担っていただきます。顧客の潜在的な課題を抽出し、現場に最適なオーダーメイド製品の提案を行い、導入から稼働後のアフターフォローまで伴走します。単なる機器の販売にとどまらず、検査の迅速化による院内ワークフローの改善や、救急・急性期医療における診療の質向上など、医療従事者との強固な信頼関係を構築しながら、患者ケアの質を高めるトータルソリューションを提供していただきます。また、定期的な保守点検やトラブルシューティングを通じて、機器が常に最適なパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう現場を支える重要な役割です。

＜具体的な業務内容＞
1. 提案・営業活動（Clinician Engagement）

• 担当エリア（大学病院、総合病院、クリニック、開業医）の医師、看護師、臨床検査技師などへのアプローチ

• 医療現場の課題のヒアリングと課題抽出

• ニーズに合わせた機器（cobas e 411、cobas pulse、cobas liatなど）や試薬のプレゼンテーション、デモンストレーションの実施

• 導入に伴う費用対効果（ROI）のシミュレーション、見積書作成、契約交渉

2. 導入・立ち上げサポート

• 機器納入時のセットアップおよび動作確認

• 医療従事者向けの操作説明会（アプリケーション・トレーニング）の実施

3. 保守点検・アフターフォロー（Technical Support）

• 契定期的な保守点検（メンテナンス）の実施

• 機器の不具合やエラー発生時の一次対応（電話によるリモートサポート、または現場への訪問・修理対応）

• 新しい試薬（検査項目）の追加提案や、最新の学術情報の提供

【応募資格（必須要件）】
医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験
（対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等）
具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方：

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

普通自動車第一種運転免許（AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】
・医療業界において、営業活動と保守サービス両方の業務を一貫して担ったご経験（ハイブリッド型のご経験）をお持ちの方
・エンジニアで、保守サービスなどのプロモーションや提案活動のご経験をお持ちの方
・臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験

【求める人物像】
Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

Achieving Results（結果志向）: 「顧客の課題解決」と「機器の安定稼働」という高い目標の達成に向け、新規提案からアフターフォローまで、当事者意識を持ち根気強く行動し続けられる方

Teamwork & Collaborations（協働と連携）: お客様に最適なトータルソリューションを届けるため、自身の役割や枠組みにとらわれず、社内のさまざまなステークホルダーを巻き込み、チームワークとコラボレーションを促進できる方

　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
　　　　　（雇い入れ直後）: 福岡オフィス　〒812-0011　福岡県福岡市博多区博多駅前1-4-4東京建物博多ビル 12F
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜
　　※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～

担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、および開業医・クリニックに対し、中型医療機器（e411）および小型検査機器（Near Patient Care / POCT）の提案から導入後の保守点検まで、一貫した価値提供を担っていただきます。顧客の潜在的な課題を抽出し、現場に最適なオーダーメイド製品の提案を行い、導入から稼働後のアフターフォローまで伴走します。単なる機器の販売にとどまらず、検査の迅速化による院内ワークフローの改善や、救急・急性期医療における診療の質向上など、医療従事者との強固な信頼関係を構築しながら、患者ケアの質を高めるトータルソリューションを提供していただきます。また、定期的な保守点検やトラブルシューティングを通じて、機器が常に最適なパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう現場を支える重要な役割です。

＜具体的な業務内容＞
1. 提案・営業活動（Clinician Engagement）

• 担当エリア（大学病院、総合病院、クリニック、開業医）の医師、看護師、臨床検査技師などへのアプローチ

• 医療現場の課題のヒアリングと課題抽出

• ニーズに合わせた機器（cobas e 411、cobas pulse、cobas liatなど）や試薬のプレゼンテーション、デモンストレーションの実施

• 導入に伴う費用対効果（ROI）のシミュレーション、見積書作成、契約交渉

2. 導入・立ち上げサポート

• 機器納入時のセットアップおよび動作確認

• 医療従事者向けの操作説明会（アプリケーション・トレーニング）の実施

3. 保守点検・アフターフォロー（Technical Support）

• 契定期的な保守点検（メンテナンス）の実施

• 機器の不具合やエラー発生時の一次対応（電話によるリモートサポート、または現場への訪問・修理対応）

• 新しい試薬（検査項目）の追加提案や、最新の学術情報の提供

医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験

jobs.title: Government & External Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Government & External Affairs Lead
Team: Health System Shaping Lab
Reports to: General Manager

Roche Slovensko is seeking a Government & External Affairs Lead to join the Local Leadership Team (Purpose Enabling Board - PEB). This senior role is responsible for shaping national policy and creating patient access strategies.

The successful candidate will proactively drive changes in the national policy and legislative environment. You will lead strategies to influence key stakeholders, ensuring patient access to our innovations. This position requires strategic thinking, political knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach to impact the Slovak healthcare system.

Key Responsibilities:

• Policy Advocacy: Lead targeted efforts to influence public health and pricing legislation to drive systemic improvements for patient access and innovation.

• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with political stakeholders, decision-makers, and payers at the national level.

• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.

• Strategic Alignment: Manage the External Engagement Strategy, ensuring it supports Patient Access goals and integrates across Pharma, Diagnostics, and the wider Roche enterprise.

• Leadership: Participate in the Purpose Enabling Board (Affiliate Leadership Team), connecting the Health System Shaping group's goals to the affiliate strategy, and guiding the team.

Required Qualifications:

• Experience: Minimum 5 years in Government & External Affairs (policy/network development). Minimum 7 years of experience in the Slovak Health Care. Minimum 6 months in leadership roles.

• Expertise:
Deep understanding of healthcare funding and external conditions impacting the system. Proven ability in strategy development, execution, and navigating complex or uncertain situations (Triple Win concept).

• Mindset:

• Systemic & Enabling: Focus on leveraging networks for value creation and scaling.

• Entrepreneurial: Self-managed, comfortable with risk, committed to continuous learning.

• Ethical: High integrity and strong alignment with affiliate values.

• Skills:
Strategic Thinking (Enterprise Mindset), VACC Leadership, Influencing, Effective Decision Making (in ambiguity), Strategic Agility (managing long-term goals amid change).

• Education & Language:
Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Medicine, Law, Health Economics). Fluent in Slovak and proficient in English.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 64,900.00 EUR - 120,540.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conduct

jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities
I. Sales Target Setting and Management
• Support the preparation of annual and quarterly sales target-setting by providing historical data, market trends, and performance insights.

• Maintain and update sales performance against targets daily/weekly/monthly, identifying variances and provide data summaries to Sales Leadership for follow-up actions.

• Ensure targets are equitably distributed and clearly communicated across the sales force.

• Manage the sales performance relevant process(contract fillment, sales rebate, allowance)
II. Territory Design and Management
• Partner with sales leaders to develop and optimize sales territory structures to ensure fair opportunity distribution, minimize channel conflict, and maximize market coverage and penetration.

• Develop and maintain territory assignment rules and policies, performing regular audits and re-alignments based on business changes, market potential, and sales force size.

• Provide analysis and recommendations on optimal sales resource deployment and headcount planning.
III. Sales Performance Management and Market intelligence Analytics
• Develop, maintain, and disseminate key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards that provide clear, actionable insights into the health of the sales pipeline and overall performance.

• Conduct deep-dive analysis on sales trends, productivity metrics, and funnel conversion rates to identify bottlenecks and areas for process improvement.

• Support regular business review preparation and follow-up, including identifying performance gaps and tracking improvement actions.
IV. Tender coordination
• Partner with sales leaders to build the systematic approach to monitor and capture tender opportunities and follow up with the sales team.

• Filter the tender by portfolio and dispatch to the respective territory sales team

• Support sales team to prepare tender documentation and compilation .

V. Process Improvement and Enablement
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize core sales processes (e.g., forecasting, pipeline management, account planning).

• Partner with Sales Enablement to translate best practices and process improvements into effective training content and tools.
Compliance & Additional Tasks

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

• Perform other tasks as assigned by the line manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Responsabilità e impegni chiave
I. Definizione e gestione degli obiettivi di vendita
• Supportare la preparazione della definizione degli obiettivi di vendita annuali e trimestrali fornendo dati storici, tendenze di mercato e approfondimenti sulle prestazioni.

• Mantenere e aggiornare le prestazioni di vendita rispetto agli obiettivi giornalieri/settimanali/mensili, identificando gli scostamenti e fornendo riepiloghi dei dati alla direzione delle vendite per le azioni di follow-up.

• Garantire che gli obiettivi siano equamente distribuiti e comunicati chiaramente a tutta la forza vendita.

• Gestire il processo relativo alle prestazioni di vendita (esecuzione del contratto, sconto sulle vendite, indennità)
II. Progettazione e gestione del territorio
• Collaborare con i leader delle vendite per sviluppare e ottimizzare le strutture del territorio di vendita per garantire un'equa distribuzione delle opportunità, ridurre al minimo i conflitti di canale e massimizzare la copertura e la penetrazione del mercato.

• Sviluppare e mantenere regole e politiche di assegnazione del territorio, eseguendo controlli regolari e riallineamenti in base ai cambiamenti aziendali, al potenziale di mercato e alle dimensioni della forza vendita.

• Fornire analisi e raccomandazioni sull'implementazione ottimale delle risorse di vendita e sulla pianificazione dell'organico.
III. Gestione delle performance di vendita e analisi delle informazioni di mercato
• Sviluppare, mantenere e diffondere indicatori chiave di prestazione (KPI) e dashboard che forniscano informazioni chiare e utilizzabili sullo stato di salute della pipeline di vendita e sulle prestazioni complessive.

• Condurre analisi approfondite sulle tendenze di vendita, sui parametri di produttività e sui tassi di conversione della canalizzazione per identificare i colli di bottiglia e le aree di miglioramento del processo.

• Supportare la preparazione e il follow-up periodici della revisione aziendale, compresa l'identificazione delle lacune prestazionali e il monitoraggio delle azioni di miglioramento.
IV. Coordinamento gare
• Collaborare con i leader delle vendite per costruire un approccio sistematico per monitorare e cogliere le opportunità di gara e seguire il team di vendita.

• Filtrare l'offerta per portafoglio e inviarla al rispettivo team di vendita territoriale

• Supportare il team di vendita nella preparazione e compilazione della documentazione di gara.

V. Miglioramento e abilitazione del processo
• Identificare opportunità per semplificare e standardizzare i principali processi di vendita (ad esempio, previsione, gestione della pipeline, pianificazione dell'account).

• Collaborare con Sales Enablement per tradurre le migliori pratiche e i miglioramenti dei processi in contenuti e strumenti di formazione efficaci.
Conformità e compiti aggiuntivi

• Condurre tutte le attività aziendali nel pieno rispetto delle politiche Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues e Roche Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection, dimostrando al contempo una solida comprensione dei requisiti di conformità e rispettando elevati standard di integrità.

• Eseguire altre attività assegnate dal manager di linea.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si dedicano al progresso della scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi hanno portato a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e a oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Ci diamo la forza reciproca di esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alte le nostre ambizioni, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita e hanno un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Kontakte, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Hauptverantwortlichkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten
I. Festlegung und Verwaltung von Vertriebszielen
• Unterstützen Sie die Vorbereitung der jährlichen und vierteljährlichen Umsatzzielsetzung durch die Bereitstellung historischer Daten, Markttrends und Leistungseinblicke.

• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie die Vertriebsleistung im Vergleich zu den Zielen täglich/wöchentlich/monatlich, identifizieren Sie Abweichungen und stellen Sie der Vertriebsleitung Datenzusammenfassungen für Folgemaßnahmen zur Verfügung.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ziele gleichmäßig verteilt und im gesamten Vertriebsteam klar kommuniziert werden.

• Verwalten Sie den verkaufsleistungsrelevanten Prozess (Vertragserfüllung, Verkaufsrückerstattung, Vergütung).
II. Gebietsgestaltung und -management
• Arbeiten Sie mit Vertriebsleitern zusammen, um Vertriebsgebietsstrukturen zu entwickeln und zu optimieren, um eine faire Chancenverteilung sicherzustellen, Kanalkonflikte zu minimieren und die Marktabdeckung und -durchdringung zu maximieren.

• Entwickeln und pflegen Sie Gebietszuweisungsregeln und -richtlinien und führen Sie regelmäßige Audits und Neuausrichtungen auf der Grundlage von Geschäftsveränderungen, Marktpotenzial und Vertriebsmitarbeitergröße durch.

• Bereitstellung von Analysen und Empfehlungen für den optimalen Einsatz von Vertriebsressourcen und die Planung des Personalbestands.
III. Sales Performance Management und Market Intelligence Analytics
• Entwickeln, pflegen und verbreiten Sie wichtige Leistungsindikatoren (KPIs) und Dashboards, die klare, umsetzbare Einblicke in den Zustand der Vertriebspipeline und die Gesamtleistung liefern.

• Führen Sie detaillierte Analysen zu Verkaufstrends, Produktivitätskennzahlen und Funnel-Conversion-Raten durch, um Engpässe und Bereiche für Prozessverbesserungen zu identifizieren.

• Unterstützen Sie die regelmäßige Vorbereitung und Nachbereitung von Geschäftsbewertungen, einschließlich der Identifizierung von Leistungslücken und der Verfolgung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Vertriebsleitern zusammen, um einen systematischen Ansatz zur Überwachung und Erfassung von Ausschreibungsmöglichkeiten zu entwickeln und mit dem Vertriebsteam nachzufassen.

• Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams bei der Vorbereitung und Zusammenstellung der Ausschreibungsunterlagen.

V. Prozessverbesserung und -aktivierung
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Rationalisierung und Standardisierung zentraler Vertriebsprozesse (z. B. Prognosen, Pipeline-Management, Account-Planung).

• Arbeiten Sie mit Sales Enablement zusammen, um Best Practices und Prozessverbesserungen in effektive Schulungsinhalte und -tools umzusetzen.
Compliance und zusätzliche Aufgaben

• Führen Sie alle Geschäftsaktivitäten in voller Übereinstimmung mit Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues und den Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltschutzrichtlinien von Roche durch und demonstrieren Sie gleichzeitig ein solides Verständnis der Compliance-Anforderungen und wahren Sie den hohen Integritätsstandard.

• Führen Sie andere vom Vorgesetzten zugewiesene Aufgaben aus.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt dafür, die Wissenschaft voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnoseprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir bestärken uns gegenseitig darin, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hochzuhalten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die eine globale Wirkung haben.

Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert.

C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste
Principales responsabilités et responsabilités
I. Définition et gestion des objectifs de vente
• Soutenir la préparation de l'établissement des objectifs de ventes annuels et trimestriels en fournissant des données historiques, des tendances du marché et des informations sur les performances.

• Maintenir et mettre à jour les performances des ventes par rapport aux objectifs quotidiennement/hebdomadairement/mensuellement, en identifiant les écarts et en fournissant des résumés de données à la direction commerciale pour les actions de suivi.

• Veiller à ce que les objectifs soient équitablement répartis et clairement communiqués à l'ensemble de la force de vente.

• Gérer le processus pertinent pour la performance des ventes (exécution du contrat, remise sur les ventes, allocation)
II. Conception et gestion du territoire
• Collaborer avec les responsables des ventes pour développer et optimiser les structures des territoires de vente afin d'assurer une répartition équitable des opportunités, minimiser les conflits de canaux et maximiser la couverture et la pénétration du marché.

• Développer et maintenir des règles et politiques d'attribution de territoire, en effectuant des audits réguliers et des réalignements en fonction des changements commerciaux, du potentiel du marché et de la taille de la force de vente.

• Fournir des analyses et des recommandations sur le déploiement optimal des ressources de vente et la planification des effectifs.
III. Gestion de la performance commerciale et analyse de la veille commerciale
• Développer, maintenir et diffuser des indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) et des tableaux de bord qui fournissent des informations claires et exploitables sur la santé du pipeline de ventes et la performance globale.

• Effectuer une analyse approfondie des tendances des ventes, des mesures de productivité et des taux de conversion de l'entonnoir pour identifier les goulots d'étranglement et les domaines d'amélioration des processus.

• Soutenir la préparation et le suivi réguliers des revues commerciales, y compris l'identification des écarts de performance et le suivi des actions d'amélioration.
IV. Coordination des appels d'offres
• Collaborer avec les responsables des ventes pour élaborer une approche systématique permettant de surveiller et de capturer les opportunités d'appel d'offres et d'effectuer un suivi avec l'équipe de vente.

• Filtrer l'offre par portefeuille et l'envoyer à l'équipe commerciale du territoire concerné

• Soutenir l'équipe commerciale pour préparer la documentation et la compilation des appels d'offres.

V. Amélioration et habilitation des processus
• Identifier les opportunités de rationaliser et de standardiser les processus de vente de base (par exemple, prévisions, gestion du pipeline, planification des comptes).

• Collaborer avec Sales Enablement pour traduire les meilleures pratiques et les améliorations de processus en contenu et outils de formation efficaces.
Conformité et tâches supplémentaires

• Mener toutes les activités commerciales en totale conformité avec les politiques de Roche Secure, Roche Behaviour in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues et Roche en matière de sûreté, de sécurité, de santé et de protection de l'environnement, tout en démontrant une solide compréhension des exigences de conformité et en respectant les normes élevées d'intégrité.

• Effectuer d'autres tâches assignées par le supérieur hiérarchique.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, garantissant à chacun l’accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts ont permis de traiter plus de 26 millions de personnes avec nos médicaments et de réaliser plus de 30 milliards de tests à l'aide de nos produits de diagnostic. Nous nous donnons les moyens d'explorer de nouvelles possibilités, de favoriser la créativité et de maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir proposer des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Bâtissons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Analyst
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As an Senior Analyst, you will collaborate closely with the Strategic Analytics & Insights team based in the US, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads, and the broader GATE team. Your primary responsibility will be to deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights that support strategic priorities, ultimately aiming for the greatest impact with customers and patients.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex projects and initiatives in pharma commercial operations, focusing on Brand Performance tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patient Journeys (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Forecasting, Product launch support and assessment, Patient adherence, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact and ROIs

• Collaborate with Therapy area managers, Ecosystem insights leads and other business stakeholders to understand market dynamics and customer behaviors, leveraging this knowledge to support data-driven strategies

• Comprehend stakeholder requirements, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage day-to-day responsibilities, including liaising and coordinating with the GATE internal team for delivery

• Lead the team and stakeholder discussions, act as thought partner and provide them with high quality analytics solutions and recommendations

• Create impactful presentations to convey crucial insights and recommendations to stakeholders effectively

• Attend meetings with teams across different time zones to ensure smooth delivery of analytical & operations related requests for the business partners

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization, focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value

• Be flexible to attend meeting during IST/PST overlapping working hours

• Provide mentorship and training to junior team members and interns on analytics principles and the Pharma domain, fostering the development of skill sets and capabilities

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor degree in Technology or a relevant discipline, with a preference for Computer Science, Software, Statistics, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and related fields and 4-8 years of analytics / consulting experience, with 2-5 years specifically in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics projects. Preferably, Master’s Degree or any certifications on analytics or data science would be an added advantage.

• Must demonstrate expertise in US Pharma Commercial Operations and possess a strong background in Sales analytics, Claims analytics, Product analysis, Patients analytics, forecasting and ROI analysis

• Experience with a range of secondary data sets, including IQVIA Sales data, 867 data, LAAD Claims, affiliations, field interactions, Veeva, medical data, and more, is a significant advantage

• Exposure to therapeutic areas like oncology, neurology, immunology, etc., along with a working knowledge of Salesforce or Veeva, is a valuable additional qualification

• Esperienza con una serie di set di dati secondari, compresi i dati di vendita IQVIA, 867 dati, reclami LAAD, affiliazioni, interazioni sul campo, Veeva, dati medici, e altro ancora, è un vantaggio significativo
• L'esposizione a aree terapeutiche come oncologia, neurologia, immunologia, ecc., insieme a una conoscenza di lavoro di Salesforce o Veeva, è una valida qualifica aggiuntiva

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Product Owner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Product Owner for our Source-to-Procure (S2P) ecosystem, you bridge the gap between technical execution and business objectives. Working at an advanced professional level alongside Senior Product Managers, you own the product backlog and drive the execution of our digital procurement roadmap. You join a collaborative, forward-thinking Informatics team focused on delivering enterprise-scale value.
In this role, you will:

• Own and prioritize the S2P product backlog, translating strategic business goals into actionable technical user stories.

• Lead the end-to-end scope and execution of large-scale S2P initiatives, managing dependencies across cross-functional teams.

• Optimize delivery methodologies by tailoring frameworks like Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or ITSM to maximize efficiency and maintain high quality.

• Act as a trusted advisor to a diverse group of stakeholders, navigating complex matrix environments to align expectations and build consensus.

• Diagnose system bottlenecks and lead root-cause analysis to design and validate technical or workflow enhancement plans.

• Mentor team members , fostering a collaborative spirit, driving mutual accountability, and guiding the team through ambiguity.

Who You Are

You are a versatile, analytical professional who thrives at the intersection of agile delivery and procurement technology. You are a natural facilitator who handles uncertainty with a pragmatic mindset and communicates effortlessly with both technical and business partners.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• 6-8 years of experience working with procurement platforms (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting, or Requisition-to-Pay), including at least 2 years supporting the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• A proven track record of leading the delivery of complex features, major product releases, or service transitions within a product ownership or delivery management capacity.

• Versatile framework expertise with hands-on experience navigating environments as a Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or Agile Coach.

• Strong strategic acumen with a demonstrated ability to translate high-level business goals into structured implementation roadmaps and technical delivery strategies.

• Advanced problem-solving skills and proficiency with modern delivery tools to analyze dependencies, run root-cause analysis, and optimize workflows.

• Exceptional relationship-building skills , with a coaching mindset

Un livello professionale avanzato insieme ai Senior Product Manager, possiedi il product backlog e guidi l'esecuzione della nostra roadmap digitale di appalti. In questo ruolo, ti ripudiai di: - Possedere e osare priorità al prodotto backlog S2P, diffusondo gli obiettivi strategici in storie utente implementabili. - Guidare l'ambito e l'esecuzione end-to-end di iniziative S2P su larga scala, gestendo le dipendenze tra team multifunzionali. - Ottimizzare le metodologie di consegna adattando framework come Scrum, SAFe, Kanban o ITSM per massimizzare l'efficienza e mantenere un'alta qualità. - Agire come consulente fidato per un gruppo diversificato di stakeholder, navigando in ambienti complessi a matrice per allineare le aspettative e costruire il consenso. - Diagnosticare i colli di bottiglia del sistema e guidare l'analisi delle cause radice per progettare e convalidare piani di potenziamento tecnici o di flusso di lavoro. - Mentore dei membri del team, promuovendo uno spirito collaborativo, favorndo la responsabilità reciproca e guidando il team attraverso l'ambiguità. Sei un facilitatore naturale che controlla l'errore con un mindset pragmatico e comunica senza sforzo con entrambi i partner tecnici e aziendali. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - 6-8 anni di esperienza nel lavoro con piattaforme di approvvigionamento (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting o Requisition-to-Pay), inclusi almeno 2 anni di supporto al settore delle scienze della vita o dell'industria farmaceutica. - No. Un track record comprovato nella guida della consegna di funzionalità complesse, di importanti rilasci di prodotti o di transizioni di servizi all'interno di una capacità di proprietà del prodotto o di gestione della consegna. - Esperienza versatile con i framework con esperienza pratica nella navigazione di ambienti come Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager o Agile Coach. - Forte acume strategica con capacità dimostrata di tradurre obiettivi aziendali di alto livello in road map di implementazione strutturate e strategie di consegna tecnica. - Abilità avanzata di problem solving e competenza con strumenti di consegna moderni per analisi le dipendenze, eseguire l'analisi delle cause eredita e ottimizza i flussi di lavoro. - Eccellenti capacità di costruzione di relazioni, con un mindset di coaching.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。
高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。

【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。

1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）

• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築

• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む）

2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート

• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務

• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務

• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務

• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務

3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動

• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供

• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます

【応募条件（必須要件）】

• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。

• 全国転勤可であること。

• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方
臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。
診断薬・医療機器メーカーの経験者 体外診断薬や医療機器メーカーにおいて、アプリケーションスペシャリスト（AS）やアプリケーションサイエンティストとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。これまでの経験を活かし、より専門性を高めながら、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上やビジネスの拡大に深くコミットしたい方。
学術部門のご経験者 製薬メーカー等の学術部門での経験があり、病気の早期発見から治療方針決定、モニタリングまで幅広く貢献する「臨床検査学」に関心をお持ちの方。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方。

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方。

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方。

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサイエンティスト
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス　※担当地域は立川または板橋
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※入社にあたり転居が必要と会社が判断した場合は、社宅適用あり
　　 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。
高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。

【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。

1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）

• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築

• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む）

2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート

• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務

• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務

• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務

• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務

3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動

• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供

• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます

【応募条件（必須要件）】

• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。

• 全国転勤可であること。

• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方
臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。
診断薬・医療機器メーカーの経験者 体外診断薬や医療機器メーカーにおいて、アプリケーションスペシャリスト（AS）やアプリケーションサイエンティストとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。これまでの経験を活かし、より専門性を高めながら、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上やビジネスの拡大に深くコミットしたい方。
学術部門のご経験者 製薬メーカー等の学術部門での経験があり、病気の早期発見から治療方針決定、モニタリングまで幅広く貢献する「臨床検査学」に関心をお持ちの方。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方。

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方。

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方。

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 （雇い入れ直後）：募集職種 フィールドサイエンティスト
（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス ※担当地域は立川または板橋
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～ ※入社にあたり転居が必要と会社が判断した場合は、社宅適用あり
時間外固定手当：月51,936円 （時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训

titleByLocale.it: Pasante de Affari Aziendali e Comunicazione

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Pasante de Corporate Affairs & Communications en Roche Chile, tienes la oportunidad única de adquirir experiencia real dentro de una industria altamente regulada. Al integrarte a nuestra área, serás un actor clave para dar vida a nuestra cultura, conectando nuestro propósito y valores institucionales con los medios de comunicación, líderes de la salud y nuestra propia comunidad interna.

La Oportunidad:

• Apoyas en tácticas de relaciones públicas mediante el monitoreo diario de prensa, la actualización de bases de datos de periodistas y la redacción de comunicados para hitos corporativos.

• Colaboras en planes de posicionamiento para promover a líderes internos de Roche como referentes técnicos del debate de salud pública.

• Ejecutas estrategias de comunicación interna usando narrativas transmedia para traducir información en mensajes movilizadores que fortalezcan nuestra cultura corporativa.

• Planificas y redactas contenido para los canales digitales de Roche Chile, adaptando mensajes complejos a formatos multiplataforma para interactuar de forma fluida con la comunidad digital.

• Asistes en el análisis de entorno y en la preparación de documentos de posición dirigidos a autoridades ministeriales y legislativas, apoyando nuestro rol en la modernización del sistema de salud chileno.

• Aseguras el soporte operativo controlando los flujos de trabajo de comunicación y garantizando el cumplimiento riguroso de los estándares normativos de la industria farmacéutica.

Quién eres:

• Eres estudiante activo de 3ero o 4to año de la carrera de Periodismo .

• Cuentas con alta capacidad de autogestión para dedicar al menos 4 horas diarias, las cuales puedes coordinar de manera flexible según tus compromisos universitarios.

• Posees sólidas habilidades de redacción periodística, ortografía, capacidad de entrevista y un excelente criterio editorial.

• Manejas a nivel intermedio herramientas de edición digital, multimedia y creación de imágenes.

• Tienes un nivel de inglés intermedio.

*Los beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta vacante.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

• You are accountable for handling complex software complaints for our sequencing and pathology products, like safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an IT related field (preferred) with knowledge of bioinformatics or genomics. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Bioinformatics or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

Locations
This is a primarily onsite position in Tucson, Arizona.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson Arizona is $77,280 and $143,520. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifi
