jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to spearhead the long-term category roadmap and command our high-value IT supplier landscape that drives the functioning of our Diagnostics Instruments? As our Global Category Manager for IT Software & Hardware in Sant Cugat, Spain (or in Indianapolis, U.S.), you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this rapidly evolving spend category. In this role, you will manage tier-one global technology providers, negotiate complex commercial frameworks, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence, and global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Digital Pathologist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Digital Pathologist, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of pathology investigations and the application of computational pathology approaches for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct, and report computational toxicologic pathology approaches to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline. You will support the automation of pathology algorithms, workflows, and platforms, remaining accountable for the scientific delivery of pathology data to inform risk assessment across projects ranging from small molecules to complex biological products.

• Core Portfolio Toxicologic Pathology : Provide expert pathology support in preclinical development, aligning toxicity study designs with current science and regulatory guidelines. Conduct qualitative and quantitative (histo)pathologic evaluations for discovery and development toxicology studies, including GLP-compliant studies. Peer-review histopathologic data and interpretations from internal or CRO pathologists per established SOPs. Integrate clinical pathology data (haematology, clinical chemistry) with histopathology findings for a holistic, mechanistic interpretation of toxicity. Deliver clear, concise test result interpretations and author pathology sections for Research Reports, regulatory filings (e.g., IND/CTA), and governance presentations.

• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment : Propose, build, test, and implement custom image analysis solutions and algorithms to automate cell and biomarker quantification on scanned tissue. Oversee the integration of ML and non-ML software to detect, segment, and score complex tissue morphologies. Extract high-dimensional spatial features and quantitative metrics from multiplexed or standard IHC and ISH slides. Transform comp

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova in Patologia e Scienze della Sicurezza Applicata, un dipartimento all'interno della funzione Scienze Farmaceutiche. Noi guidiamo la valutazione di sicurezza non ciclica dei candidati alla droga da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi durante le fasi di scoperta e sviluppo a Roche. L'opportunità Come un Patologo Digitale impegnato, si svolgerà un ruolo cardine nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di indagini patologiche e nell'applicazione di approcci di patologia computazionale per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di proporre, condurre e riferire approcci di patologia tossicologica computazionale per comprendere meccanismi di tossicità, sfruttando strumenti moderni per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione e avanzare la nostra pipeline terapeutica. Sosterrete l'automazione di algoritmi di patologia, flussi di lavoro e piattaforme, rimanendo responsabili per la consegna scientifica dei dati di patologia per informare la valutazione del rischio attraverso progetti che vanno da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi.
• Patologia Tossicologica Core Portfolio: Fornire un supporto di patologia esperto nello sviluppo preclinico, allineare i progetti di studio tossicologico con le attuali linee guida scientifiche e regolamentari. Condurre valutazioni qualitative e quantitative (sito)patologiche per la scoperta e lo sviluppo di studi tossicologici, compresi gli studi conformi al GLP. Peer-review dati e interpretazioni istopatologiche dai patologi interni o CRO per i SOP consolidati. Integra i dati di patologia clinica (ematologia, chimica clinica) con i risultati di istopatologia per un'interpretazione olistica e meccanistica della tossicità. Fornire chiare e concise interpretazioni dei risultati dei test e sezioni di patologia dell'autore per i Rapporti di ricerca, i documenti normativi (ad esempio, IND/CTA) e le presentazioni di governance.
• Deployment: Proporre, costruire, testare e implementare soluzioni e algoritmi di analisi delle immagini personalizzate per automatizzare la quantificazione delle celle e dei biomarcatori sui tessuti scansionati. Controllare l'integrazione di software ML e non-ML per rilevare, segmentare e segnare morfologie di tessuto complesse. Estrarre caratteristiche spaziali altamente dimensionali e metriche quantitative da multisala o standard IHC e ISH diapositive. Trasformazione comp

Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Diese Position befindet sich in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, einer Abteilung innerhalb der Pharmaceutical Sciences Funktion. Wir fördern die nichtklinische Sicherheitsbewertung von Wirkstoffkandidaten von kleinen Molekülen bis hin zu komplexen biologischen Produkten während der Entdeckungs- und Entwicklungsphase bei Roche. Die Chance Als engagierter Digital Pathologist spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Entwicklung, Validierung und Umsetzung von Pathologieuntersuchungen und der Anwendung von computergestützten Pathologieansätzen für die translationale Sicherheitsbewertung. Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, rechnerische toxikologische Pathologieansätze vorzuschlagen, durchzuführen und zu berichten, um die Mechanismen der Toxizität zu verstehen, indem Sie moderne Werkzeuge nutzen, um wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse zu maximieren, Innovationen voranzutreiben und unsere therapeutische Pipeline voranzutreiben. Sie unterstützen die Automatisierung von Pathologiealgorithmen, Workflows und Plattformen und bleiben für die wissenschaftliche Bereitstellung von Pathologiedaten verantwortlich, um die Risikobewertung in Projekten von kleinen Molekülen bis hin zu komplexen biologischen Produkten zu unterstützen.
• Kernportfolio Toxikologische Pathologie: Bereitstellung von Experten-Pathologie-Unterstützung bei der präklinischen Entwicklung, Ausrichtung der Toxizitätsstudien mit aktuellen wissenschaftlichen und regulatorischen Richtlinien. Durchführung qualitativer und quantitativer (histo)pathologischer Bewertungen für toxikologische Studien zur Entdeckung und Entwicklung, einschließlich GLP-konformer Studien. Peer-Review histopathologische Daten und Interpretationen von internen oder CRO-Pathologen nach etablierten SOPs. Integrieren Sie klinische Pathologiedaten (Hämatologie, klinische Chemie) mit histopathologischen Befunden für eine ganzheitliche, mechanistische Interpretation der Toxizität. Liefern Sie klare, prägnante Interpretationen der Testergebnisse und Abschnitte zur Pathologie des Autors für Forschungsberichte, behördliche Einreichungen (z. B. IND / CTA) und Governance-Präsentationen.
• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment: Vorschlagen, erstellen, testen und implementieren Sie benutzerdefinierte Bildanalyselösungen und Algorithmen, um die Quantifizierung von Zellen und Biomarkern auf gescanntem Gewebe zu automatisieren. Beaufsichtigen Sie die Integration von ML- und Nicht-ML-Software, um komplexe Gewebemorphologien zu erkennen, zu segmentieren und zu bewerten. Extrahieren Sie hochdimensionale räumliche Merkmale und quantitative Metriken aus gemultiplexten oder standardisierten IHC- und ISH-Objektträgern. Verwandeln comp

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Ce poste est situé à Pathology and Applied Safety Science, un département de la fonction Sciences pharmaceutiques. Nous conduisons l'évaluation non clinique de l'innocuité des médicaments candidats à partir de petites molécules à des produits biologiques complexes pendant les phases de découverte et de développement à Roche. L'opportunité En tant que pathologiste numérique engagé, vous jouerez un rôle central dans le développement, la validation et la mise en oeuvre des enquêtes de pathologie et l'application des approches de pathologie computationnelle pour l'évaluation de la sécurité translationnelle. Votre responsabilité principale sera de proposer, de conduire et de rapporter des approches toxicologiques computationnelles pour comprendre les mécanismes de toxicité, en tirant parti des outils modernes pour maximiser les connaissances scientifiques, stimuler l'innovation et faire progresser notre pipeline thérapeutique. Vous soutiendrez l'automatisation des algorithmes de pathologie, des workflows et des plates-formes, en restant responsable de la livraison scientifique des données de pathologie pour éclairer l'évaluation des risques à travers des projets allant de petites molécules à des produits biologiques complexes.
• Portfolio de base Pathologie toxicologique : Fournir un soutien en pathologie experte dans le développement préclinique, en alignant les modèles d'études de toxicité avec les lignes directrices scientifiques et réglementaires actuelles. Effectuer des évaluations (histo)pathologiques qualitatives et quantitatives pour des études toxicologiques de découverte et de développement, y compris des études conformes aux BPL. Examen par les pairs des données histopathologiques et des interprétations des pathologistes internes ou du CRO selon les SOP établies. Intégrer les données de pathologie clinique (hématologie, chimie clinique) avec les résultats de l'histopathologie pour une interprétation globale et mécaniste de la toxicité. Fournir des interprétations des résultats d'essais claires et concises et des sections sur la pathologie des auteurs pour les rapports de recherche, les dépôts réglementaires (p. ex., l'IND/LTC) et les présentations sur la gouvernance.
• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Déploiement : Proposez, construisez, testez et implémentez des solutions d'analyse d'images personnalisées et des algorithmes pour automatiser la quantification des cellules et des biomarqueurs sur les tissus numérisés. Superviser l'intégration des logiciels ML et non-ML pour détecter, segmenter et marquer des morphologies tissulaires complexes. Extraire des caractéristiques spatiales haute dimension et des mesures quantitatives des diapositives IHC et ISH standard ou multiplexées. Transformer comp

jobs.title: IT Strategic Risk & Audit Manager

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Strategico dei Rischi IT e Audit
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Stratégique des Risques IT et Audit

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves a personalized healthcare solution. As the IT Strategic Risk & Audit Manager , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our digital evolution—from AI-driven drug discovery to personalized healthcare apps—is built on a foundation of trust and resilience. You will act as a strategic partner to Digital Technology leaders, ensuring that risks are managed proactively rather than reactively.
This role moves beyond tactical "checkbox" auditing to focus on strategic foresight —anticipating shifts in the threat landscape, regulatory environment, and emerging technologies (like AI and Cloud architecture)

Job Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership): Defines the strategic vision for IT risk, audit, and compliance, and drives strategic initiatives for long-term risk management success. Initiates and leads large, complex projects with a significant impact on the organization. Leads the development of enterprise-wide risk and compliance policies and advises on emerging trends and best practices.

• Strategic Risk Architecture & Vision: Define and architect the global IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), aligning long-term digital strategy with Roche’s risk appetite to ensure "Compliance by Design" across complex, interconnected global portfolios.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of highly complex business and risk challenges with significant organizational impact, proactively identifying potential strategic issues within your sphere of influence. Develops comprehensive risk management and compliance policies, implements proactive measures to avoid repeated issues, and leads initiatives to anticipate and mitigate future risks. Contributes to framing strategic questions and facilitates strategic decision-making at the executive level.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders at the executive level and external partners, analyzing enterprise-wide stakeholder landscapes. Leads enterprise-wide risk, audit, and compliance initiatives, presenting them to executive leadership to secure support and strategic alignment for risk-related investments. Navigates highly complex and politically sensitive landscapes, acting as an organizational trust builder and providing expert counsel on critical strategic decisions.

• E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership: Lead the full lifecycle of complex IT audits and continuous monitoring programs across infrastructure and applications, ensuring the organization meets global regulatory requirements while proactively identifying systemic issues to prevent recurrence.

• Inspection Command & Control: Serve as the primary IT liaison during complex Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, etc.), leading "Front-Room/Back-Room" operations, coaching SMEs in regulatory interview techniques, and ensuring the rapid delivery of high-quality, validated evidence.

• Data Integrity & ALCOA+ Systematically audit and enforce the "Digital Thread" to ensure all health-regulated data remains Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, and Accurate, maintaining the integrity of life-saving digital health solutions.

• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigate sensitive landscapes to lead enterprise-wide risk initiatives, partnering with IT owners to develop robust remediation CAPAs and innovating risk management approaches to drive lasting, transformative impact across the global org

Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

Tu agirai come partner strategico per i leader della tecnologia digitale, assicurando che i rischi siano gestiti in modo proattivo piuttosto che reattivo.

Questo ruolo va oltre il controllo tattico "checkbox" per concentrarsi sulla prospettiva strategica.Anticipando cambiamenti nel paesaggio di minaccia, ambiente normativo e tecnologie emergenti (come l'architettura AI e Cloud)

Responsabilità del lavoro

Ambito / (Content Leadership) - Definisce la visione strategica per il rischio IT, audit, e conformità, e guida iniziative strategiche per il successo di gestione del rischio a lungo termine. - Inizia e conduce grandi progetti complessi con un impatto significativo sull'organizzazione. - Guida lo sviluppo di politiche di rischio e conformità a livello aziendale e consiglia le tendenze emergenti e le best practice.

Strategic Risk Architecture & Vision - Define and architect the global IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), allineando la strategia digitale a lungo termine con l'appetito al rischio di Roche per garantire l'"Compliance by Design" in portafogli globali complessi e interconnessi.

Responsabilità/Problema di soluzione - Guida l'analisi di sfide aziendali e di rischio estremamente complesse con un impatto organizzativo significativo, identificando proattivamente potenziali questioni strategiche all'interno della vostra sfera di influenza. - Sviluppa politiche complete di gestione del rischio e conformità, implementa misure proattive per evitare problemi ripetuti e porta le iniziative ad anticipare e mitigare i rischi futuri. - Contribuisce a formulare domande strategiche e facilita il processo decisionale strategico a livello esecutivo.

Gestione delle parti interessate - Identifica e coinvolge i principali stakeholder a livello esecutivo e partner esterni, analizzando i paesaggi delle parti interessate a livello aziendale. - Leader di iniziative di rischio, audit e compliance aziendali, presentandoli alla leadership esecutiva per garantire il supporto e l'allineamento strategico per gli investimenti legati al rischio. - Navigates paesaggi estremamente complessi e politicamente sensibili, fungendo da costruttore di trust organizzativo e fornendo consulenza su decisioni strategiche critiche.

E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership - Guidare l'intero ciclo di vita di audit informatici complessi e programmi di monitoraggio continuo attraverso infrastrutture e applicazioni, assicurando che l'organizzazione soddisfi i requisiti normativi globali, identificando proattivamente le questioni sistemiche per prevenire le ricorrenza.

Comando e controllo delle ispezioni - Serve come collegamento informatico primario durante complesse ispezioni dell'Autorità Sanitaria (FDA, EMA, ecc.), operazioni "Front-Room/Back-Room" di testa, coaching delle PMI nelle tecniche di intervista regolamentare e garanzia di una rapida consegna di prove convalidate di alta qualità.

Integrità dei dati & ALCOA+ - Verificare e far rispettare il "File Digitale" per garantire che tutti i dati regolati dalla salute rimangano Attribuibili, Legibili, Conterneous, Originali e Accurati, mantenendo l'integrità delle soluzioni di salute digitale salvavita.

Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management - Navigare paesaggi sensibili per guidare iniziative di rischio a livello aziendale, collaborando con i proprietari IT per sviluppare solide CAPA di bonifica e innovando approcci di gestione del rischio per guidare l'impatto duraturo e trasformativo attraverso l'orgasmo globale
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves a personalized healthcare solution. As the IT Strategic Risk & Audit Manager , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our digital evolution—from AI-driven drug discovery to personalized healthcare apps—is built on a foundation of trust and resilience. You will act as a strategic partner to Digital Technology leaders, ensuring that risks are managed proactively rather than reactively.
This role moves beyond tactical "checkbox" auditing to focus on strategic foresight —anticipating shifts in the threat landscape, regulatory environment, and emerging technologies (like AI and Cloud architecture)

Job Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership): Defines the strategic vision for IT risk, audit, and compliance, and drives strategic initiatives for long-term risk management success. Initiates and leads large, complex projects with a significant impact on the organization. Leads the development of enterprise-wide risk and compliance policies and advises on emerging trends and best practices.

• Strategic Risk Architecture & Vision: Define and architect the global IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), aligning long-term digital strategy with Roche’s risk appetite to ensure "Compliance by Design" across complex, interconnected global portfolios.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of highly complex business and risk challenges with significant organizational impact, proactively identifying potential strategic issues within your sphere of influence. Develops comprehensive risk management and compliance policies, implements proactive measures to avoid repeated issues, and leads initiatives to anticipate and mitigate future risks. Contributes to framing strategic questions and facilitates strategic decision-making at the executive level.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders at the executive level and external partners, analyzing enterprise-wide stakeholder landscapes. Leads enterprise-wide risk, audit, and compliance initiatives, presenting them to executive leadership to secure support and strategic alignment for risk-related investments. Navigates highly complex and politically sensitive landscapes, acting as an organizational trust builder and providing expert counsel on critical strategic decisions.

• E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership: Lead the full lifecycle of complex IT audits and continuous monitoring programs across infrastructure and applications, ensuring the organization meets global regulatory requirements while proactively identifying systemic issues to prevent recurrence.

• Inspection Command & Control: Serve as the primary IT liaison during complex Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, etc.), leading "Front-Room/Back-Room" operations, coaching SMEs in regulatory interview techniques, and ensuring the rapid delivery of high-quality, validated evidence.

• Data Integrity & ALCOA+ Systematically audit and enforce the "Digital Thread" to ensure all health-regulated data remains Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, and Accurate, maintaining the integrity of life-saving digital health solutions.

• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigate sensitive landscapes to lead enterprise-wide risk initiatives, partnering with IT owners to develop robust remediation CAPAs and innovating risk management approaches to drive lasting, transformative impact across the global org
descriptionByLocale.de:
Über Roche Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Die Position Bei Roche glauben wir, dass jeder Patient eine personalisierte Gesundheitslösung verdient. Als IT-Strategischer Risk & Audit Manager spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle dabei, sicherzustellen, dass unsere digitale Evolution – von der KI-getriebenen Medikamentenentdeckung bis hin zu personalisierten Healthcare-Apps – auf einem Fundament von Vertrauen und Widerstandsfähigkeit beruht. Sie werden als strategischer Partner der führenden Unternehmen der Digital Technology agieren und sicherstellen, dass Risiken proaktiv und nicht reaktiv verwaltet werden.

Diese Rolle geht über die taktische "Checkbox"-Prüfung hinaus, um sich auf strategische Voraussicht zu konzentrieren – vorausschauende Veränderungen in der Bedrohungslandschaft, dem regulatorischen Umfeld und neuen Technologien (wie KI- und Cloud-Architektur)

Aufgaben

Scope / (Content Leadership) - Definiert die strategische Vision für IT-Risiko, Audit und Compliance und treibt strategische Initiativen für langfristigen Risikomanagement-Erfolg voran. - Initiiert und leitet große, komplexe Projekte mit erheblichen Auswirkungen auf die Organisation. - Leitet die Entwicklung unternehmensweiter Risiko- und Compliance-Politiken und berät zu neuen Trends und Best Practices.

Strategische Risikoarchitektur & Vision - Definieren und gestalten Sie das globale IT Enterprise Risikomanagement (ERM) Framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), das die langfristige digitale Strategie mit dem Risikohunger von Roche abstimmt, um "Compliance by Design" in komplexen, vernetzten globalen Portfolios sicherzustellen.

Das Projekt hat die Aufgabe, die wichtigsten Stakeholder auf der Führungsebene und externe Partner zu identifizieren und zu engagieren, um unternehmensweite Stakeholderlandschaften zu analysieren. - Leitet unternehmensweite Risiko-, Audit- und Compliance-Initiativen, um sie der Führungsspitze zu präsentieren, um die Unterstützung und strategische Ausrichtung für risikobezogene Investitionen zu sichern. - Navigiert hochkomplexe und politisch sensible Landschaften, fungiert als Organisations-Trustbuilder und bietet kompetente Beratung bei kritischen strategischen Entscheidungen.

E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership - Führen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus komplexer IT-Audits und kontinuierlicher Monitoring-Programme in Infrastruktur und Anwendungen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Organisation globalen regulatorischen
• Anforderungen entspricht und proaktiv systemische Probleme identifiziert, um Wiederholungen zu verhindern.

Data Interation & ALCOA+ - Systematisch prüfen und durchsetzen Sie die "Digital Thread" um sicherzustellen, dass alle gesundheitsregulierten Daten satellitenfähig, lesbar, gleichzeitig, original und präzise bleiben, wobei die Integrität der lebensrettenden digitalen Gesundheitslösungen erhalten bleibt.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
A propos de Roche Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés par les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement.

La position Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque patient mérite une solution de santé personnalisée. En tant que gestionnaire de risques et d'audits stratégiques en TI, vous jouerez un rôle central pour faire en sorte que notre évolution numérique – de la découverte de médicaments à l'IA aux applications de soins personnalisés – repose sur la confiance et la résilience.

Ce rôle va au-delà de l'audit tactique « case à cocher » pour se concentrer sur la prospective stratégique – les changements anticipés dans le paysage de la menace, l'environnement réglementaire et les technologies émergentes (comme l'IA et l'architecture Cloud)

Responsabilités professionnelles

Portée / ( Leadership en matière de contenu) - Définir la vision stratégique en matière de risque, de vérification et de conformité en matière de TI et diriger les initiatives stratégiques pour assurer la réussite à long terme de la gestion des risques. - Initie et dirige des projets complexes de grande envergure ayant une incidence importante sur l'organisation. - Dirige l'élaboration de politiques de gestion des risques et de conformité à l'échelle de l'organisation et donne des conseils sur les nouvelles tendances et les pratiques exemplaires.

Architecture et vision des risques stratégiques - Définir et concevoir le cadre mondial de gestion des risques d'entreprise des TI (RTM) (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), en harmonisant la stratégie numérique à long terme avec l'appétit de Roche pour le risque afin d'assurer la « conformité par la conception » à l'échelle de portefeuilles mondiaux complexes et interconnectés.

Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes - Dirige l'analyse des défis opérationnels et des risques très complexes ayant une incidence organisationnelle importante, en identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes stratégiques potentiels dans votre sphère d'influence. - Élaborer des politiques globales de gestion et de conformité des risques, mettre en oeuvre des mesures proactives pour éviter les problèmes répétés et mener des initiatives pour prévoir et atténuer les risques futurs. - Contribue à l'établissement de questions stratégiques et facilite la prise de décisions stratégiques au niveau des cadres de direction.

Gestion des intervenants - Identifier et mobiliser les intervenants clés au niveau de la direction et des partenaires externes, en analysant les paysages des intervenants à l'échelle de l'entreprise. - Diriger les initiatives de gestion des risques, de vérification et de conformité à l'échelle de l'entreprise, en les présentant aux dirigeants pour obtenir un soutien et un alignement stratégique pour les investissements liés aux risques. - Navigue les paysages très complexes et politiquement sensibles, en agissant comme bâtisseur de confiance organisationnelle et en fournissant des conseils d'experts sur les décisions stratégiques critiques.

Leadership en matière de vérification et de conformité E2E - Diriger le cycle de vie complet des vérifications complexes des TI et des programmes de surveillance continue dans l'ensemble de l'infrastructure et des applications, en veillant à ce que l'organisation respecte les exigences réglementaires mondiales tout en identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes systémiques afin d'éviter que les problèmes ne se reproduisent.

Contrôle et commandement des inspections - servir de liaison principale en TI lors des inspections complexes des autorités sanitaires (ADF, EMA, etc.), diriger les opérations « Chambre avant/salle arrière », entraîner les PME dans les techniques d'entrevue réglementaire et assurer la livraison rapide de preuves validées de haute qualité.

Intégrité des données et ALCOA+ - Audit systématique et application du « fil numérique » pour s'assurer que toutes les données réglementées par la santé demeurent Attributables, lisibles, contemporaines, originales et précises, en maintenant l'intégrité des solutions de santé numériques qui sauvent la vie.

Gestion mondiale des intervenants et de la transformation - Naviguer dans des paysages sensibles pour diriger des initiatives de gestion des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise, en partenariat avec les propriétaires de TI pour élaborer des APC robustes en matière d'assainissement et en innovant des approches de gestion des risques pour favoriser des impacts durables et transformatifs dans l'ensemble de l'organisation mondiale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir in EFG
Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedene Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services. Wir stellen für alle Bereiche entlang der Pharma- und Diagnostics Wertschöpfungskette an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg die entsprechende Infrastruktur und Services zur Verfügung. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg - wo wir die Zukunft aktiv gestalten.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle verbindest Du strategische Vision mit der operativen Einführung. Du verantwortest die Architektur, die strukturierte Pilotierung und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Integrated Facility Management (IFM) Projekts. Als Experte in Zusammenarbeit mit interen und externen Stakeholdern gestaltest Du das Zusammenspiel verschiedener Stakeholder und machst IFM zu einem werttreibenden Steuerungs- und Service-Framework für unsere Standorte.

• Projektsteuerung & Roll-out: Du verantwortest die Architektur sowie Implementierung des IFM-Projekts. Du steuerst die standortübergreifende Umsetzung (Pilot-, Scaling- und Stabilisierungsphasen) bis zur sicheren Erreichung aller strategischen Meilensteine.

• Strategische Architektur: Du entwickelst innovative Service Delivery Modelle weiter und definierst Standards, Prozesse sowie Service Level Agreements (SLAs), die optimal auf die Anforderungen in Mannheim und Penzberg abgestimmt sind.

• Stakeholder-Management & Change: Du brichst Silos auf und vernetzt Fachbereiche (u.a. Site Management, Business Units, Einkauf, Legal) sowie globale Netzwerke. Mit einer gezielten Engagement-Strategie und Change-Management-Aktivitäten schaffst Du Akzeptanz für das neue integrierte Modell.

• Vertrags-Governance & Provider-Steuerung: Du konzipierst output-orientierte Performance-Modelle (z. B. Performance-based Vesting). Du steuerst die Ausgestaltung der Beziehungen zu externen Providern und stellst die rechtliche sowie operative Exzellenz sicher.

• Prozessoptimierung & Finanzen: Du etablierst nutzerzentrierte Standards und erarbeitest Business Cases sowie KPI-Sets (z.B. Kosten pro m², Performance-Dashboards), um den Wertbeitrag des Projekts messbar zu machen.

• Wissens-Enablement: Du förderst den Best-Practice-Austausch und agierst als Mentor für projektbezogene Fachthemen, neue IFM-Trends und innovative Lösungen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master oder Bachelor) in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Facility Management, BWL oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

• Du verfügst über fundierte einschlägige Erfahrung (ca. 7-10 Jahre) im Projektmanagement im IFM-Umfeld. Du hast idealerweise bereits die Einführung von integrierten Management-Modellen erfolgreich begleitet.

• Tiefgehendes Wissen über Integrated Facility Management Modelle, Provider-Steuerung und ein klares Verständnis für output-orientierte Verträge und KPI-Reporting.

• Du besitzt Zusatzqualifikationen wie GEFMA, PMP oder PRINCE2 sowie Erfahrung im Change Management. Ein ausgeprägtes Growth Mindset zeichnet Dich aus.

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch. Als durchsetzungsstarker Teamplayer vermittelst Du komplexe Zusammenhänge souverän auf allen Managementebenen.

• Dienstreisen zwischen unseren Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg (Anteil ca. 20

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo nell'EGF In Management Mannheim/Penzberg, siamo un buon 1.300 specialisti per varie infrastrutture e servizi professionali. Forniamo l'infrastruttura appropriata e servizi per tutte le aree lungo la catena del valore farmaceutico e diagnostico presso i siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. In un ambiente dinamico, promuoviamo una collaborazione senza soluzione di continuità tra business unit e funzioni, offriamo soluzioni innovative e migliorare l'ambiente di lavoro dei dipendenti nei siti di Mannheim e Penzberg, dove formiamo attivamente il futuro. Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta In questo ruolo, si combina la visione strategica con l'implementazione operativa. Sarete responsabili dell'architettura, del pilotaggio strutturato e del continuo sviluppo del progetto Integrated Facility Management (IFM). Il design come esperto in cooperazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni Interagisci con diversi stakeholder e rendi IFM un framework di gestione e servizio orientato al valore per le nostre sedi.
• Project management & roll-out: Lei è responsabile dell'architettura e dell'implementazione del progetto IFM. Si controlla l'implementazione cross-site (fasi pilota, scala e stabilizzazione) fino al raggiungimento sicuro di tutte le pietre miliari strategiche.
• Architetture strategiche: si sviluppano modelli di fornitura di servizi innovativi e definiscono standard, processi e accordi di livello di servizio (SLA) che sono perfettamente adattati alle esigenze di Mannheim e Penzberg.
• Gestione e cambiamento degli Stakeholder: Si rompe silos e aree specializzate in rete (ad esempio Gestione del sito, Unità aziendali, Acquisti, Legali) e reti globali. Con una strategia di coinvolgimento mirata e attività di gestione dei cambiamenti, si crea l'accettazione per il nuovo modello integrato.
• Contratto Governance & Provider Control: progetta modelli di prestazioni orientati all'output (ad esempio, gilet basato sulle prestazioni). Si controlla la progettazione di relazioni con i fornitori esterni e garantire l'eccellenza legale e operativa.
• Ottimizzazione dei processi e finanza: si stabiliscono standard focalizzati sull'utente e si sviluppano casi di business e set KPI (ad esempio i costi per m2, dashboard di performance) per rendere il contributo valore del progetto misurabile.
• Attivazione della conoscenza: Promuovi lo scambio di buone pratiche e agisci come mentore per temi legati al progetto, nuove tendenze IFM e soluzioni innovative. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti
• Hai completato con successo gli studi universitari (Master o Bachelor) in Business Engineering, Facility Management, Business Administration o un campo di studio comparabile.
• Hai un'esperienza approfondita (circa 7-10 anni) nella gestione dei progetti nell'ambiente IFM. Idealmente, hai già accompagnato con successo l'introduzione di modelli di gestione integrati.
• Conoscenza approfondita dei modelli di gestione integrata delle strutture, del controllo dei fornitori e della chiara comprensione dei contratti orientati all'output e della segnalazione KPI.
• Hai ulteriori qualifiche come GEFMA, PMP o PRINCE2 e l'esperienza nella gestione dei cambiamenti. Una forte mentalità di crescita ti distingue.
• Parli tedesco e inglese negoziabile. Come giocatore di squadra assertivo attraverso Hai relazioni complesse a tutti i livelli di gestione.
• Viaggi d'affari tra i nostri uffici a Mannheim e Penzberg (parte ca.) 20

jobs.title: Solution Architect - DIA R&D

titleByLocale.it: Architetto di soluzioni - Ricerca e sviluppo DIA

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

Technical Skills

• General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions and interfaces.

• Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions.

• Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for the solution, including conducting vendor assessments.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information and successfully build consensus.

• Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improve existing solutions, and manage technical deb

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La soluzione di posizionamento Architetto - DIA R&D La soluzione Architetto si concentra sulla progettazione di soluzioni basate su business, standard e future-ready in un contesto specifico di soluzione. In questo ruolo, si progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti dei prodotti, priorità aziendali e standard aziendali, mentre la gestione di requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e funzioni di fitness. Si svilupperà e mantenere la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto, fornire la supervisione tecnica ai team di prodotti, e valutare le nuove tecnologie per migliorare continuamente le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico.

Opportunità - Scope / (Content Leadership): Progetta soluzioni che soddisfino i requisiti dei prodotti, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno di uno specifico contesto di soluzione. Gestisce requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e funzioni di fitness. Documenti e evolve l'architettura durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance. - Responsabilità / soluzione dei problemi: risolve i problemi complessi prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti e esercitando giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione.

Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il panorama attuale della soluzione. Valuta e consulta gli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, il rischio e il paesaggio applicativo. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, Taxenomics e Ontologies per la soluzione e le sue interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli e garantisce che siano registrati adeguatamente Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). - Gestione delle parti interessate: illustra informazioni difficili o sensibili chiaramente e attivamente lavora per costruire il consenso tra le parti interessate.

Guida la condivisione delle informazioni e lo scambio sulla soluzione. - Impact/Strategy: Sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce supervisione tecnica, orientamento e consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico e ricerca, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identifica le opportunità di migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali. - Complessità / (Dimensioni del prodotto): funziona principalmente all'interno di un contesto definito di soluzione.

- Business / Technical abilità: Applica conoscenze generali e approfondite in uno o due settori tecnologici. Contribuisce in modo minimale ma efficace allo sviluppo delle pratiche di architettura e di mentoring. Chi sei Istruzione / esperienza - esperienza dimostrativa che progetta soluzioni basate su business, basate su standard, future-ready in un contesto specifico di soluzione. - esperienza mantenendo la visione, roadmap, e paesaggio attuale per soluzioni tecniche, e valutando l'impatto delle iniziative sui paesaggi di rischio e di applicazione.

Capacità tecniche - Conoscenze generali e approfondite in uno o due settori tecnologici. - Professionalità nella creazione di modelli di dati concettuali e logici, di Taxonomie e di Ontologies per soluzioni e interfacce. - Capacità di definire e guidare architetture di riferimento, modelli, NFR e funzioni di fitness. - Capacità di guidare tendenze tecnologiche esterne e valutare la fattibilità della soluzione, comprese valutazioni dei fornitori.

Qualificazioni aggiuntive - Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di spiegare informazioni difficili o sensibili e costruire con successo il consenso. - Mindset proattivo per individuare opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali, migliorare le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Der Positionslösungsarchitekt - DIA R&D Der Solution Architect konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung von geschäftsorientierten, standardbasierten und zukunftsfähigen Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext. In dieser Funktion entwerfen Sie Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards entsprechen, während Sie nicht-funktionale Anforderungen (NFRs) und Fitnessfunktionen verwalten. Sie entwickeln und pflegen die Technologie-Roadmap des Produkts, stellen Produktteams technische Aufsicht bereit und bewerten neue Technologien, um bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern und technische Schulden zu verwalten.

The Opportunity - Scope / (Content Leadership): Lösungen für die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext. Verwalten von nicht-funktionalen Anforderungen (NFR) und Fitnessfunktionen. Dokumente und entwickeln die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und stimmen mit der Architektur-Community für Governance überein. - Accountability/Problemlösung: Lösen komplexe Probleme, indem Sie eine neue Perspektive auf bestehende Lösungen nehmen und Urteile auf der Grundlage der Analyse mehrerer Informationsquellen ausüben.

Bewahrt die Vision, die Roadmap und die aktuelle Landschaft für die Lösung. Assesses und berät über die Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft. Erstellt Konzept- & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies und Ontologies für die Lösung und ihre Schnittstellen. Definiert und treibt Referenzarchitekturen, Muster und sorgt dafür, dass Architekturentscheidungs-Datensätze (ADRs) angemessen aufgezeichnet werden. - Archivverwaltung: Erklärt schwierige oder sensible Informationen klar und aktiv, um Konsens zwischen den Stakeholdern zu schaffen.

Fördert den Informationsaustausch und den Austausch über die Lösung. - Impact/Strategy: Entwickelt und pflegt die Technologie-Roadmap des Produkts. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Beratung und Beratung zu spezifischen Technologien für Produktteams. Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden, erforscht, bewertet, Piloten und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien. Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Wert und Geschäftsprozessen. - Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Operiert in erster Linie innerhalb eines definierten Lösungskontexts.

- Business / Technical ability: Applys allgemeines und vertieftes Wissen in einem oder zwei Technologiebereichen. Trägt minimal, aber effektiv zur Entwicklung und Mentoring von Architekturpraktiken bei. Wer Sie sind Bildung / Erfahrung - Demonstrierte Erfahrung, die Business-getriebene, standardbasierte, zukunftsfähige Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext entwirft. - Erfahrung mit der Aufrechterhaltung der Vision, Roadmap und der aktuellen Landschaft für technische Lösungen und die Bewertung der Auswirkungen von Initiativen auf Risiko- und Anwendungslandschaften.

Technische Fähigkeiten - Allgemeines und fundiertes Wissen in einem oder zwei Technologiebereichen. - Kompetenz bei der Erstellung von Konzept- und Logikdatenmodellen, Taxonomien und Ontologien für Lösungen und Schnittstellen. - Fähigkeit, Referenzarchitekturen, Muster, NFRs und Fitnessfunktionen zu definieren und zu steuern. - Starke Fähigkeit, externe Technologietrends zu steuern und die Machbarkeit der Lösung zu bewerten, einschließlich der Durchführung von Lieferantenbewertungen.

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen - Starke Kommunikation und Stakeholder Management Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, schwierige oder sensible Informationen zu erklären und erfolgreich Konsens zu schaffen. - Proaktive Denkweise, um Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, Wert und Geschäftsprozesse zu verbessern, bestehende Lösungen zu verbessern und technische Schulden zu verwalten.

The Position

Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader for the Master Data Data Product, you will be a vital member of the MRHub Team within the Data Management & Data Quality Platforms department. Your primary mission is to deliver high-quality IT operation services that empower our business partners to reliably provide life-saving products to patients.
In this role, you will lead the setup and lifecycle management of Master Data Data Products, ensuring they deliver consistent value regardless of the source system (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub).

Job Responsibilities

• Leads the Master Data Product setup and lifecycle, independent of specific source systems

• Manages and directs a small external team (4 people) delivering the Master Data Data Products and Snowflake capabilities.

• Manages the end‑to‑end request process for new/changed Master Data Data Products: intake, governance board engagement, approvals, coordinating with source system owners.

• Designs and implements the Data Product technically in Snowflake (pipelines, datasets, exposure for consumption).

• Coordinates closely with the Data Quality team and Ataccama so data quality rules run on Snowflake datasets from the Master Data Data Products.

• Serves as the main operational contact for ongoing demand, changes, and incident/support needs around the Master Data Data Products

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data and analytics needs and develop a product roadmap that aligns with business goals.

• Define and prioritise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data and analytics products and ensure what was agreed gets delivered.

• Collaborate with Infrastructure Teams and software developers to ensure that data and analytics products are integrated into existing systems and platforms in a sustainable way that still meets the needs of business to generate the insights necessary to drive their decisions.

Education / Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field.

• Extensive experience leading complex data science projects from end-to-end and driving significant business impact.

• Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions.

• Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks and best practices.

Technical Skills

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Medical Affairs Partner, you will act as a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded collaborator within our customer engagement ecosystem. Based in the affiliate team, you will drive the local medical strategy, build deep peer-to-peer connections with scientific communities, and ensure our diagnostic and therapeutic innovations reach their full potential to transform patient lives.

In this role, you will:

• Drive Scientific & Medical Strategy: Lead the medical component of the integrated therapeutic strategy, translating complex clinical data into a clear, differentiated value story across key disease areas.

• Cultivate Trusted Partnerships: Proactively engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), external scientific experts, and healthcare stakeholders to foster meaningful, science-driven collaborations.

• Advance Evidence Generation: Develop and implement local integrated evidence plans, identifying data gaps and supporting Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies, non-interventional studies, and investigator-initiated research.

• Accelerate Patient Market Access: Contribute scientific expertise to local Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions, articulating the real-world value of our innovations to secure faster patient access.

• Lead Digital & Ecosystem Innovation: Systematically gather external clinical insights, utilizing emerging digital tools and AI insights responsibly to anticipate and optimize local medical practice adoption.

• Ensure Absolute Excellence & Compliance: Oversee medical information requests and collaborate with Regulatory and Clinical Operations teams, maintaining strict adherence to industry regulations, ethical standards, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP).

Who You Are
You are an entrepreneurial, solution-oriented professional who thrives in cross-functional team environments. You balance deep scientific expertise with the strategic acumen required to navigate ambiguity and communicate complex insights with clarity and impact.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Excellence: You hold an advanced degree in Medical, Pharmaceutical, or Natural Sciences (e.g., MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).

• Professional Experience: You bring proven experience in Medical Affairs or equivalent clinical/scientific expertise within relevant therapeutic areas preferably in Retinal Diseases & Ophthalmology

• Strategic Communication: You possess exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to confidently lead peer-to-peer scientific dialogue at an executive level in English.

• Digital Literacy: You maintain a growth mindset toward digital tools, demonstrating basic AI literacy and the ability to ensure robust human-in-the-loop oversight of digital content.

• Compliance & Collaborative Mindset: You demonstrate strong personal accountability, a collaborative approach to cross-functional "squad" environments, and an unwavering commitment to ethical compliance.

La position En tant que partenaire des affaires médicales, vous agirez en tant que collaborateur fiable, ciblé et scientifiquement fondé au sein de notre écosystème d'engagement client. Basée dans l'équipe d'affiliation, vous dirigerez la stratégie médicale locale, établirez des liens profonds entre les pairs et les communautés scientifiques, et vous assurerez que nos innovations diagnostiques et thérapeutiques atteignent leur plein potentiel pour transformer la vie des patients. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Diriger la stratégie scientifique et médicale : Diriger la composante médicale de la stratégie thérapeutique intégrée, en transformant des données cliniques complexes en une histoire de valeur claire et différenciée dans les domaines clés de la maladie.
• Cultiver des partenariats de confiance : dialoguer de façon proactive avec des leaders clés de l'opinion, des experts scientifiques externes et des intervenants de la santé pour favoriser des collaborations significatives et axées sur la science.
• Production avancée de données probantes : Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des plans intégrés locaux de données probantes, cerner les lacunes dans les données et appuyer les études sur les données probantes dans le monde réel, les études non interventionnelles et la recherche initiée par les chercheurs.
• Accélérer l'accès au marché des patients : Contribuez à l'expertise scientifique des présentations locales d'évaluation des technologies de la santé (ETS), articulant la valeur réelle de nos innovations afin d'obtenir un accès plus rapide aux patients.
• Lead Digital & Ecosystem Innovation: Rassembler systématiquement des informations cliniques externes, en utilisant des outils numériques émergents et des informations sur l'IA de manière responsable pour anticiper et optimiser l'adoption de pratiques médicales locales.
• Assurer l'excellence absolue et la conformité : Surveiller les demandes d'information médicale et collaborer avec les équipes des opérations réglementaires et cliniques, en maintenant le strict respect des règlements de l'industrie, des normes éthiques et des bonnes pratiques cliniques (BCP). Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel entrepreneurial orienté vers la solution qui prospère dans des environnements d'équipe interfonctionnels. Vous équilibrez une expertise scientifique profonde avec l'acuité stratégique requise pour naviguer dans l'ambiguïté et communiquer des idées complexes avec clarté et impact. Vos qualifications :
• Excellence en éducation : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme avancé en sciences médicales, pharmaceutiques ou naturelles (p. ex., MD, PharmD, PhD ou équivalent).
• Expérience professionnelle : vous apportez une expérience éprouvée en affaires médicales ou une expertise clinique/scientifique équivalente dans les domaines thérapeutiques pertinents de préférence en maladies rétiniennes et en ophtalmologie
• Communication stratégique : Vous possédez des compétences exceptionnelles en communication verbale et écrite, avec la capacité de diriger avec confiance le dialogue scientifique entre pairs au niveau des cadres en anglais.
• Littératie numérique : Vous gardez une attitude de croissance envers les outils numériques, démontrant la littératie de base en matière d'IA et la capacité d'assurer une surveillance robuste du contenu numérique.
• Compliance & Collaborative Mindset: Vous faites preuve d'une forte responsabilité personnelle, d'une approche collaborative des environnements interfonctionnels de l'équipe et d'un engagement indéfectible envers la conformité éthique. Ensemble, nous progresserons tout au long du parcours patient avec l'aspiration à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. jobs.title: Clinical Selling Specialist - Toledo
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Clinician Selling Specialist , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en impulsar la adopción de nuestros biomarcadores y soluciones innovadoras dentro de las comunidades clínicas. Construirás relaciones sólidas con líderes de opinión clave (KOLs), investigadores y proveedores de atención médica para avanzar en nuestra misión de mejorar los resultados de los pacientes a través de la medicina personalizada y una mejor gestión de enfermedades crónicas.

En este rol, serás la persona de referencia para aspectos clínicos y técnicos en el área de Castilla-La Mancha . Serás responsable de promover nuestras soluciones con un enfoque técnico-científico, adaptando las estrategias globales a la realidad local de la Atención Primaria y los centros especializados, asegurando que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a los pacientes adecuados en el momento adecuado.

Tus Responsabilidades Clave

• Ventas Estratégicas y Promoción Técnica: Promover productos y servicios con mensajes científicos diferenciadores. Negociarás con centros de salud y hospitales, proporcionando explicaciones técnicas de alto nivel centradas en el tratamiento y la gestión del paciente.

• Enfoque en Atención Primaria y Diabetes: Serás un socio clave para los proveedores de Atención Primaria, especialmente en el contexto de la Diabetes , promoviendo las ventas con un enfoque orientado al tratamiento e identificando nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro de las cuentas existentes.

• Participación de las Partes Interesadas: Identificar y cultivar una red de defensores (KOLs, Líderes Clínicos, Directores Médicos). Adaptarás los planes de ventas para satisfacer sus necesidades y comunicarás las implicaciones de las licitaciones públicas al Gerente de Zona.

• Formación Clínica: Educar al personal de enfermería y a los profesionales de la salud tanto en hospitales como en centros de Atención Primaria sobre el uso del producto, coordinando la participación de las enfermeras en los protocolos de atención al paciente.

• Experiencia Científica: Actuar como el experto local, presentando las soluciones de Roche en foros regionales y simposios. Te mantendrás actualizado sobre las regulaciones IVDR y los algoritmos de gestión de pacientes.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Recopilar y compartir información sobre tendencias del mercado y competencia. Implementarás campañas de marketing y colaborarás con los Gerentes de Producto en actividades promocionales locales (congresos, talleres, etc.).

• Inversión y ROI: Proponer e implementar inversiones en tu territorio basadas en un retorno (ROI) definido y asegurar que se cumplan todos los compromisos con el cliente.

• Movilidad: Este puesto requiere una alta presencia en campo, con viajes esperados dentro del área designada (Castilla-La Mancha) 70+% del tiempo.

Quién Eres
Buscamos un perfil científico con una fuerte enfoque comercial y experiencia en el ecosistema sanitario local.

• Educación: Se necesita Licenciatura. Se valorará altamente la Licenciatura en Ciencias.

• Experiencia: 3 a 5 años de experiencia en la industria de ciencias de la vida. Es esencial una experiencia probada en Atención Primaria.

• Experiencia en la Materia: Se valora profundamente el conocimiento o la experiencia en Diabetes.

• Construcción de Relaciones: Gran capacidad para construir y mantener relaciones con profesionales de la salud a todos los niveles.

• Idiomas: Se valora mucho la fluidez en español ; un dominio sólido del inglés es obligatorio para la colaboración global.

• Ubicación: D

Technical Product Owner - Legal - RDT Group Functions

We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner to partner with Business Product Owners and stakeholders in Legal to translate requirements into strategic digital solutions. You will work closely with the IT Product Manager to shape the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of Legal-related products within Roche. This includes supporting platforms that span global teams across both Pharma and Diagnostics.

The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling the automation and digitization of workflows - ranging from review and approval to oversight, monitoring, and governance frameworks - while ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

About Our Team: RDT Legal Product

Sitting within the broader Legal, Compliance & Group Communication division, our team partners with the Legal department to enable efficiency and effectiveness through legal-specific solutions. Working hand-in-hand, we blend IT expertise with business know-how to support Legal at every step of their digital journey.

The Legal Product portfolio covers solutions for legal spend and matter management, document management, and contract management, as well as workflows and reporting. We handle the entire lifecycle of these solutions - whether we build (make) or buy, manage, or operate them.

Business Requirements & Process Analysis

• Conduct detailed discovery and analysis of processes across legal global teams to identify current pain points, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.

• Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications and technical requirements for development teams.

• Develop comprehensive business cases and impact assessments for legal products, quantifying benefits (cost reduction, time savings, risk mitigation) aligned to organizational goals.

• Create and maintain detailed process maps, workflow diagrams, and requirements documentation to ensure shared understanding across stakeholders.

Strategic Alignment & Partnership

• Collaborate with the Business Product Owner to define product strategies and outcomes that address organizational business objectives.

• Actively contribute to the global legal technology strategy through technical insights and feasibility analysis, including the development and alignment of long-term goals (e.g., Data Domain & AI-driven solutions).

• Partner with external vendors and internal teams across Roche to assess existing platforms, propose innovative approaches, and ensure optimal solutions for Legal Products.

• Conduct gap analysis between current state processes and target state solutions to inform product roadmap decisions.

La posizione Titolare del prodotto tecnico - Legale - Funzioni del Gruppo RDT Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Analista e Proprietario del Prodotto Tecnico per collaborare con i Proprietari del Prodotto Business e gli stakeholder in Legal per tradurre i requisiti in soluzioni digitali strategiche. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con l'IT Product Manager per modellare la visione strategica, roadmap e la consegna dei prodotti legali all'interno di Roche. Questo include piattaforme di supporto che abbracciano team globali sia in farmacia che in diagnostica. Il Technical Business Analyst e Product Owner svolgeranno un ruolo chiave nell'analisi di processi aziendali complessi, nell'individuazione delle opportunità di ottimizzazione, e nell'accertamento dell'automazione e della digitalizzazione dei flussi di lavoro - che vanno dalla revisione e dall'approvazione ai quadri di supervisione, monitoraggio e governance - garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con la filosofia "One Roche". Il portafoglio Legal Product copre soluzioni per la gestione legale della spesa e della materia, la gestione dei documenti e la gestione dei contratti, nonché flussi di lavoro e reporting.
