• Condurre la scoperta dettagliata e l'analisi dei processi in team legali globali per identificare i punti di dolore attuali, le inefficienze e le opportunità di miglioramento.
• Tradurre complessi requisiti aziendali in chiare specifiche funzionali e requisiti tecnici per i team di sviluppo.
• Sviluppare casi aziendali completi e valutazioni d'impatto per i prodotti legali, quantificando i benefici (riduzione dei costi, risparmio di tempo, mitigazione dei rischi) allineati agli obiettivi organizzativi.
• Creare e mantenere mappe di processo dettagliate, diagrammi di flusso di lavoro e documentazione dei requisiti per garantire la comprensione condivisa tra gli stakeholder. Allineamento strategico e partenariato
• Collaborare con il proprietario del prodotto per definire le strategie e i risultati del prodotto che affrontano gli obiettivi aziendali organizzativi.
• Contribuire attivamente alla strategia globale della tecnologia legale attraverso approfondimenti tecnici e analisi di fattibilità, tra cui lo sviluppo e l'allineamento di obiettivi a lungo termine (ad esempio, soluzioni basate su Data Domain & AI).
• Partner con fornitori esterni e team interni di Roche per valutare le piattaforme esistenti, proporre approcci innovativi e garantire soluzioni ottimali per i prodotti legali.
• Condurre l'analisi del gap tra i processi attuali dello stato e le soluzioni di stato di destinazione per informare le decisioni della roadmap del prodotto. Selezione e gestione dei requisiti
• Collaborare con il Product Manager e il Business Owner sulle valutazioni dei fornitori definendo requisiti funzionali e tecnici, valutando le funzionalità del software e contribuendo a criteri tecnici esperti alla richiesta di proposte (RFP).
• Costruire la fiducia e agire come un'interfaccia chiave tra Roche e fornitori di servizi esterni per garantire la consegna del valore, la fattibilità e l'allineamento con gli standard Roche.
• Impegnarsi a stretto contatto con Procurement per adottare Roche buona pratica e garantire sufficiente due diligence è applicato, non solo su funzionale e tecnicamente adatta, ma anche soddisfare la sicurezza e la privacy richiesta

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Product Owner - Legal - RDT Group Functions

We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner to partner with Business Product Owners and stakeholders in Legal to translate requirements into strategic digital solutions. You will work closely with the IT Product Manager to shape the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of Legal-related products within Roche. This includes supporting platforms that span global teams across both Pharma and Diagnostics.

The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling the automation and digitization of workflows - ranging from review and approval to oversight, monitoring, and governance frameworks - while ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

About Our Team: RDT Legal Product

Sitting within the broader Legal, Compliance & Group Communication division, our team partners with the Legal department to enable efficiency and effectiveness through legal-specific solutions. Working hand-in-hand, we blend IT expertise with business know-how to support Legal at every step of their digital journey.

The Legal Product portfolio covers solutions for legal spend and matter management, document management, and contract management, as well as workflows and reporting. We handle the entire lifecycle of these solutions - whether we build (make) or buy, manage, or operate them.

Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Process Analysis

• Conduct detailed discovery and analysis of processes across legal global teams to identify current pain points, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.

• Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications and technical requirements for development teams.

• Develop comprehensive business cases and impact assessments for legal products, quantifying benefits (cost reduction, time savings, risk mitigation) aligned to organizational goals.

• Create and maintain detailed process maps, workflow diagrams, and requirements documentation to ensure shared understanding across stakeholders.

Strategic Alignment & Partnership

• Collaborate with the Business Product Owner to define product strategies and outcomes that address organizational business objectives.

• Actively contribute to the global legal technology strategy through technical insights and feasibility analysis, including the development and alignment of long-term goals (e.g., Data Domain & AI-driven solutions).

• Partner with external vendors and internal teams across Roche to assess existing platforms, propose innovative approaches, and ensure optimal solutions for Legal Products.

• Conduct gap analysis between current state processes and target state solutions to inform product roadmap decisions.

Vendor Selection & Requirement Management

• Collaborate with the Product Manager and the Business Owner on vendor evaluations by defining functional and technical requirements, evaluating software capabilities, and contributing expert technical criteria to Request for Proposals (RFPs).

• Build trust and act as a key interface between Roche and external service providers to ensure value delivery, feasibility, and alignment with Roche standards.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Propriétaire de produit technique - Légal - RDT Group Fonctions Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste technique d'affaires et propriétaire de produit expérimenté pour nous associer avec les propriétaires de produits d'affaires et les intervenants en droit afin de traduire les exigences en solutions numériques stratégiques. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le gestionnaire de produits informatiques pour définir la vision stratégique, la feuille de route et la livraison des produits liés au droit au sein de Roche. Cela inclut les plateformes de soutien qui couvrent les équipes mondiales à la fois Pharma et Diagnostics. L'analyste technique des affaires et le propriétaire du produit joueront un rôle clé dans l'analyse des processus opérationnels complexes, dans l'identification des possibilités d'optimisation et dans l'automatisation et la numérisation des workflows - allant de l'examen et de l'approbation aux cadres de surveillance, de surveillance et de gouvernance - tout en assurant l'alignement avec la philosophie « One Roche ». À propos de notre équipe: RDT Legal Product Siégeant au sein de la division juridique, Compliance & Communication de groupe, notre équipe s'associe au département juridique pour permettre l'efficience et l'efficacité grâce à des solutions juridiques spécifiques. Travaillant main dans la main, nous mélangeons l'expertise informatique avec le savoir-faire d'affaires pour soutenir Legal à chaque étape de leur parcours numérique. Le portefeuille de produits juridiques couvre les solutions pour la gestion légale des dépenses et des matières, la gestion des documents et la gestion des contrats, ainsi que les flux de travail et les rapports. Nous gérons tout le cycle de vie de ces solutions - que nous construisions (make) ou les achetions, les gérons ou les exploitions. Principales responsabilités Exigences opérationnelles et analyse des processus
• Effectuer la découverte et l'analyse détaillées des processus entre les équipes juridiques mondiales pour identifier les points de douleur actuels, les inefficacités et les possibilités d'amélioration.
• Traduire les exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et exigences techniques pour les équipes de développement.
• Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation et des analyses d'impact complètes pour les produits juridiques, quantifier les avantages (réduction des coûts, économies de temps, atténuation des risques) alignés sur les objectifs organisationnels.
• Créer et tenir à jour des cartes de processus détaillées, des diagrammes de flux de travail et de la documentation sur les exigences afin d'assurer une compréhension partagée entre les intervenants. Alignement stratégique et partenariat
• Collaborer avec le propriétaire du produit d'entreprise pour définir des stratégies et des résultats qui répondent aux objectifs opérationnels de l'organisation.
• Contribuer activement à la stratégie mondiale en matière de technologies juridiques au moyen d'études techniques et d'analyses de faisabilité, y compris l'élaboration et l'alignement d'objectifs à long terme (par exemple, les solutions axées sur le domaine des données et l'IA).
• Partenaire avec des fournisseurs externes et des équipes internes à Roche pour évaluer les plateformes existantes, proposer des approches innovantes et garantir des solutions optimales pour les produits juridiques.
• Effectuer une analyse des écarts entre les processus actuels de l'État et les solutions de l'État cible pour éclairer les décisions relatives à la feuille de route des produits. Gestion de la sélection des fournisseurs et des besoins
• Collaborer avec le gestionnaire de produit et le propriétaire d'entreprise à l'évaluation des fournisseurs en définissant les exigences fonctionnelles et techniques, en évaluant les capacités logicielles et en fournissant des critères techniques spécialisés à la demande de propositions.
• Renforcer la confiance et agir comme interface clé entre Roche et les fournisseurs de services externes pour assurer la prestation de valeur, la faisabilité et l'alignement sur les normes Roche.
• S'engager étroitement avec les Approvisionnements pour adopter les bonnes pratiques de Roche et veiller à ce qu'une diligence raisonnable suffisante soit appliquée, non seulement sur le plan fonctionnel et technique, mais aussi pour assurer la sécurité et la protection de la vie privée

The Position

Enterprise Architect - Data & AI (Cross Domain)
The Principal Enterprise Architect for Data & AI provides essential architectural oversight, visionary leadership, and strategic guidance across a Cross-Domain context. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture, this highly impactful role is specifically designed to architect and oversee Roche’s largest, most promising AI and Data use cases that span across multiple functions (Pharma R&D, Pharma Medicines, Diagnostics, Group Functions, Data, AI, EPIE, Information Security).
In this role, you will act as a principal orchestrator across the broader global architecture community. Rather than focusing on a single sub-function, you will guide cross-domain alignment to balance enterprise coherence with functional autonomy. By architecting scalable Data & AI ecosystems and defining the "digital laws" that govern them, you will safely accelerate the adoption of high-value AI capabilities while actively preventing technological fragmentation and agentic chaos.

Description of the Area

The Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Enterprise Architecture function shapes, aligns, and executes technology strategy by connecting business ambition to investment, architecture, and delivery. For this specific role, a primary domain is Informatics (RDT scope), alongside other complex cross-enterprise domains.
You will partner closely with the RDT Artificial Intelligence and RDT Data functions to bridge overarching enterprise strategy with tangible technology execution. While you will support our vertical business facing functions to implement the most complex AI solutions you will ensure that foundational AI models, data products, and agentic workflows are built for enterprise-wide reuse, aligning closely with the ambitious RDT Excellence goals to simplify our landscape and drive value through digital synergy.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Enterprise Architect

The Principal Enterprise Architect provides essential architectural oversight, visionary leadership, and strategic guidance across a broad Cross-Domain context. In this highly impactful role, you will take on the most complex, cross-functional topics that span multiple business and technology areas.
A significant focus of your mandate will be architecting "RDT as a Business" (Informatics Domain), treating our internal Roche Digital Technology organization as a critical business line. Your scope will also encompass other overarching enterprise initiatives across and beyond RDT. You will guide others in resolving highly complex issues and problems that have widespread implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes.

Description of the area

The Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Enterprise Architecture function shapes, aligns, and executes technology strategy by connecting business ambition to investment, architecture, and delivery. For this specific role, a primary domain is Informatics (RDT scope), alongside other complex cross-enterprise domains.
You will partner closely with operational leaders, the Transformation Office, RDT Excellence, and Portfolio Management to establish a modern, integrated operating model. This area ensures that operations are built on insight generation and adhere to industry standards (e.g., IT4IT, ITIL), establishing robust architecture support for strategic internal and cross-functional initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

• Architecting the North Star for "RDT as a Business": Define target-state architectures and capability models for RDT's internal operations. Take ownership of defining and evolving the RDT Application and Technology Landscape and Data Model, ensuring robust architecture support for strategic internal initiatives.

• Operating Model optimization: Actively support the evolution of the Operating Model and integrating its elements (eg. Strategy, Portfolio, Delivery, Operations). Shift the organization toward Data-Driven Portfolio Management and Agile, AI enabled Delivery and Operations, ensuring connection to our existing IT landscape assets and providing traceability.

• Architecture Governance & Standards ("Enable & Govern"): Lead architecture governance for Informatics Domain and drive cross-domain alignment across Information, Technology, Business, and Application Architecture. Provide clarity, "paved roads," and guardrails that enable speed and effectiveness in delivery rather than creating bureaucratic friction.

• Tackling Complex Cross-Functional Topics: Guide matrixed teams in resolving the most complex cross-functional issues with broad implications on organizational processes and outcomes. Act as the architectural lead for major cross-domain initiatives that span beyond a single function, ensuring cohesive target architectures across the enterprise.

• Cross-Domain Coherence & Technical Debt Management: Conduct rigorous architectural impact assessments for cross-domain initiatives. Actively manage technical debt and support Future State Architecture by systematically simplifying the application landscape, decommissioning redundant systems, and establishing governance to prevent future complexity.

Un obiettivo significativo del vostro mandato sarà l'architettura di "RDT come Business" (Informatics Domain), che tratta la nostra organizzazione interna della tecnologia digitale come una linea di business critica. Il vostro scopo includerà anche altre iniziative aziendali generali attraverso e oltre RDT. Si guiderà altri nella risoluzione di problemi e problemi altamente complessi che hanno implicazioni diffuse sui processi e i risultati organizzativi cross-funzionali.

- Architecture Governance & Standards ("Abilita & Governance"): Lead architecture governance for Informatica Dominio e guidare l'allineamento tra i domini attraverso l'Architettura delle Informazioni, Tecnologia, Business e Application. Fornire chiarezza, "strade asfaltate" e guardrails che consentono velocità ed efficacia nella consegna piuttosto che creare attrito burocratico.

• Ein solides Verständnis der Materialwissenschaft, das auf Arzneimittelverabreichungssysteme angewendet wird, mit Expertise in Schadensmechanismen, Fehlererkennung und Leistungstests.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Global Technical Development (PTD) est une organisation de plus de deux mille personnes dans le monde qui font partie intégrante de la mission de Roche de développer des médicaments significatifs pour les patients. Par conséquent, nous collaborons activement et développons des solutions techniques créatives pour combler les besoins en produits en début de phase, en fin de phase et en commercial. Le mandat consiste à livrer le pipeline et à fournir des produits de qualité aux patients. Le service de développement des dispositifs au sein de Roche Technical Development est responsable du développement et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie, de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et le soutien des produits commercialisés. L'ingénierie des appareils combine la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la fabrication pour mettre au point des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments fiables et sûrs qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des fournisseurs de soins de santé et des autorités sanitaires. L'occasion : Ce rôle pratique stimule l'excellence en ingénierie en appliquant des contrôles de conception, en résolvant les défis complexes d'ingénierie des appareils et en fournissant des conseils techniques stratégiques pour assurer le développement et la conformité robustes des produits. Dans ce rôle, vous vous engagerez dans une collaboration interfonctionnelle, particulièrement avec des équipes d'assurance de la qualité, de MSAT d'appareils, d'affaires réglementaires, de développement pharmaceutique, clinique et commerciale.
• Servir de chef de projet technique ou d'expert en matière de projet pour stimuler le développement robuste de produits combinés et d'instruments médicaux, en assurant une progression transparente dans les phases cliniques et les applications commerciales.
• Appliquer une expertise en ingénierie profonde et des idées stratégiques, établir des exigences techniques robustes pour les produits et développer des solutions de conception de produits combinés médicament-dispositifs pour assurer que les appareils maintiennent le niveau de performance requis tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Collaborer avec des partenaires externes pour assurer la supervision technique des conceptions mécaniques pour les produits combinés tout en assurant des performances élevées, la robustesse de conception et en favorisant l'innovation.
• Diriger les enquêtes techniques internes et externes pour résoudre rapidement les problèmes complexes liés à la conception au moyen de méthodes structurées de résolution de problèmes.
• Auteur et gestion d'une documentation complète sur le contrôle de la conception - y compris les plans d'élaboration de la conception, les spécifications relatives aux exigences de l'utilisateur, les intrants/extrants de conception, les plans de vérification/validation, les évaluations de la conformité et les dossiers de gestion des risques.
• Naviguez dans le paysage réglementaire mondial pour s'assurer que toutes les conceptions et tous les procédés de produits sont conformes aux normes de l'industrie, notamment ISO 13485, ISO 14971 et 21 CFR Part 820 (en mettant l'accent sur les contrôles de conception 820.30). Qui vous êtes :
• Diplôme universitaire (BSc ou MSc) en génie ou dans une discipline technique connexe d'un établissement accrédité.
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en génie mécanique et en mise au point d'appareils de distribution de médicaments dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou hautement réglementés (cGxP, QSR).
• Expertise pratique dans le développement du stylo injecteur et de l'autoinjecteur tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Solide fond dans les systèmes de fermeture des contenants, en particulier les seringues préremplies et les cartouches pour l'administration de médicaments parentéraux.
• Un leadership technique éprouvé et des capacités avancées de résolution de problèmes dans des environnements d'équipe interfonctionnels.
• Compréhension solide de la science des matériaux appliquée aux systèmes de livraison de médicaments, avec une expertise dans les mécanismes de dommages, l'identification des défauts et les tests de performance.
• Connaissance approfondie de la réglementation, de l'industrie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are in the midst of the ASPIRE program—one of our most significant enterprise-wide digital transformations, simplifying global processes and transitioning our global footprint to a modern ERP environment . A transformation of this scale succeeds only when built on a foundation of high-fidelity, trusted data .
The ASPIRE Data Migration team orchestrates the journey of our global data footprint . We are looking for a highly skilled Data Management & Governance Specialist to execute our end-to-end data migration strategy, ensuring a seamless, accurate, and secure transition from complex legacy systems to our future-state digital backbone .

The Role: What You Will Do
In this enterprise-level position, you will bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business goals . You will navigate complex legacy data structures, manage large-scale data governance platforms, and ensure migrated data perfectly supports global operations .
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Migration Strategy Execution: Lead the design and execution of comprehensive data migration frameworks, policies, and processes to smoothly transition legacy data into the new ERP environment .

• Advanced Governance & Compliance: Design, implement, and maintain advanced enterprise-level data governance frameworks that scale across the organization, ensuring robust data compliance practices .

• Complex Problem Solving: Tackle highly complex data migration anomalies and discrepancies, performing root-cause analysis to protect the integrity of corporate data .

• Data Profiling & Quality: Establish rigorous data quality metrics, validation standards, cleansing routines, and profiling methodologies to ensure a high-fidelity migration .

• Target Data Mapping: Analyze convoluted, highly fragmented legacy data architectures and map them cleanly to future-state target ERP data models .

• Senior Stakeholder Alignment: Act as a key strategic advisor, liaising directly with senior leadership, functional business owners, and external vendors to align on migration strategy and translate technical data risks into clear business impacts .

• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Guide, direct, and mentor junior specialists and cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment .

​ What You Will Bring to the Team
Experience & Background

• Extensive Experience: A proven track record of leading full-cycle data migration projects for major ERP platforms and continuously improving complex migration frameworks .

• Governance Impact: Demonstrated success spearheading high-impact data governance projects that successfully shape overarching organizational data policies and long-term business strategies .

• Matrix Collaboration: Experience working alongside technical teams, business leaders, and external consultants within a global, fast-moving organization .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Tooling Expertise: Recognized technical mastery in industry-standard data migration and ETL tools .

• Data Cleansing & Profiling: Advanced capabilities in data profiling, structural validation, and complex data cleansing to achieve absolute data hygiene .

• Data Modeling: Exceptional ability to deconstruct legacy systems and translate them into clean, structured target configurations .

Leadership & Communication

• Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management and advisory skills, comfortable guiding senior executives through governance strategy decis

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Chez Roche, nous sommes au cœur du programme ASPIRE, l'une de nos transformations numériques les plus importantes à l'échelle de l'entreprise, simplifiant les processus mondiaux et transformant notre empreinte mondiale en un environnement ERP moderne. Une transformation de cette échelle ne réussit que lorsqu'elle est construite sur une base de haute fidélité, de données de confiance. L'équipe ASPIRE Data Migration orchestre le parcours de notre empreinte de données globale. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste hautement qualifié en gestion de données et gouvernance pour exécuter notre stratégie de migration de données de bout en bout, en assurant une transition transparente, précise et sécurisée de systèmes existants complexes à notre colonne vertébrale numérique future. Le rôle : ce que vous ferez Dans cette position au niveau de l'entreprise, vous comblerez l'écart entre l'ingénierie des données techniques et les objectifs commerciaux stratégiques. Vous naviguerez dans des structures complexes de données existantes, gérerez des plates-formes de gouvernance de données à grande échelle et vous assurerez que les données migrées prennent parfaitement en charge les opérations mondiales. Vos responsabilités principales comprendront :
• Exécution de la stratégie de migration : Diriger la conception et l'exécution de cadres, de politiques et de processus complets de migration des données pour assurer une transition harmonieuse des données héritées dans le nouvel environnement ERP.
• Gouvernance et conformité avancées : Concevoir, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des cadres avancés de gouvernance des données au niveau de l'entreprise qui s'étendent à l'ensemble de l'organisation, assurant des pratiques de conformité des données solides.
• Résoudre les problèmes complexes : Tâcher des anomalies et des anomalies de migration des données très complexes, effectuer une analyse racine-cause pour protéger l'intégrité des données de l'entreprise.
• Profil et qualité des données: Établir des mesures rigoureuses de qualité des données, des normes de validation, des routines de nettoyage et des méthodologies de profilage pour assurer une migration à haute fidélité.
• Cible de cartographie des données : Analyser les architectures de données existantes, très fragmentées, et les cartographier proprement aux modèles de données ERP cibles futurs.
• Alignement des intervenants principaux : Agir en tant que conseiller stratégique clé, assurer la liaison directe avec les cadres supérieurs, les propriétaires d'entreprises fonctionnels et les fournisseurs externes afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie de migration et de traduire les risques liés aux données techniques en impacts opérationnels clairs.
• Leadership d'équipe et mentorat : Guider, diriger et mentorer les jeunes spécialistes et les équipes interfonctionnelles, favoriser un environnement collaboratif et performant. Ce que vous apporterez à l'équipe Expérience et contexte
• Expérience approfondie: Une expérience éprouvée de projets de migration de données à cycle complet pour les grandes plates-formes ERP et l'amélioration continue des cadres de migration complexes.
• Impact de la gouvernance : Succès démontré à l'origine de projets de gouvernance des données à impact élevé qui façonnent avec succès les politiques globales en matière de données organisationnelles et les stratégies opérationnelles à long terme .
• Collaboration Matrix : Expérience en collaboration avec des équipes techniques, des chefs d'entreprise et des consultants externes au sein d'une organisation mondiale en évolution rapide. Compétences techniques et artisanat
• Expertise en matière d'outillage : Maîtrise technique reconnue dans les outils de migration de données standard et ETL.
• Nettoyage et profilage des données: Capacités avancées en profilage des données, validation structurelle et nettoyage des données complexes pour atteindre l'hygiène absolue des données.
• Modélisation des données: Capacité exceptionnelle de déconstruire les systèmes existants et de les traduire en configurations cibles propres et structurées. Leadership et communication
• Présence de la haute direction : compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des intervenants et en conseil, orientation confortable des cadres supérieurs à travers la stratégie de gouvernance décis

jobs.title: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

titleByLocale.en: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy.

As the Head of Compliance and Quality Governance (Practice Leader), you will be accountable for the entire lifecycle of this critical function, from strategic planning and service design to operational execution and continuous improvement. Operating as a senior escalation and decision authority, you will define the functional vision, strategy, and roadmap, transforming business needs into tangible, high-value capabilities. Leveraging a distinctive combination of deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insight, you will lead multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver desirable, viable, and sustainable functional services that meet the evolving needs of our users while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

The Opportunity

• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the Technology Compliance & Quality Governance strategy, establishing clear governance frameworks, decision models, and accountabilities while translating global biotech regulations and corporate policies into clear technology outcomes.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted partner and senior escalation authority for executives, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Security leadership, representing Technology in executive forums, audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.

• Functional Management & Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery and lifecycle of defined functions (e.g., QMS), ensuring Technology adherence to GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO) through pragmatic, risk-based interpretations.

• Risk Management & Assurance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and compliance maturity evaluations, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Team Leadership & Development: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing global team of professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and transparency while guiding senior leaders on risk-based decision-making.

• Operational Excellence & Improvement: Define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) and leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions, immediate operational improvements, and strategic optimizations to achieve business goals.

• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the immediate team's budget and resources, developing detailed business cases—including cost-benefit analyses and resource estimates—for new functional initiatives and significant process changes.

Who You Are

• Experienced Global Leader: You bring 15+ years of IT domain experience, including 10+ years managing global multidisciplinary teams and 10+ years in Technology, Compliance, Q

We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

• Concettualizzare, guidare, eseguire e/o coordinare tutte le attività relative ai lanci di prodotto, promozioni di prodotti, formazione scientifica e per il team Vendite, analisi del mercato Customer &, co-creazione e realizzazione di piani di marketing e gestione del budget A& P assegnato.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

• Roche Diagnostics Pakistan is looking for a Product Manager, internally titled as Manager Business Innovation Molecular. Reporting to the Team Lead- Business Innovation, this position will see you developing specific marketing plans for products within the organization, interprets and translate scientific clinical data into commercial implications. You will analyze data and make strategic recommendations while providing marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches.

• This is a permanent and individual contributor position based in Karachi, within our Diagnostics business.

Your Opportunity

• Conceptualize, lead, execute and/or coordinate all activities related to product launches, product promotions, scientific training and for the Sales team, Customer & market analyses, co-creation and implementation of marketing plans and management of allocated A& P budget.

• Co-create with Medical, Sales teams, Clinical Value Marketing promotional, educational, access and partnership initiatives or business model solutions, which support faster adoption of Diagnostics solutions according to clinical guidelines and protocols

• Partner with relevant internal and external stakeholders to develop and communicate unique value propositions for our Diagnostics portfolio

• Identify strategic partners (public or private organizations) which can facilitate improved Patient Access – e.g. MoH, telehealth/teleconsultation system providers, insurance and financial institutions, patient coaching providers, NGOs, Hospitals etc.

• Co-develop the marketing plan based on robust market insights and analytics and informed by regular key Customer visits with Medical & Sales

• Source & analyze (including the development of business cases) market insight for new product launch potential, competitor intelligence, hospital procurement policies, pricing, etc.

• Leverage globally developed campaigns and brand assets to deploy locally translated promotional/educational materials for new and existing products, including brochures, leaflets, detailing materials, presentations, Lead HCP and Institutional marketing efforts for product promotion. including disease education

• Maintain strong disease and product knowledge; support internal and external customer education programs and product training

• Lead KOL engagement and speaker programs

• Leverage Medical and Scientific studies to create content for patients, HCPs and Institutions

• Drive shift in engaging HCPs on digital marketing platforms

• Conduct double visits with the Sales team to shape actionable content and format for the product training and promotional campaigns

• Coordinate with Medical to establish relevant presence and engagement for strategic events (symposia, conferences, etc.)

• Collaborate seamlessly with the rest of the Sales, Medical and other functions to deliver on the company’s objectives

• Ensure full compliance with Roche policies, coordinate with Quality & Regulatory functions, and secure timely and proper approval & documentation of activities and assets according to SOPs including the local customization process

• Contribute to actionable training & progress of the Sales Team by feedback & feed forward and sharing Customer Insight

• Implement Globally developed/validated tools and assets, customized for local use as applicable

• Track and consolidate relevant analytics and ROI KPIs

• Adopt

• Mettre en œuvre des outils et des actifs développés ou validés à l'échelle mondiale, adaptés à l'usage local, selon le cas
• Suivre et consolider les analyses pertinentes et les ICR ROI

jobs.title: Territory Manager – Foundation Medicine
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

​ Accelerate Your Career in Precision Medicine If you are looking to transition from traditional medical sales into the frontier of genomic innovation, this permanent role offers the perfect platform for your professional evolution. As part of the Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) team within Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, this role is based in Lahore and will cover the Central and North regions. Reporting directly to the Business Manager for FMI, you won't just be managing a territory—you will be building a market, expanding your strategic business acumen, and establishing yourself as a leading expert in comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP).

• The primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche : Own your territory and build high-level partnerships by serving as the trusted, expert face of Foundation Medicine (FMI) for prominent Oncologists, Pathologists, and multidisciplinary tumor boards across the Central and North regions.

• Responsible for Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs : Champion the scientific adoption of FMI's cutting-edge genomic testing portfolio, directly influencing personalized healthcare pathways.

• Disease landscape understanding and products knowledge : Sharpen your scientific expertise by mastering complex molecular oncology, precision diagnostics, and genomic data to consult confidently with top-tier medical experts.

• Responsibility of Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support its appropriate use : Step up to the challenge of managing regional commercial targets, honing your data-driven territory planning and execution skills.

• Broad understanding of his/her therapeutic area and its respective future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions: Grow into a strategic leader by collaborating directly with the FMI Business Manager to co-create regional business blueprints, analyze market dynamics, and map long-term institutional accounts.

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community : Develop sophisticated problem-solving skills as you work across complex hospital ecosystems to streamline genomic testing workflows from sample to report.

• Awareness of disease Diagnosis : Position yourself as a thought leader by educating clinicians on the paradigm-shifting value of comprehensive genomic profiling over traditional testing.

• HCP education (pre-approved & post-approved products) : Expand your professional presentation and leadership skills by driving scientific roundtables, medical meetings, and clinical case reviews.

• Patients’ Access to available funds e.g PBM/SSP & others : Gain valuable experience in healthcare market access by exploring and leveraging institutional funding and patient support avenues.

• Proactive communication with HCPs on PSP : Drive impactful patient-centric solutions by ensuring healthcare providers are fully aware of programs designed to maximize testing accessibility.

• PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem: Develop high-level "systems thinking" capabilities by embedding FMI testing into standard hospital clinical protocols.

• Responsible to repor

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità Accelera la tua carriera in medicina di precisione Se stai cercando di passare dalle vendite mediche tradizionali alla frontiera dell'innovazione genomica, questo ruolo permanente offre la piattaforma perfetta per la tua evoluzione professionale. Nell'ambito del team Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) all'interno di Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, questo ruolo è basato in Lahore e coprirà le regioni centrali e nord. Segnalando direttamente al Business Manager per FMI, non solo gestirai un territorio – costruirai un mercato, espanderai il tuo acume strategico aziendale e ti stabilirai come un esperto leader nella profilazione genomica completa (CGP).
• Il punto di contatto primario (ma non esclusivo) tra le parti interessate e Roche: Possedere il proprio territorio e costruire partnership di alto livello servendo come il volto di fiducia, esperto di medicina della Fondazione (FMI) per oncologi di spicco, patologi, e schede tumorali multidisciplinari in tutte le regioni del Centro e del Nord.
• Responsabile per i prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e supporta il loro uso appropriato, che include la condivisione dei loro meriti con HCP: Campione dell'adozione scientifica del portafoglio di test genomici all'avanguardia di FMI, influenzando direttamente percorsi sanitari personalizzati.
• Conoscenza del paesaggio delle malattie e dei prodotti: Affilare le tue competenze scientifiche masterizzando oncologia molecolare complessa, diagnostica di precisione e dati genomici per consultare con fiducia esperti medici di alto livello.
• Responsabilità dei prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e sostenere il suo uso appropriato: salire alla sfida di gestire gli obiettivi commerciali regionali, affinare le vostre capacità di pianificazione e esecuzione del territorio.
• Ampia comprensione della sua area terapeutica e della sua rispettiva futura pipeline, tale da poter lavorare su soluzioni future: Crescere in un leader strategico collaborando direttamente con FMI Business Manager per co-creare progetti di business regionali, analizzare le dinamiche di mercato e mappare conti istituzionali a lungo termine.
• Partner con stakeholder di viaggio del paziente per rimuovere i blocchi stradali e sbloccare le possibilità per fornire valore per i pazienti e la comunità: Sviluppare sofisticate capacità di problem solving mentre lavori in ecosistemi ospedalieri complessi per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro di test genomici dal campione al report.
• Consapevolezza della malattia Diagnosi: Posizionati come leader di pensiero educando i medici sul valore di cambiamento del paradigma della profilazione genomica completa sul test tradizionale.
• Istruzione HCP (prodotti pre-approvati e post-approvati) : Espandi le tue capacità professionali di presentazione e leadership guidando tavole rotonde scientifiche, riunioni mediche e recensioni di casi clinici.
• I pazienti’ Accesso ai fondi disponibili, ad esempio PBM/SSP & altri: Ottieni una preziosa esperienza nell'accesso al mercato sanitario esplorando e sfruttando i finanziamenti istituzionali e i viali di supporto dei pazienti.
• Comunicazione proattiva con HCP su PSP: Soluzioni impattanti per il paziente-centric assicurando ai fornitori di servizi sanitari la piena consapevolezza dei programmi progettati per massimizzare l'accessibilità ai test.
• PJP agisce come un pensatore di sistema con la capacità di identificare lo scopo condiviso tra le parti interessate e lo sfrutta per co-creare soluzioni con le parti interessate nell'ecosistema: Sviluppare capacità di "sistemi di pensiero" di alto livello incorporando i test FMI nei protocolli clinici ospedalieri standard.
• Responsabile del repo

• Proaktive Kommunikation mit HCPs auf PSP: Führen Sie wirkungsvolle patientenzentrierte Lösungen durch, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass Gesundheitsdienstleister sich der Programme bewusst sind, die die Zugänglichkeit von Tests maximieren.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Functional expertise – Primary Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Play the role of “strategic product champion” to lead the development of the local (or above affiliate) marketing strategy and drive/coordinate branding development or evolution process

• Ensure the development of the marketing strategies and their execution with a strong focus of patient value and connected with all the strategies and solutions generated by different functions and teams

• Design and deliver delightful end-to-end customer experiences through networked way of working

• Maintain up to date knowledge of the global market for the therapy area

• Use appropriate data analytics: analyze and assesses the data to extrapolate meaning and opportunities that drives the product’s overall market strength and positioning

• Enable a wide range of tactical activities to support a seamless, well integrated brand message and overall position across multiple marketing platforms. These activities may span several customer types (e.g. payers, HCPs) and will require working knowledge across different types of marketing

• Monitor competitor activity and recommend action

• Cultivate and develop Key Opinion Leaders, product advocates and speakers Ensure that all products are actively forecasted; manage the introduction/withdrawal of products; and that product changes/updates are communicated

• Provide input into public relations and access strategy Respect the compliance with all relevant Roche guidelines and policies

Mindset & Behaviors

• Enterprise thinking, eager to learn, system thinker, self-managed & directed, bold, and being able to prioritize

• VACC mindset

• The ability to work with cross-functional teams is a must

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools

• Embracing & implementing agile ways of working is a must

• Entrepreneurial mindset with good partnering capabilities (ability to deeply listen, question & understand, communicate smoothly)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, takes risks and experiments, embrace challenges and failures, and contributes to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside Roche

Operating Principles

• Put Patients First: I always act as if patients I know are in the room and do what's best for them

• Follow the science: I seek answers through experiments, data and debate, and act on facts

• Act as one team: I care, collaborate and commit without boundaries, and trust others to do their part

• Embrace differences: I seek diverse perspectives, invite opposing views, and challenge myself and others

• Accelerate learning: I push to learn new things even if difficult, and openly share my successes and failures

• Simplify radically: I eliminate complexity, reuse with pride, and accomplish more with less

• Make impact now: I take accountability to do what's right, deliver value fast, and don't wait for certainty

• Think long term: I choose actions today that benefit future generations

Skills and Experience :

• You have at least 8 years of experience in sales, marketing (at least 1 years of marketing relevant experience/projects including work packages and gigs), digital engagement and/or commercial operations (including leadership), with demonstrable evidence of successfully partnering with customers and achieving shared goals and outcomes.

• Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology , Business, Marketing or other related fields preferred

• You have a proven track record of

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Information Solutions (RIS) , we believe that every line of code can improve a patient’s life. Within our Patient Software Insights group, we build a diverse portfolio of digital solutions—from web apps to desktop tools—that help healthcare providers and patients stay one step ahead of disease.
We don't just "deploy"; we deliver trust.
As a Senior DevOps Automation Engineer , you will be the guardian of our delivery lifecycle, ensuring that our life-saving software reaches those who need it with the highest quality and security.

The Opportunity: Where Engineering meets Purpose
Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is life-changing. You will join a cross-functional squad of brilliant engineers, designers, and product owners to:

• Master the Pipeline: Architect and oversee complex CI/CD ecosystems for Backend, Web, API, and Desktop environments (Windows/MacOS).

• Define the Standard: Establish best-in-class code branching and review processes that empower our dev teams.

• Automation at Scale: Use your Python mastery to eliminate manual bottlenecks and create self-healing deployment flows.

• Security & Resilience: Integrate cutting-edge SAST/DAST tools (SonarQube, Mayhem) to ensure our medical software is impenetrable.

• Lead by Example: Mentor fellow engineers and act as a technical lighthouse within the organization.

Who You Are: The Architect of Flow
You are a seasoned engineer who sees the "big picture." You are passionate about clean code, robust infrastructure, and, above all, the people you work with.
Your technical footprint:

• Proven Track Record: 7+ years of hands-on experience in high-level CI/CD automation across diverse platforms (Web, API, Lambdas, Desktop).

• The CI/CD Trio: Deep expertise in GitHub Actions , Jenkins, or GitLab CI.

• Containerization & Repos: Master of Docker/Containerd and artifact management (Nexus/Artifactory).

• The Language of Automation: Proficiency in Python (or a similar high-level language).

• Security-Minded: Experience weaving security tools (Trivy, SonarQube) into the fabric of the development process.

• Soft Skills: A collaborative spirit, a desire to mentor, and excellent English communication skills.

You’ll stand out if you bring: Familiarity with AWS, experience with testing frameworks (Appium, Selenium, JUnit), or a background in SaaS/E-commerce.

What’s in it for you? (The Roche Experience)

• Work with Purpose: Direct contact with our users to understand how your work helps people living with diabetes and other conditions.

• Innovation Culture: We welcome "technical evangelists." If you want to speak at a conference or write a blog, we’ll support you 100%.

• State-of-the-Art Tech: From native development to Infrastructure-as-Code in the cloud.

• Premium Benefits: Brand new Apple hardware, professional training budget, fitness and lunch benefits, public transport support, and language classes.

• A Hub of Talent: Join a diverse, agile environment in Sant Cugat where knowledge sharing is part of our DNA.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior DevOps Automation Engineer The Patient Software Insights group within Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is responsible for a portfolio of software solutions that support healthcare providers and patients across various applications and disease areas. For a quick look at what we do, check out Roche tech4life . The Opportunity: Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk! You will oversee application releases and manage the automation process to support building our applications. Tasks may include scripting, testing, troubleshooting problems, and communicating issues to software engineers. Who you are: We seek an experienced, motivated Senior DevOps Software Engineer who will work closely with engineers and our product teams. Required skills to accomplish your mission:
• At least 7 years of hands-on experience automating CI/CD pipelines (for example, Backend, Web, API, Lambdas, and Desktop (Windows, MacOS)).
• Proven ability to establish code branching and review processes.
• Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language.
• Deep experience in:
• Setting up and maintaining CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
• Building containers (Containerd, Docker).
• Managing artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory).
• Integrating SAST and DAST security tools (SonarQube, Mayhem, Trivy).
• A real enthusiasm for teamwork and helping others across different teams.
• A desire to mentor colleagues and share your knowledge.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. The following skills significantly strengthen your application:
• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud platforms.
• Experience in building and testing applications (e.g., JMeter, Appium, xCUITest, JUnit, Selenium),
• Background in developing digital products such as SaaS, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms.
• Knowledge of the diabetes or similar healthcare industries. Here's what you can expect from us:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• We welcome technical evangelists, so if you are interested in any thought leadership contributions (blogs, conferences) within the realm of the organization, we are happy to support you.
• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget,...) You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits. You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcare systems worldwide. Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you!

titleByLocale.fr: Business Architecte – Platform Strategy and Transformation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.
Your tasks and Responsibilities

• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.

• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness.

Who you are

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea o Master in Informatica o Ingegneria, con almeno 10 anni di esperienza in business/reference architettura e strategie di piattaforma condivise.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist - NMR Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

NMR Expert in pRED-pCMC Analytical Chemistry

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This role is situated within the preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC) department, part of the Small Molecule Research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities (TMo). We pave the path for drug candidates from early research to development in a diverse, ambitious, and innovative environment. Collaborating actively with our discovery and development partners, we leverage cutting-edge technologies and scientific excellence to transform molecules into future medicines. As CMC experts, we bring a rich diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, pioneering advancements in small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid-based medicines.

The Opportunity

We are offering a unique opportunity for a hands-on NMR Expert in our Analytical Molecular Characterization group. As a Centre of Excellence for Analytics, we provide state-of-the-art methods and services for determining chemical structures, purities, and impurities, supporting portfolio projects throughout the entire value chain. In this role you plan, run and report NMR experiments for structure elucidation and inter- and intra-molecular interaction studies.

• Innovative Analytics: By applying cutting-edge analytics you support synthesis and formulation development enabling fast progress for projects, and identification of possible challenges.

• Method Development: You develop and implement new NMR experiments and give input for future developments of our NMR group.

• Scientific Excellence: You enhance scientific excellence by identifying relevant industry trends, and building and maintaining academic partnerships.

• Strategic Vision: You contribute deep scientific insights to shape the mid- and long-term strategy for NMR within the Roche portfolio. Working alongside the NMR group and the Leadership Team, you guide the translation of your strategic input into actionable team strategies.

• Collaboration and Relationship Building: You foster trustful relationships and effective collaboration with internal discovery and technical development teams as well as with external partners.

Who You Are

• Educational Background: Masters with a minimum of 5 years or PhD in analytical chemistry or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the industry.

• Technical Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of NMR analytics and its applications paired with a deep understanding of the technical and theoretical basis beyond the standard experiments for liquid and solid state NMR. Experience with other methods for biophysical characterization is a plus.

• Proven Experience: Hands on expertise in structure elucidation and interaction studies by NMR for synthetic oligonucleotides and/or peptides. Demonstrated expertise on higher order structure studies and aggregation studies.

• Mindset: You possess an open-minded and highly proactive, "just-do-it" approach. You enjoy problem-solving and developing new ways

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su Roche

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Esperto di chimica analitica pRED-pCMC

Nell'organizzazione di ricerca farmaceutica e sviluppo precoce di Roche (pRED), realizziamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte del mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono autorizzati e ispirati a portare avanti a velocità straordinarie innovazioni che cambiano la vita.

Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del dipartimento di Chimica, Produzione e Controlli (pCMC), parte dell'organizzazione di Ricerca Molecola in Modalità terapeutiche pRED (TMo). Apriamo il percorso per i candidati alla ricerca precoce e allo sviluppo in un ambiente diversificato, ambizioso e innovativo. Iliamo attivamente con i nostri partner di scoperta e sviluppo, sfruttiamo tecnologie all'avanguardia e l'eccellenza scientifica per trasformare le molecole in farmaci futuri.

Come esperti CMC, offriamo una ricca varietà di competenze tecniche in chimica, progettazione di formulazione, scienza dei materiali e chimica analitica, progressi pionieristici in piccole molecole, peptidi e farmaci a base di acido nucleico.

L'opportunità

Offriamo un'opportunità unica per un esperto NMR pratico nel nostro gruppo di caratterizzazione molecolare analitica. Come centro di eccellenza per l'analisi, forniamo metodi e servizi all'avanguardia per determinare strutture chimiche, purità e impurità, supportando progetti di portafoglio per tutta la catena del valore. In questo ruolo pianifichi, gestisci e riporti esperimenti NMR per la chiarificazione della struttura e studi di interazione inter- e intra-molecolare.

- Analisi innovativa: applicando analisi all'avanguardia, supporti lo sviluppo di sintesi e formulazione consentendo rapidi progressi per i progetti e individuando possibili sfide. - Sviluppo del metodo: Sviluppi e implementi nuovi esperimenti NMR e dai input per gli sviluppi futuri del nostro gruppo NMR. - Eccellenza scientifica: Migliora l'eccellenza scientifica individuando le tendenze del settore e costruendo e mantenendo partnership accademiche.

- Visione strategica: Lei contribuisce a profonde conoscenze scientifiche per definire la strategia a medio e lungo termine per NMR all'interno del portafoglio Roche. Lavorando insieme al gruppo NMR e al Team di Leadership, Lei guida la traduzione del Suo input strategico in strategie di team attuabili. - Il 21a e il Relationship Building: Lei promuove rapporti di fiducia ed efficace collaborazione con i team di scoperta interna e di sviluppo tecnico così come con i partner esterni.

Chi sei

- Background didattico: Master con un minimo di 5 anni o dottorato in chimica analitica o campi correlati con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore. - Esperti tecnici: Conoscenza completa dell'analisi NMR e delle sue applicazioni abbinata ad una profonda comprensione della base tecnica e teorica oltre agli esperimenti standard per NMR a stato liquido e solido. L'esperienza con altri metodi per la caratterizzazione biofisica è un plus.

- Esperienza di Proven: Mani sulla competenza in strutture di chiarificazione e di interazione studi da NMR per oligonucleotidi sintetici e / o peptidi. Esperti dimostrato su studi di struttura di ordine superiore e studi di aggregazione. - Mente: Si dispone di un approccio aperto e altamente proattivo, "just-do-it". Godete di problem-solving e lo sviluppo di nuovi modi
