jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Market Access and Public Policy Partner is driven by a profound commitment to facilitating the entry of Roche’s innovative diagnostic solutions and actively shaping healthcare policy, supporting the vision of "Innovating Diagnostics, Shaping Healthcare and Changing Lives in Taiwan."
We are looking for a Market Access and Public Policy Partner to spearhead healthcare policy shaping, alongside the strategic development and tactical implementation of access initiatives for Roche innovations. This role involves close collaboration with internal cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to optimize access for new products and indications and drive meaningful policy reform.

Key responsibilities

• Build and implement sustainable market access and pricing strategies for Roche’s products and portfolio from pre-launch through life-cycle management.

• Identify the primary focus of high medical value products to guide future new product planning efforts.

• Drive ecosystem and policy-shaping activities to support and expand broader patient access opportunities.

• Lead successful NHIA reimbursement submissions and negotiations and oversee the end-to-end process.

• Formulate and execute pharmacoeconomics and HTA strategies.

• Ensure robust, payer-relevant evidence is generated (via clinical trials, health economic modeling, real-world evidence, and meta-analyses) to comprehensively demonstrate product value.

• Identify patient access barriers or opportunities and develop best-in-class access solutions for the self-pay market and areas beyond standard NHIA coverage.

• Collaborate with global teams, commercial teams, and cross-functional groups to align and execute overall access strategies.

• Develop and execute engagement plans with KOLs, patient advocacy groups, and diverse external stakeholders.

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Education and experience

• A bachelor degree in the field (pharmacy, public health, economics, public policy or life sciences). An advanced (Master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

• >5 years experience in medical device/diagnostic test reimbursement and/or self-pay strategy experience is preferred.

Required skills and qualifications

• Familiar with NHIA process of medical devices/diagnostic solutions and key stakeholders.

• Strong business acumen with ability to think strategically.

• Deep appreciation of science and ability to translate scientific information into strategy. Ability to take evidence and other complex data and convert them into easy to understand deliverables that can support commercial use.

• A collaborative attitude and ability to manage multiple demands and priorities on time, influence without authority, gain alignment and drive decision making.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills are a must with a strong track record of delivering results in a matrix-based environment.

• Big picture oriented with the ability to understand the implications of reimbursement and market access trends that will affect commercial success.

• Proficient in English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desired.

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance vi

As the organisation's landscape expands across cloud, on-premises, AI infrastructure, and shared scientific platforms, the team is evolving to deliver five core capabilities: infrastructure visibility, scalable governance for hybrid environments, financial economics (forecasting and attribution), investment prioritisation, and efficiency optimisation.

The Opportunity

The Senior Infrastructure Business Operations Manager is an individual contributor role within the xRED FinOps & Technical Enablement function of Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence Portfolio & Operations (CS CoE P&O). This role establishes and operates the business, financial, and governance mechanisms needed to support better infrastructure decision-making across cloud, on-premises, AI infrastructure, shared scientific platforms, and emerging computational environments.
The successful candidate will partner closely with R&D (i.e. architecture, engineering, and research), RDT, finance, and procurement to improve visibility, attribution, forecasting, showback, optimisation, and investment governance.

In this position you will:

• Portfolio & Financial Operations: Support the execution, reporting, and continuous improvement of infrastructure forecasting, budgeting, showback, and financial planning activities to improve infrastructure financial visibility across cloud, on-premises, AI infrastructure, shared platforms, storage, and compute environments. Translate infrastructure usage, cost, ownership, and forecast data into decision-ready insights for leaders and technical teams, and partner with finance, portfolio, and technical teams to connect infrastructure demand with budget planning and portfolio priorities while developing infrastructure economic analyses, business cases, and decision-support materials for infrastructure investment and capacity planning discussions.

• Hybrid Infrastructure Governance: Support the implementation and continuous improvement of cloud and on-premises attribution and showback methodologies to improve infrastructure ownership, accountability, and governance maturity across teams and platforms. Partner with scientists, software engineers, application owners, product owners, RDT, and infrastructure teams to strengthen ownership visibility, while contributing to governance models for AI infrastructure across cloud, on-premises, GPU environments, shared infrastructure, and emerging scientific computing platforms, and supporting the implementation of lightweight governance mechanisms that are practical, scalable, and usable by technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Study Start Up Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche/Genentech Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), we are determined to transform drug development and realize our Pharma Ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2029.
As a key member of our Country Study Start-Up team, you will drive and facilitate the efficient initiation of clinical trials, ultimately helping to deliver innovative treatments to patients. You'll work in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment, where you have the opportunity to influence and shape our clinical trial delivery strategy. This is a unique opportunity to use your expertise to make a meaningful impact by ensuring seamless trial execution for patients, investigators, and clinical site staff.
Vendor Management
The Role

• Lead Country Strategy: You will lead the country strategy for study start-up, driving efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external stakeholders.

• Oversee Operations: You will lead start-up operations to ensure timely and efficient site activation and regulatory compliance.

• Drive Process Improvements: You will identify and lead opportunities for process automation, standardization, and innovation at both the country and site levels.

• Collaborate and Harmonize: You will collaborate with local, regional, and global counterparts to harmonize systems and improve timelines.

• Manage Clinical Trial Submissions: You will lead the development and management of clinical trial submissions and amendments, ensuring regulatory coordination.

• Strategize on Budget & Contracts: You will provide strategic oversight for and operational delivery of all aspects of budgeting and contract management, including developing budget strategies and negotiating with internal and external stakeholders.

• Influence the Environment: You will participate in external industry collaborations to influence the country's start-up environment.

• Payments and Vendors' Management: Strategically oversee and manage site payment processes, budget escalations, financial reporting, and the reconciliation of financial activities. Contribute to local vendor management (excluding CROs) as required to support site activities.

• Manage Post-trial access Submissions and execution: You will lead the development and management of post-trial access submissions and amendments, ensuring their strategic planning and execution in accordance with regulatory requirements and local procedures.

• Lead a Team (if applicable): If you are a People Leader, you will provide coaching, support, and leadership to a team, championing inclusive behaviors and helping them grow their skills and careers.

Who You Are

• You have a degree (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) in life sciences or a related field. A postgraduate degree is highly desirable.

• You have demonstrated strong experience in clinical trial start-up, regulatory submissions, and cross-functional collaboration (at least 4 years of relevant clinical trial operations experience).

• You possess a strong understanding of ICH-GCP, EU CTR, and local regulatory environments. Proficient and practical understanding of Ukrainian clinical trial legislation, operations, and regulatory environments (including medicinal products and medical devices) is mandatory.

• You have excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a collaborative mindset.

• You are able to work independently and responsibly, with respect to shared values and goals.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
A Roche/Genentech Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), siamo determinati a trasformare lo sviluppo della droga e realizzare il nostro Pharma Ambition per fornire 20 farmaci trasformativi che affrontano le malattie con il più alto peso sociale entro il 2029.
Come membro chiave del nostro Country Study Start-Up team, guiderai e faciliterai l'iniziazione efficiente delle prove cliniche, contribuendo infine a fornire trattamenti innovativi ai pazienti. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e interfunzionale, dove hai l'opportunità di influenzare e modellare la nostra strategia di consegna clinica. Questa è un'opportunità unica per utilizzare la vostra esperienza per fare un impatto significativo assicurando l'esecuzione di prova senza soluzione di continuità per pazienti, ricercatori e personale del sito clinico.
Gestione del fornitore
Il ruolo

• Lead Country Strategy: guiderai la strategia del paese per l'avvio dello studio, l'efficienza di guida, l'innovazione e la collaborazione con gli stakeholder esterni.

• Oversee Operations: Condurrai le operazioni di start-up per garantire l'attivazione tempestiva ed efficiente del sito e la conformità alle normative.

• Miglioramenti del processo di trasmissione: Identificherai e porterà opportunità per l'automazione dei processi, la standardizzazione e l'innovazione sia a livello di paese che di sito.

• Collaborate e Harmonize: collaborerete con controparti locali, regionali e globali per armonizzare i sistemi e migliorare le tempistiche.

• Gestisci le sottomissioni di prova clinica: guiderai lo sviluppo e la gestione delle presentazioni e degli emendamenti di prova clinica, garantendo il coordinamento normativo.

• Strategize on Budget & Contracts: Fornirai una supervisione strategica per e la consegna operativa di tutti gli aspetti del budget e della gestione dei contratti, tra cui lo sviluppo di strategie di bilancio e la negoziazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Influenza nell'ambiente: parteciperai a collaborazioni esterne per influenzare l'ambiente di start-up del paese.

• Gestione dei pagamenti e dei fornitori: supervisionare strategicamente e gestire processi di pagamento del sito, escalation del budget, reporting finanziario e la riconciliazione delle attività finanziarie. Contribuire alla gestione locale dei fornitori (esclusi i CRO) come richiesto per supportare le attività del sito.

• Gestisci l'accesso post-trial Sottomissioni e l'esecuzione: guiderai lo sviluppo e la gestione delle presentazioni e degli emendamenti di accesso post-trial, garantendo la loro pianificazione strategica ed esecuzione in conformità con i requisiti normativi e le procedure locali.

• Lead a Team (se applicabile): Se sei un Leader del Popolo, ti fornirà coaching, supporto e leadership a una squadra, sostenendo comportamenti inclusivi e aiutandoli a crescere le loro abilità e carriere.

Chi sei

• Hai una laurea (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) in scienze della vita o un campo correlato. Una laurea post-laurea è altamente auspicabile.

• Hai dimostrato una forte esperienza nell'avvio di studi clinici, nelle presentazioni normative e nella collaborazione interfunzionale (almeno 4 anni di esperienza di sperimentazione clinica rilevante).

• Possiedi una forte comprensione di ICH-GCP, CTR UE e ambienti normativi locali. È obbligatoria la comprensione efficace e pratica della legislazione, delle operazioni e degli ambienti normativi clinici ucraini (compresi i medicinali e i dispositivi medici).

• Hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, interpersonale e problem solving, con una mentalità collaborativa.

• Siete in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente e responsabile, rispetto ai valori e agli obiettivi condivisi.

• Verwalten Sie die Einreichung von klinischen Studien: Sie werden die Entwicklung und das Management von Einreichungen und Änderungen klinischer Studien leiten und die regulatorische Koordination sicherstellen.

• Strategize auf Budget & Verträge: Sie übernehmen die strategische Aufsicht und operative Umsetzung aller Aspekte der Budgetierung und des Vertragsmanagements, einschließlich der Entwicklung von Haushaltsstrategien und der Verhandlungen mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.

• Einfluss auf die Umwelt: Sie werden an externen Branchenkooperationen teilnehmen, um das Start-up-Umfeld des Landes zu beeinflussen.

• Zahlungen und Management der Anbieter: Strategische Überwachung und Verwaltung der Zahlungsprozesse vor Ort, Haushaltseskalationen, Finanzberichterstattung und Abstimmung der Finanzaktivitäten. Beitrag zum lokalen Lieferantenmanagement (ausgenommen CROs), soweit dies zur Unterstützung der Standortaktivitäten erforderlich ist.

• Verwalten Sie Post-Trial-Zugangsbeiträge und -ausführungen: Sie leiten die Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Post-Trial-Zugangsbeiträgen und -änderungen und stellen deren strategische Planung und Ausführung in Übereinstimmung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen und lokalen Verfahren sicher.

• Führen Sie ein Team (falls zutreffend): Wenn Sie ein People Leader sind, bieten Sie einem Team Coaching, Unterstützung und Führung an, setzen sich für integrative Verhaltensweisen ein und helfen ihnen, ihre Fähigkeiten und Karrieren auszubauen.

Wer du bist

• Sie haben einen Abschluss (MD, PhD, MA / MS, BA / BS) in Life Sciences oder einem verwandten Bereich. Ein postgradualer Abschluss ist sehr wünschenswert.

• Sie haben starke Erfahrung in der klinischen Studienstart, Zulassungsanträge und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit (mindestens 4 Jahre einschlägige klinische Studienerfahrung) gezeigt.

• Sie besitzen ein starkes Verständnis von ICH-GCP, EU CTR und lokalen regulatorischen Umgebungen. Ein professionelles und praktisches Verständnis der ukrainischen Gesetzgebung, des Betriebs und des regulatorischen Umfelds (einschließlich Arzneimitteln und Medizinprodukten) ist obligatorisch.

• Sie haben ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, zwischenmenschliche und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit einer kollaborativen Denkweise.

• Sie sind in der Lage, unabhängig und verantwortungsvoll zu arbeiten, in Bezug auf gemeinsame Werte und Ziele.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Chez Roche/Genentech Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), nous sommes déterminés à transformer le développement des médicaments et à réaliser notre ambition Pharma pour fournir 20 médicaments transformatifs qui s'attaquent aux maladies qui ont le fardeau sociétal le plus élevé d'ici 2029.
En tant que membre clé de notre équipe de démarrage de l'étude de pays, vous piloterez et faciliterez le lancement efficace des essais cliniques, aidant finalement à fournir des traitements innovants aux patients. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement hautement collaboratif et interfonctionnel, où vous aurez l'occasion d'influencer et de façonner notre stratégie de prestation des essais cliniques. C'est une occasion unique d'utiliser votre expertise pour avoir un impact significatif en assurant une exécution d'essai transparente pour les patients, les chercheurs et le personnel du site clinique.
Gestion des fournisseurs
Le rôle

• Stratégie de pays chef de file : Vous dirigerez la stratégie de pays pour le démarrage des études, l'efficacité, l'innovation et la collaboration avec les parties prenantes externes.

• Superviser les opérations : Vous dirigerez les opérations de démarrage pour assurer l'activation du site en temps opportun et efficace et la conformité réglementaire.

• Amélioration des processus : Vous identifierez et dirigerez les possibilités d'automatisation des processus, de normalisation et d'innovation au niveau du pays et du site.

• Collaborer et harmoniser : Vous collaborerez avec des homologues locaux, régionaux et mondiaux pour harmoniser les systèmes et améliorer les délais.

• Gérer les présentations d'essais cliniques : Vous dirigerez l'élaboration et la gestion des présentations et des modifications d'essais cliniques, en assurant la coordination réglementaire.

• Stratégisez sur le budget et les marchés : Vous assurerez la supervision stratégique et l'exécution opérationnelle de tous les aspects de la budgétisation et de la gestion des contrats, y compris l'élaboration de stratégies budgétaires et la négociation avec les intervenants internes et externes.

• Influence sur l'environnement : Vous participerez à des collaborations industrielles externes pour influencer l'environnement de démarrage du pays.

• Gestion des paiements et des fournisseurs : Superviser et gérer stratégiquement les processus de paiement sur place, les escalades budgétaires, les rapports financiers et le rapprochement des activités financières. Contribuer à la gestion des fournisseurs locaux (à l'exclusion des ORC) au besoin pour appuyer les activités du site.

• Gérer l'accès après le procès Présentations et exécution : Vous dirigerez l'élaboration et la gestion des présentations et des modifications d'accès après le procès, en assurant leur planification stratégique et leur exécution conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux procédures locales.

• Diriger une équipe (le cas échéant): Si vous êtes un chef de file, vous fournirez un encadrement, un soutien et un leadership à une équipe, en défendant des comportements inclusifs et en les aidant à développer leurs compétences et leur carrière.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en sciences de la vie ou d'un domaine connexe (MD, doctorat, MA/MS, BA/BS). Un diplôme de troisième cycle est hautement souhaitable.

• Vous avez fait preuve d'une solide expérience dans le démarrage des essais cliniques, les présentations réglementaires et la collaboration interfonctionnelle (au moins 4 ans d'expérience pertinente des essais cliniques).

• Vous avez une bonne compréhension des environnements ICH-GPC, CTR de l'UE et de la réglementation locale. Une compréhension adéquate et pratique de la législation, des opérations et des environnements réglementaires ukrainiens relatifs aux essais cliniques (y compris les médicaments et les dispositifs médicaux) est obligatoire.

• Vous avez une excellente capacité de communication, interpersonnelle et de résolution de problèmes, avec un état d'esprit collaboratif.

• Vous pouvez travailler de façon indépendante et responsable, en ce qui concerne les valeurs et les objectifs communs.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - DIA R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, translating complex technical concepts into successful solutions addressing problems across R&D laboratories. Your responsibilities will span the entire solution lifecycle, from design to implementation, ensuring solutions meet high-performance standards and security requirements. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of enterprise IT landscapes, driving digital transformation and operational efficiency for organizations across various industries.

The Opportunity

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Solution Design: Architect scalable, secure and cost-effective solutions tailored to business needs.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Understand technical opportunities to improve business value. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value.

Who you are
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

• Hands on experience in creating PoCs

• Previous experience collaborating with R&D users preferred

Technical Skills

• Modern architecture practices, including effective use of non functional requirements

jobs.title: Expert Transport et Distribution (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

En tant qu'Expert Transport et Distribution (d/f/m), vous reportez directement au Responsable Supply Chain, au sein d'une équipe aux compétences et expertises variées.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous êtes garant(e) de la qualité des services logistiques et de transport en adéquation avec nos offres clients, et veillez à fournir le niveau de service attendu par nos clients au meilleur coût, tout en respectant les réglementations et les normes de qualité de Roche.

• Vous assurez la gestion des prestataires de logistique et de transport, y compris les appels d'offres, l'évaluation de la qualité de service, les audits, en collaboration avec les équipes d'achats globales/locales et les équipes opérationnelles locales.

• Vous garantissez la satisfaction client et gérez les réclamations clients liées à la livraison.

• Vous gérez le budget : prévisions budgétaires, suivi mensuel, optimisation des coûts de transport et des prestations logistiques.

• Vous veillez au respect des réglementations locales et internationales en matière de transport, ainsi qu'aux normes de qualité de Roche et aux formations associées pour les équipes de la Supply Chain. Vous gérez les réglementations douanières et fiscales pour les importations et les exportations; les réglementations liées au transport de matières dangereuses (IATA/ADR) et le rapport annuel TMD.

• Vous maîtrisez particulièrement les notions douanières touchant aux DROM.

• Vous êtes responsable de l'aspect Transport/Distribution lors des audits (Qualité, Douane, Comptable, RSE, etc.) et êtes le contact privilégié pour le module Qualité (qualification des itinéraires logistiques, qualification des prestataires et gestion des contraintes de température, etc.).

• Vous assurez l'alignement et la cohérence des stratégies globales et régionales sur le sujet "Entrepôt et distribution", dirigez et participez à des projets logistiques de transport et de distribution pour la région EMEA LATAM

• Vous avez également le rôle d’export control officer en relation avec le Groupe

• Enfin, vous contribuez à la définition de la politique RSE et des indicateurs de performance correspondants pour le transport/logistique et êtes force de proposition dans l'amélioration continue du service.

Qui vous êtes:

• Diplômé(e) universitaire en logistique, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine équivalent.

• Vous disposez d'une solide expérience dans la gestion logistique et du transport et de solides connaissances des réglementations locales et internationales en matière de transport.

• Vous avez une expérience des réglementations douanières (particulièrement flux DROM) et fiscales pour les importations et les exportations. Vous êtes familier(ère) avec les réglementations de transport des matières dangereuses (IATA/ADR) et le rapport annuel TMD, vous avez les certifications nécessaires en lien.

• Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences en gestion de projet et avez une capacité avérée à collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires.

• Vous avez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, des compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles.

• Enfin, votre niveau d'anglais et de français est courant

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people tre

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che vantate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete stimati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di tre sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui amiamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Come esperto di trasporto e distribuzione (d/f/m), si segnala direttamente al responsabile della supply chain, all'interno di un team con varie competenze e competenze.

Le vostre principali responsabilità:

• Siete il garante della qualità dei servizi logistici e di trasporto in linea con le nostre offerte dei clienti, e assicuratevi di fornire il livello di servizio previsto dai nostri clienti al miglior costo, rispettando le normative e gli standard di qualità di Roche.

• Gestisci fornitori di logistica e trasporti, tra cui l'offerta, la qualità della valutazione dei servizi, gli audit, in collaborazione con team di approvvigionamento globale/locale e team operativi locali.

• Garantisci la soddisfazione del cliente e gestisci le richieste dei clienti relative alla consegna.

• Gestisci il bilancio: previsioni di bilancio, monitoraggio mensile, ottimizzazione dei costi di trasporto e servizi logistici.

• Garantisci la conformità alle normative locali e internazionali sui trasporti, nonché agli standard di qualità Roche e alla formazione associata per i team di Supply Chain. Gestisci i regolamenti doganali e fiscali per le importazioni e le esportazioni; Regolamento relativo al trasporto di merci pericolose (IATA/ADR) e alla relazione annuale TDG.

• Lei conosce particolarmente i concetti doganali relativi ai DROM.

• L'utente è responsabile dell'aspetto dei trasporti/distribuzione durante gli audit (Qualità, Dogana, Contabile, CSR, ecc.) e è il contatto preferito per il modulo Qualità (qualifica delle rotte logistiche, qualifica dei fornitori di servizi e gestione dei vincoli di temperatura, ecc.).

• Garantisci l'allineamento e la coerenza delle strategie globali e regionali in materia di "warehouse e distribuzione", guidare e partecipare a progetti di trasporto e distribuzione logistica per la regione EMEA LATAM

• Ha anche il ruolo di responsabile del controllo delle esportazioni in relazione al Gruppo

• Infine, si contribuisce alla definizione della politica CSR e dei corrispondenti indicatori di performance per i trasporti/logistici e sono la forza trainante per il continuo miglioramento del servizio.

Chi sei:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive End-to-End asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Department, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Define and lead advanced drug design, optimisation strategies, and comprehensive compound profiling, integrating cutting-edge DMPK principles with target biology validation and complex translational PK/PD concepts.

• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.

• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Direct advanced M&S activities (including complex PKPD, PBPK, DDI, and sophisticated human dose/regimen prediction) to critically inform and de-risk projects from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early and late-stage clinical development (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.

• Implementation & Innovation: Pioneer and oversee the implementation of robust biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close partnership with key stakeholders to maximise patient safety and therapeutic benefit.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships.

Who You Are

• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 15 - 20 years of post-PhD progressive industry experience in a senior pharmacokinetic-related role.

• You possess deep, comprehensive expertise across the entire discovery, preclinical and develop

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità.

All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo di asset End-to-End attraverso l'intera catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto del mercato. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani.

L'opportunità

Come leader di progetto DMPK-PD esperto all'interno del Dipartimento DMPK-PD Traduzionale, sarete fondamentali per garantire che il farmaco giusto viene consegnato alla dose giusta, in modo sicuro ed efficace ai pazienti. Condurrai strategie non cliniche e traduttive, collaborando in aree terapeutiche per trasformare le ipotesi scientifiche in candidati clinici innovativi.

I vostri impatti e responsabilità:

• Leadership strategica: Definire e condurre la progettazione avanzata della droga, strategie di ottimizzazione e profilazione completa dei composti, integrando i principi DMPK all'avanguardia con la convalida della biologia di destinazione e concetti di PK/PD traduttivi complessi.

• Esperienza traduttiva: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, guidare i team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di sofisticate strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione target, sfruttando la conoscenza biochimica e farmacologica profonda.

• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): attività M&S avanzate dirette (comprese PKPD complessi, PBPK, DDI e sofisticate predizioni dose/regimen umane) per informare criticamente e de-rischiare i progetti da Lead Optimisation (LO) attraverso lo sviluppo clinico precoce e di fine fase (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Mastery di regolamentazione: Autore e presente valutazioni scientifiche definitive e di alta qualità dei dati DMPK non clinici per le recensioni critiche dei programmi interni e tutte le principali sottomissioni normative esterne (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assicurando la conformità globale e tempi accelerati.

• Attuazione e innovazione: Pioneer e supervisionare l'implementazione di robuste strategie biomarcatrici e bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con le principali parti interessate per massimizzare la sicurezza dei pazienti e il beneficio terapeutico.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion trasparente, data-driven decision-making, agendo come consulente affidabile e coltivando relazioni professionali di alta fiducia in team di progetto globali, enti di governance e partnership esterne.

Chi sei

• Hai un PharmD o un PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia, Bioingegneria o simili, accoppiato con oltre 15 - 20 anni di esperienza post-PhD nell'industria progressiva in un ruolo legato alla farmacocinetica senior.

• Possiedi competenze profonde e complete in tutta la scoperta, preclinica e sviluppare

Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie.

A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité, pharmacologie translationnelle et biomarqueurs — nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, de l'évaluation des cibles au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain.

L'opportunité

En tant que chef de projet expérimenté de la DMPK-PD au sein du département de la DMPK-PD translationnel, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour vous assurer que le bon médicament est livré à la bonne dose, en toute sécurité et efficacement aux patients. Vous dirigerez des stratégies non cliniques et translationnelles, en collaborant dans des domaines thérapeutiques pour transformer des hypothèses scientifiques en candidats cliniques révolutionnaires.

Votre impact et vos responsabilités :

• Leadership stratégique: Définir et diriger la conception avancée de médicaments, les stratégies d'optimisation et le profilage complet des composés, en intégrant les principes de pointe de DMPK avec la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/PD translationnels complexes.

• Expertise translationnelle : servir d'expert en la matière, guider les équipes de découverte précoce dans l'élaboration de stratégies translationnelles sophistiquées pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible, en tirant parti de connaissances biochimiques et pharmacologiques profondes.

• Modélisation et simulation avancées (M&S) : Diriger les activités de M&S avancées (y compris la PKPD complexe, la PBPK, l'IDD et la prédiction sophistiquée des doses/régimes humains) afin d'informer de façon critique les projets d'optimisation du plomb et de les éliminer jusqu'au développement clinique en début et en fin de développement (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Maîtrise de la réglementation : Auteur et présentation d'évaluations scientifiques définitives et de haute qualité des données DMPK non cliniques pour les examens internes critiques des programmes et toutes les principales présentations de réglementation externe (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assurant la conformité mondiale et des délais accélérés.

• Implementation & Innovation: Pioneer et superviser la mise en œuvre de stratégies biomarqueurs et bioanalytiques robustes en partenariat étroit avec les principales parties prenantes afin de maximiser la sécurité des patients et les avantages thérapeutiques.

• Influence interfonctionnelle : Championne, prise de décision transparente et axée sur les données, agissant comme conseiller de confiance et cultivant des relations professionnelles de haute confiance entre les équipes de projet mondiales, les organismes de gouvernance et les partenariats externes.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie, bioingénierie ou similaire, associé à plus de 15 à 20 années d'expérience de l'industrie progressive post-PhD dans un rôle pharmacocinétique supérieur.

• Vous possédez une expertise approfondie et complète dans toute la découverte, préclinique et développer

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), located in Basel, Switzerland, focuses on the discovery and early development of innovative treatments for specific diseases that affect the lives of millions. In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

We are seeking an experienced Research Associate with a strong industry background to join our Cardiovascular and Metabolic Diseases (CVM) in vitro department. In this role, you will design and execute in-vitro experiments using complex cellular models to evaluate the efficacy and safety of novel therapeutic candidates for cardiovascular and metabolic diseases.

The opportunity

• Cultivation of primary cell lines from human and animal tissues, optimizing protocols for primary cell isolation, differentiation and maintenance.

• Execution of functional cell based and enzymatic assays to study metabolic pathways and other relevant metabolic pathways related readouts e.g. lipolysis, glucose uptake, cAMP signaling

• Experience in advanced cellular and biochemical techniques, such as cell painting, and metabolic flux analysis using Seahorse to evaluate cellular bioenergetics.

• Strong knowledge of standard molecular biology techniques such as qPCR, Western Blot, Immunohistochemistry.

• Analyze experimental data with statistical tools, preparing high-quality reports and presentations to communicate findings effectively.

• Experience with animal handling, treatment and functional metabolic experimentation is advantageous

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in biology, biochemistry, or a related field, or have completed vocational training in biology. A minimum of 3 years in a pharma industry laboratory setting is required.

• You are proficient in cell culture, molecular biology, and biochemical techniques and are familiar with metabolic and/or cardiovascular cellular models.

• You communicate effectively in English, both in writing and orally. Skillfully able to interact with people and have strong commitment to teamwork.

• Strong organizational skills, excellent data management and record-keeping skills are required.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Nella zona cardiovascolare e metabolismo, stiamo sviluppando terapie all'avanguardia per il trattamento delle malattie metaboliche.

Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Research Associate con un forte background industriale per unire le nostre Malattie cardiovascolari e metaboliche (CVM) in reparto vitro. • Forte conoscenza delle tecniche di biologia molecolare standard come qPCR, Western Blot, Immunohistochemistry.

• Analizzare i dati sperimentali con strumenti statistici, preparare report e presentazioni di alta qualità per comunicare efficacemente i risultati.

• Esperienza con gestione degli animali, trattamento e sperimentazione metabolica funzionale è vantaggiosa

Chi sei:

• Hai una laurea o master in biologia, biochimica, o un campo correlato, o hai completato la formazione professionale in biologia. È richiesto un minimo di 3 anni in un ambiente di laboratorio dell'industria farmaceutica.

• Siete abili nella cultura cellulare, nella biologia molecolare e nelle tecniche biochimiche e conoscete i modelli cellulari metabolici e/o cardiovascolari.

• Si comunica efficacemente in inglese, sia per iscritto che per via orale. Abilmente in grado di interagire con le persone e avere un forte impegno per il lavoro di squadra.

• Sono necessarie forti capacità organizzative, eccellenti capacità di gestione dei dati e di registrazione.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI) mit Sitz in Basel, Schweiz, konzentriert sich auf die Entdeckung und frühzeitige Entwicklung innovativer Behandlungen für spezifische Krankheiten, die das Leben von Millionen Menschen beeinflussen. Im kardiovaskulären und metabolischen Bereich entwickeln wir innovative Therapien zur Behandlung von Stoffwechselerkrankungen.

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Research Associate mit einem starken Branchenhintergrund, um unserer In-vitro-Abteilung für Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen (CVM) beizutreten. In dieser Rolle entwerfen und führen Sie In-vitro-Experimente mit komplexen Zellmodellen durch, um die Wirksamkeit und Sicherheit neuartiger therapeutischer Kandidaten für Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen zu bewerten.

Die Chance

• Kultivierung von Primärzelllinien aus menschlichem und tierischem Gewebe, Optimierung von Protokollen für die Isolierung, Differenzierung und Wartung von Primärzellen.

• Durchführung von funktionellen zellbasierten und enzymatischen Assays zur Untersuchung von Stoffwechselwegen und anderen relevanten Stoffwechselwegen, z. B. Lipolyse, Glukoseaufnahme, cAMP-Signalisierung

• Erfahrung in fortgeschrittenen zellulären und biochemischen Techniken wie Zellmalerei und metabolische Flussanalyse mit Seahorse zur Bewertung der zellulären Bioenergetik.

• Ein fundiertes Wissen über standardisierte molekularbiologische Techniken wie qPCR, Western Blot, Immunhistochemie.

• Analysieren Sie experimentelle Daten mit statistischen Tools und erstellen Sie qualitativ hochwertige Berichte und Präsentationen, um die Ergebnisse effektiv zu kommunizieren.

• Erfahrungen mit Tierhandhabung, -behandlung und funktionellen Stoffwechselexperimenten sind von Vorteil

Wer du bist:

• Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Biologie, Biochemie oder einem verwandten Bereich oder haben eine berufliche Ausbildung in Biologie abgeschlossen. Ein Minimum von 3 Jahren in einem Labor der Pharmaindustrie ist erforderlich.

• Sie beherrschen Zellkultur, Molekularbiologie und biochemische Techniken und sind mit metabolischen und / oder kardiovaskulären Zellmodellen vertraut.

• Sie kommunizieren effektiv auf Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich. Geschickt in der Lage, mit Menschen zu interagieren und haben ein starkes Engagement für Teamarbeit.

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten, ausgezeichnetes Datenmanagement und Aufzeichnungsfähigkeiten sind erforderlich.

Bei Roche streben wir nach lebensverändernden Gesundheitslösungen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf Patienten und Gesundheitssysteme weltweit zu machen, ist dies der richtige Ort für Sie.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie.

pRED Cardiopathie & Métabolisme, Immunologie (CMI), située à Bâle, Suisse, se concentre sur la découverte et le développement précoce de traitements innovants pour des maladies spécifiques qui affectent la vie de millions de personnes. Dans le domaine cardiovasculaire et métabolique, nous développons des thérapies de pointe pour traiter les maladies métaboliques.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un associé de recherche expérimenté avec une solide expérience de l'industrie pour rejoindre notre département des maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques (CVM) in vitro. Dans ce rôle, vous concevez et exécutez des expériences in vitro à l'aide de modèles cellulaires complexes pour évaluer l'efficacité et la sécurité des nouveaux candidats thérapeutiques pour les maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques.

L'opportunité

• Culture de lignées cellulaires primaires à partir de tissus humains et animaux, optimisation des protocoles d'isolement, de différenciation et d'entretien des cellules primaires.

• Exécution d'essais fonctionnels basés sur des cellules et enzymatiques pour étudier les voies métaboliques et d'autres voies métaboliques pertinentes liées à la lecture, p.ex. lipolyse, absorption de glucose, signalisation de l'AMPc

• Expérience en techniques cellulaires et biochimiques avancées, comme la peinture cellulaire, et l'analyse des flux métaboliques en utilisant Seahorse pour évaluer la bioénergétique cellulaire.

• Forte connaissance des techniques de biologie moléculaire standard telles que qPCR, Western Blot, Immunohistochimie.

• Analyser les données expérimentales à l'aide d'outils statistiques, préparer des rapports et des présentations de haute qualité pour communiquer efficacement les résultats.

• Expérience de la manipulation animale, du traitement et de l'expérimentation métabolique fonctionnelle est avantageux

Qui vous êtes :

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en biologie, en biochimie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou avez suivi une formation professionnelle en biologie. Un minimum de 3 ans dans un laboratoire de l'industrie pharmaceutique est requis.

• Vous maîtrisez la culture cellulaire, la biologie moléculaire et les techniques biochimiques et vous connaissez les modèles cellulaires métaboliques et/ou cardiovasculaires.

• Vous communiquez efficacement en anglais, tant par écrit que oralement. Aptitude à interagir avec les gens et engagement ferme envers le travail d'équipe.

• De solides compétences organisationnelles, d'excellentes compétences en gestion des données et en tenue de dossiers sont nécessaires.

Chez Roche, nous nous efforçons de fournir des solutions de soins de santé qui changent la vie. Si vous êtes prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur les patients et les systèmes de santé dans le monde, c'est l'endroit pour vous.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

La posizione
Cosa aspettarsi:
Il Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale è responsabile del servizio clienti tecnico-applicativo specifico per sistemi di analisi e reagenti del portafoglio prodotti Roche. In qualità di Senior Application Specialist (m/f/d), sei il contatto diretto per le richieste relative alle applicazioni dei nostri rappresentanti di vendita e dei nostri clienti negli ospedali, nella ricerca e nei laboratori privati.

Come Senior Application Specialist, hai i seguenti compiti:

• Sei responsabile dell'applicazione di supporto dei prodotti Roche Diagnostics Sequencing al fine di garantire la disponibilità dei sistemi e la qualità dei risultati per i nostri clienti nazionali e internazionali.

• Si informano i clienti sui risultati attuali di sviluppo e sui cambiamenti di prodotto derivati da loro.

• In collaborazione con le organizzazioni dei paesi e le unità globali, si raccolgono e si elaborano reclami.

• Condurrai sia la formazione dei clienti che dei dipendenti nel Customer Support Center e con i clienti.

• Quando risolve i problemi, supporta anche le nostre organizzazioni di paese sul sito.

• Monitorate i nostri processi di servizio e la qualità generale del prodotto/sistema.

Chi sei:

• Hai completato con successo uno studio di biologia e idealmente continuato con un dottorato.

• Hai almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale in una struttura di ricerca o servizio dove hai acquisito una conoscenza approfondita delle tecnologie di sequenziamento di prossima generazione.

• L'esperienza nella creazione di flussi di lavoro NGS su vari sistemi di gestione dei liquidi è un vantaggio.

• Siete motivati a viaggiare – anche a breve termine – verso altri paesi europei.

• Hai una buona conoscenza del mercato IVD e un sano background scientifico in genomica e oncologia così come nell'ambiente del prodotto e del mercato.

• È possibile analizzare rapidamente i problemi e presentare una soluzione adeguata.

• Hai già lavorato in progetti e hai esperienza nella gestione dei progetti.

• Ti piace lavorare in un team interculturale e sei un contatto competente per clienti e colleghi.

• Lei parla inglese fluente; La conoscenza del tedesco è un vantaggio.

The Position
What to expect:
The Regional Customer Support Center is responsible for technical and application-related customer service specifically for analysis systems and reagents from the Roche product portfolio. As a Senior Application Specialist (m/f/d), you are the direct contact for application-related inquiries from our sales representatives and our customers in hospitals, research and private laboratories.

As a Senior Application Specialist, you have the following tasks:

• You are responsible for the application support of Roche Diagnostics Sequencing products with the aim of ensuring the availability of the systems and the quality of the results for our national and international customers.

• You inform customers about current development results and product changes derived from them.

• You work in the area of Next Generation Sequencing to solve problems and advise our customers.

• You will process telephone and written requests from customers and Roche employees in EMEA countries.

• In cooperation with the country organizations and global units, you collect and process complaints.

• You will conduct both customer and employee training in the Customer Support Center and with customers.

• When solving problems, you also support our country organizations on site.

• You monitor our service processes and general product/system quality.

Who you are:

• You have successfully completed a study of biology and ideally continued with a doctorate.

• You have at least 3 years of professional experience in a research or service facility where you have acquired in-depth knowledge of next generation sequencing technologies.

• Experience in establishing NGS workflows on various liquid handling systems is an advantage.

• You are motivated to travel – also in the short term – to other European countries.

• You have a good knowledge of the IVD market as well as a sound scientific background in genomics and oncology as well as in the product and market environment.

• You can quickly analyze problems and present an adequate solution.

• You have already worked in projects and have experience in project management.

• You enjoy working in an intercultural team and are a competent contact for customers and colleagues.

• You speak fluent English; Knowledge of German is an advantage.

• Vous surveillez nos processus de service et la qualité générale des produits/systèmes.

Qui vous êtes :

• Vous avez réussi une étude de biologie et idéalement poursuivi avec un doctorat.

• Vous avez au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans une installation de recherche ou de service où vous avez acquis une connaissance approfondie des technologies de séquençage de la prochaine génération.

• L'expérience dans l'établissement de flux de travail NGS sur divers systèmes de traitement des liquides est un avantage.

• Vous êtes motivé à voyager – aussi à court terme – vers d'autres pays européens.

• Vous avez une bonne connaissance du marché des DIV ainsi qu'une solide expérience scientifique en génomique et oncologie ainsi que dans l'environnement des produits et des marchés.

• Vous pouvez rapidement analyser les problèmes et présenter une solution adéquate.

• Vous avez déjà travaillé dans des projets et avez de l'expérience en gestion de projet.

• Vous aimez travailler dans une équipe interculturelle et êtes un contact compétent pour les clients et les collègues.

• Vous parlez couramment anglais; la connaissance de l'allemand est un avantage.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), located in Basel, Switzerland, focuses on the discovery and early development of innovative treatments for specific diseases that affect the lives of millions. In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

We are currently looking for a diligent and highly motivated Research Associate with a strong industry background to join our Cardiovascular and Metabolic Diseases (CVM) in-vivo pharmacology department . In this role, you will design and execute in-vivo experiments in rodents to evaluate the pharmacodynamics, efficacy and safety of novel therapeutic candidates for cardiovascular and metabolic diseases.

The opportunity

• Establish, validate and use disease relevant rodent models (e.g., obesity and diabetes) and readouts to support various drug discovery projects.

• Collaboratively design and execute in-vivo studies, and interpret data from in-vivo experiments to assess the pharmacodynamics and therapeutic efficacy of novel compounds.

• Support the development and characterization of novel in-vivo models for obesity-related comorbidities.

• Diligently follow national and international animal welfare laws, and align with the company's commitment to the 3Rs (Replace, Reduce, Refine).

• Continuously improve test systems, analyses, and data evaluation. Contribute to work process optimization including data capture, storage and assay automation.

• Work closely with all members of the group, share duties, maintain a clean work environment and actively contribute to the positive work atmosphere within the group.

Who You Are

• MSc/BSc in Life Sciences or completion of an apprenticeship for a research associate (“Lehrabschluss”)(no PhD) with at least 3 years of industry experience working with in-vivo models.

• Mouse work experience required; managing animal cohorts, injections via various routes, behavioral assays, mouse monitoring, tissue sampling and processing.

• LTK1 or equivalent is required.

• Experience in rodent models of obesity and functional readouts, such as glucose and insulin tolerance tests, body composition analysis, whole-body metabolism (Promethion), blood pressure.

• You communicate effectively in English, both in writing and orally. Skillfully able to interact with people and have strong commitment to teamwork.

• Excellent data management and record-keeping skills are required.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore n

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), situato a Basilea, Svizzera, si concentra sulla scoperta e lo sviluppo precoce di trattamenti innovativi per malattie specifiche che influiscono sulla vita di milioni di persone. Nella zona cardiovascolare e metabolismo, stiamo sviluppando terapie all'avanguardia per il trattamento delle malattie metaboliche.

Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di una ricerca diligente e altamente motivata Associata con un forte background industriale per aderire al nostro dipartimento di farmacologia cardiovascolare e metabolica (CVM). In questo ruolo, progettare ed eseguire esperimenti in-vivo in roditori per valutare la farmacodinamica, l'efficacia e la sicurezza di nuovi candidati terapeutici per le malattie cardiovascolari e metaboliche.

L'opportunità

• Stabilire, convalidare e utilizzare i modelli di roditori rilevanti (ad esempio, obesità e diabete) e le letture per sostenere vari progetti di scoperta della droga.

• Collaborativamente progettare ed eseguire studi in-vivo, e interpretare i dati da esperimenti in-vivo per valutare la farmacodinamica e l'efficacia terapeutica di nuovi composti.

• Sostenere lo sviluppo e la caratterizzazione di nuovi modelli in-vivo per le comorbidità legate all'obesità.

• Diligentemente seguire le leggi nazionali e internazionali sul benessere degli animali, e allineare con l'impegno dell'azienda ai 3R (Sostituire, Ridurre, Raffinare).

• Migliorare costantemente i sistemi di prova, le analisi e la valutazione dei dati. Contribuisci all'ottimizzazione dei processi di lavoro, tra cui l'acquisizione dei dati, l'archiviazione e l'automazione del test.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con tutti i membri del gruppo, condividere i doveri, mantenere un ambiente di lavoro pulito e contribuire attivamente all'atmosfera di lavoro positiva all'interno del gruppo.

Chi sei

• MSc/BSc in Scienze della Vita o il completamento di un apprendistato per un socio di ricerca (“Lehrabschluss”)(no PhD) con almeno 3 anni di esperienza industriale che lavorano con modelli in-vivo.

• Esperienza di lavoro del mouse necessaria; gestione coorte animali, iniezioni attraverso vari percorsi, saggi comportamentali, monitoraggio del mouse, campionamento del tessuto e l'elaborazione.

• LTK1 o equivalente è richiesto.

• Esperienza nei modelli roditori di obesità e riletture funzionali, come test di tolleranza al glucosio e all'insulina, analisi della composizione del corpo, metabolismo del corpo intero (Prometion), pressione sanguigna.

• Si comunica efficacemente in inglese, sia per iscritto che per via orale. Abilmente in grado di interagire con le persone e avere un forte impegno per il lavoro di squadra.

• Sono necessarie eccellenti capacità di gestione dei dati e di registrazione.

A Roche, ci proponiamo di offrire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita. Se siete pronti a fare un impatto significativo su pazienti e sistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo, questo è il posto per voi.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare n

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI) mit Sitz in Basel, Schweiz, konzentriert sich auf die Entdeckung und frühzeitige Entwicklung innovativer Behandlungen für spezifische Krankheiten, die das Leben von Millionen Menschen beeinflussen. Im kardiovaskulären und metabolischen Bereich entwickeln wir innovative Therapien zur Behandlung von Stoffwechselerkrankungen.

Wir suchen derzeit einen fleißigen und hochmotivierten Research Associate mit einem starken Branchenhintergrund, um unserer In-vivo-Pharmakologieabteilung für Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen (CVM) beizutreten. In dieser Rolle entwerfen und führen Sie In-vivo-Experimente an Nagetieren durch, um die Pharmakodynamik, Wirksamkeit und Sicherheit neuer therapeutischer Kandidaten für Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen zu bewerten.

Die Chance

• Etablieren, validieren und verwenden Sie krankheitsrelevante Nagetiermodelle (z. B. Fettleibigkeit und Diabetes) und Anzeigen zur Unterstützung verschiedener Arzneimittelforschungsprojekte.

• Konzipieren und führen Sie gemeinsam In-vivo-Studien durch und interpretieren Sie Daten aus In-vivo-Experimenten, um die Pharmakodynamik und therapeutische Wirksamkeit neuer Verbindungen zu bewerten.

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung und Charakterisierung neuer In-vivo-Modelle für Adipositas-bezogene Komorbiditäten.

• Befolgen Sie die nationalen und internationalen Tierschutzgesetze und stimmen Sie mit dem Engagement des Unternehmens für die 3Rs (Replace, Reduce, Refine) überein.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Testsystemen, Analysen und Datenauswertung. Tragen Sie zur Optimierung des Arbeitsprozesses bei, einschließlich Datenerfassung, Speicherung und Assay-Automatisierung.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit allen Mitgliedern der Gruppe zusammen, teilen Sie Aufgaben, pflegen Sie ein sauberes Arbeitsumfeld und tragen Sie aktiv zur positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre innerhalb der Gruppe bei.

Wer du bist

• MSc / BSc in Life Sciences oder Abschluss einer Lehre für einen wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeiter ("Lehrabschluss") (keine Promotion) mit mindestens 3 Jahren Branchenerfahrung in der Arbeit mit in-vivo-Modellen.

• Maus-Arbeitserfahrung erforderlich; Verwaltung von Tierkohorten, Injektionen über verschiedene Routen, Verhaltenstests, Mausüberwachung, Gewebeentnahme und Verarbeitung.

• LTK1 oder gleichwertig ist erforderlich.

• Erfahrung in Nagetiermodellen von Fettleibigkeit und funktionellen Anzeigen wie Glukose- und Insulintoleranztests, Körperzusammensetzungsanalyse, Ganzkörpermetabolismus (Promethion), Blutdruck.

• Sie kommunizieren effektiv auf Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich. Geschickt in der Lage, mit Menschen zu interagieren und haben ein starkes Engagement für Teamarbeit.

• Hervorragende Datenmanagement- und Aufzeichnungsfähigkeiten sind erforderlich.
