Stiamo cercando uno scienziato altamente motivato Discovery con competenza specializzata nella retina neurale e patologia retinica, tra cui processi come l'infiammazione, disfunzione vascolare, ischemia, fibrosi e neurodegenerazione, per guidare i nostri sforzi di scoperta della droga di fase precoce.

L'opportunità:

In questo ruolo, le tue responsabilità chiave includono, ma non sono limitate a:

• Identificazione e convalida del bersaglio: Utilizzare e stabilire modelli avanzati in vitro e in vivo di malattia oculare, e sfruttare i dataset campione dei pazienti disponibili per identificare, convalidare e caratterizzare nuovi obiettivi terapeutici della droga.

• Sviluppo dell'approccio terapeutico: dentifico e valuto le modalità terapeutiche ottimali per gli obiettivi selezionati.

• Leadership del progetto: guidare e gestire in modo indipendente i progetti di scoperta della droga dall'avvio del bersaglio attraverso le prime fasi di sviluppo clinico (fino alla prontezza della fase II).

• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: Partner con team interdisciplinari attraverso pRED (compresa la bioinformatica, la sicurezza e la medicina traduttiva) per avanzare programmi di pipeline.

• Collaborazione esterna: avviare e condurre progetti di collaborazione esterna per rafforzare gli sforzi interni. Gestisci le attività CRO, tra cui la progettazione del progetto, le linee temporali e la qualità dei prodotti.

• Comunicazione scientifica: I risultati attuali della ricerca in riunioni decisionali interne, autore di pubblicazioni ad alto impatto in riviste peer-reviewed di alto livello, e rappresentano Roche in conferenze scientifiche internazionali.

• Discovery Lab Management: Supporto e coordinate di sicurezza, salute e processi ambientali in laboratorio.

Voi che siete:

• Hai un dottorato in Biologia, Neuroscienze, Biochimica, o una disciplina relativa delle scienze della vita.

• Hai completato una Fellowship Postdoctoral in Vision Research, Neural Retina, Ophthalmology, o un campo strettamente correlato.

• Porti una conoscenza completa della biologia della retina neurale e dei meccanismi che stanno alla base della patogenesi della malattia retina, insieme ad una comprovata traccia di esperimenti con modelli di angiogenesi oculare, fibrosi, infiammazione o neurodegenerazione.

• Hai un'esperienza diretta nella gestione degli animali e/o nelle procedure oculari, O dimostrato esperienza nello sviluppo di nuovi sistemi di modelli 2D/3D, come organoidi o organ-on-a-chip. Porti anche l'esperienza nella cultura cellulare/materiale, tecnologie -omics e/o strumenti bioinformatici di base.

• Lei dimostra eccellenti capacità organizzative, scritture discografiche rigorose, eccezionale comunicazione orale e scritta inglese, e una forte mentalità collaborativa in un ambiente frenetico.

• Porti 2–3 anni di esperienza professionale aggiuntiva in ambienti di scoperta di farmaci accademici o di settore, insieme a un comprovato track record di progetti di ricerca e team di progetto interfunzionali e un forte record di pubblicazione in top-tier vision o riviste scientifiche.

• Hai una rete professionale consolidata all'interno della comunità globale di ricerca di oftalmologia.

A Roche, ci proponiamo di offrire soluzioni sanitarie in continuo cambiamento. Se siete pronti a fare un impatto significativo su pazienti e sistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo, questo è il posto per voi.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Ophthalmology team in Basel focuses on discovering novel therapeutic approaches for major eye diseases, encompassing dry AMD/geographic atrophy and neovascular forms, as well as diabetic retinopathy, and other retinal vascular diseases. We are seeking a highly motivated Discovery Scientist with specialized expertise in the neural retina and retinal pathology, including processes such as inflammation, vascular dysfunction, ischemia, fibrosis, and neurodegeneration, to drive our early-stage drug discovery efforts.

The opportunity:

In this role, your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Target Identification & Validation: Utilize and establish advanced in vitro and in vivo models of ocular disease, and leverage available patient sample datasets to identify, validate, and characterize novel therapeutic drug targets.

• Therapeutic Approach Development: I dentify and evaluate optimal therapeutic modalities for selected targets.

• Project Leadership: Independently lead and manage drug discovery projects from target initiation through early clinical development stages (up to Phase II readiness).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with interdisciplinary teams across pRED (including bioinformatics, safety, and translational medicine) to advance pipeline programs.

• External Collaboration: Initiating and leading external collaboration projects to bolster internal efforts. Manage CRO activities, including project design, timelines, and quality of deliverables.

• Scientific Communication: Present research findings at internal decision-making meetings, author high-impact publications in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, and represent Roche at international scientific conferences.

• Discovery Lab Management: Support and coordinate safety, health, and environmental processes in the lab.

You who are:

• You hold a PhD in Biology, Neuroscience, Biochemistry, or a related life sciences discipline.

• You have completed a Postdoctoral Fellowship in Vision Research, Neural Retina, Ophthalmology, or a closely related field.

• You bring comprehensive knowledge of neural retina biology and the mechanisms underlying retinal disease pathogenesis, together with a proven track record of conducting experiments using models of ocular angiogenesis, fibrosis, inflammation, or neurodegeneration.

• You have direct hands-on experience in animal handling and/or ocular procedures, OR demonstrated expertise in developing novel 2D/3D model systems, such as organoids or organ-on-a-chip. You also bring experience in cell/tissue culture, -omics technologies, and/or basic bioinformatic tools.

• You demonstrate excellent organizational skills, rigorous record-keeping, exceptional oral and written English communication, and a strong collaborative mindset in a fast-paced environment.

• You bring 2–3 years of additional professional experience in academic or industry drug discovery settings, together with a proven track record of leading research projects and cross-functional project teams and a strong publication record in top-tier vision or scientific journals.

• You have an established professional network within the global ophthalmology research community.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Unser Ophthalmologie-Team in Basel konzentriert sich auf die Entdeckung neuer therapeutischer Ansätze für schwere Augenkrankheiten, darunter trockene AMD / geographische Atrophie und neovaskuläre Formen sowie diabetische Retinopathie und andere retinale Gefäßerkrankungen. Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Discovery Scientist mit spezialisiertem Fachwissen in der neuronalen Netzhaut und Netzhautpathologie, einschließlich Prozessen wie Entzündungen, vaskulärer Dysfunktion, Ischämie, Fibrose und Neurodegeneration, um unsere Bemühungen im Frühstadium der Wirkstoffforschung voranzutreiben.

Die Gelegenheit:

In dieser Rolle umfassen Ihre Hauptaufgaben, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Zielidentifizierung und -validierung: Verwenden und etablieren Sie fortschrittliche In-vitro- und In-vivo-Modelle von Augenerkrankungen und nutzen Sie verfügbare Patientenprobendatensätze, um neue therapeutische Wirkstoffziele zu identifizieren, zu validieren und zu charakterisieren.

• Therapeutische Ansatzentwicklung: Ich dentify und bewerten optimale therapeutische Modalitäten für ausgewählte Ziele.

• Projektleitung: Unabhängige Leitung und Verwaltung von Wirkstoffforschungsprojekten von der Zielinitiierung bis zu frühen klinischen Entwicklungsphasen (bis zur Phase-II-Bereitschaft).

• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Partnerschaft mit interdisziplinären Teams in pRED (einschließlich Bioinformatik, Sicherheit und translationale Medizin), um Pipeline-Programme voranzutreiben.

• Externe Zusammenarbeit: Initiierung und Leitung externer Kooperationsprojekte zur Stärkung interner Bemühungen. Verwalten Sie CRO-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Projektdesign, Zeitpläne und Qualität der Ergebnisse.

• Wissenschaftliche Kommunikation: Präsentieren Sie Forschungsergebnisse auf internen Entscheidungssitzungen, schreiben Sie einflussreiche Publikationen in erstklassigen, von Experten begutachteten Fachzeitschriften und vertreten Sie Roche auf internationalen wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen.

• Discovery Lab Management: Unterstützung und Koordination von Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltprozessen im Labor.

Sie, die

• Sie haben einen PhD in Biologie, Neurowissenschaften, Biochemie oder einer verwandten Life-Science-Disziplin.

• Sie haben ein Postdoc-Stipendium in Vision Research, neuronaler Retina, Augenheilkunde oder einem eng verwandten Bereich abgeschlossen.

• Sie bringen umfassende Kenntnisse der neuronalen Netzhautbiologie und der Mechanismen, die der Pathogenese von Netzhauterkrankungen zugrunde liegen, zusammen mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Durchführung von Experimenten mit Modellen der Augenangiogenese, Fibrose, Entzündung oder Neurodegeneration.

• Sie haben direkte praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Tieren und / oder Augenverfahren oder haben Fachwissen in der Entwicklung neuartiger 2D / 3D-Modellsysteme wie Organoide oder Organ-on-a-Chip gezeigt. Sie bringen auch Erfahrung in Zell- / Gewebekultur, -omik-Technologien und / oder grundlegende bioinformatische Werkzeuge mit.

• Sie zeigen hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten, strenge Aufzeichnungen, außergewöhnliche mündliche und schriftliche englische Kommunikation und eine starke kollaborative Denkweise in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung.

• Sie bringen 2-3 Jahre zusätzliche Berufserfahrung in akademischen oder industriellen Drug Discovery-Einstellungen mit, zusammen mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz von führenden Forschungsprojekten und funktionsübergreifenden Projektteams und einer starken Publikationsbilanz in erstklassigen Visionen oder wissenschaftlichen Zeitschriften.

• Sie haben ein etabliertes professionelles Netzwerk innerhalb der globalen ophthalmologischen Forschungsgemeinschaft.

Bei Roche wollen wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern. Wenn Sie bereit sind, einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf Patienten und Gesundheitssysteme weltweit zu haben, ist dies der richtige Ort für Sie.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit engagieren sich
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Notre équipe d'ophtalmologie à Bâle se concentre sur la découverte de nouvelles approches thérapeutiques pour les principales maladies oculaires, incluant la DMLA sèche/atrophie géographique et les formes néovasculaires, ainsi que la rétinopathie diabétique et d'autres maladies vasculaires rétiniennes. Nous recherchons un chercheur hautement motivé ayant une expertise spécialisée dans la rétine neurale et la pathologie rétinienne, y compris des processus tels que l'inflammation, la dysfonction vasculaire, l'ischémie, la fibrose et la neurodégénérescence, pour stimuler nos efforts de découverte de médicaments en début de développement.

L'occasion :

Dans ce rôle, vos principales responsabilités comprennent, sans s'y limiter :

• Identification et validation des cibles : Utiliser et établir des modèles avancés de maladies oculaires in vitro et in vivo, et tirer parti des ensembles de données disponibles sur les patients pour identifier, valider et caractériser de nouvelles cibles thérapeutiques.

• Développement de l'approche thérapeutique : Je dentifie et évalue les modalités thérapeutiques optimales pour certaines cibles.

• Leadership du projet : Diriger et gérer de façon indépendante les projets de découverte de médicaments depuis le lancement de la cible jusqu'aux premières étapes du développement clinique (jusqu'à la phase II).

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : S'associer à des équipes interdisciplinaires à travers le PRED (y compris la bioinformatique, la sécurité et la médecine translationnelle) pour faire progresser les programmes de pipelines.

• Collaboration externe : lancer et diriger des projets de collaboration externe pour renforcer les efforts internes. Gérer les activités du CRO, y compris la conception du projet, les échéanciers et la qualité des produits livrables.

• Communication scientifique : Présenter les résultats de la recherche lors des réunions internes de prise de décisions, rédiger des publications à fort impact dans des revues de premier ordre évaluées par des pairs et représenter Roche aux conférences scientifiques internationales.

• Gestion des laboratoires de découverte : Soutenir et coordonner les processus de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement dans le laboratoire.

Vous qui êtes :

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en biologie, en neuroscience, en biochimie ou dans une discipline connexe des sciences de la vie.

• Vous avez obtenu une bourse postdoctorale en recherche sur la vision, en rétine neurale, en ophtalmologie ou dans un domaine étroitement lié.

• Vous apportez une connaissance complète de la biologie de la rétine neurale et des mécanismes sous-jacents à la pathogenèse des maladies rétiniennes, ainsi qu'une expérience éprouvée de la conduite d'expériences utilisant des modèles d'angiogenèse oculaire, de fibrose, d'inflammation ou de neurodégénérescence.

• Vous avez une expérience pratique directe dans la manipulation des animaux et/ou les procédures oculaires, OU démontré une expertise dans le développement de nouveaux systèmes de modèles 2D/3D, tels que les organoïdes ou les organes sur puce. Vous apportez également de l'expérience dans la culture cellulaire ou tissulaire, les technologies -omiques et/ou les outils bio-informatiques de base.

• Vous faites preuve d'excellentes compétences organisationnelles, d'une tenue rigoureuse des dossiers, d'une communication orale et écrite exceptionnelle en anglais et d'une solide collaboration dans un environnement rapide.

• Vous apportez 2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle supplémentaire dans des milieux universitaires ou industriels de découverte de médicaments, ainsi qu'une expérience éprouvée de projets de recherche de premier plan et d'équipes de projets interfonctionnelles et une solide publication dans des revues scientifiques ou de vision de haut niveau.

• Vous avez un réseau professionnel établi au sein de la communauté mondiale de recherche en ophtalmologie.

Chez Roche, nous visons des solutions de soins de santé qui changent la vie. Si vous êtes prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur les patients et les systèmes de santé dans le monde entier, c'est l'endroit pour vous.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés

Importante: Dopo la vostra applicazione, vi contatteremo via e-mail entro pochi giorni. Per assicurarti di non perdere un messaggio importante, ti chiediamo di controllare la cartella spam o spazzatura accanto alla tua casella di posta. Se non si sente da noi entro una settimana, contattare basel.berufslehre@roche.com .

Sai cosa farai dopo la laurea? Diventa un potenziatore del mondo o un salvagente? Non solo devi reinventare il tuo futuro. Anche noi. Impara. Il futuro. Roche.

Argomenti principali per il lavoro

Il tuo profilo

• CVC

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Engineering Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity:

The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

​This is a field-based role - the territory is Chicago with the ideal candidate to live in the Northern or Northwest part of Chicago.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireles

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Specialista di ingegneria del campo

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Roche Support Network offre un'opportunità emozionante per le persone che sono appassionati di problem solving. In qualità di azienda sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche è dedicata alla scoperta, allo sviluppo e alla fornitura di prodotti diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi. Con un impegno per lo sviluppo dei dipendenti e un ambiente di lavoro che valorizza il rispetto e l'empowerment, Roche offre interessanti prospettive di carriera per coloro che cercano di avere un impatto significativo sulla cura dei pazienti.

L'opportunità:

Il gruppo Roche Support Network si impegna a fornire ai propri clienti un supporto a definizione industriale. In qualità di Field Engineering Specialist, avrai l'opportunità di viaggiare e dimostrare la tua esperienza come specialista tecnico di riparazione e/o installazione per le linee di prodotti Roche assegnate e fornire un servizio prezioso ai tuoi clienti di laboratorio in un territorio assegnato. Questa posizione funge da specialista tecnico di riparazione o installazione per i prodotti Roche per le linee di prodotto e geografie assegnate.

• Fornisce assistenza tecnica ordinaria ai clienti sugli aspetti operativi e di manutenzione delle apparecchiature di sistema.

• Esegue il servizio in loco, la riparazione e/o l'installazione dei prodotti aziendali. Ciò può includere qualsiasi aspetto del supporto sul campo e non è limitato a hardware e software meccanici/sistema, networking/wireless networking.

• Serve come contatto cliente su problemi tecnici e di servizio di routine. Riceve la formazione e fornisce il servizio nell'ambito normale della posizione. Segui le pratiche, le politiche e le procedure documentate per fornire supporto di riparazione e installazione.

• Diagnostica guasto meccanico, hardware, software e sistema, utilizzando procedure stabilite. Determina la riparazione/risoluzione più conveniente per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo del cliente.

• Fornisce analisi, feedback e raccomandazioni sulle tendenze di guasto del prodotto e problemi di manutenzione. Documenta tutte le attività in modo conforme alle procedure di qualità dell'azienda. Conoscenza specializzata generalmente di una particolare area, sistema o attrezzature. Richiede formazione e certificazione specifiche.

• Riguarda alcune competenze avanzate alla posizione o specializzazione. Può adattare procedure, processi, strumenti, attrezzature e tecniche per soddisfare i requisiti più complessi della posizione. I doveri sono generalmente di routine, ma possono includere compiti non di routine.

• Risolve la maggior parte delle domande e dei problemi e si riferisce solo alle questioni più complesse a livelli più elevati.

• Responsabile del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso azioni quotidiane.

Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo - il territorio è Chicago con il candidato ideale per vivere nella parte nord-occidentale di Chicago.

Chi sei?

• Diploma di scuola superiore e 2 anni di scuola tecnica o di formazione militare equivalente o esperienza lavorativa equivalente

• 5 anni di progressiva esperienza di riparazione o manutenzione di hardware e software meccanici/sistema, o networking/wireless networking O una laurea in ingegneria biomedica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica, chimica o campo correlato più 1-2 anni di esperienza progressiva riparazione o manutenzione complessa hardware e software meccanico/sistema, o networking/wireles

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Field Engineering Spezialist

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Roche Support Network bietet eine aufregende Gelegenheit für Personen, die sich für die Problemlösung begeistern. Als forschungsorientiertes Gesundheitsunternehmen widmet sich Roche der Entdeckung, Entwicklung und Bereitstellung innovativer Diagnostik- und Therapieprodukte. Mit einem Engagement für die Mitarbeiterentwicklung und einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Respekt und Empowerment wertschätzt, bietet Roche spannende Karriereperspektiven für diejenigen, die einen signifikanten Einfluss auf die Patientenversorgung haben wollen.

Die Gelegenheit:

Die Roche Support Network-Gruppe hat sich verpflichtet, ihren Kunden branchenspezifische Unterstützung zu bieten. Als Field Engineering Specialist haben Sie die Möglichkeit zu reisen und Ihre Expertise als technischer Reparatur- und / oder Installationsspezialist für Roche zugewiesene Produktlinien unter Beweis zu stellen und Ihren Laborkunden in einem zugewiesenen Gebiet einen wertvollen Service zu bieten. Diese Position dient als technischer Reparatur- oder Installationsspezialist für Roche-Produkte für zugeordnete Produktlinien und Regionen.

• Bietet routinemäßigen technischen Support für Kunden zu Betriebs- und Wartungsaspekten der Systemausrüstung.

• Führt Vor-Ort-Service, Reparatur und / oder Installation von Unternehmensprodukten durch. Dies kann jeden Aspekt der Feldunterstützung umfassen und ist nicht auf mechanische/System-Hardware und -Software, Vernetzung/drahtlose Vernetzung beschränkt.

• Dient als Kundenkontakt bei routinemäßigen technischen und servicebezogenen Problemen. Erhält Training und liefert Service im normalen Rahmen der Position. Befolgt dokumentierte Praktiken, Richtlinien und Verfahren bei der Bereitstellung von Reparatur- und Installationsunterstützung.

• Diagnosen mechanischer, Hardware-, Software- und Systemfehler unter Verwendung etablierter Verfahren. Bestimmt die kostengünstigste Reparatur/Auflösung, um Kundenausfälle zu minimieren.

• Bietet Analysen, Feedback und Empfehlungen zu Produktfehlertrends und Serviceability-Problemen. Dokumentiert alle Aktivitäten in Übereinstimmung mit den Qualitätsverfahren des Unternehmens. Spezialisierte Kenntnisse im Allgemeinen eines bestimmten Bereichs, Systems oder Geräts. Erfordert eine spezifische Ausbildung und Zertifizierung.

• Wendet einige fortgeschrittene Fähigkeiten auf die Position oder Spezialisierung an. Kann Verfahren, Prozesse, Werkzeuge, Ausrüstung und Techniken anpassen, um die komplexeren Anforderungen der Position zu erfüllen. Aufgaben sind in der Regel Routine, können aber auch nicht routinemäßige Aufgaben umfassen.

• Löst die meisten Fragen und Probleme und verweist nur die komplexesten Fragen auf höhere Ebenen.

• Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung des Qualitätssystems und die Erreichung der Qualitätsziele durch tägliches Handeln.

Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle - das Territorium ist Chicago mit dem idealen Kandidaten, um im nördlichen oder nordwestlichen Teil von Chicago zu leben.

Wer Du bist:

• Abitur und 2 Jahre technische Schule oder gleichwertige militärische Ausbildung oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung

• 5 Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Reparatur oder Wartung von mechanischer / System-Hardware und -Software oder Vernetzung / drahtlose Vernetzung ODER ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Biomedizinischer Technik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Chemie oder verwandten Bereichen plus 1-2 Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Reparatur oder Wartung komplexer mechanischer / System-Hardware und -Software oder Netzwerk / Leitungen

La position
Spécialiste du génie sur le terrain

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Roche Support Network offre une opportunité passionnante aux personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes. En tant qu'entreprise de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche se consacre à la découverte, au développement et à la fourniture de diagnostics et de produits thérapeutiques innovants. Avec un engagement envers le perfectionnement des employés et un milieu de travail qui valorise le respect et l'autonomisation, Roche offre des perspectives de carrière stimulantes à ceux qui cherchent à avoir un impact significatif sur les soins aux patients.

La possibilité :

Le groupe Roche Support Network s'engage à fournir un soutien à ses clients pour définir l'industrie. En tant que spécialiste en génie de terrain, vous aurez l'occasion de voyager et de démontrer votre expertise en tant que spécialiste en réparation technique et/ou installation pour les gammes de produits assignées à Roche et de fournir un service précieux à vos clients de laboratoire dans un territoire assigné. Ce poste sert de spécialiste en réparation ou installation technique pour les produits Roche pour les lignes de produits et les géographies assignées.

• Fournit un soutien technique régulier aux clients sur les aspects opérationnels et d'entretien de l'équipement du système.

• Effectue le service sur place, la réparation et/ou l'installation des produits de la société. Cela peut inclure n'importe quel aspect de l'appui sur le terrain et ne se limite pas au matériel et aux logiciels mécaniques/systèmes, au réseautage/réseau sans fil.

• Servit comme contact client sur les problèmes techniques et de service de routine. Reçoit la formation et fournit le service dans le cadre normal du poste. Suivre les pratiques, politiques et procédures documentées en matière de réparation et d'installation.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Are you ready to shape the future of medical device instrument control software? We are seeking a driven Senior Software Engineer in Cybersecurity to join our team at Roche Tissue Diagnostics (RTD) as our Cybersecurity Champion Lead. In this pivotal role, you will work directly with software product development teams to provide guidance and oversight on secure design patterns, risk assessments, and vulnerability analysis. Beyond individual projects, you will also lead department-level initiatives for our cybersecurity uplift program and work directly with the Roche Product Security & Privacy Organization (PSPO). If you have a passion for secure software development, experience with medical device regulations or cloud security, and hold an advanced degree with relevant industry experience, we invite you to help us defend and innovate our next-generation technology.

The Opportunity:

• Contribute as a Subject Matter Expert to cybersecurity risk assessments for the RTD product portfolio, including risk identification, risk analysis and verification of risk mitigations.

• Consult development teams in analyzing potential impacts and exposure of vulnerabilities.

• Contribute technical knowledge to development teams about secure design patterns and the right use of security technologies.

• Create and review documentation of security concepts, secure designs and plans to maintain the secure state of the product portfolio throughout its lifecycle.

• Manage and oversee penetration tests with internal product teams and external service providers. Assess and track mitigation strategies.

• Collaborate with Roche’s Product Security and Privacy Operations group to disseminate process updates and state of the art best practices to product development teams.

• Prepare and deliver presentations of product security posture results to large and diverse internal audiences.

Who You Are:

• BS degree and least 8 years of related experience or equivalent in a directly related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience. MS degree in directly related discipline + 4 years of related experience required; OR, PhD degree in a directly related discipline + 2 years of related experience required.

• Prior experience in secure software development. Cybersecurity certification(s) desired, but not required (e.g. CISA, CISM, CISSP).

• Experience in Cloud security concepts and with medical devices, especially IVD systems, desired.

• Knowledge about Windows and .Net technology stack (Java and Linux are a plus).

• Knowledge of cybersecurity regulations, laws and standards for the medical device industry.

• Driven, self-starter with good planning and organizational skills and a strong attention to detail.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ is $104,000 - $193,100. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Are you ready to shape the future of medical device instrument control software? We are seeking a driven Senior Software Engineer in Cybersecurity to join our team at Roche Tissue Diagnostics (RTD) as our Cybersecurity Champion Lead. In this pivotal role, you will work directly with software product development teams to provide guidance and oversight on secure design patterns, risk assessments, and vulnerability analysis. Beyond individual projects, you will also lead department-level initiatives for our cybersecurity uplift program and work directly with the Roche Product Security & Privacy Organization (PSPO). If you have a passion for secure software development, experience with medical device regulations or cloud security, and hold an advanced degree with relevant industry experience, we invite you to help us defend and innovate our next-generation technology.

The Opportunity:

• Consult development teams in analyzing potential impacts and exposure of vulnerabilities.

• Contribute technical knowledge to development teams about secure design patterns and the right use of security technologies.

• Create and review documentation of security concepts, secure designs and plans to maintain the secure state of the product portfolio throughout its lifecycle.

• Manage and oversee penetration tests with internal product teams and external service providers. Assess and track mitigation strategies.

• Collaborate with Roche’s Product Security and Privacy Operations group to disseminate process updates and state of the art best practices to product development teams.

• Prepare and deliver presentations of product security posture results to large and diverse internal audiences.

Who You Are:

• BS degree and least 8 years of related experience or equivalent in a directly related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience. MS degree in directly related discipline + 4 years of related experience required; OR, PhD degree in a directly related discipline + 2 years of related experience required.

• Prior experience in secure software development. Cybersecurity certification(s) desired, but not required (e.g. CISA, CISM, CISSP).

• Experience in Cloud security concepts and with medical devices, especially IVD systems, desired.

• Knowledge about Windows and .Net technology stack (Java and Linux are a plus).

• Knowledge of cybersecurity regulations, laws and standards for the medical device industry.

• Driven, self-starter with good planning and organizational skills and a strong attention to detail.

A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

• Assist in the development and ongoing maintenance of the compliance microsite, ensuring content such as policies, standards, communications, and monitoring reports are kept up to date

• Provide administrative and coordination support for compliance monitoring activities, including following up with internal stakeholders to obtain required information and documentation

• Perform other administrative and ad-hoc tasks as assigned by the compliance team

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a degree in Law, Business, Life Sciences, Political Science or a related field

• Strong written communication skills and attention to detail

• Proactive, organized, and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders

• Interest in legal, compliance, and corporate governance matters

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• · Documenti sorgente di revisione per potenziali rapporti di eventi avversi e reclami di prodotto.

Competenze

Competenze specifiche del lavoro:

• · Meticolosa, accurata e forte attenzione ai dettagli.
• · Eccellente capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo.
• · L'alto livello di integrità come mantenimento della riservatezza di tutti i clienti e pazienti dati personali è fondamentale.
• · Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra.

Competenza
• Istruzione/Qualificazione:
• · È richiesta la certificazione minima SPM, IGCSE o equivalente.
• · Attualmente perseguire una laurea in Scienze della Vita, Biologia, Biotecnologia, Biochimica, Bioingegneria, o un campo correlato.
• · Fluente in inglese scritto e parlato e Bahasa Malesia.
• · Proficienza in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) e altri software o applicazioni di base del computer.
• · Familiarità e esperienza pratica con LLM e pronte avanzate
• · Familiarità o esperienza pratica con strumenti digitali moderni, automazione del flusso di lavoro di base (ad esempio App Script), Python sarà preferito.

Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
We are seeking a motivated and detailed-oriented RPAP Intern to join our Roche Patient Assistance Program (RPAP) team. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the execution of RPAP and making a difference to patient’s lives. This role will be supporting the patient’s journey throughout the program while compliantly improving access of Roche products to patients in Malaysia.

• Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Operational Excellence:
• · Support the streamlining of RPAP processes utilizing digital & AI solutions
• · Assist in updating patient information and treatment cycles accurately into Roche electronic systems.
• · Review of supporting documents via various channels.
• · Review source documents for potential reports of adverse events and product complaints.
• · Update the status of treatment cycles within Roche electronic systems.
• · Support general administrative duties such as filing documents, distributing documents to hospitals and other data management.

Others:
· Any other duties that may be assigned from time to time as required by the business.

Competencies

Job Specific Competencies:

• · Meticulous, thorough and strong attention to detail.
• · Excellent organizational and time management skills.
• · High level of integrity as maintenance of confidentiality of all customers and patients personal data is utmost important.
• · A bility to work independently and as part of a team.

Expertise
• Education/Qualification:
• · Minimum SPM, IGCSE or equivalent certification is required.
• · Currently pursuing a degree in Life Sciences, Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Bioengineering, or a related field.
• · Fluent in written and spoken English and Bahasa Malaysia.
• · Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and other basic computer software/applications.
• · Familiarity and hands-on experience with LLMs and advanced prompting
• · Familiarity or hand-on experience with modern digital tools, basic workflow automation (eg. App Script), Python will be preferred.
• · Internship Duration: Capability to commit to a 6-month full-time internship (highly preferred).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Zweck der Tätigkeit
Wir suchen einen motivierten und detailorientierten RPAP-Praktikanten, der unserem Team des Roche Patient Assistance Program (RPAP) beitritt. Dieses Praktikum bietet eine hervorragende Gelegenheit, praktische Erfahrungen in der Durchführung von RPAP zu sammeln und das Leben des Patienten zu verändern. Diese Rolle wird die Reise des Patienten während des gesamten Programms unterstützen und gleichzeitig den Zugang von Roche-Produkten zu Patienten in Malaysia verbessern.

• Verantwortlichkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten
• Operational Excellence:
• · Unterstützung der Rationalisierung von RPAP-Prozessen durch digitale und KI-Lösungen
• · Unterstützung bei der genauen Aktualisierung der Patienteninformationen und Behandlungszyklen in den elektronischen Systemen von Roche.

• · Überprüfen Sie die Quelldokumente auf mögliche Berichte über unerwünschte Ereignisse und Produktbeschwerden.
• · Aktualisieren Sie den Status der Behandlungszyklen innerhalb der elektronischen Systeme von Roche.
• Unterstützen Sie allgemeine Verwaltungsaufgaben wie die Einreichung von Dokumenten, die Verteilung von Dokumenten an Krankenhäuser und andere Datenverwaltung.

Andere:
· Alle anderen Aufgaben, die von Zeit zu Zeit zugewiesen werden können, wie vom Unternehmen verlangt.

Kompetenzen

Stellenspezifische Kompetenzen:

• · Akribische, gründliche und starke Liebe zum Detail.
• · Ausgezeichnete Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten.
• · Hohe Integrität, da die Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit aller personenbezogenen Daten von Kunden und Patienten von größter Bedeutung ist.
• · Die Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams zu arbeiten.

Expertise
• Ausbildung/Qualifikation:
• · Mindest-SPM-, IGCSE- oder gleichwertige Zertifizierung ist erforderlich.
• · Derzeit verfolgen einen Abschluss in Biowissenschaften, Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Bioengineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• · Fließend in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch und Bahasa Malaysia.
• · Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) und anderen grundlegenden Computersoftware / Anwendungen.
• · Vertrautheit und praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und erweiterten Aufforderungen
• · Vertrautheit oder praktische Erfahrung mit modernen digitalen Tools, grundlegende Workflow-Automatisierung (z. B. App-Script), Python wird bevorzugt.
• · Praktikumsdauer: Fähigkeit, sich zu einem 6-monatigen Vollzeitpraktikum zu verpflichten (sehr bevorzugt).

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Autres:

• · En anglais et en bahasa malais.
• · Compétence en Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) et autres logiciels/applications informatiques de base.
• · Familiarité et expérience pratique avec les LLM et stimulation avancée
• · Familiarité ou expérience pratique avec les outils numériques modernes, l'automatisation de base du workflow (par exemple App Script), Python sera préféré.
• · Durée du stage : Capacité de s'engager à un stage de 6 mois à temps plein (très préféré).

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

The Position

ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer with MFS experience to join our team and take ownership of a highly complex, validated warehouse management solution. This warehouse is one of the biggest ones of the Roche Pharma division with a high degree of automation. You guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level.

The Opportunity

• Design & Implementation : Develop and implement complex enhancements to our SAP EWM solution, including MFS and WebDynpro user interfaces

• Independent Problem-Solving : Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions; troubleshoot issues at the code level without requiring constant guidance

• Technical Deep-Dive : Investigate complex technical challenges, debug code, and optimize system performance

• Stakeholder Collaboration : Work closely with business teams to understand requirements, manage expectations, and communicate technical constraints and timelines

• Validated Environment Management : Execute changes in compliance with our regulated environment, including documentation, test cases, and validation requirements

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

• Extensive SAP EWM Experience : Minimum 5+ years working with SAP EWM in production environments, including complex configurations and customizations

• MFS Expertise : Proven hands-on experience implementing and maintaining SAP MFS

• ABAP Development Skills : Solid programming background with ability to debug, and optimize ABAP code

• Validated Environment Experience : Demonstrated familiarity with regulated environments, change management processes, and compliance documentation

• SAFe Framework Knowledge : Working understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices

• Fluent English : Strong verbal and written communication skills (essential)

• German Language (Preferred) : Fluency in German is a significant plus

Who you are:

• Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 15%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Functional Consultant – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

We are seeking an SAP EWM/ TM Functional Consultant to join our team supporting a highly complex, customized SAP solution. This role is ideal for a consultant who thrives in technically challenging environments and is passionate about deep-dive problem-solving and continuous learning. We are looking for a consultant who is not intimidated by complexity but energized by it. This role requires someone who views an individualized SAP solution as an intellectual challenge rather than an obstacle, and who sees continuous learning as a core part of the job.

The Opportunity

• Provide functional consulting and support for our bespoke SAP solution with extensive custom developments.

• Analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize complex business processes in the supply chain and logistics space.

• Collaborate with development and technical teams to understand non-standard functionality and custom implementations.

• Drive system enhancements, testing, and deployment activities in a GxP context.

• Deal with uncertainty and make decisions at the product level.

• Provide solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.

• Primarily interact within product teams and squads as applicable.

• Interact directly with stakeholders medium to large engagements.

• Communicate information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicate the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement.

Who you are:

• Hands-on experience with SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management).

• Hands-on experience of SAP Transportation Management (TM) concepts and integration points.

• Working knowledge of BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) and its application in custom developments.

• Familiarity with BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call) functionality.

• Experience supporting complex, non-standard SAP solutions with custom code.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams.

• Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn new concepts and technologies quickly.

Nice to have:

• German language skills (written and spoken).

• Experience with SAP ABAP or custom object development.

• Experience in the Pharmaceutical environment following GxP guidelines.

• Familiarity with change management and process improvement methodologies.

• Familiarity with agile methodologies like SAFe.

• Intermediate level of business process domain knowledge in supply chain.

What you get:

• Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 15%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Consulente funzionale – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions Stiamo cercando un consulente funzionale SAP EWM/TM per unire il nostro team supportando una soluzione SAP altamente complessa e personalizzata. Questo ruolo è ideale per un consulente che prospera in ambienti tecnicamente impegnativi ed è appassionato di deep-dive problem-solving e apprendimento continuo. Siamo alla ricerca di un consulente che non è intimidito dalla complessità ma stimolato da esso. Questo ruolo richiede qualcuno che vede una soluzione SAP individualizzata come una sfida intellettuale piuttosto che un ostacolo, e che vede l'apprendimento continuo come una parte fondamentale del lavoro. L'opportunità
• Fornire consulenza e supporto funzionali per la nostra soluzione SAP su misura con ampi sviluppi personalizzati.
• Analizzare, risolvere i problemi e ottimizzare i processi aziendali complessi nella supply chain e nello spazio logistico.
• Collabora con team di sviluppo e tecnici per comprendere funzionalità non standard e implementazioni personalizzate.
• Miglioramento del sistema di azionamento, test e attività di distribuzione in un contesto GxP.
• Affrontare l'incertezza e prendere decisioni a livello del prodotto.
• Fornire soluzioni a una vasta gamma di problemi difficili.
• Interagisci principalmente all'interno di team di prodotti e squadre come applicabile.
• Interagisci direttamente con le parti interessate da media a grandi impegni.
• Comunicare informazioni, problemi e potenziali soluzioni all'interno dei team di prodotti e comunicare chiaramente l'impatto del proprio lavoro nel contesto delle esigenze aziendali.
• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, i workshop e il coinvolgimento dei clienti. Chi sei:
• Esperienza pratica con SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management).
• Esperienza pratica dei concetti e dei punti di integrazione di SAP Transportation Management (TM).
• Conoscenze di lavoro di BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) e la sua applicazione negli sviluppi personalizzati.
• Familiarità con funzionalità BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call).
• Esperienza di supporto soluzioni SAP complesse e non standard con codice personalizzato.
• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di navigare ambiguità.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e funzionali.
• Volontà e capacità dimostrata di imparare rapidamente nuovi concetti e tecnologie. Bello da avere:
• Competenze linguistiche tedesche (scritte e parlate).
• Esperienza con SAP ABAP o sviluppo di oggetti personalizzati.
• Esperienza nell'ambiente farmaceutico seguendo le linee guida GxP.
• Familiarità con la gestione dei cambiamenti e metodi di miglioramento dei processi.
• Familiarità con metodologie agili come SAFe.
• Livello intermedio di conoscenza del dominio del processo aziendale nella supply chain. Che cosa si ottiene:
• Gamma di insalata 10.100 - 18.800 PLN mensile lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.
• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 12%).
• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).
• Prendere tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).
• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.
• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).
• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport.
• Aggiunti di acquisto azionario.
• Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e auto e uomo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics Central Asia and Caucasian countries.

Please submit your CV in English.

Location: Kazakhstan, Almaty

What will you do?

• You will join the healthcare innovation team.

• You will be responsible for growing the portfolio; delivering on the marketing plan and working cross functionally with related colleagues.

• You will prepare short term (annual) and medium term business/marketing plans for the products.

• You will be expected to maintain and communicate a high level of market and product knowledge.

• You will organize training programs for commercial team about products, product marketing strategies and competition.

• You will organize product related marketing events (congresses, conferences, etc.) in cooperation with related parties

Who are you?

• Bachelor's Degree in medicine, biology, chemistry

• Preferably 1-2 years’ experience of product management in the diagnostic, pharmaceutical, or related industry

• Budget management and product launch experience preferred

• Strong communication, analytical and presentation skills

• At least upper-intermediate level of English and fluent Russian

• Having driving license and willing to travel (approximately 40%)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Stiamo cercando un Product Manager presso Roche Diagnostics Central Asia e paesi caucasici.

Invia il tuo CV in inglese.

Ubicazione: Kazakistan, Almaty

Cosa farai?

• Ti unirai al team di innovazione sanitaria.

• Sarete responsabili per la crescita del portafoglio; fornire sul piano di marketing e lavorare cross funzionalmente con colleghi correlati.

• Si preparerà a breve termine (annuale) e piani di business/marketing a medio termine per i prodotti.

• Sarete tenuti a mantenere e comunicare un alto livello di conoscenza del mercato e del prodotto.

• Organizzerai programmi di formazione per team commerciale su prodotti, strategie di marketing del prodotto e concorrenza.

• Organizzerai eventi di marketing relativi ai prodotti (congressi, conferenze, ecc.) in collaborazione con le parti correlate

Chi sei?

• Laurea in medicina, biologia, chimica

• Preferibilmente 1-2 anni di esperienza di gestione del prodotto nel settore diagnostico, farmaceutico o relativo

• Gestione del bilancio e l'esperienza di lancio del prodotto preferito

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, analitica e presentazione

• Almeno il livello intermedio superiore del russo inglese e fluente

• Avere patente di guida e disposto a viaggiare (circa il 40%)

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.
