jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access

As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team protects the organization’s global digital assets by developing and operating sophisticated security platforms. We work at the forefront of identity governance, fine-grained authorization, and hybrid cloud security to support users and business-critical systems in a highly regulated global healthcare ecosystem.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access , you will be part of a global team responsible for the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Policy Based Access Control (PBAC) infrastructure. You will play a critical role in protecting our information and assets by moving beyond traditional access models toward a dynamic, fine-grained authorization framework that supports our global Zero Trust strategy. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to global application owners, ensuring that our security policies are scalable, resilient, and deployed seamlessly through automated code pipelines.

The Opportunity

• Architect PBAC Infrastructure: Serve as the technical owner of core PBAC components (PDP/PEP) across a hybrid global landscape, ensuring high availability and peak performance.

• Drive Strategic Implementation: Lead the enterprise transition from initial access use cases to global adoption, defining organization-wide standards for policy-based authorization.

• Consult on Integration Pathways: Act as the primary technical consultant for application and data owners, integrating critical systems via RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC, and LDAP.

• Pioneer Policy as Code (PaC): Drive the shift to PaC by designing automated pipelines for versioning, testing, and deploying authorization logic like modern software.

• Manage Platform Lifecycles: Own the tactical lifecycle of the authorization platforms, including version upgrades, continuous performance tuning, and security patching.

• Lead Incident Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analytical investigations and root cause analysis into moderately complex cybersecurity incidents, threat patterns, and vulnerabilities.

• Streamline Asset Onboarding: Optimize and accelerate onboarding processes for new digital assets while ensuring strict alignment with international data privacy regulations like GDPR.

• Collaborate Across Product Squads: Partner closely with product managers, developers, and global stakeholders to build secure, user-friendly, and friction-free PBAC workflows.

Who you are

• Experienced Security Professional: You bring 4–9 years of professional experience in IT Security, including 3+ years specifically focused on IAM and PBAC/ABAC in large enterprise environments.

• Technical Security Master: You possess advanced, deep-level knowledge of XACML, decentralized policy management, and Zero Trust frameworks (RBAC and ABAC).

• Identity Foundations Expert: You are highly proficient in core identity standards, including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Single Sign-On (SSO), and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).

• DevOps & Integration Developer: You are skilled in Java or Python for custom integrations, with practical experience utilizing Git and CI/CD pipelines for secure code deployment.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

• Analytical Problem Solver: You have advanced logical reason

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Accesso basato sulla politica

Nell’ambito di Roche Digital Technology (RDT), il nostro team Identity and Access Management (IAM) protegge i beni digitali globali dell’organizzazione sviluppando e operando sofisticate piattaforme di sicurezza. Lavoriamo all'avanguardia nella governance dell'identità, nell'autorizzazione a grana fine e nella sicurezza cloud ibrida per supportare gli utenti e i sistemi business-critical in un ecosistema sanitario globale altamente regolamentato.

Come Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access , sarete parte di un team globale responsabile per la progettazione, l'implementazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita della nostra infrastruttura Policy Based Access Control (PBAC). Potrai svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nella protezione delle nostre informazioni e dei nostri beni spostando oltre i modelli di accesso tradizionali verso un quadro di autorizzazione dinamico e fine-grained che supporta la nostra strategia globale Zero Trust. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente affidabile per i proprietari di applicazioni globali, assicurando che le nostre politiche di sicurezza sono scalabili, resilienti e implementati senza soluzione di continuità attraverso pipeline di codice automatizzati.

L'opportunità

• Architetto PBAC Infrastructure: Servire come proprietario tecnico di componenti PBAC core (PDP/PEP) in un paesaggio globale ibrido, garantendo elevata disponibilità e prestazioni di picco.

• Guidare l'attuazione strategica: portare la transizione dell'impresa dai primi casi di accesso all'adozione globale, definendo gli standard organizzativi per l'autorizzazione basata sulle politiche.

• Consultare l'integrazione Pathways: agire come consulente tecnico primario per i proprietari di applicazioni e dati, integrando sistemi critici tramite API RESTful, SQL/JDBC e LDAP.

• Pioneer Policy as Code (PaC): Guida il passaggio a PaC progettando pipeline automatizzate per la versione, il test e la distribuzione di logica di autorizzazione come software moderno.

• Gestisci i cicli di vita della piattaforma: Possiedi il ciclo di vita tattico delle piattaforme di autorizzazione, compresi gli aggiornamenti della versione, la regolazione continua delle prestazioni e la patch di sicurezza.

• Analisi degli incidenti di piombo: condurre indagini analitiche approfondite e analisi delle cause della radice in incidenti di sicurezza informatica moderatamente complessi, modelli di minacce e vulnerabilità.

• Ottimizzare e accelerare i processi di onboarding per i nuovi asset digitali, garantendo un rigoroso allineamento con le normative internazionali sulla privacy dei dati come GDPR.

• Collaborate Across Product Squads: collaborare a stretto contatto con i product manager, gli sviluppatori e gli stakeholder globali per costruire flussi di lavoro PBAC sicuri, facili da usare e privi di attrito.

Chi sei

• Professionista di sicurezza esperto: Lei porta 4–9 anni di esperienza professionale in sicurezza informatica, tra cui 3+ anni specificamente focalizzati su IAM e PBAC/ABAC in ambienti di grande impresa.

• Master di sicurezza tecnica: Possiedi conoscenze avanzate e di livello profondo di XACML, gestione delle politiche decentrate e framework Zero Trust (RBAC e ABAC).

• Esperto di fondazioni di identità: Lei è altamente esperto in standard di identità fondamentali, tra cui SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Singolo Sign-On (SSO), e Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).

• DevOps & Integration Sviluppatore: Sei esperto in Java o Python per integrazioni personalizzate, con esperienza pratica utilizzando Git e CI/CD pipelines per la distribuzione sicura di codice.

• Professionista Educato: Hai una laurea o una laurea avanzata in Informatica, sicurezza informatica, tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo relativo (o equivalente esperienza professionale).

• Analitico Problem Solver: Hai una ragione logica avanzata

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access

Als Teil von Roche Digital Technology (RDT) schützt unser Identity and Access Management (IAM)-Team die globalen digitalen Assets des Unternehmens durch die Entwicklung und den Betrieb anspruchsvoller Sicherheitsplattformen. Wir arbeiten an vorderster Front bei Identitäts-Governance, fein abgestimmter Autorisierung und hybrider Cloud-Sicherheit, um Benutzer und geschäftskritische Systeme in einem stark regulierten globalen Gesundheits-Ökosystem zu unterstützen.

Als Senior Cybersecurity Analyst - Policy Based Access sind Sie Teil eines globalen Teams, das für das Design, die Implementierung und das Lifecycle Management unserer Policy Based Access Control (PBAC) Infrastruktur verantwortlich ist. Sie werden eine entscheidende Rolle beim Schutz unserer Informationen und Vermögenswerte spielen, indem Sie sich über traditionelle Zugangsmodelle hinaus zu einem dynamischen, fein abgestimmten Autorisierungsrahmen bewegen, der unsere globale Zero Trust-Strategie unterstützt. In dieser Rolle fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für globale Anwendungsbesitzer und stellen sicher, dass unsere Sicherheitsrichtlinien skalierbar, belastbar und nahtlos über automatisierte Code-Pipelines bereitgestellt werden.

Die Chance

• Architect PBAC Infrastructure: Als technischer Eigentümer von PBAC-Kernkomponenten (PDP/PEP) in einer hybriden globalen Landschaft zu dienen, um hohe Verfügbarkeit und Spitzenleistung zu gewährleisten.

• Strategische Umsetzung vorantreiben: Führen Sie den Unternehmensübergang von anfänglichen Zugriffs-Anwendungsfällen zur globalen Einführung und definieren Sie organisationsweite Standards für richtlinienbasierte Autorisierung.

• Beratung zu Integrationspfaden: Handeln Sie als primärer technischer Berater für Anwendungs- und Datenbesitzer und integrieren Sie kritische Systeme über RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC und LDAP.

• Pioneer Policy as Code (PaC): Betreiben Sie den Wechsel zu PaC, indem Sie automatisierte Pipelines für die Versionierung, das Testen und die Bereitstellung von Autorisierungslogik wie moderne Software entwerfen.

• Plattformlebenszyklen verwalten: Besitzen Sie den taktischen Lebenszyklus der Autorisierungsplattformen, einschließlich Versionsupgrades, kontinuierlichem Performance-Tuning und Sicherheitspatch.

• Lead Incident Analysis: Durchführung tiefgründiger analytischer Untersuchungen und Ursachenanalysen zu mäßig komplexen Cybersicherheitsvorfällen, Bedrohungsmustern und Schwachstellen.

• Optimierung und Beschleunigung von Onboarding-Prozessen für neue digitale Assets bei gleichzeitiger strikter Abstimmung mit internationalen Datenschutzbestimmungen wie der DSGVO.

• Zusammenarbeit über Produktteams hinweg: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagern, Entwicklern und globalen Stakeholdern, um sichere, benutzerfreundliche und reibungslose PBAC-Workflows zu erstellen.

Wer du bist

• Erfahrener Security Professional: Sie bringen 4-9 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Sicherheit mit, davon 3+ Jahre speziell auf IAM und PBAC/ABAC in großen Unternehmensumgebungen.

• Technical Security Master: Sie verfügen über fortgeschrittene, fundierte Kenntnisse in XACML, dezentralem Policy Management und Zero Trust Frameworks (RBAC und ABAC).

• Experte für Identitätsstiftungen: Sie beherrschen die wichtigsten Identitätsstandards, einschließlich SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Single Sign-On (SSO) und Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).

• DevOps & Integration Developer: Sie sind mit Java oder Python für benutzerdefinierte Integrationen vertraut und verfügen über praktische Erfahrung mit Git- und CI/CD-Pipelines für die sichere Codebereitstellung.

• Ausgebildeter Fachmann: Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Advanced-Abschluss in Informatik, Cyber Security, Informationstechnologie oder einem verwandten Bereich (oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung).

• Analytischer Problemlöser: Sie haben den logischen Grund fortgeschritten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Analyste principal de la cybersécurité - Accès axé sur les politiques

Dans le cadre de Roche Digital Technology (RDT), notre équipe Identity and Access Management (IAM) protège les actifs numériques mondiaux de l'organisation en développant et en exploitant des plateformes de sécurité sophistiquées. Nous travaillons à l'avant-garde de la gouvernance de l'identité, de l'autorisation à grain fin et de la sécurité du cloud hybride pour soutenir les utilisateurs et les systèmes critiques dans un écosystème mondial de soins de santé hautement réglementé.

En tant qu'analyste principal de la cybersécurité - Accès fondé sur les politiques, vous ferez partie d'une équipe mondiale responsable de la conception, de la mise en oeuvre et de la gestion du cycle de vie de notre infrastructure de contrôle d'accès fondé sur les politiques (PBAC). Vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans la protection de nos informations et de nos biens en allant au-delà des modèles d'accès traditionnels vers un cadre d'autorisation dynamique et à grain fin qui appuie notre stratégie globale Zero Trust. Dans ce rôle, vous agirez comme conseiller de confiance auprès des propriétaires d'applications mondiales, en veillant à ce que nos politiques de sécurité soient évolutives, résilientes et déployées de façon transparente par des pipelines de codes automatisés.

L'opportunité

• Architecte PBAC Infrastructure: Servir de propriétaire technique des composants de base PBAC (PDP/PEP) dans un paysage mondial hybride, assurant une disponibilité élevée et des performances de pointe.

• Diriger la mise en œuvre stratégique : Diriger la transition de l'entreprise des cas d'utilisation initiale à l'adoption mondiale, en définissant des normes à l'échelle de l'organisation pour l'autorisation fondée sur les politiques.

• Consulter sur les chemins d'intégration: agir en tant que consultant technique principal pour les applications et les propriétaires de données, intégrant les systèmes critiques via les API RESTful, SQL/JDBC et LDAP.

• Pioneer Policy as Code (PAC) : Conduisez le passage à PAC en concevant des pipelines automatisés pour la version, l'essai et le déploiement de la logique d'autorisation comme un logiciel moderne.

• Gérer les cycles de vie des plates-formes : Posséder le cycle de vie tactique des plates-formes d'autorisation, y compris les mises à niveau de version, le réglage continu des performances et le patching de sécurité.

• Analyse des incidents liés au plomb : Mener des enquêtes analytiques approfondies et des analyses des causes profondes en cas d'incidents de cybersécurité modérément complexes, de menaces et de vulnérabilités.

• Streamline Asset Onboarding: Optimisez et accélérez les processus d'embarquement pour les nouveaux actifs numériques tout en assurant un alignement strict avec les règles internationales de confidentialité des données comme le RGPD.

• Collaborez avec les équipes de produits : partenariatz étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les développeurs et les intervenants mondiaux pour créer des workflows PBAC sécurisés, conviviaux et sans friction.

Qui vous êtes

• Professionnel de sécurité expérimenté: Vous apportez 4 à 9 ans d'expérience professionnelle en sécurité informatique, y compris 3 ans et plus spécifiquement axée sur IAM et PBAC/ABAC dans les environnements de grande entreprise.

• Technical Security Master: Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie de XACML, une gestion des politiques décentralisée et des cadres Zero Trust (RBAC et ABAC).

• Expert des fondations d'identité : Vous êtes très compétent en normes d'identité de base, y compris SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Single Sign-On (SSO) et Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).

• DevOps & Integration Developer: Vous êtes qualifié en Java ou Python pour les intégrations personnalisées, avec une expérience pratique en utilisant des pipelines Git et CI/CD pour un déploiement sécurisé de code.

• Professionnel formé: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'un diplôme avancé en informatique, cybersécurité, technologie de l'information ou un domaine connexe (ou expérience professionnelle équivalente).

• Solution de problème analytique: Vous avez avancé raison logique

jobs.title: Praktikum im Bereich Talent Acquisition (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Deine Abteilung

Im Team der Talent Acquisition Partner in Deutschland bringen wir mit viel Engagement und Leidenschaft das Thema Recruiting voran. Wir arbeiten in einem deutschlandweiten Netzwerk bestehend aus motivierten Talent Acquisition Partner:innen und Praktikant:innen. Wir leben in unserem Team eine “Du”-Kultur. Eine enge Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung sind für uns selbstverständlich. Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant*in einen Einblick in das daily business eines Talent Acquisition Partner geben und Dir ein klares Bild unserer Version „ We link Roche to Talents & Talents to Roche “ vermitteln. Wir suchen einen Praktikanten oder eine Praktikantin für unseren Standort in Grenzach, Mannheim oder Penzberg.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du verstehst es zu begeistern? Dann begeistere als Praktikant*in unser Team, indem Du bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Auswahlverfahren unterstützt und selbst Verantwortung übernimmst. Als Roche-Botschafter stehst Du dabei in direktem Kontakt mit den Kandidaten und garantierst, dass diese eine tolle Candidate Experience erleben.

• Pre-Screening von Bewerbungen und die Unterstützung bei Interviews gehören zu Deinem Aufgabengebiet.

• Du begleitest den gesamten Recruiting Prozesses von der Stellenausschreibung bis hin zur Einstellung.

• Durch den direkten Kontakt mit Führungskräften und Bewerbern erhältst Du spannende Einblicke und viele Lernmöglichkeiten.

• Dein Engagement ist gefragt: Denn Du arbeitest an aktuellen Themen und hast die Möglichkeit, eigene (standortübergreifende und internationale) Projekte auf die Beine zu stellen.

Dein Profil

• Das Thema Talent Acquisition / Recruiting begeistert Dich und Du möchtest Erfahrungen in diesem Bereich sammeln.

• Aktuell bist Du in einem wirtschafts-, geistes- oder sozialwissenschaftlichen Studium immatrikuliert oder befindest Dich im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor und Master.

• Du bist kommunikativ, gehst offen auf Menschen zu und bist motiviert, Dich in neue Prozesse einzuarbeiten.

• Du zeichnest Dich durch ein hohes Maß an Flexibilität aus und bewegst Dich sicher im virtuellen Umfeld.

• Außerdem hast du ein positives Mindset und verfügst über eine Can-Do-Mentalität.

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients in person, via phone or Email.

Deine Vorteile

• Deine Entwicklung ist uns wichtig: Daher legen wir viel Wert darauf, dass Du an vielfältigen Aufgabenstellungen arbeiten kannst und immer etwas Neues dazu lernst.

• In unserem Team übernimmst Du schon früh Verantwortung und unterstützt uns aktiv in Recruiting-Prozessen.

• Mobiles Arbeiten ist natürlich auch für Dich als Praktikant möglich und deine Arbeitszeit kannst Du Dir auch flexibel einteilen.

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade nur Deinen aktuellen Lebenslauf online hoch.
Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir keine weiteren Dokumente.
Bitte beachte, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year.

Zeitraum : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your department

jobs.title: R&D Solution Architect - Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
R&D Solution Architect - Medical Affairs

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Within the Pharma Organisation Medical Affairs serves as the bridge between clinical development and the commercialization of medicines. The domain is increasingly focused on External Stakeholder Engagement, aiming to derive deep insights into unmet medical needs, treatment barriers, and patient perceptions of data. By synthesizing these insights, Medical Affairs shapes the organization’s overall strategic direction and orchestrates external Medical Engagement. As an IT Solution Architect in this space, you will support the digital transformation of how scientific evidence is generated, managed, and communicated to the global medical and patient community.

The opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within the solution context of Scientific Communications and Medical Engagement.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in different technology areas supporting the Scientific Commu

La posizione
R&D Solution Architect - Medical Affairs

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

All'interno dell'Organizzazione Farmacia Medical Affairs serve come ponte tra lo sviluppo clinico e la commercializzazione dei farmaci. Il dominio è sempre più focalizzato sull'Engagement degli Stakeholder Esterni, mirando a ricavare profonde intuizioni sui bisogni medici non soddisfatti, sulle barriere di trattamento e sulle percezioni dei dati dei pazienti. sintetizzando queste intuizioni, gli Affari medici modellano la direzione strategica generale dell'organizzazione e orchestrano l'impegno medico esterno. In qualità di IT Solution Architect in questo spazio, supporterete la trasformazione digitale di come le prove scientifiche siano generate, gestite e comunicate alla comunità medica e paziente globale.

L'opportunità:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti del prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno di uno specifico Context Solution. Gestisce i requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Sostegni problemi complessi prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti ed esercitando un giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per la soluzione. Assesse e consultazioni sugli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, sui rischi e sul paesaggio delle applicazioni. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie e ontologie per la soluzione e le sue interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli, e assicura che l'Architettura Decision Records (ADRs) sono adeguatamente registrati.

• Stakeholder Management: Spiega informazioni difficili o sensibili in modo chiaro e attivo lavora per costruire il consenso tra le parti interessate. Guida la condivisione e lo scambio di informazioni sulla soluzione.

• Impatto/Strategia: Sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per i team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico, e le ricerche, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identificare le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona principalmente nel contesto di soluzione delle comunicazioni scientifiche e dell'ingaggio medico.

• Attività commerciale/tecnica: si basa sulla conoscenza generale e approfondita delle diverse aree tecnologiche a sostegno della Comune Scientifica

Die Position
R&D Solution Architect - Medizinische Angelegenheiten

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial erschließt und Durchbrüche ermöglicht, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden und erforscht, bewertet, pilotiert und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien voran. Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Wert- und Geschäftsprozessen.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Arbeitet hauptsächlich im Lösungskontext von Scientific Communications und Medical Engagement.

• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Wendet allgemeine und fundierte Kenntnisse in verschiedenen Technologiebereichen an, die das Scientific Commu unterstützen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Architecte des solutions de R-D - Affaires médicales

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

Au sein de la Pharma Organisation, les affaires médicales servent de pont entre le développement clinique et la commercialisation des médicaments. Le domaine est de plus en plus axé sur l'engagement externe des intervenants, en vue d'obtenir des connaissances approfondies sur les besoins médicaux non satisfaits, les obstacles au traitement et la perception des données par les patients. En synthétisant ces idées, Medical Affairs façonne la direction stratégique globale de l'organisation et orchestre l'engagement médical externe. En tant qu'architecte de solutions informatiques dans cet espace, vous soutiendrez la transformation numérique de la façon dont les preuves scientifiques sont générées, gérées et communiquées à la communauté médicale et patiente mondiale.

L'occasion :

• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) : Concevoir des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Gérer les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de conditionnement physique. Documente et évolue l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit et s'harmonise avec la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance.

• Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : Se pose des problèmes complexes en adoptant une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes et en exerçant un jugement fondé sur l'analyse de multiples sources d'information. Maintenir la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel de la solution. Évaluer et consulter les répercussions et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le contexte d'application. Crée des modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, taxonomies et ontologies pour la solution et ses interfaces. Définit et anime les architectures de référence, les modèles et veille à ce que les documents décisionnels d'architecture (ADR) soient dûment enregistrés.

• Gestion des intervenants : Explique clairement et activement l'information difficile ou délicate afin d'établir un consensus entre les intervenants. Permet le partage et l'échange d'informations sur la solution.

• Impact/Stratégie : Élaborer et maintenir la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies spécifiques aux équipes de produits. Améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies. Indique les possibilités d'améliorer la valeur et les processus opérationnels.

• Complexité / (taille du produit): Fonctionne principalement dans le contexte de la solution des communications scientifiques et de l'engagement médical.

• Capacités commerciales et techniques: Applique des connaissances générales et approfondies dans différents domaines technologiques appuyant la Communauté scientifique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Product Owner - Patient Support

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the Technical Product Owner (m/f/d) for the DIA Commercial Patient Support area, you will operate at the intersection of complex systems engineering and strategic commercial outcomes. You will own the technical vision, architectural coherence, and feature backlog for the platforms that enable our commercial customer service ecosystem. Acting as the definitive bridge between Business Product Owners (BPOs), engineering squads, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and enterprise architecture, you will translate high-level business priorities into precise, scalable, secure, and compliant technical implementations.

The opportunity:

In this role, you will be the driving force behind the technical excellence and operational execution of your product area:

• Outcome Accountability & Execution: Own the product backlog for assigned systems, prioritizing features and operational needs based on business value and compliance (CSV & QA best practices). You will actively champion high-value work and challenge low-impact efforts.

• Architecture & Non-Functional Excellence: Proactively ensure all solutions adhere to established architectural patterns, global technology strategies, and non-functional expectations (performance, reliability, scalability). (Strong Salesforce knowledge is a plus).

• Business Collaboration: Partner closely with BPOs to align technical execution with commercial objectives, translating functional customer service needs into robust technical realities.

• System Ownership & Governance: Serve as the accountable System Owner, ensuring applications remain fit-for-purpose, secure, and fully compliant with IT governance throughout their lifecycle.

• Financial Responsibilities: Manage project budgets and resource allocation effectively, ensuring all initiatives are delivered within financial constraints and optimized.

• Knowledge Transfer & Operational Continuity: Drive the structured capture of product knowledge, comprehensive system documentation, and operational runbooks to ensure high availability and seamless operational handovers.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive alignment across integrations, data workflows, and Managed Service Provider (MSP) coordination while actively participating in Agile ceremonies.

Who you are:

You are a technically fluent product leader with a track record of realizing value in complex, cross-functional settings:

• Leadership & Coaching: Demonstrated experience defining tasks, coaching engineer

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Titolare del prodotto tecnico - Supporto paziente

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Come il proprietario del prodotto tecnico (m/f/d) per l'area di supporto commerciale DIA, si opera all'incrocio di sistemi complessi ingegneria e risultati commerciali strategici. Possiederai la visione tecnica, la coerenza architettonica e avrai un backlog per le piattaforme che permettono al nostro ecosistema di servizio clienti commerciale. Essendo il ponte definitivo tra Business Product Owners (BPOs), team di ingegneria, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), e l'architettura aziendale, tradurrai priorità aziendali di alto livello in implementazioni tecniche precise, scalabili, sicure e conformi.

L'opportunità:

In questo ruolo, sarete la forza trainante dietro l'eccellenza tecnica e l'esecuzione operativa della vostra area di prodotto:

• Accountability & Execution: Possedere il backlog del prodotto per i sistemi assegnati, privilegiare le funzionalità e le esigenze operative basate sul valore aziendale e sulla conformità (le best practice CSV & QA). Sarete attivamente campione di lavoro ad alto valore e sfidare gli sforzi a basso impatto.

• Architettura & Eccellenza Non-Functional: Proattivamente assicurarsi che tutte le soluzioni aderiscano a modelli architettonici consolidati, strategie tecnologiche globali e aspettative non funzionali (performance, affidabilità, scalabilità). (La conoscenza della forza di vendita è un plus).

• Collaborazione aziendale: collaborare a stretto contatto con BPOs per allineare l'esecuzione tecnica con obiettivi commerciali, traducendo le esigenze funzionali del servizio clienti in solide realtà tecniche.

• Proprietario di sistema & Governance: Servire come proprietario responsabile del sistema, assicurando che le applicazioni rimangano adeguate, sicure e pienamente conformi alla governance IT durante il loro ciclo di vita.

• Responsabilità finanziarie: Gestisci i budget del progetto e l'allocazione delle risorse in modo efficace, assicurando che tutte le iniziative siano consegnate entro vincoli finanziari e ottimizzate.

• Trasferimento di conoscenza & Continuità operativa: Guidare la cattura strutturata delle conoscenze dei prodotti, la documentazione completa del sistema e i runbook operativi per garantire elevata disponibilità e consegne operative senza interruzioni.

• Coordinamento cross-Functional: Allineamento dell'azionamento attraverso integrazioni, flussi di lavoro dati e coordinamento Managed Service Provider (MSP), partecipando attivamente alle cerimonie Agile.

Chi sei:

Sei un leader di prodotto tecnicamente fluente con un track record di realizzazione del valore in ambienti complessi e interfunzionali:

• Leadership & Coaching: esperienza dimostrata che definiscono i compiti, ingegnere di coaching

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior QA Automation Engineer

At Roche Information Solutions (RIS), we now do what patients need next. We are transforming healthcare through digital innovation, building high-scale, cloud-native platforms that support clinicians and patients globally. We are seeking a high-seniority Senior QA Automation Engineer for our Warsaw-based hub who can be co-located, and brings an AI-first mindset to the software development lifecycle.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity
You will work on a cloud-native digital pathology platform that is transforming how pathology laboratories operate worldwide. The system enables pathologists, histotechnicians, and laboratory coordinators to digitize tissue slide specimens, manage clinical cases end-to-end, review high-resolution slide images remotely, run AI-powered algorithms for diagnostic decision support, and seamlessly exchange data with laboratory information systems (LIS) and PACS archives. The vision is to deliver advanced medical insights and drive personalized healthcare by replacing manual, microscope-bound workflows with a connected, software-defined laboratory experience.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will own, build, and evolve the automated test frameworks and quality gates that guarantee the reliability of these clinical workflows - from UI and API test layer strategies to algorithm orchestration and third-party integrations - directly contributing to faster, more confident diagnoses for patients globally.

Who you are:

The "AI-First" Mindset
Beyond technical mastery, we value engineers who treat AI agents as a core partner in their workflow:

• SDLC Optimization: Using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, or LLMs) to accelerate test script generation, test data synthesis, refactoring, and root-cause analysis of test failures.

• Agentic Awareness: Understanding how to leverage AI agents to automate routine tasks such as converting specifications into automated test scenarios, test data generation, documentation, and PR descriptions.

• Efficiency: A proactive approach to using prompt engineering to drive speed, coverage, and quality in production-ready test suites.

Technical Skills:

• Expertise in Java: Deep understanding of Core Java and modern design patterns applied to test automation.

• Playwright & JUnit 5: Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and solid knowledge of JUnit 5 for both UI and API test automation.

• Test Architecture & Layering: Proven experience designing maintainable, scalable test frameworks, structuring multimodule suites in Maven, and executing a sound Test Layering Strategy.

• API Testing: Deep understanding of API test types (contract, functional, integration, smoke) and knowing precisely when to apply each.

• Code Quality Principles: Sound understanding of coding principles (SOLID, DRY, KISS) and their applicability in test codebases to produce stable, reliable, non-flaky tests.

• CI/CD & Reporting: Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitHub Actions) and leveraging test reporting tools like Allure or comparable frameworks.

• Tools & Ecosystem: Proficiency with Git, Jira, and Confluence. Experience with Angular,

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior QA Automation Engineer

At Roche Information Solutions (RIS), we now do what patients need next. We are transforming healthcare through digital innovation, building high-scale, cloud-native platforms that support clinicians and patients globally. We are seeking a high-seniority Senior QA Automation Engineer for our Warsaw-based hub who can be co-located, and brings an AI-first mindset to the software development lifecycle.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity
You will work on a cloud-native digital pathology platform that is transforming how pathology laboratories operate worldwide. The system enables pathologists, histotechnicians, and laboratory coordinators to digitize tissue slide specimens, manage clinical cases end-to-end, review high-resolution slide images remotely, run AI-powered algorithms for diagnostic decision support, and seamlessly exchange data with laboratory information systems (LIS) and PACS archives. The vision is to deliver advanced medical insights and drive personalized healthcare by replacing manual, microscope-bound workflows with a connected, software-defined laboratory experience.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will own, build, and evolve the automated test frameworks and quality gates that guarantee the reliability of these clinical workflows - from UI and API test layer strategies to algorithm orchestration and third-party integrations - directly contributing to faster, more confident diagnoses for patients globally.

Who you are:

The "AI-First" Mindset
Beyond technical mastery, we value engineers who treat AI agents as a core partner in their workflow:

• SDLC Optimization: Using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, or LLMs) to accelerate test script generation, test data synthesis, refactoring, and root-cause analysis of test failures.

• Agentic Awareness: Understanding how to leverage AI agents to automate routine tasks such as converting specifications into automated test scenarios, test data generation, documentation, and PR descriptions.

• Efficiency: A proactive approach to using prompt engineering to drive speed, coverage, and quality in production-ready test suites.

Technical Skills:

• Expertise in Java: Deep understanding of Core Java and modern design patterns applied to test automation.

• Playwright & JUnit 5: Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and solid knowledge of JUnit 5 for both UI and API test automation.

• Test Architecture & Layering: Proven experience designing maintainable, scalable test frameworks, structuring multimodule suites in Maven, and executing a sound Test Layering Strategy.

• API Testing: Deep understanding of API test types (contract, functional, integration, smoke) and knowing precisely when to apply each.

• Code Quality Principles: Sound understanding of coding principles (SOLID, DRY, KISS) and their applicability in test codebases to produce stable, reliable, non-flaky tests.

• CI/CD & Reporting: Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitHub Actions) and leveraging test reporting tools like Allure or comparable frameworks.

• Tools & Ecosystem: Proficiency with Git, Jira, and Confluence. Experience with Angular,

• Architecture de test et calque: Expérience éprouvée en concevant des cadres de test évolutifs, en structurant des suites multimodules à Maven et en exécutant une stratégie de calque de test.

Are you an agile engineering professional looking to keep cutting-edge life sciences laboratories operating at peak performance? Join our cross-functional site network across Santa Clara and Pleasanton as a Manufacturing Equipment Engineer. In this high-impact role, you will safeguard our facility's "Right to Operate" by managing critical laboratory infrastructure, ensuring continuous regulatory compliance, and maximizing system uptime. By serving as the core technical leader for our Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) and quality risk management, your expertise will directly ensure data integrity, operational efficiency, and product quality in a regulated environment.

As a Manufacturing Equipment Engineer, you will serve as the system controller and administrator for the site’s Environmental Monitoring System (EMS), overseeing everything from database administration and alert matrices to software maintenance and sensor allocation. Beyond EMS stewardship, you will drive total equipment lifecycle management across clinical and facility infrastructure—including liquid handling devices, CTUs, and imaging systems—by leading calibrations, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting. • Supporto Audit & Compliance: Fornire supporto tecnico diretto di fronte-camera e backroom durante le recensioni di qualità interna e controlli normativi esterni (ad esempio, FDA, BSI) assemblando registri di attrezzature critiche e registri delle escursioni.

• Equipaggiamento Lifecycle & Manutenzione: Pianificare, validare, calibrare ed eseguire la manutenzione preventiva e correttiva attraverso le attrezzature del sito e i sistemi di utilità per minimizzare i tempi di fermo operativo.

• Infrastructure & Commissioning Support: supervisionare l'installazione, la risoluzione dei problemi e i programmi C&Q (Commissioning & Qualification) per CTU, utilità di processo e sistemi di struttura, analizzando continuamente le tendenze di stato del sistema per i miglioramenti.

• Formazione e amministrazione del sito: Gestisci le credenziali di accesso al sistema, conduci la formazione di software tecnico e funge da addestratore qualificato per le procedure operative standard del sito C&Q (SOP).

Wer du bist

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Vulnerability & Exposure Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche is dedicated to protecting our networks, systems, applications, and users from constantly evolving cyber threats. As a Security Engineer within the Vulnerability & Exposure Management team, you will play a critical role in identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and reducing cybersecurity risks across Roche’s global environment.

This role goes beyond reviewing scanner outputs. You will help investigate critical vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, improve security tooling and automation capabilities, and partner with stakeholders globally to strengthen Roche’s security posture.

You will join a collaborative and highly technical cybersecurity team that values innovation, curiosity, continuous learning, and proactive risk reduction.

Your Opportunity
In this role, you will:

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities impacting Roche systems and applications

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities identified through security tools and external programs, including bug bounty initiatives

• Research emerging threats and assess exploitability against Roche’s attack surface

• Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application, and security teams to drive remediation activities

• Assess company systems and web applications using automated and manual testing approaches

• Engineer and enhance vulnerability scanning, detection, automation, and monitoring capabilities

• Contribute to security monitoring and incident response activities within a global environment

• Develop scripts, detection logic, templates, and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across vulnerability and exposure management processes

Who you are
You bring a strong cybersecurity foundation combined with analytical thinking, technical curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving complex security challenges.

You also bring:

• Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of professional experience in information security, with demonstrated experience triaging, analyzing, and escalating security vulnerabilities

• Strong understanding of web application, network, endpoint, and cloud security concepts, including vulnerability management or attack surface management within complex enterprise environments

• Hands-on scripting or programming experience using languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Node.js, with familiarity in security tooling, detection logic, automation, or custom scripting

• Experience validating vulnerabilities, assessing exploitability, and supporting security monitoring or incident response activities

• Ability to communicate technical risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, while balancing operational priorities and research initiatives

• Passion for cybersecurity, continuous learning, and emerging security trends, with exposure to open-source security projects or modern AI-assisted engineering workflows considered advantageous

• Professional fluency in English, with industry certifications related to offensive or application security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE) and enterprise cloud security experience viewed as strong assets

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mill

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il team Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR) di Roche è dedicato a proteggere le nostre reti, sistemi, applicazioni e utenti da minacce informatiche in continua evoluzione. Come Ingegnere di Sicurezza all'interno del team Vulnerability & Exposure Management, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell'individuazione, nella valutazione, nella priorità e nella riduzione dei rischi di sicurezza informatica in tutto l'ambiente globale di Roche.

Questo ruolo va oltre la revisione degli output dello scanner. Aiuterai a indagare sulle vulnerabilità critiche, valutare l’utilità, migliorare le funzionalità di sicurezza e automazione e collaborare con gli stakeholder a livello globale per rafforzare la postura di sicurezza di Roche.

Ti unirai a un team di cybersecurity collaborativo e altamente tecnico che valorizza innovazione, curiosità, apprendimento continuo e riduzione del rischio proattivo.

La tua opportunità
In questo ruolo, voi:

• Triage, indagare e rispondere alle vulnerabilità critiche che influenzano i sistemi e le applicazioni Roche

• Valutare e privilegiare le vulnerabilità identificate attraverso strumenti di sicurezza e programmi esterni, comprese le iniziative di bug bounty

• Ricerca di minacce emergenti e valutazione dell’exploit contro la superficie di attacco di Roche

• Collabora con i team di infrastruttura, cloud, applicazione e sicurezza per guidare le attività di bonifica

• Valutare i sistemi aziendali e le applicazioni web utilizzando approcci di test automatizzati e manuali

• Ingegnere e migliorare le capacità di scansione, rilevamento, automazione e monitoraggio della vulnerabilità

• Contribuisci alle attività di monitoraggio della sicurezza e risposta agli incidenti in un ambiente globale

• Sviluppare script, logica di rilevamento, modelli e flussi di lavoro di automazione per migliorare l'efficienza operativa

• Sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso processi di vulnerabilità e gestione dell'esposizione

Chi sei
Porti una forte fondazione di sicurezza informatica combinata con il pensiero analitico, la curiosità tecnica e un approccio proattivo per risolvere complesse sfide di sicurezza.

Porti anche:

• Associate Degree in un campo rilevante o 5+ anni di esperienza professionale nella sicurezza delle informazioni, con esperienza dimostrata triaging, analisi e accelerazione delle vulnerabilità di sicurezza

• Forte comprensione dei concetti di applicazione web, rete, endpoint e sicurezza cloud, compresa la gestione delle vulnerabilità o la gestione della superficie di attacco all'interno di ambienti aziendali complessi

• Hands-on scripting o esperienza di programmazione utilizzando linguaggi come Python, JavaScript o Node.js, con familiarità negli strumenti di sicurezza, logica di rilevamento, automazione o script personalizzati

• Esperienza validazione delle vulnerabilità, valutazione dell'exploit e supporto al monitoraggio della sicurezza o alle attività di risposta agli incidenti

• Capacità di comunicare efficacemente i rischi tecnici agli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici, bilanciando le priorità operative e le iniziative di ricerca

• Passione per la sicurezza informatica, l'apprendimento continuo e le tendenze di sicurezza emergenti, con l'esposizione a progetti di sicurezza open source o moderni flussi di lavoro di ingegneria assistiti dall'IA considerati vantaggiosi

• Fluency professionale in inglese, con certificazioni del settore relative alla sicurezza offensiva o di applicazione (ad esempio, OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE) e esperienza di sicurezza cloud enterprise vista come asset forti

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 mulini

• Agile Collaboration: Guidare l'integrazione del nuovo modello operativo, servendo come modello di ruolo per una collaborazione agile all'interno del sottocategoria di creazione dei contenuti.

• Leadership trasversale: collaborare efficacemente con diversi capitoli, sottocategorie e altri team rilevanti per guidare soluzioni di creazione di contenuti efficaci e allineare con le strategie di business e Global Digital Hub.

• Qualità del servizio: fornire raccomandazioni per migliorare la qualità dei servizi, la reattività e l'output dei contenuti per soddisfare o superare le aspettative dei partner commerciali.

• Governance dei processi: Stabilire e mantenere i principi di governance dei processi, garantire la corretta documentazione e l'aderenza alle best practice di creazione dei contenuti nell'ambito della responsabilità del Subchapter Creazione dei contenuti.

• Impegno di Stakeholder: Rappresenta professionalmente il Subchapter Content Creation con i principali stakeholder, promuovendo il valore e l'impatto della creazione di contenuti all'interno dell'organizzazione.

• Contenuti Tech & AI Integration: Guida l'adozione del team, la formazione e la condivisione best-practice intorno ai moderni contenuti tech, strumenti di scrittura GenAI, sistemi DAM e piattaforme di revisione regolamentare (ad esempio, Veeva Vault).

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Der Global Digital Hub ist eine wachsende Geschäftslinie im Roche Services & Solutions Center. Unser primäres Ziel ist es, die digitalen Fähigkeiten von Roche weltweit zu verbessern, indem wir zentrale Initiativen in Bereichen wie Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation und Creative Design unterstützen.

Die Chance
Der Content Creation Subchapter Lead ist eine zentrale Führungskraft, die Unterkapitelmitglieder dazu inspiriert und engagiert, im gesamten Netzwerk zusammenzuarbeiten und einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu den zehnjährigen Ambitionen von Roche zu leisten. Diese Rolle ist verantwortlich für die Integration des neuen Betriebsmodells, das die agile Zusammenarbeit veranschaulicht. Das Content Creation Chapter Team besteht aus medizinischen Autoren, Content Editoren, Projektbereitstellungskoordinatoren und Spezialisten für die Qualitätssicherung von medizinischen Kopien.

Als Content Creation Subchapter Lead sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, die strategische Vision und Ausrichtung des Kapitels zu unterstützen und kontinuierlich nach Möglichkeiten für Innovation und Wertschöpfung zu suchen. Diese kritische Position hat eine globale Reichweite und führt ein vielfältiges Team in verschiedenen Regionen. Ihre Arbeit umfasst, aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• People Leadership: Führen, Mentoren und entwickeln Sie Teammitglieder und bieten Sie Coaching und Unterstützung, damit sie Content-Erstellungsprojekte erfolgreich durchführen und ihre Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich verbessern können. Erstellen und implementieren Sie persönliche Entwicklungspläne, die auf individuelle Bedürfnisse und Wünsche zugeschnitten sind.

• Operative Führung: Koordinieren Sie den Betrieb des Content Creation Unterkapitels, um eine hohe Effektivität der zugewiesenen Content Creation-Aktivitäten zu gewährleisten. Verwalten Sie Ressourcen zur Erstellung von Inhalten, überwachen Sie deren Nutzung und stellen Sie die Kundenzufriedenheit im Unterkapitel sicher.

• Rekrutierung: Finden, gewinnen, entwickeln und halten Top-Talente, ausgerichtet auf die sich entwickelnden Bedürfnisse der Funktion und des Unternehmens. Führen Sie Interviews durch und erleichtern Sie den Onboarding-Prozess.

• Capability Building: Fördern Sie die Entwicklung der Mitglieder des Content-Erstellungsteams und fördern Sie eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens, der Innovation und der Exzellenz der Inhalte.

• Agile Collaboration: Betreiben Sie die Einbettung des neuen Betriebsmodells und dienen Sie als Vorbild für die agile Zusammenarbeit im Unterkapitel Content Creation.

• Funktionale Führung: Arbeiten Sie effektiv mit verschiedenen Kapiteln, Unterkapiteln und anderen relevanten Teams zusammen, um wirkungsvolle Content-Erstellungslösungen voranzutreiben und sich an Geschäfts- und Global Digital Hub-Strategien auszurichten.

• Servicequalität: Geben Sie Empfehlungen zur Verbesserung der Servicequalität, Reaktionsfähigkeit und Inhaltsausgabe, um die Erwartungen von Geschäftspartnern zu erfüllen oder zu übertreffen.

• Prozess-Governance: Festlegung und Aufrechterhaltung von Prozess-Governance-Prinzipien, Gewährleistung einer ordnungsgemäßen Dokumentation und Einhaltung der Best Practices für die Erstellung von Inhalten im Rahmen der Verantwortung des Content Creation-Unterkapitels.

• Stakeholder-Engagement: Repräsentieren Sie das Content Creation Unterkapitel professionell mit den wichtigsten Stakeholdern und fördern Sie den Wert und die Auswirkungen der Content-Erstellung innerhalb des Unternehmens.

• Content Tech & AI Integration: Fördert Teamakzeptanz, Schulungen und Best-Practice-Sharing rund um moderne Content Tech, GenAI-Schreibwerkzeuge, DAM-Systeme und regulatorische Überprüfungsplattformen (z. B. Veeva Vault).

La position
Le Global Digital Hub est un secteur d'activité en croissance au sein du Roche Services & Solutions Center. Notre objectif principal est d'améliorer les capacités numériques de Roche à l'échelle mondiale en soutenant des initiatives centrales dans des domaines tels que la gestion des médias sociaux, le soutien aux marques, les services d'édition numérique, l'automatisation du marketing, la création de contenu et le design créatif.

L'opportunité
Le sous-chapitre Création Lead est un chef de file de personnes pivots qui inspire et engage les membres du sous-chapitre à collaborer à travers le réseau, contribuant de façon significative à Roches Ten Year Ambitions. Ce rôle est responsable de l'intégration du nouveau modèle d'exploitation, qui illustre la collaboration agile. L'équipe du chapitre de création de contenu se compose d'écrivains médicaux, d'éditeurs de contenu, de coordonnateurs de l'exécution de projets et de spécialistes de l'assurance de la qualité des copies médicales.

En tant que sous-chapitre responsable de la création de contenu, vous serez chargé de soutenir la vision stratégique et la direction du chapitre, en cherchant continuellement des possibilités d'innovation et de création de valeur. Cette position critique a une portée mondiale, dirigeant une équipe diversifiée dans différentes régions. Votre travail comprendra entre autres :

• People Leadership : Dirigez, mentorez et développez les membres de l'équipe, en fournissant coaching et soutien pour leur permettre d'exécuter des projets de création de contenu avec succès et d'améliorer continuellement leurs compétences. Créer et mettre en oeuvre des plans de développement personnel adaptés aux besoins et aspirations individuels.

• Leadership opérationnel : Coordonner le fonctionnement du sous-chapitre Création de contenu, assurant une grande efficacité des activités de création de contenu assignées. Gérer les ressources de création de contenu, surveiller leur utilisation et assurer la satisfaction des clients au sein du sous-chapitre.

• Recrutement : Trouver, attirer, développer et retenir les meilleurs talents, en fonction de l'évolution des besoins de la fonction et de l'entreprise. Mener des entrevues et faciliter le processus d'embarquement.

• Renforcement des capacités : Favoriser le développement des membres de l'équipe de création de contenu, promouvoir une culture de l'apprentissage continu, de l'innovation et de l'excellence du contenu.

• Collaboration Agile : Conduire l'intégration du nouveau modèle opérationnel, servant de modèle pour la collaboration agile au sein du sous-chapitre création de contenu.

• Leadership trans-fonctionnel : Collaborez efficacement avec différents chapitres, sous-chapitres et autres équipes pertinentes afin de générer des solutions de création de contenu impactées et de s'aligner sur les stratégies d'affaires et de Global Digital Hub.

• Qualité du service : Fournir des recommandations pour améliorer la qualité du service, la réactivité et la production de contenu afin de répondre aux attentes des partenaires commerciaux ou de les dépasser.

• Gouvernance du processus : Établir et maintenir des principes de gouvernance du processus, en veillant à ce que la documentation appropriée et le respect des pratiques exemplaires de création de contenu soient compris dans la responsabilité du sous-chapitre Création de contenu.

• Engagement des intervenants : représentez professionnellement le sous-chapitre Création de contenu avec les intervenants clés, en faisant la promotion de la valeur et de l'impact de la création de contenu au sein de l'organisation.

• Intégration de la technologie du contenu et de l'intelligence artificielle : favorise l'adoption par l'équipe, la formation et le partage des meilleures pratiques autour de la technologie du contenu moderne, des outils d'écriture GenAI, des systèmes DAM et des plateformes d'examen réglementaire (par exemple, Veeva Vault).

• OneRoche Mindset : Soutenir l'intégration de l'esprit OneRoche au sein du sous-chapitre Création de contenu et à travers le Global Digital Hub, favorisant une culture d'innovation et de collaboration.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un individu dynamique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

The Medical Copy and Content Team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.

The Opportunity
As a Medical Copywriter (Junior Medical Writer), you will support the growing Medical Writing Team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives.
In addition, you will work with Senior Medical Writers to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs.
As a Medical Copywriter you will commit to continuous professional development and you will uphold the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality, and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines, both local and international.

As an emerging expert, you will:

• Engage in continuous learning and development. Participate actively in mentorship and training programs to gain comprehensive knowledge of Roche’s therapeutic areas and enhance medical writing skills. This includes attending workshops, seminars, and one-on-one mentoring sessions to ensure the production of high-quality scientific documents.

• Assist in writing and editing medical content for different formats/digital channels and platforms, including information for patients, educational materials for HCPs (slides, posters, speaker briefs and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports/study summaries, and materials for use in public relations teams.

• Exhibit excellent writing skills and be open to working on briefs across various outputs and disease areas with internal support.

• Understand and analyze briefs by identifying key components and formulating relevant questions for clients. Proactively identify and raise potential issues with briefs that may affect delivery.

• Demonstrate high-level self-editing to understand common proofing errors and ensure client-ready quality.

• Accurately reference and create marked-up packs, ensuring the authenticity and authority of source files with clear, accurate mark-up and appropriate filing.

• Adhere to regulatory frameworks and research specific guidelines for accurate writing.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines.

• Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered on time.

• Prepare content for LMR approval in VVPM (incl. referencing).

• Partner with the Creative teams to develop content.

• Proactively contribute creative ideas, concepts or suggestions to provide added value

• Exercise excellent interpersonal/communication skills for effective and professional liaison with the internal team, clients, healthcare professiona
