jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche PD’s mission is to improve patients’ lives around the world through unique medicines that have a meaningful impact. Cross functionally we conduct global clinical trials, analyse results, monitor safety and work with regulatory authorities to provide truly differentiated medicines to patients. Our primary disease focus areas are Oncology, Hematology, Neurology, Immunology, Ophthalmology and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM).

The Product Development Global Clinical Operations team is at the heart of this mission, and we aspire to be leaders in Clinical Operations. We are responsible for providing operational project management, leadership and expertise. We act as the interface between Roche and external parties for optimal study delivery emphasising the importance of speed and cost-effectiveness. We instill an enterprise-wide perspective in all our work so that we continue to deliver for patients and Roche in accordance with regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) standards.

As an Industrial Placement Student (IPS) in Clinical Operations, you will get involved in supporting key tasks across a broad range of topics with potential to build your network outside of the department, ultimately helping accelerate drug development and the successful execution of clinical trials.
We want you to join our mission and be part of our passionate, collaborative, dynamic Clinical Operations community!

The Opportunity :

We are offering an outstanding 13 month placement opportunity for up to six Industrial Placement Students (IPS), who will be based in Welwyn Garden City, UK .
The IPS-COA will sit within Clinical Operations and be assigned to a clinical trial as well as be a valued part of a supportive and collaborative study community. The IPS-COA will be included in working groups where they will do meaningful work and have the opportunity to develop their skills and knowledge as well as connect and collaborate with individuals in other functions outside of Operations. The IPS-COA will work closely with the Global Studies Leader (GSL) and the Global Studies Asset Manager (GSAM), who are responsible for effective and efficient leadership and delivery of all operational components of a clinical trial across study start up, conduct and close-out in accordance with the appropriate quality standards including Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and applicable regulations.

Students may also have the opportunity to work alongside the Country and Study Start-Up Teams. In this capacity they will strengthen site engagement, ensure effective communication and collaboration with clinical trial sites, and add value to Roche’s portfolio, from early to late-stage development across Roche assets.

Key activities include:

• Day-to-Day Operations: Support the study team with daily operational tasks to ensure the clinical trial runs smoothly (e.g., patient recruitment, problem-solving, and working with contracts).

• Vendor Management: Assist in managing external vendors and Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

• Drug Supply: Support the management of clinical drug supply and shipments.

• Site Engagement: Work with the local study team to support effective study start-up strategies and assist in developing strong relationships with trial sites (including potential site visit opportunities).

• Compliance: Ensure study adherence to GCP and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Networking: Attend and actively participate in non-stud

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
La missione di Roche PD è di migliorare la vita dei pazienti in tutto il mondo attraverso farmaci unici che hanno un impatto significativo. Attraversiamo funzionale studi clinici globali, analisi dei risultati, monitoraggio della sicurezza e lavoro con le autorità di regolamentazione per fornire farmaci veramente differenziati ai pazienti. Le nostre aree principali sono Oncologia, Ematologia, Neurologia, Immunologia, Oftalmologia e Cardiovascolare, Renale e Metabolismo (CVRM).

Il team Global Clinical Operations è al centro di questa missione, e aspiriamo ad essere leader nelle Operazioni Cliniche. Siamo responsabili della gestione operativa dei progetti, della leadership e della competenza. Agiamo come interfaccia tra Roche e parti esterne per una consegna ottimale dello studio che sottolinea l'importanza della velocità e dell'efficacia dei costi. Instilliamo una prospettiva a livello aziendale in tutto il nostro lavoro in modo che continuiamo a fornire per i pazienti e Roche in conformità con le normative, buona pratica clinica (GCP) e buone pratiche di farmacovigilanza (GVP) standard.

In qualità di studente di collocamento industriale (IPS) nelle operazioni cliniche, sarete coinvolti nel sostenere i compiti chiave in una vasta gamma di argomenti con il potenziale di costruire la vostra rete al di fuori del dipartimento, in ultima analisi, aiutando ad accelerare lo sviluppo della droga e l'esecuzione riuscita di studi clinici.
Vogliamo che si unisca alla nostra missione e faccia parte della nostra appassionata, collaborativa, dinamica comunità di Operazioni Cliniche!

L'opportunità :

Stiamo offrendo una straordinaria opportunità di collocamento di 13 mesi per un massimo di sei studenti di collocamento industriale (IPS), che saranno basati in Welwyn Garden City, Regno Unito .
La IPS-COA siederà all'interno delle Operazioni Cliniche e sarà assegnata ad una sperimentazione clinica e sarà una parte preziosa di una comunità di studio solidale e collaborativa. L'IPS-COA sarà incluso in gruppi di lavoro dove faranno un lavoro significativo e avranno l'opportunità di sviluppare le proprie competenze e conoscenze, nonché di connettersi e collaborare con gli individui in altre funzioni al di fuori delle Operazioni. L'IPS-COA lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Global Studies Leader (GSL) e il Global Studies Asset Manager (GSAM), che sono responsabili di una leadership efficace ed efficiente e la consegna di tutti i componenti operativi di uno studio clinico attraverso l'avvio, la condotta e la chiusura in conformità con gli standard di qualità appropriati, tra cui la buona pratica clinica (GCP) e le normative applicabili.

Gli studenti possono anche avere l'opportunità di lavorare accanto al Paese e Studio Start-Up Teams. In questa capacità rafforzeranno l’impegno del sito, garantiranno una comunicazione efficace e una collaborazione con i siti di sperimentazione clinica, e aggiungeranno valore al portafoglio di Roche, dal primo al tardo stadio dello sviluppo dei beni Roche.

Le attività principali includono:

• Operazioni giornaliere: Sostenere il team di studio con compiti operativi giornalieri per garantire che la sperimentazione clinica funzioni senza intoppi (ad esempio, il reclutamento dei pazienti, la risoluzione dei problemi e il lavoro con i contratti).

• Gestione del Fornitore: Assist nella gestione di fornitori esterni e organizzazioni di ricerca dei contratti (CRO).

• Droga: Supporta la gestione dell'approvvigionamento e delle spedizioni di farmaci clinici.

• Engagement del sito: lavorare con il team di studio locale per sostenere strategie di avvio di studio efficaci e aiutare a sviluppare relazioni forti con i siti di prova (incluse le potenziali opportunità di visita del sito).

• Compliance: Assicurare l'adesione di studio a GCP e procedure operative standard (SOP).

• Networking: Partecipare e partecipare attivamente al non-stud

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Mission von Roche PD ist es, das Leben von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt durch einzigartige Medikamente zu verbessern, die eine bedeutende Wirkung haben. Funktionell führen wir globale klinische Studien durch, analysieren Ergebnisse, überwachen die Sicherheit und arbeiten mit Regulierungsbehörden zusammen, um Patienten wirklich differenzierte Medikamente zur Verfügung zu stellen. Unsere primären Krankheitsschwerpunkte sind Onkologie, Hämatologie, Neurologie, Immunologie, Augenheilkunde und Herz-Kreislauf-, Nieren- und Stoffwechsel (CVRM).

Das Product Development Global Clinical Operations Team steht im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission, und wir streben danach, führend in Clinical Operations zu sein. Wir sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung von operativem Projektmanagement, Führung und Expertise. Wir fungieren als Schnittstelle zwischen Roche und externen Parteien für eine optimale Studienabwicklung und betonen die Bedeutung von Geschwindigkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit. Wir vermitteln bei all unserer Arbeit eine unternehmensweite Perspektive, so dass wir weiterhin für Patienten und Roche gemäß den Standards Good Clinical Practice (GCP) und Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) liefern.

Als Industrial Placement Student (IPS) in Clinical Operations werden Sie in die Unterstützung von Schlüsselaufgaben in einem breiten Spektrum von Themen mit dem Potenzial, Ihr Netzwerk außerhalb der Abteilung aufzubauen, letztlich helfen, die Medikamentenentwicklung und die erfolgreiche Durchführung von klinischen Studien zu beschleunigen.
Wir möchten, dass Sie sich unserer Mission anschließen und Teil unserer leidenschaftlichen, kooperativen, dynamischen Clinical Operations Community werden!

Die Gelegenheit:

Wir bieten eine hervorragende 13-monatige Praktikumsmöglichkeit für bis zu sechs Industrial Placement Students (IPS), die in Welwyn Garden City, Großbritannien, ansässig sein werden.
Die IPS-COA wird innerhalb der Clinical Operations angesiedelt und einer klinischen Studie zugewiesen sowie ein geschätzter Teil einer unterstützenden und kooperativen Studiengemeinschaft sein. Die IPS-COA wird in Arbeitsgruppen aufgenommen, in denen sie sinnvolle Arbeit leisten und die Möglichkeit haben, ihre Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse zu entwickeln und sich mit Einzelpersonen in anderen Funktionen außerhalb von Operations zu verbinden und zusammenzuarbeiten. Die IPS-COA wird eng mit dem Global Studies Leader (GSL) und dem Global Studies Asset Manager (GSAM) zusammenarbeiten, die für die effektive und effiziente Führung und Durchführung aller operativen Komponenten einer klinischen Studie in Übereinstimmung mit den entsprechenden Qualitätsstandards, einschließlich Good Clinical Practice (GCP) und den geltenden Vorschriften, verantwortlich sind.

Die Studierenden können auch die Möglichkeit haben, neben dem Land und Study Start-Up Teams zu arbeiten. In dieser Eigenschaft werden sie die Standortbindung stärken, eine effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit klinischen Studienstandorten sicherstellen und das Portfolio von Roche von der frühen bis zur späten Entwicklungsphase in allen Roche-Vermögensbereichen bereichern.

Zu den wichtigsten Aktivitäten gehören:

• Tagesgeschäft: Unterstützen Sie das Studienteam bei täglichen operativen Aufgaben, um sicherzustellen, dass die klinische Studie reibungslos abläuft (z. B. Patientenrekrutierung, Problemlösung und Arbeit mit Verträgen).

• Vendor Management: Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung externer Anbieter und Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

• Drug Supply: Unterstützung des Managements der klinischen Arzneimittelversorgung und -lieferungen.

• Site Engagement: Arbeiten Sie mit dem lokalen Studienteam zusammen, um effektive Startstrategien für Studien zu unterstützen und dabei zu helfen, starke Beziehungen zu Studienstandorten aufzubauen (einschließlich potenzieller Besuchsmöglichkeiten).

• Compliance: Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von GCP und Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Networking: Beteiligen und aktiv an Non-Stud
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Roche a pour mission d'améliorer la vie des patients à travers le monde grâce à des médicaments uniques qui ont un impact significatif. Nous menons des essais cliniques mondiaux, analysons les résultats, surveillons la sécurité et travaillons avec les autorités de régulation pour fournir des médicaments vraiment différenciés aux patients. Nos principaux domaines d'intervention pour les maladies sont l'oncologie, l'hématologie, la neurologie, l'immunologie, l'ophtalmologie et le cardiovasculaire, le renal et le métabolisme (CVRM).

L'équipe Développement de produits Opérations cliniques mondiales est au cœur de cette mission, et nous aspirons à être des leaders en Opérations cliniques. Nous sommes responsables de la gestion opérationnelle des projets, du leadership et de l'expertise. Nous agissons en tant qu'interface entre Roche et les parties externes pour une prestation optimale de l'étude en soulignant l'importance de la rapidité et de la rentabilité. Nous instilisons une perspective globale dans tous nos travaux afin que nous continuions à fournir pour les patients et Roche conformément aux règlements, aux bonnes pratiques cliniques (BCP) et aux bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance (GVP).

En tant qu'étudiant en placement industriel (IPS) en opérations cliniques, vous participerez à l'appui de tâches clés sur un large éventail de sujets susceptibles de créer votre réseau à l'extérieur du ministère, en fin de compte aider à accélérer le développement de médicaments et la réussite des essais cliniques.
Nous voulons que vous rejoigniez notre mission et participiez à notre communauté d'opérations cliniques passionnée, collaborative et dynamique!

La possibilité :

Nous offrons une occasion exceptionnelle de placement de 13 mois pour jusqu'à six étudiants en placement industriel (IPS), qui seront basés à Welwyn Garden City, Royaume-Uni .
L'IPS-COA siégera dans le cadre des Opérations cliniques et sera affecté à un essai clinique ainsi qu'à une partie précieuse d'une communauté d'étude solidaire. L'IPS-COA sera inclus dans des groupes de travail où ils feront un travail significatif et auront la possibilité de développer leurs compétences et leurs connaissances ainsi que de communiquer et de collaborer avec des personnes dans d'autres fonctions en dehors des opérations. L'IPS-COA travaillera en étroite collaboration avec le responsable des études mondiales et le gestionnaire des biens d'études mondiales (GSAM), qui sont responsables de la direction et de la prestation efficaces et efficientes de toutes les composantes opérationnelles d'un essai clinique tout au long du démarrage, de la conduite et de la clôture de l'étude, conformément aux normes de qualité appropriées, y compris les bonnes pratiques cliniques (BCP) et les règlements applicables.

Les étudiants peuvent également avoir la possibilité de travailler avec les équipes de démarrage de pays et d'études. À ce titre, ils renforceront l'engagement du site, assureront une communication et une collaboration efficaces avec les sites d'essais cliniques et ajouteront de la valeur au portefeuille de Roches, du début à la fin du développement de l'ensemble des actifs de Roche.

Les principales activités sont les suivantes :

• Opérations quotidiennes : Appuyer l'équipe d'étude avec des tâches opérationnelles quotidiennes pour assurer le bon déroulement de l'essai clinique (p. ex. recrutement de patients, résolution de problèmes et travail avec des contrats).

• Gestion des fournisseurs : Aider à gérer les fournisseurs externes et les organismes de recherche contractuels (ORC).

• Offre de médicaments : Appuyer la gestion de l'offre et des expéditions de médicaments cliniques.

• Engagement sur place : Collaborer avec l'équipe d'étude locale pour appuyer des stratégies de démarrage efficaces et aider à établir des relations solides avec les sites d'essai (y compris les possibilités de visite sur place).

• Conformité : Veiller à ce que l'étude respecte le PSG et les procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON).

• Réseautage: Participer et participer activement à des activités non-stud

jobs.title: Intern - Brand & Customer Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Le Poste
Au sein du département Business Operations de Roche, le/la stagiaire sera intégré(e) à l’équipe Marketing (Hémophilie ou Oncologie).
Le stage permettra de contribuer à la mise en œuvre de stratégies marketing innovantes visant à améliorer l’engagement des professionnels de santé et le parcours patient en Hémophilie. Il offre une immersion complète dans un environnement dynamique, à l’interface entre marketing, médical et stratégie, avec une forte orientation patient-centric.

Tâches Principales
- Contribuer au développement d’une stratégie multicanal et à l’exécution de campagnes marketing (digital, supports promotionnels, contenus éducatifs)
- Participer aux tâches administratives liées aux campagnes (process de validation, coordination logistique, impression)
- Assurer le suivi des performances des campagnes en lien avec les équipes terrain et proposer des recommandations d’optimisation
- Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour développer des contenus adaptés aux différents canaux d’engagement
- Participer à l’organisation d’événements scientifiques (congrès, symposiums, séminaires)
- Participer à la gestion de projets marketing (conception, initiation, coordination et suivi)
- Travailler en transverse avec les équipes médicales, réglementaires et accès au marché
- Contribuer aux réflexions stratégiques (plan stratégique, initiatives d’amélioration du parcours patient)

Qui vous etes?
- Vous avez une formation scientifique (Pharmacie, Médecine, Biologie) doublée d’une spécialisation en Marketing
- Vous avez une première expérience en marketing en industrie pharmaceutique, en conseil ou stratégie.
- Vous faites preuve de rigueur et d’organisation, et vous aimez le travail en équipe et êtes doté(e) de bonnes aptitudes relationnelles et de communication.
- Développement d’une approche customer-centric et patient-centric
- Analyse de la performance des campagnes marketing et génération d’insights
- Gestion de projet (planning, coordination, suivi)
- Collaboration cross-fonctionnelle (médical, réglementaire, market access)
- Développement de contenus marketing et scientifiques
- Rigueur, organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités

Durée du stage: 6 mois avec possibilité de renouvellement selon les besoins de l'entreprise.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As an Engineering Manager you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

What you’ll be working on

People Management

• Responsible for providing a wide range of leadership for the team including but not limited to: Provide proactive feedback and coaching to responsible employees and provide feedback to leadership. Provide development support, performance evaluation, compensation, support, succession and talent management, conflict handling, and performance improvement planning with the support of the operation managers. Foster's a healthy, trusted environment, positive, energetic, inclusive, and enthusiastic environment to ensure people's engagement and a high sense of morale. Leaders will also ensure that People & Culture and compliance policies are adhered to by their team.

• Service Management : Responsible for achieving the agreed Service Level and ensuring operational KPIs are met with excellence by leveraging the right people and capabilities to provide the best user experience possible. Ensures the right people are in the right jobs and staffing levels are maintained according to requirements. Ensures that the units, processes, services & activities are fulfilling the defined objectives & targets, making improvements as required. Participates in collaborative regional and global squads to support the organization. Ensure ongoing monitoring of service level daily, proactively highlight any issue to create the proper actions

• Account Management : In account management, the leader would be the point of contact for assigned and designated site(s). The leader will provide: Monthly service reviews. 1st point of contact for escalation management.. Assist in new account transition and knowledge transfer. Proactively communicating with Stakeholders on any changes and potential issues - addressing difficult situations upfront. Support account improvement plan and coordinate actions with the respective teams

• Project Management : In project management, the leader would participate or sometimes lead certain projects. This includes : The new system goes live. New scope transition. New site transition. The leader would be expected to: Support/Lead transition activities (including knowledge transfer, hiring, training, etc). Support the transition team in resource allocation/management. Involve in Hypercare

• People-oriented mindset, highly accountable, agile, and results-oriented. Acts as a servant leader. Lives the Roche values and leadership commitments, has a growth mindset and drives a collaborative culture in the organization. Represent and support the desired ways of working (Agile, LEAN, ITIL, VACC). Ability to work in, co-create and contribute to a highly complex and team-oriented global environment.

• Ability to work in, and contribute to, a fast-paced and changing environment, where multiple priorities need to be effectively managed, while maintaining composure and flexibility

Partecipa a squadre regionali e globali collaborative per sostenere l'organizzazione. Assicurare il monitoraggio continuo del livello di servizio quotidiano, evidenziare proattivamente qualsiasi problema per creare azioni adeguate

• Gestione account: Nella gestione account, il leader sarebbe il punto di contatto per i siti/i assegnati e designati. Il leader fornirà: recensioni mensili di servizio. 1° punto di contatto per la gestione dell'escalation.. Assistere nella transizione di nuovi account e trasferimento di conoscenze. Proattivamente comunicare con Stakeholders su eventuali cambiamenti e potenziali problemi - affrontare situazioni difficili in anticipo. Supporta il piano di miglioramento del conto e coordina le azioni con le rispettive squadre

• Gestione dei progetti: nella gestione dei progetti, il leader parteciperà o a volte guiderà alcuni progetti. Questo include: il nuovo sistema va in diretta. Nuova transizione di portata. Nuova transizione del sito. Si prevede che il leader: Support/Lead attività di transizione (tra cui trasferimento di conoscenze, assunzione, formazione, ecc.). Sostenere il team di transizione in allocazione delle risorse / gestione. Coinvolgere in Hypercare

• mentalità orientata alla gente, altamente responsabile, agile e orientata ai risultati. Agisce come un capo servo. Vive i valori Roche e gli impegni di leadership, ha una mentalità di crescita e guida una cultura collaborativa nell'organizzazione. Rappresentare e sostenere le modalità di lavoro desiderate (Agile, LEAN, ITIL, VACC). Capacità di lavorare, co-creare e contribuire a un ambiente globale altamente complesso e orientato al team.

• Capacità di lavorare e contribuire a un ambiente veloce e mutevole, in cui più priorità devono essere gestite in modo efficace, pur mantenendo la compostezza e la flessibilità

Deine Hauptaufgaben:

• Mithilfe bei Instandhaltungsarbeiten, Identifikation und Behebung von Störungen.

• Bei Bedarf Gruppenübergreifende Unterstützung innerhalb von Logistics Solutions

• Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und GMP-Anweisungen

• Sicherstellung der effizienten und kundengerechten Leistungserbringung

• Proaktive Mitarbeit in Projekten als Fachexperte

Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken Team-Fähigkeiten. In diesem Sinne bringst Du eine offene und kollaborative Einstellung und Denkweise mit, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in deinem Team und bereichsübergreifend benötigt. Du vertraust dir und anderen, übernimmst Verantwortung und lebst eine offene Speak-Up- und Fehlerkultur. Deine lösungsorientierte Grundhaltung und "Can-Do Einstellung" bestimmen Dein tägliches Handeln.
Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Logistiker EFZ oder Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe EFZ sowie mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Logistik, bevorzugt im Bereich der Pharmabranche sowie über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Data Science - Engagement Lead , you will join the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) within Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) in San José, Costa Rica . In this high-impact, technical leadership role, you will architect advanced enterprise AI solutions, mentor data science talent, and serve as a strategic consultant across global business divisions (Commercial, R&D, Diagnostics). Operating in an agile environment, you will drive predictive, causal, and generative AI initiatives while shaping GATE-level product strategy, talent enablement, and cross-center innovation.

The Opportunity

• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and mentor Senior Data Scientists across Predictive AI and Causal & Experimentation AI sub-teams, fostering modular coding standards, MLOps best practices, and agile delivery.

• Strategic Business Consulting: Act as a trusted AI consultant to global executive stakeholders, translating complex healthcare and business challenges into actionable Data Science and AI strategies.

• GATE Strategy & Product Roadmap: Drive GATE-wide center initiatives, shaping AI product development strategy, talent enablement programs, and standard methodologies across the ecosystem.

• Rapid Prototyping & ROI: Design and build Proofs of Concept (POCs), prototypes, and business cases to demonstrate tangible value and secure executive buy-in.

• Advanced AI Architecture: Architect robust predictive models, causal inference frameworks (A/B testing, quasi-experiments), and Enterprise Generative AI solutions (RAG, fine-tuning, Agentic AI workflows).

• End-to-End MLOps & Delivery: Partner with Data Engineering and MLOps teams to design, operationalize, and maintain scalable ML/AI pipelines, ensuring automated deployment and monitoring.

• Agile Collaboration: Collaborate across global cross-functional teams, facilitating reviews, demos, and retrospectives to continuously enhance solution delivery.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, AI/ML, Computer Science, Quantitative Analytics, or a related field. Professional certifications in Data Science, Cloud AI, or GenAI are advantageous.

• 12+ years of overall experience in Data Science/AI, including 5+ years leading AI product lifecycles and mentoring data science teams.

• Proven track record in predictive modeling, causal inference, LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI).

Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are looking for an experienced AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, and evolve secure, scalable, and automated cloud solutions on AWS.

You will work as part of a team of Cloud Engineers, taking ownership of solutions from design through implementation and operation. This is a hands-on engineering role : we are looking for someone who enjoys staying close to the technology, solving complex technical challenges, and turning architectural concepts into reliable production solutions.

The role has a strong focus on Amazon EKS, AWS Bedrock, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD , as well as cloud networking and security .

The opportunity:

• Design, build, and operate Amazon EKS environments and Kubernetes-based workloads, including cluster architecture, workload deployment, networking, security, observability, and lifecycle management.

• Build cloud infrastructure using AWS CDK , applying Infrastructure as Code principles to create reusable, maintainable, and automated infrastructure components.

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments using GitLab CI/CD and/or GitHub Actions .

• Design and implement AWS networking architectures , including VPCs, subnets, routing, private connectivity, DNS, load balancing, ingress/egress patterns, and integration across cloud environments.

• Embed security by design across cloud solutions, including IAM, least-privilege access, secrets and key management, network security, encryption, and security controls.

• Implement robust logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability to ensure production environments are transparent, reliable, and supportable.

• Build and integrate solutions using additional AWS services such as Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, S3, API Gateway , and other services as appropriate.

• Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, security, Kubernetes, and deployment issues across the technology stack.

• Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, automation, technical documentation, and cloud best practices.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Product Development Data Sciences and Analytics (PDD) department in Roche's Pharmaceutical Division focuses on three core areas: identifying evidence needed in bringing our drugs to market, making high-quality data accessible and generating insights through data analysis. This involves leveraging diverse datasets from clinical trials, real-world evidence and digital sources to understand patient pathways, disease progression and patient outcomes.

Data science has become essential for extracting meaningful insights from the growing variety and complexity of data enabled by advances in digital technology. In biopharma, each data point represents part of a patient’s journey, contributing to the understanding of disease and the development of better medicines. Maximizing the potential of this data allows for groundbreaking analyses and insights.

The PDD Department in Welwyn Garden City is seeking 10 industrial placement students starting in July 2027 for 13 months to support the advancement of medicines. Successful candidates will be evaluated for one of multiple roles across the department, each requiring a diverse range of skills.

For further information about all of the available roles please see further down in the ad. Candidates will be considered for all roles but please indicate in your cover letter your preferred roles.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il dipartimento di Scienze e Analytics (PDD) per lo sviluppo del prodotto nella divisione farmaceutica di Roche si concentra su tre aree principali: identificare le prove necessarie per portare i nostri farmaci sul mercato, rendendo i dati di alta qualità accessibili e generando insight attraverso l'analisi dei dati. Ciò comporta la leva di diversi set di dati da studi clinici, prove reali e fonti digitali per comprendere le vie del paziente, la progressione della malattia e i risultati del paziente.

La scienza dei dati è diventata essenziale per estrarre informazioni significative dalla crescente varietà e complessità dei dati abilitati dai progressi nella tecnologia digitale. Nel biofarmaco, ogni data point rappresenta parte del viaggio di un paziente, contribuendo alla comprensione della malattia e allo sviluppo di farmaci migliori. La massimizzazione del potenziale di questi dati consente analisi e approfondimenti innovativi.

Il Dipartimento di PDD a Welwyn Garden City sta cercando 10 studenti di collocamento industriale a partire dal luglio 2027 per 13 mesi per sostenere l'avanzamento dei farmaci. I candidati di successo saranno valutati per uno dei ruoli multipli in tutto il dipartimento, ciascuno che richiede una vasta gamma di competenze.

Per ulteriori informazioni su tutti i ruoli disponibili, consultare l'annuncio. I candidati saranno considerati per tutti i ruoli, ma si prega di indicare nella lettera di copertura i vostri ruoli preferiti.

La nostra sede farmaceutica del Regno Unito, uno dei nostri principali uffici globali, si trova a Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire ed è circondato da una bella campagna. Sostenuto da grandi autostrade e aeroporti, oltre ad essere un viaggio in treno di 25 minuti al centro di Londra, l'accesso è facile. Con oltre 1800 persone che occupano il nostro sito a Welwyn, ci si può aspettare interazioni con lo sviluppo del prodotto (PD), lo sviluppo precoce (pRED), commerciale (Rx) e la nostra funzione aziendale. L'ampia sovrapposizione e l'interazione con altre funzioni significa che Roche offre un'esperienza senza pari e ampie opportunità di networking.

Requisiti di laurea
È necessario studiare per una laurea o master integrati, e essere idonei a lavorare nel Regno Unito.

Se siete appassionati di fare la differenza nella vita dei pazienti e possedere il lavoro di squadra e l'innovazione che stiamo cercando, Roche potrebbe essere la soluzione perfetta per voi. In cambio, forniamo uno stipendio competitivo e benefici eccellenti, tra cui un autentico interesse per lo sviluppo e la progressione della tua carriera.

Processo di reclutamento:
Fase I:

• Presentazione della lettera di copertura (inclusi i ruoli preferiti) & CV: Valutazione delle competenze e delle motivazioni.

Fase II:

• I candidati selezionati saranno invitati a un'intervista video online per valutare la loro motivazione e passione.

Fase III:

• I candidati che superano la fase di intervista video saranno invitati a unirsi a noi per un centro di valutazione in persona. Questo si terrà il 25 o 26 novembre 2026 presso il nostro ufficio Roche UK a Welwyn Garden City. Assicuratevi di essere disponibili in queste date per procedere con la vostra richiesta.

• In persona Centro di valutazione finale: Questo coinvolgerà una giornata intera di interviste, compiti di gruppo e un test di attitudine tecnica. Vedremo cosa ti motiva e come lavori con gli altri, e valuteremo la tua attitudine tecnica (per quei ruoli che hanno una componente tecnica). C'è anche tempo messo da parte per la costruzione di tour e conversazioni con i membri del personale PDD. Ad esempio, sarete in grado di conoscere i membri del personale di PDD e fare domande sul lavoro e l'ambiente di lavoro.

Se siete interessati a una di queste posizioni e soddisfare la richiesta di laurea

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Abteilung Product Development Data Sciences and Analytics (PDD) in der Pharmaceutical Division von Roche konzentriert sich auf drei Kernbereiche: die Identifizierung von Beweisen, die für die Markteinführung unserer Medikamente erforderlich sind, den Zugang zu hochwertigen Daten und die Generierung von Erkenntnissen durch Datenanalyse. Dazu werden verschiedene Datensätze aus klinischen Studien, Evidenz aus der realen Welt und digitale Quellen genutzt, um die Signalwege der Patienten, das Fortschreiten der Krankheit und die Ergebnisse der Patienten zu verstehen.

Data Science ist unerlässlich geworden, um aussagekräftige Erkenntnisse aus der wachsenden Vielfalt und Komplexität von Daten zu gewinnen, die durch Fortschritte in der digitalen Technologie ermöglicht werden. In Biopharma stellt jeder Datenpunkt einen Teil der Reise eines Patienten dar und trägt zum Verständnis von Krankheiten und zur Entwicklung besserer Medikamente bei. Die Maximierung des Potenzials dieser Daten ermöglicht bahnbrechende Analysen und Erkenntnisse.

Die PDD-Abteilung in Welwyn Garden City sucht ab Juli 2027 für 13 Monate 10 Praktikumsstudenten, um die Weiterentwicklung von Medikamenten zu unterstützen. Erfolgreiche Kandidaten werden für eine von mehreren Rollen in der gesamten Abteilung bewertet, die jeweils eine Vielzahl von Fähigkeiten erfordern.

Für weitere Informationen zu allen verfügbaren Rollen lesen Sie bitte weiter unten in der Anzeige. Kandidaten werden für alle Rollen berücksichtigt, aber bitte geben Sie in Ihrem Anschreiben Ihre bevorzugten Rollen an.

Unsere britische Pharmazentrale, eine unserer wichtigsten globalen Niederlassungen, befindet sich in Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire und ist von einer wunderschönen Landschaft umgeben. Unterstützt von wichtigen Autobahnen und Flughäfen, sowie eine 25-minütige Zugfahrt ins Zentrum von London, ist der Zugang einfach. Mit über 1800 Mitarbeitern, die unseren Standort in Welwyn besetzen, können Sie Interaktionen mit Produktentwicklung (PD), Frühentwicklung (pRED), Commercial (Rx) und unserer Unternehmensfunktion erwarten. Die umfangreiche Überlappung und Interaktion mit anderen Funktionen bedeutet, dass Roche eine unübertroffene Erfahrung sowie reichlich Networking-Möglichkeiten bietet.

Anforderungen an den Grad
Sie müssen für einen Bachelor- oder integrierten Master-Abschluss studieren und berechtigt sein, in Großbritannien zu arbeiten.

Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert sind, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern und die Teamarbeit und Innovation zu besitzen, nach der wir suchen, könnte Roche genau das Richtige für Sie sein. Im Gegenzug bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und hervorragende Leistungen, einschließlich eines echten Interesses an Ihrer Karriereentwicklung und -entwicklung.

Rekrutierungsprozess:
Phase I:

• Einreichung des Anschreibens (einschließlich bevorzugter Rollen) & CV: Bewertung von Fähigkeiten und Motivationen.

Phase II:

• Die nominierten Kandidaten werden zu einem Online-Videointerview eingeladen, um ihre Motivation und Leidenschaft zu beurteilen.

Phase III:

• Kandidaten, die die video-interview-phase bestehen, werden eingeladen, sich uns für ein persönliches assessment-zentrum anzuschließen. Diese findet am 25. oder 26. November 2026 in unserem Roche UK Büro in Welwyn Garden City statt. Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie an diesen Daten verfügbar sind, um mit Ihrer Bewerbung fortzufahren.

• Persönliches Abschlussbewertungszentrum: Dies beinhaltet einen ganzen Tag mit Interviews, Gruppenaufgaben und einem technischen Eignungstest. Wir werden uns ansehen, was Sie motiviert und wie Sie mit anderen arbeiten, und Ihre technische Eignung bewerten (für Rollen, die eine technische Komponente haben). Es ist auch Zeit für den Bau von Touren und Gesprächen mit PDD-Mitarbeitern vorgesehen. Zum Beispiel können Sie PDD-Mitarbeiter kennenlernen und Fragen zum Job und zum Arbeitsumfeld stellen.

Wenn Sie an einer dieser Positionen interessiert sind und den Grad erfüllen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Le département des sciences et de l'analyse des données de développement des produits (DDP) de la Division pharmaceutique de Roche se concentre sur trois domaines principaux : identifier les preuves nécessaires pour mettre nos médicaments sur le marché, rendre les données de haute qualité accessibles et générer des idées grâce à l'analyse des données. Cela implique de tirer parti de divers ensembles de données provenant d'essais cliniques, de données factuelles et de sources numériques pour comprendre les voies des patients, la progression de la maladie et les résultats des patients.

La science des données est devenue essentielle pour tirer des enseignements significatifs de la diversité et de la complexité croissantes des données rendues possibles par les progrès de la technologie numérique. Dans le biopharma, chaque point de données fait partie d'un parcours patient, contribuant à la compréhension de la maladie et au développement de meilleurs médicaments. Maximiser le potentiel de ces données permet d'effectuer des analyses et des analyses novatrices.

Le département PDD de Welwyn Garden City recherche 10 étudiants en placement industriel à partir de juillet 2027 pendant 13 mois pour soutenir l'avancement des médicaments. Les candidats retenus seront évalués pour l'un des rôles multiples à l'échelle du ministère, chacun exigeant un éventail diversifié de compétences.

Pour de plus amples informations sur tous les rôles disponibles, voir plus bas dans l'annonce. Les candidats seront considérés pour tous les rôles, mais veuillez indiquer dans votre lettre de présentation vos rôles préférés.

Notre siège social UK Pharmaceutical , l'un de nos principaux bureaux mondiaux, est situé à Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire et est entouré par une belle campagne. Appuyé par les grandes autoroutes et les aéroports, et étant un trajet en train de 25 minutes vers le centre de Londres, l'accès est facile. Avec plus de 1800 personnes occupant notre site à Welwyn, vous pouvez vous attendre à des interactions avec Product Development (PD), Early Development (PRED), Commercial (Rx) et notre fonction corporative. Le chevauchement et l'interaction avec d'autres fonctions font que Roche offre une expérience inégalée ainsi que de nombreuses possibilités de réseautage.

Degré requis
Vous devez étudier pour un diplôme de premier cycle ou de maîtrise intégrée, et être admissible à travailler au Royaume-Uni.

Si vous êtes passionné par le fait de faire une différence dans la vie des patients et si vous possédez le travail d'équipe et l'innovation que nous recherchons, Roche pourrait être la solution idéale pour vous. En retour, nous fournissons un salaire compétitif et d'excellents avantages, y compris un véritable intérêt pour votre développement de carrière et votre progression.

Processus de recrutement :
Phase I :

• Présentation de la lettre d'accompagnement (y compris les rôles privilégiés) et CV : Évaluation des compétences et des motivations.

Phase II:

• Les candidats présélectionnés seront invités à une entrevue vidéo en ligne pour évaluer leur motivation et leur passion.

Phase III:

• Les candidats qui passent l'étape de l'entrevue vidéo seront invités à se joindre à nous pour un centre d'évaluation en personne. Elle aura lieu le 25 ou 26 novembre 2026 dans notre bureau de Roche UK à Welwyn Garden City. Veuillez vous assurer que vous êtes disponible à ces dates pour poursuivre votre demande.

• En personne Centre d'évaluation finale : Il s'agira d'une journée complète d'entrevues, de tâches de groupe et d'un test d'aptitude technique. Nous examinerons ce qui vous motive et comment vous travaillez avec les autres, et évaluerons votre aptitude technique (pour les rôles qui ont une composante technique). Il y a aussi du temps pour les visites guidées et les conversations avec les membres du personnel de la DDP. Par exemple, vous pourrez connaître les membres du personnel de la DDP et poser des questions sur le poste et l'environnement de travail.

Si vous êtes intéressé par l'un de ces postes et remplir le diplôme requis

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
The Accounts Payable Analyst plays a key role, responsible for ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of all disbursements while maintaining adequate internal controls. Works within the Accounts Payable team to help establish the processes and system improvements to increase the efficiency of the department based on best practices. Our ideal candidate is a dedicated team player with an entrepreneurial spirit who is self-motivated and driven. Excellent communication skills are required as you will work closely with different countries and departments.

The Opportunity:

• Review invoices correctly and timely.

• Properly process Accounts Payable invoices, to assure payments are released on time according to payment terms.

• Respond timely and accurately to internal and external inquiries (Roche colleagues and Vendors/Suppliers).

• Monitor timely payments.

• Set up/maintain documentation for Accounts Payable Processes.

• Provide supporting documentation for audit processes.

• Reconcile Accounts Payable transactions.

• Assist with the monthly close process.

Who you are:

• 2 or 3 years minimum of Accounts Payable experience is required.

• Fluent English is required.

• SAP ERP with large experience is required.

• Full cycle of Accounts Payable experience.

• Must be hands-on, organized, detail-oriented, a team player, analytical, accurate, and have strong multi-tasking skills.

• Must be able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Should demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills and be able to interact professionally with internal and external customers, with great customer service.

• Proficiency in MS Office with working knowledge of Excel

• Ability to work within a team to achieve the team’s specific and overall goals.

• General accounting knowledge is desirable.

• Teamwork, achieving results, and strategic agility.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
The Position
The Accounts Payable Analyst plays a key role, responsible for ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of all disbursements while maintaining adequate internal controls. Works within the Accounts Payable team to help establish the processes and system improvements to increase the efficiency of the department based on best practices. Excellent communication skills are required as you will work closely with different countries and departments.

The Opportunity:

• Review invoices correctly and timely.

• Properly process Accounts Payable invoices, to assure payments are released on time according to payment terms.

• Set up/maintain documentation for Accounts Payable Processes.

• Provide supporting documentation for audit processes.

• Reconcile Accounts Payable transactions.

Who you are:

• Ability to work within a team to achieve the team’s specific and overall goals.

• Teamwork, achieving results, and strategic agility.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Für unser Chapter Discovery Sciences bei Roche Diagnostics GmbH suchen wir einen motivierten und talentierten Projektleiter (m/w/d) . Als Teil des Subchapters „In Silico Biomarker and Technology“ verstärkst du ein hochmotiviertes Forschungsteam, das wegweisende Diagnostiklösungen der nächsten Generation entwickelt.

In dieser Rolle treibst du ein Forschungsprojekt im Bereich der Immunologie – mit Fokus auf T-Zell-Immunologie – eigenverantwortlich voran, um innovative Diagnostik-Strategien zu entwickeln und unser Verständnis zentraler Immunmechanismen zu vertiefen. Du wirst wissenschaftliche Konzepte von der anfänglichen Strategie bis zur Ausführung voranbringen und das Projekt durch die verschiedenen Projektmeilensteine führen.

Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von Vertrauen, Transparenz und Kollaboration. Wir suchen einen proaktiven Kollegen, der unabhängiges, kritisches Denken mit Teamgeist und Flexibilität zur Zusammenarbeit über verschiedene Abteilungen und interdisziplinäre Teams in Einklang bringt.

Die Chance

• Du formulierst den medizinischen Bedarf, bewertest Machbarkeit sowie strategischen Nutzen und legst sowohl die technischen Anforderungen als auch die Budgetrahmen für den Projektstart fest.

• Du leitest das Projekt durch alle Entwicklungsphasen, führst ein funktionsübergreifendes Matrix-Team und stellst sicher, dass die Projektziele hinsichtlich Qualität, Zeitlinien und Budget zuverlässig erreicht werden.

• Du verantwortest die Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung komplexer immunologischer wet-lab Experimente, teilweise oder initial möglicherweise noch hands-on, sowie die Analyse komplexer biologischer Datensätze (inklusive Omics-Daten), um die Projektziele zu erreichen.

• Du fasst komplexe wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse in klaren Präsentationen für das Management zusammen und leitest interdisziplinäre Meetings, um Meilensteine und Ergebnisse an interne und externe Stakeholder zu kommunizieren und Feedback einzuholen.

• Du pflegst ein starkes internes und externes Netzwerk (inkl. akademischer Partner) im Fachbereich und übernimmst die fachliche Anleitung von Techniker:innen und betreust Masterand:innen sowie Praktikant:innen in deiner Einheit.

• Du dokumentierst Forschungsergebnisse für Patentanmeldungen und präsentierst deine Arbeiten in wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften sowie auf internationalen Konferenzen. ​

​Wer Du bist

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium mit anschließender Promotion (PhD) in Immunologie oder eng verwandten Fachbereich sowie 1–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Projektleitung, idealerweise in der Diagnostikbranche.

• Tiefes wissenschaftliches Verständnis der T-Zell-Immunologie und fundierte Erfahrung mit zellulären/molekularen Assays (z.B Primärzellassays, T-Zell funktionale Stimulations- und Differenzierungsassays (z.B T-Zell “stemness”) ELISA, qPCR etc.), nachgewiesen durch Publikationen mit hohem Impact-factor oder Patente.

• Hands-on Expertise in der Analyse von Transcriptomics Datensätzen z. B. Single-Cell RNA-Seq, von der Datengenerierung bis zur Analyse (library prep, erste Datenverarbeitung und explorative Analyse mit R, Python oder Bash, Verständnis bioinformatischer Pipelines).

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in statistischen Konzepten und Testverfahren zur Auswertung komplexer biologischer Daten

• Du besitzt Eigenantrieb, eine hohe Lernbereitschaft und die Fähigkeit, Verantwortung in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu übernehmen sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Networking-Fähigkeiten.

• Verhandlungssicheres Engli

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Per il nostro capitolo Discovery Sciences di Roche Diagnostics GmbH stiamo cercando un project manager motivato e talentuoso (m/f/d). Nell’ambito del sottocapitolo “In Silico Biomarker and Technology” vi unirete ad un team di ricerca altamente motivato che sviluppa soluzioni diagnostiche di nuova generazione.

In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili di un progetto di ricerca nel campo dell'immunologia – con un focus sull'immunologia T-cell – per sviluppare strategie diagnostiche innovative e approfondire la nostra comprensione dei meccanismi immunitari centrali. Avanzerai concetti scientifici dalla strategia iniziale all'esecuzione e guiderai il progetto attraverso le varie tappe del progetto.

La nostra cultura è caratterizzata da fiducia, trasparenza e collaborazione. Siamo alla ricerca di un collega proattivo che combina il pensiero indipendente, critico con lo spirito di squadra e la flessibilità per collaborare in diversi reparti e team interdisciplinari.

L'opportunità

• Voi formulate le esigenze mediche, valutate la fattibilità e i benefici strategici, e definite sia i requisiti tecnici che il quadro di bilancio per l'avvio del progetto.

• Condurre il progetto attraverso tutte le fasi di sviluppo, guidare un team di matrice trasversale e garantire che gli obiettivi del progetto siano raggiunti in modo affidabile in termini di qualità, tempi e budget.

• Sarete responsabili per la pianificazione, la conduzione e la valutazione di complessi esperimenti immunologici a lastra bagnata, parzialmente o inizialmente possibilmente ancora hands-on, così come l'analisi di complessi set di dati biologici (compresi i dati omici) per raggiungere gli obiettivi del progetto.

• Combinate i risultati scientifici complessi in presentazioni chiare per la gestione e condurre riunioni interdisciplinari per comunicare le pietre miliari e i risultati alle parti interessate interne ed esterne e raccogliere feedback.

• Si mantiene una forte rete interna ed esterna (compreso i partner accademici) nel dipartimento e prendere il controllo professionale dei tecnici e supervisiona Masterand:innen e stage:innen nella vostra unità.

• Documenti i risultati della ricerca per le domande di brevetto e presenti il tuo lavoro in riviste scientifiche e in conferenze internazionali.

Chi sei

• Con successo completato il master con il dottorato successivo (PhD) in immunologia o disciplina strettamente correlata, nonché 1-3 anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione del progetto, idealmente nel settore della diagnostica.

• Profonda comprensione scientifica dell'immunologia T-cell e dell'esperienza approfondita con saggi cellulari/molecolari (ad esempio, test delle cellule primarie, stimolazione funzionale T-cell e test di differenziazione (ad esempio, T-cell “stemness”) ELISA, qPCR, ecc.) provati da pubblicazioni con alto fattore di impatto o brevetti.

• Competenze pratiche nell'analisi dei dataset transcriptomics, ad esempio RNA-Seq monocell, dalla generazione dei dati all'analisi (prep biblica, prima elaborazione dei dati e analisi esplorativa con R, Python o Bash, comprensione delle condotte bioinformatiche).

• Conoscenza approfondita dei concetti statistici e dei metodi di prova per la valutazione dei dati biologici complessi

• Hai la tua auto, un'alta disponibilità ad imparare e la capacità di assumerti la responsabilità in un ambiente dinamico, così come forti capacità di comunicazione e networking.

• Negotiable Engli
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For our chapter Discovery Sciences at Roche Diagnostics GmbH we are looking for a motivated and talented project manager (m/f/d). As part of the “In Silico Biomarker and Technology” subchapter, you will join a highly motivated research team that develops pioneering next-generation diagnostic solutions.

In this role, you will be responsible for a research project in the field of immunology – with a focus on T-cell immunology – in order to develop innovative diagnostic strategies and deepen our understanding of central immune mechanisms. You will advance scientific concepts from initial strategy to execution and guide the project through the various project milestones.

Our culture is characterised by trust, transparency and collaboration. We are looking for a proactive colleague who combines independent, critical thinking with team spirit and flexibility to collaborate across different departments and interdisciplinary teams.

The opportunity

• You formulate medical needs, evaluate feasibility and strategic benefits, and define both the technical requirements and the budget framework for the start of the project.

• You lead the project through all stages of development, lead a cross-functional matrix team and ensure that the project goals are reliably achieved in terms of quality, timelines and budget.

• You will be responsible for planning, conducting and evaluating complex immunological wet-lab experiments, partially or initially possibly still hands-on, as well as the analysis of complex biological data sets (including omics data) to achieve the project goals.

• You will combine complex scientific findings into clear presentations for management and lead interdisciplinary meetings to communicate milestones and results to internal and external stakeholders and gather feedback.

• You maintain a strong internal and external network (including academic partners) in the department and take over the professional guidance of technicians and supervises Masterand:innen and intern:innen in your unit.

• You document research results for patent applications and present your work in scientific journals as well as at international conferences.

Who you are

• Successfully completed master’s degree with subsequent doctorate (PhD) in immunology or closely related discipline as well as 1–3 years of professional experience in project management, ideally in the diagnostics industry.

• Deep scientific understanding of T-cell immunology and in-depth experience with cellular/molecular assays (e.g. primary cell assays, T-cell functional stimulation and differentiation assays (e.g. T-cell “stemness”) ELISA, qPCR, etc.) proven by publications with high impact factor or patents.

• Hands-on expertise in the analysis of transcriptomics datasets e.g. single-cell RNA-Seq, from data generation to analysis (library prep, first data processing and exploratory analysis with R, Python or Bash, understanding of bioinformatic pipelines).

• In-depth knowledge of statistical concepts and test methods for the evaluation of complex biological data

• You have your own drive, a high willingness to learn and the ability to take on responsibility in a dynamic environment as well as strong communication and networking skills.

• Negotiable Engli

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Pour notre chapitre Discovery Sciences chez Roche Diagnostics GmbH, nous recherchons un chef de projet motivé et talentueux (h/f/d). Dans le cadre du sous-chapitre "In Silico Biomarker and Technology", vous rejoindrez une équipe de recherche très motivée qui développe des solutions de diagnostic de nouvelle génération.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable d'un projet de recherche dans le domaine de l'immunologie – mettant l'accent sur l'immunologie des cellules T – afin de développer des stratégies diagnostiques innovantes et d'approfondir notre compréhension des mécanismes immunitaires centraux. Vous avancerez les concepts scientifiques de la stratégie initiale à l'exécution et guiderez le projet à travers les différentes étapes du projet.

Notre culture se caractérise par la confiance, la transparence et la collaboration. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un collègue proactif qui combine la pensée indépendante et critique avec l'esprit d'équipe et la flexibilité pour collaborer entre les différents départements et équipes interdisciplinaires.

L'opportunité

• Vous formulez des besoins médicaux, évaluez la faisabilité et les avantages stratégiques et définissez à la fois les besoins techniques et le cadre budgétaire pour le démarrage du projet.

• Vous dirigez le projet à toutes les étapes du développement, dirigez une équipe matricielle interfonctionnelle et assurez-vous que les objectifs du projet sont atteints de façon fiable en termes de qualité, de calendrier et de budget.

• Vous serez responsable de la planification, de la réalisation et de l'évaluation d'expériences complexes en laboratoire humide immunologique, partiellement ou éventuellement encore pratique, ainsi que de l'analyse d'ensembles de données biologiques complexes (y compris des données omiques) pour atteindre les objectifs du projet.

• Vous combinerez des résultats scientifiques complexes en présentations claires pour la gestion et dirigerez des réunions interdisciplinaires pour communiquer les jalons et les résultats aux intervenants internes et externes et recueillir des commentaires.

• Vous maintenez un solide réseau interne et externe (y compris des partenaires académiques) dans le département et prenez en charge l'orientation professionnelle des techniciens et supervisez Masterand:innen et interne:innen dans votre unité.

• Vous documentez les résultats de la recherche pour les demandes de brevet et présentez vos travaux dans des revues scientifiques ainsi que lors de conférences internationales.

Qui vous êtes

• Maîtrise avec succès avec doctorat (PhD) en immunologie ou discipline étroitement liée ainsi que de 1 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle en gestion de projet, idéalement dans l'industrie du diagnostic.

• Compréhension scientifique approfondie de l'immunologie des cellules T et expérience approfondie des essais cellulaires/moléculaires (p. ex., essais de cellules primaires, stimulation fonctionnelle des cellules T et essais de différenciation (p. ex., cellules T, stemness) ELISA, qPCR, etc.) prouvés par des publications ayant un facteur d'impact élevé ou des brevets.

• Expertise pratique dans l'analyse des ensembles de données transcriptomiques, p.ex. RNA-Seq monocellulaire, de la production de données à l'analyse (prép. de bibliothèque, premier traitement des données et analyse exploratoire avec R, Python ou Bash, compréhension des pipelines bio-informatiques).

• Connaissance approfondie des concepts statistiques et des méthodes d'essai pour l'évaluation de données biologiques complexes

• Vous avez votre propre dynamisme, une grande volonté d'apprendre et la capacité d'assumer des responsabilités dans un environnement dynamique ainsi que des compétences solides en communication et en réseautage.

• Engli négociable

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part of achieving this vision is delivering new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

Within Pharma Technical Operations (PT), we catalyze the global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy, aiming to activate data citizenship, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem, and generate transformative insights. As a global healthcare leader committed to innovation, we provide an environment where your impact can reshape patient care worldwide.

The Opportunity

• Serve as a key subject matter expert to define, support, and execute master data standards across assigned PT domains in alignment with global Pharma value chain requirements.

• Collaborate closely with PT and IT stakeholders to map the data landscape, identify critical gaps, and establish unified data standards.

• Partner with Data Stewards, System Owners, and Data Product teams to guide the accurate implementation of global standards in site-specific systems and local initiatives.

• Document and maintain comprehensive data lineage, data catalogs, and data dictionaries to meet stringent regulatory, CMO, and end-user access requirements.

• Maintain consistent terminology and reference datasets across PT platforms to ensure continuous data integrity and high-quality data health.

• Oversee compliance with established data standards, evaluating deviation reports, performing impact assessments, and escalating systemic risks to leadership.

• Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and work alongside Data Steward Leads to mitigate data quality issues and resolve standards gaps across source systems.

Who You Are

• You bring 10+years of experience in a master data standards, data governance, or data management role, ideally within a pharmaceutical or healthcare environment.

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management, or a related technical discipline.

• You possess proven expertise in applying and maintaining master, transactional, and reference data standards across complex enterprise system landscapes.

• You demonstrate a strong grasp of data governance principles, paired with proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL to interrogate datasets and detect quality patterns.

• You are familiar with modern data cataloging and quality solutions (e.g., Collibra, Monte Carlo, Ataccama) and bring valuable exposure to cloud environments such as AWS or Snowflake.

• You have exceptional communication skills with a proven talent for explaining technical data standards clearly to diverse business stakeholders.

• You are a detail-oriented, self-directed professional who excels at delivering accurate documentation while working independently toward strategic organizational goals.

**Relocation benefits not available for this position**
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936.00 and 179,728.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
A Roche, prosperiamo per fornire più benefici ai pazienti come parte della nostra visione Pharma di 10 anni. Una parte integrante del raggiungimento di questa visione sta fornendo nuove e innovative soluzioni di analisi dei dati ai nostri scienziati attraverso Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

All’interno di Pharma Technical Operations (PT), catalizziamo lo sviluppo globale e l’esecuzione della strategia di PT Digital and Operational Excellence, mirando ad attivare la cittadinanza dei dati, rivoluzionare il nostro ecosistema dati FAIR e generare insight trasformativi. In qualità di leader globale nel settore sanitario impegnato nell'innovazione, forniamo un ambiente in cui il vostro impatto può rimodellare la cura dei pazienti in tutto il mondo.

L'opportunità

• Servire come esperto di materia chiave per definire, supportare ed eseguire standard di dati master in domini PT assegnati in allineamento con i requisiti globali della catena del valore di Pharma.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder PT e IT per mappare il paesaggio dei dati, identificare lacune critiche e stabilire standard di dati unificati.

• Partner con i team Data Stewards, System Owners e Data Product per guidare l'implementazione accurata degli standard globali nei sistemi site-specific e nelle iniziative locali.

• Documentare e mantenere la linea di dati completa, i cataloghi di dati e i dizionari di dati per soddisfare severi requisiti di regolazione, CMO e accesso all'utente finale.

• Mantenere una terminologia coerente e set di dati di riferimento su piattaforme PT per garantire l'integrità dei dati continua e la salute dei dati di alta qualità.

• Controllare la conformità con gli standard di dati stabiliti, valutare i rapporti di deviazione, eseguire valutazioni di impatto e aumentare i rischi sistemici per la leadership.

• Traccia gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e collabora con Data Steward Conduce a mitigare i problemi di qualità dei dati e a risolvere le lacune degli standard nei sistemi sorgente.

Chi sei

• Porti 10+anni di esperienza in un ruolo di master data standards, data governance o gestione dei dati, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico o sanitario.

• Hai una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Gestione delle informazioni, o una disciplina tecnica correlata.

• Possiedi una comprovata esperienza nell'applicazione e nel mantenimento di standard di dati master, transazionali e di riferimento in contesti complessi di sistemi aziendali.

• Si dimostra una forte comprensione dei principi di governance dei dati, abbinati alla competenza in strumenti di analisi dei dati come SQL per interrogare i dataset e rilevare i modelli di qualità.

• Conoscete le moderne soluzioni di catalogazione e qualità dei dati (ad esempio Collibra, Monte Carlo, Ataccama) e portate una preziosa esposizione ad ambienti cloud come AWS o Snowflake.

• Hai competenze di comunicazione eccezionali con un talento dimostrato per spiegare gli standard di dati tecnici chiaramente a diversi stakeholder aziendali.

• Sei un professionista orientato al dettaglio, autodiretto che eccelle nel fornire documentazione accurata mentre si lavora in modo indipendente verso obiettivi organizzativi strategici.

** Vantaggi di trasferimento non disponibili per questa posizione**
L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione primaria di Mississauga è 136,936.00 e 179,728.50 della gamma di assunzione. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro, determinati dalla società.
Utilizziamo l'intelligenza artificiale per visualizzare, valutare o selezionare i candidati per questo ruolo.

Questa pubblicazione è per un posto vacante esistente presso Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati
