Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Chance
Als klinischer Vertragsverwalter spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der reibungslosen finanziellen und operativen Durchführung unserer klinischen Studien. Sie werden als wichtiger Mitarbeiter zwischen Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Procurement, Legal und Finance fungieren, um den Lebenszyklus von Lieferantenverträgen und Zahlungen zu verwalten. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, sich einem leistungsstarken Team anzuschließen, in dem Ihre Liebe zum Detail die Bereitstellung innovativer Gesundheitslösungen direkt unterstützt.

Die wichtigsten Verantwortlichkeiten für diese Position umfassen, aber nicht beschränkt auf

• Fördern Sie die Finanzgenauigkeit: Erstellen und verfolgen Sie Bestellungen (POs), Rechnungen und Rückstellungen mit unseren Finanzsystemen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Lieferantenzahlungen präzise und zeitnah sind.

• Datenintegrität optimieren: Vertragsinformationen innerhalb unserer Tracking-Tools pflegen und aktualisieren, um jederzeit Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Master Contract Lifecycle Management: Übernehmen Sie die End-to-End-Verantwortung für den Vertragsunterzeichnungsprozess, von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Beendigung des Dienstes und dem endgültigen Abgleich. Verfolgen, pflegen und aktualisieren Sie zugewiesene Vertragsinformationen innerhalb der CDMA-Tracking-Tools, um gegebenenfalls Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Champion Compliance Reporting: Erstellen und Einreichen von Berichten über Wertübertragungen an Gesundheitsdienstleister, um die vollständige Einhaltung der Transparenzstandards der Branche wie dem Sunshine Act sicherzustellen.

• Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften: Pflegen Sie starke, kooperative Beziehungen mit funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften und externen Lieferanten, um ehrgeizige Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

• Helfen Sie, die Budgetverhandlungen der Website in Übereinstimmung mit dem Fair Market Value voranzutreiben.

• Von Zeit zu Zeit können andere Aufgaben zugewiesen werden, um die gesamte CDMA-Funktion zu unterstützen.

Wer du bist
Sie sind ein organisierter und detailorientierter Fachmann, der in schnelllebigen, matrixförmigen Umgebungen gedeiht. Sie sind ein natürlicher Mitarbeiter, der es genießt, komplexe finanzielle administrative Herausforderungen zu lösen, während Sie mit verschiedenen globalen Teams zusammenarbeiten.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:

• Educational Foundation: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Business oder einem verwandten Bereich (oder gleichwertige relevante Expertise in der Gesundheitsbranche).

• Branchenerfahrung: 3-5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung mit spezifischer Expertise in der Erstellung von Bestellungen (PO) und Rechnungsverwaltung. Erfahrung mit Verhandlungsbudgets mit klinischen Standorten ist ein Plus.

• Technische Kompetenz: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Tracking von Finanzdaten wie Rückstellungen und Zahlungen in komplexen Geschäftsumgebungen.

• Collaborative Mindset: Die Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig effektiv in Funktionen wie Legal, Procurement und Clinical Operations zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Demonstrieren Sie Flexibilität und Anpassungsfähigkeit, um in einer schnelllebigen, matrixförmigen Umgebung zu arbeiten, in der eine flüssige, teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit von entscheidender Bedeutung ist.

• Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Englisch).

Bei Roche werden Sie in einer Kultur gedeihen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven schätzt und einen Ort der Zugehörigkeit schafft, in dem wir uns herausfordern, gemeinsam zu übertreffen und starke Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Wenn Lohntransparenz gilt, werden die Einzelheiten auf der Grundlage des primären Entsendeortes angegeben. Für diese Rolle ist der Hauptstandort Sant Cugat del Vallès. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
L'opportunité
En tant qu'administrateur du contrat clinique, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour assurer la bonne exécution financière et opérationnelle de nos études cliniques. Vous agirez à titre de collaborateur clé entre les Opérations cliniques, les Affaires médicales, le Développement clinique, l'Approvisionnement, le Droit et les Finances pour gérer le cycle de vie des contrats et des paiements des fournisseurs. C'est l'occasion de rejoindre une équipe hautement performante où votre attention aux détails soutient directement la prestation de solutions de santé innovantes.

Les principales responsabilités relatives à ce poste comprennent notamment :

• Exactitude financière : Créer et suivre les bons de commande, les factures et les comptes d'exercice en utilisant nos systèmes financiers pour s'assurer que tous les paiements des fournisseurs sont précis et opportuns.

• Optimisez l'intégrité des données : maintenez et mettez à jour l'information contractuelle dans nos outils de suivi afin d'assurer l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude en tout temps.

• Gestion du cycle de vie du contrat principal : assumer la responsabilité de bout en bout du processus de signature du contrat, de la demande initiale à la résiliation du service et au rapprochement final. Suivre, tenir à jour et mettre à jour les informations relatives aux contrats dans le cadre des outils de suivi CDMA afin d'assurer l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude, le cas échéant.

• Rapport sur la conformité des champions : Préparer et soumettre des rapports sur les transferts de valeur aux fournisseurs de soins de santé, en veillant au respect intégral des normes de transparence de l'industrie, comme la Loi sur Sunshine.

• Bâtir des partenariats stratégiques : Cultiver des relations solides et collaboratives avec des dirigeants interfonctionnels et des fournisseurs externes pour atteindre des objectifs commerciaux ambitieux.

• Aider à diriger les négociations budgétaires du site en fonction de la juste valeur marchande.

• D'autres tâches peuvent être assignées de temps à autre à l'appui de la fonction globale du CDMA.

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes un professionnel organisé et axé sur les détails qui prospère dans des environnements rapides et matriciaux. Vous êtes un collaborateur naturel qui aime résoudre des défis administratifs financiers complexes tout en travaillant aux côtés de diverses équipes mondiales.

• Proporre e condurre la prova di concetti (PoC) per valutare la fattibilità tecnica insieme al team Tech

• Lavorare con RDT adottando l'uso delle soluzioni AI e ML sia nello sviluppo che nella gestione delle pipeline di dati.

• Partecipa attivamente e collabora con soluzioni, informazioni e architetti d'impresa all'interno del team di ingegneria e attraverso i prodotti

Chi sei

• Hai costruito 7+ anni di esperienza lavorativa come Solution Architect o Technical Lead, di cui almeno 4 anni in Scienze della vita o Industria farmaceutica. Conoscenza delle Norme di Farmaci (GxP, Convalida del Computer) esperienza preferita

• Esperienza mantenendo la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per soluzioni multiple, e valutando gli impatti delle iniziative su capacità, rischi e paesaggi applicativi

• Provato track record di proattivamente contribuire allo sviluppo di pratiche di architettura e mentoring altri

• Esperienza nel dominio Pharma/Biotech, in particolare nei sistemi di dati clinici di prova, come i sistemi elettronici di Data Capture (EDC), i sistemi di dati Non-CRF, le tecnologie per la salute digitale e i magazzini di dati clinici

• Esperienza con ETLs/ELTs, data warehouse/lake/lakehouses, modelli di integrazione dei dati aziendali, database relazionali e oggetti e esperienza con AWS o altre tecnologie cloud

• Conoscenza approfondita ed esperta in più aree tecnologiche

• Proficienza nella creazione di modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie, ontologie e percorsi di integrazione per i prodotti

Questo ruolo è in Analytical Data Science, una funzione fondamentale all'interno di Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) che fornisce leadership strategica e rigore scientifico attraverso lo sviluppo a Roche. I team di PDD Analytical Data Science sono mobilitati in tutto il portafoglio per generare informazioni basate sui dati, identificare le opportunità di scala e implementare soluzioni di impatto.

PDD Analytical Data Science è riconosciuto come un hub leader per i migliori talenti del settore, operante come una forza lavoro agile per fornire impegni normativi in tutto il portafoglio. Questo include uscite sia statiche che dinamiche, come tabelle, elenchi, figure e visualizzazioni interattive dei dati o dashboard. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term position until 31.10.2027.

As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

The Opportunity:

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office).

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 1900 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La posizione

In qualità di Accounts Payable Accountant è responsabile dei servizi di alta qualità per fornitori Roche e partner interni. Sarete responsabili della prenotazione di fatture complesse in conformità con Roche e gli standard locali in modo che il fornitore riceve i fondi in tempo per le merci fornite e i servizi resi. Avrete la possibilità di avere piena responsabilità per il processo AP end-to-end e la gestione di domande interne e di fornitori ricevute per telefono o per posta in lingua locale.

L'opportunità:

• Elaborare e convalidare le fatture e le richieste di pagamento, gestire e eseguire pagamenti

• Gestione degli account fornitori

• Audit, report e supporto AP fattura risoluzione

• Le domande di fattura interna della filiale maniglia

• Agire come punto di contatto, promuovendo forti relazioni di collaborazione tra i team finanziari della filiale e tutti gli altri team SSC interni

• Partecipazione al miglioramento dei processi e ai progetti in corso, opportunità di partecipare al trasferimento di conoscenze

Chi sei:

• Laurea in finanza o esperienza professionale rilevante

• Comprensione generale dei processi finanziari e degli standard. Ampia esperienza nei processi di pagamento dei conti (o relativi campi) e l'utilizzo di SAP è un vantaggio

• Forte comunicazione e competenze di consulenza e si è in grado di affrontare problemi complessi

• centricità del cliente attraverso le interazioni quotidiane

• Responsabilità end-to-end, capacità di problem solving, crescita e mentalità agile in situazioni ambigue

• accettazione multiculturale, capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce e mutevole

• Proficienza in inglese

In cambio vi forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti & flessibilità: Roche Bonus annuale, Indennità mensile di trasporto, Home Office set - up attrezzature, Assicurazione sanitaria, Assicurazione per la vita / incidente, Full salario quando su congedo per malati per i primi 9 giorni, Occhiali regolamento, opzioni di pagamento una volta per vari eventi nella vita, ad esempio matrimonio, parto, Service Awards: Apprezziamo la fedeltà con le vacanze aggiuntive e il pagamento bonus, Lavorare in un modello ibrido (2 giorni / settimana dall'ufficio).

• Una comunità inclusiva globale, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione.

La pensione inizia da 1900 EUR lordo/mese. Lo stipendio finale dipende dal livello di esperienza, competenze e qualifiche del candidato di successo.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Le salaire commence à partir de 1900 EUR brut par mois. Le salaire final dépend du niveau d'expérience, des compétences et des qualifications du candidat reçu.

Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

jobs.title: Patient Strategy - Integration Tech Lead

titleByLocale.it: Strategia del paziente - Integrazione Tech Lead

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Lead Engineer takes ownership of critical tasks and technical topics, actively challenging the status quo and fostering collaboration within their project or squad. In this role, you will act as a technical mentor, deeply understanding how individual components fit into the broader organizational strategy. You will lead the design and implementation of solutions using the team's primary programming languages and cloud services. By defining testing strategies, ensuring secure coding practices, and translating organizational goals into actionable technical roadmaps, you will maintain the highest engineering and coding standards.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and topics in the “grey zone” (where there is no defined owner) and successfully drives small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level. Leads technical design and implementation while applying established patterns and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Diagnoses and resolves complex technical issues and addresses performance bottlenecks. Challenges the status quo, skillfully navigates group dynamics in diversified settings, and fosters good collaboration, knowledge sharing, coaching, and mentoring.

• Stakeholder Management: Prioritizes and communicates with stakeholders effectively. Maintains a "bigger picture" view to thoroughly understand how various technical components fit into the overall product strategy and organizational goals. Communicates technical decisions effectively to the team and broader audiences.

• Impact/Strategy: Acts as a technical mentor and aligns development plans with the global strategy. Translates goals into a technical roadmap, guides technical direction, and gets involved in initiatives reaching outside of the regular project scope. Actively gives speeches and shares knowledge in internal events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live).

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at the Product or Site level, making a direct impact on the technical decisions within the product and the ways of working of other chapter members.

• Business / Technical ability: Possesses a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond the specific component being worked on. Formulates and implements technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives, investing time and energy in initiatives that boost creativity and innovation while maintaining the highest engineering quality. Understands and applies agile principles in daily development tasks.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience translating organizational goals into technical roadmaps and leading the design and implementation of software solutions.

• Proven track record of acting as a technical mentor, navigating group dynamics, and actively participating in internal knowledge-sharing events.

Technical Skills

• Strong proficiency in establishing high coding standards and conducting comprehensive code reviews for MuleSoft implementations

• Deep technical capability working with Salesforce APIs (REST, GraphQL, GRPC, Bulk 2.0, Composite) and architecting real-time synchronization using Salesforce Platform Events, CDC, and PushTopics while managing Governor Limits.

• Hands-on experience designing scalable pub/sub messaging patterns and integrating with event brokers like Solace PubSub+ for real-time data streaming.

• Experience developing

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
L'Ingegnere di piombo prende la proprietà di compiti critici e argomenti tecnici, sfidando attivamente lo status quo e promuovendo la collaborazione all'interno del loro progetto o squadra. In questo ruolo, agirai come mentore tecnico, comprendendo profondamente come i singoli componenti si adattano alla più ampia strategia organizzativa. Condurrai la progettazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni utilizzando i principali linguaggi di programmazione e servizi cloud del team. Definindo strategie di test, assicurando pratiche di codifica sicure e traducendo obiettivi organizzativi in roadmap tecniche attuabili, manterrete i più alti standard di ingegneria e codifica.
Descrizione della zona
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership): prende la proprietà di compiti e argomenti ambigui nella "grande zona" (dove non c'è un proprietario definito) e guida con successo iniziative da piccole a medie (S/M) a livello di progetto, squadra o prodotto. Conduce la progettazione tecnica e l'implementazione durante l'applicazione di modelli consolidati e migliori pratiche.

• Responsabilità/Problem Solving: Diagnosi e risolve complessi problemi tecnici e affronta i colli di bottiglia delle prestazioni. Sfida lo status quo, naviga abilmente le dinamiche di gruppo in ambienti diversificati, e favorisce una buona collaborazione, condivisione delle conoscenze, coaching e mentoring.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorizza e comunica con gli stakeholder in modo efficace. Mantiene una visione "grande immagine" per capire a fondo come i vari componenti tecnici si adattano alla strategia globale del prodotto e obiettivi organizzativi. Comunica le decisioni tecniche efficacemente al team e al pubblico più ampio.

• Impact/Strategy: agisce come mentore tecnico e allinea i piani di sviluppo con la strategia globale. Traduci gli obiettivi in una roadmap tecnica, guida la direzione tecnica, e si impegna in iniziative che raggiungono al di fuori della portata del progetto regolare. Attivamente dà discorsi e condivide la conoscenza in eventi interni (ad esempio, DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live).

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona a livello del prodotto o del sito, avendo un impatto diretto sulle decisioni tecniche all'interno del prodotto e sui modi di lavorare di altri membri del capitolo.

• Business / Capacità tecnica: Possede una profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio oltre la componente specifica su cui si lavora. Formula e implementa strategie tecniche allineate agli obiettivi organizzativi, investendo il tempo e l'energia in iniziative che incrementano la creatività e l'innovazione mantenendo la massima qualità ingegneristica. Comprende e applica principi agili nei compiti di sviluppo quotidiano.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Esperienza dimostrata che traduce obiettivi organizzativi in roadmap tecniche e conduce la progettazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni software.

• Provato record di agire come mentore tecnico, navigare dinamica di gruppo, e attivamente partecipare a eventi di condivisione della conoscenza interna.

Competenze tecniche

• Forte competenza nella definizione di elevati standard di codifica e nella conduzione di recensioni complete di codice per le implementazioni di MuleSoft

• Capacità tecnica profonda che funziona con Salesforce APIs (REST, GraphQL, GRPC, Bulk 2.0, Composite) e l'archiviazione in tempo reale della sincronizzazione utilizzando Salesforce Platform Events, CDC e PushTopics mentre gestiscono i limiti del governatore.

• Hands-on esperienza nella progettazione di modelli di messaggistica scalabile pub/sub e integrazione con i broker di eventi come Solace PubSub+ per lo streaming di dati in tempo reale.

• Sviluppo dell'esperienza

Stellenbeschreibung

In dieser Rolle werden Sie als technischer Mentor fungieren und verstehen, wie einzelne Komponenten in die breitere Organisationsstrategie passen. Durch die Definition von Teststrategien, die Gewährleistung sicherer Kodierungspraktiken und die Umsetzung organisatorischer Ziele in umsetzbare technische Roadmaps erhalten Sie die höchsten Engineering- und Kodierungsstandards.
Beschreibung des Gebiets
Aufgabenbereich

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Übernimmt die Verantwortung für mehrdeutige Aufgaben und Themen in der "Grauzone" (wo es keinen definierten Eigentümer gibt) und treibt erfolgreich kleine bis mittlere (S / M) Initiativen auf Projekt-, Squad- oder Produktebene voran. Leitet das technische Design und die Implementierung unter Anwendung etablierter Muster und Best Practices.

• Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Diagnose und Behebung komplexer technischer Probleme und Behebung von Leistungsengpässen. Fordert den Status quo heraus, navigiert geschickt die Gruppendynamik in diversifizierten Umgebungen und fördert gute Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch, Coaching und Mentoring.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorisiert und kommuniziert effektiv mit Stakeholdern. Behält ein "größeres Bild" Ansicht, um gründlich zu verstehen, wie verschiedene technische Komponenten in die gesamte Produktstrategie und organisatorische Ziele passen. Kommuniziert technische Entscheidungen effektiv an das Team und ein breiteres Publikum.

• Impact/Strategie: Agiert als technischer Mentor und richtet Entwicklungspläne an der globalen Strategie aus. Übersetzt Ziele in eine technische Roadmap, leitet die technische Richtung und beteiligt sich an Initiativen, die außerhalb des regulären Projektumfangs liegen. Gibt aktiv Vorträge und teilt Wissen in internen Veranstaltungen (z.B. DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live).

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert auf Produkt- oder Site-Ebene und hat direkten Einfluss auf die technischen Entscheidungen innerhalb des Produkts und die Arbeitsweise anderer Kapitelmitglieder.

• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Verfügt über ein tiefes Verständnis der breiteren technischen Landschaft über die spezifische Komponente hinaus, an der gearbeitet wird. Formuliert und implementiert technische Strategien, die auf organisatorische Ziele ausgerichtet sind, und investiert Zeit und Energie in Initiativen, die Kreativität und Innovation fördern und gleichzeitig höchste technische Qualität gewährleisten. Versteht und wendet agile Prinzipien bei täglichen Entwicklungsaufgaben an.

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung, die organisatorische Ziele in technische Roadmaps übersetzt und das Design und die Implementierung von Softwarelösungen leitet.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Tätigkeit als technischer Mentor, der Navigation in der Gruppendynamik und der aktiven Teilnahme an internen Veranstaltungen zum Wissensaustausch.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Starke Kenntnisse in der Festlegung hoher Codierungsstandards und Durchführung umfassender Code-Reviews für MuleSoft-Implementierungen

• Tiefe technische Fähigkeiten, die mit Salesforce APIs (REST, GraphQL, GRPC, Bulk 2.0, Composite) arbeiten und Echtzeit-Synchronisierung mit Salesforce Platform Events, CDC und PushTopics unter Verwaltung von Governor Limits.

• Praktische Erfahrung beim Entwerfen skalierbarer Pub / Sub-Messaging-Muster und der Integration mit Event-Brokern wie Solace PubSub + für Echtzeit-Datenstreaming.

• Erfahrungsentwicklung

As a business product owner, you will work within an agile team, contributing to the creation and delivery of desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products and solutions that fulfill customer needs. What You Bring to the Table
You aren’t just a backlog manager; you are the strategic bridge between digital learning innovation and business value. You understand that a great learning experience isn't just about pushing content—it’s about engagement, seamless architecture, and driving a clear return on investment.
To thrive in this role, you should bring a mix of the following skills, mindsets, and experiences:

The Digital Learning Acumen

• EdTech Ecosystem Savvy: Solid grasp of modern learning ecosystems (LMS/LXP, content authoring, resource management) and how to integrate them.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Senior Lead Engineer defines tasks for others and drives medium to large-scale initiatives across a product or product line. In this strategic role, you will coach and lead other engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge through publications, inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service solutions. With expertise in advanced cloud features and Kubernetes, you will promote architectural consistency, drive technical strategy for major components, and mentor senior engineers to ensure the highest standards of engineering quality across the organization.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving: Defines tasks for others and successfully drives medium to large (M/L) initiatives across a Product or Product Line. Challenges others in a growth-enabling way, effectively leverages team strengths, and acts as a coach and lead for other engineers.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs, excelling in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provides clear direction to mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Provides global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Actively gives speeches and shares knowledge at global and international events, and drives tech universities, Centers of Excellence (CoEs), and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Engaged in Chapter/Site related activities.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at the Product Line, Chapter, Domain, or Site level, making a direct impact on the growth and engagement of other chapter members.

• Business / Technical ability: Actively contributes to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (e.g., playing the role of capability owner/hero). Inspires innovation, drives innovative solutions in line with emerging technology trends, and engages in building new approaches to existing problems.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience defining tasks, coaching engineers, and successfully driving medium to large-scale initiatives across a product or product line.

• Proven track record of contributing to the technical strategy for major components/services and participating in global knowledge-sharing events.

Technical Skills

• Deep, hands-on experience designing and implementing Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and/or Salesforce Health Cloud.

• Strong understanding of the core Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud) and how to extend it for patient support services.

• Proficiency with declarative tools like Flow Builder, and deep familiarity with OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors) for building industry-specific UI/UX.

• Hands-on experience configuring and deploying Agentforce to build custom, autonomous AI agents for life sciences use cases (e.g., patient program enrollment, MSL support, or clinical trial screening). Ability to define agent actions, set strict compliance guardrails, and utilize prompt builder.

• Experience with Einstein AI capabilities for next-best-action or patient insights

• Proven experience implementing Salesforce Shield (Platform Encryption, Field Audit Trail, Event Monitoring) to secure sensitive Patient Health Information (PHI)

• Working knowledge of M

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Senior Lead Engineer defines tasks for others and drives medium to large-scale initiatives across a product or product line. In this strategic role, you will coach and lead other engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge through publications, inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service solutions. With expertise in advanced cloud features and Kubernetes, you will promote architectural consistency, drive technical strategy for major components, and mentor senior engineers to ensure the highest standards of engineering quality across the organization.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving: Defines tasks for others and successfully drives medium to large (M/L) initiatives across a Product or Product Line. Challenges others in a growth-enabling way, effectively leverages team strengths, and acts as a coach and lead for other engineers.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs, excelling in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provides clear direction to mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Provides global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Actively gives speeches and shares knowledge at global and international events, and drives tech universities, Centers of Excellence (CoEs), and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Engaged in Chapter/Site related activities.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at the Product Line, Chapter, Domain, or Site level, making a direct impact on the growth and engagement of other chapter members.

• Business / Technical ability: Actively contributes to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (e.g., playing the role of capability owner/hero). Inspires innovation, drives innovative solutions in line with emerging technology trends, and engages in building new approaches to existing problems.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience defining tasks, coaching engineers, and successfully driving medium to large-scale initiatives across a product or product line.

• Proven track record of contributing to the technical strategy for major components/services and participating in global knowledge-sharing events.

Technical Skills

• Deep, hands-on experience designing and implementing Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and/or Salesforce Health Cloud.

• Strong understanding of the core Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud) and how to extend it for patient support services.

• Proficiency with declarative tools like Flow Builder, and deep familiarity with OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors) for building industry-specific UI/UX.

• Hands-on experience configuring and deploying Agentforce to build custom, autonomous AI agents for life sciences use cases (e.g., patient program enrollment, MSL support, or clinical trial screening). Ability to define agent actions, set strict compliance guardrails, and utilize prompt builder.

• Experience with Einstein AI capabilities for next-best-action or patient insights

• Proven experience implementing Salesforce Shield (Platform Encryption, Field Audit Trail, Event Monitoring) to secure sensitive Patient Health Information (PHI)

• Working knowledge of M

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung
Der Senior Lead Engineer definiert Aufgaben für andere und treibt mittlere bis große Initiativen über ein Produkt oder eine Produktlinie hinweg voran. In dieser strategischen Rolle coachen und leiten Sie andere Ingenieure, zeichnen sich durch Stakeholder-Verhandlungen aus und geben Orientierung für mittel- bis langfristige Ziele. Sie werden durch Publikationen aktiv zum technischen Wissen beitragen, Innovationen anregen und das Design komplexer Multi-Service-Lösungen leiten. Mit Expertise in fortschrittlichen Cloud-Funktionen und Kubernetes fördern Sie die architektonische Konsistenz, treiben die technische Strategie für wichtige Komponenten voran und betreuen leitende Ingenieure, um die höchsten Standards für technische Qualität im gesamten Unternehmen zu gewährleisten.
Beschreibung des Gebiets
Aufgabenbereich

• Umfang / (Content Leadership) & Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Definiert Aufgaben für andere und fördert erfolgreich mittlere bis große (M/W)-Initiativen in einem Produkt oder einer Produktlinie. Fordert andere auf wachstumsfördernde Weise heraus, nutzt effektiv Teamstärken und fungiert als Coach und Lead für andere Ingenieure.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstriert ein starkes Verständnis der Stakeholder-Ökosysteme und ihrer Bedürfnisse und zeichnet sich durch Verhandlungen und Partnerschaften zum gegenseitigen Nutzen aus. Bietet eine klare Richtung für mittel- bis langfristige Ziele.

• Impact/Strategie: Bietet Unterstützung auf globaler Ebene für innovative und technologische Initiativen. Aktiv hält Vorträge und teilt Wissen auf globalen und internationalen Veranstaltungen und treibt Tech-Universitäten, Centers of Excellence (CoEs) und Wissensaustausch-Initiativen voran. Engagiert in Kapitel / Site bezogene Aktivitäten.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert auf der Ebene der Produktlinie, des Kapitels, der Domain oder der Site und hat direkte Auswirkungen auf das Wachstum und Engagement anderer Kapitelmitglieder.

• Business / Technical Fahigkeit: Trägt aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung des technischen Wissens in diesem Bereich durch Publikationen, Präsentationen und Mentoring bei (z. B. durch die Rolle des Fahigkeitsbesitzers / Helden). Beflügelt Innovationen, treibt innovative Lösungen im Einklang mit aufkommenden Technologietrends voran und entwickelt neue Ansätze für bestehende Probleme.

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung bei der Definition von Aufgaben, dem Coaching von Ingenieuren und der erfolgreichen Förderung von mittleren bis großen Initiativen über ein Produkt oder eine Produktlinie hinweg.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei Beiträgen zur technischen Strategie für wichtige Komponenten/Dienste und bei der Teilnahme an globalen Veranstaltungen zum Wissensaustausch.

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Tiefe, praktische Erfahrung beim Entwerfen und Implementieren von Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud und/oder Salesforce Health Cloud.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der zentralen Salesforce-Plattform (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud) und wie sie für Patientenunterstützungsdienste erweitert werden kann.

• Kenntnisse mit deklarativen Tools wie Flow Builder und tiefe Vertrautheit mit OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors) für die Erstellung branchenspezifischer UI / UX.

• Praktische Erfahrung bei der Konfiguration und Bereitstellung von Agentforce, um benutzerdefinierte, autonome KI-Agenten für Anwendungsfälle in den Biowissenschaften zu erstellen (z. B. Patientenprogrammregistrierung, MSL-Unterstützung oder Screening von klinischen Studien). Fähigkeit, Agentenaktionen zu definieren, strenge Compliance-Leitplanken festzulegen und einen prompten Builder zu verwenden.

• Erfahrung mit Einstein KI-Fähigkeiten für Next-Best-Action- oder Patienten-Insights

• Bewährte Erfahrungen mit der Implementierung von Salesforce Shield (Plattformverschlüsselung, Field Audit Trail, Ereignisüberwachung) zur Sicherung sensibler Patientengesundheitsinformationen (PHI)

• Kenntnisse über M

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description du poste
L'ingénieur principal définit les tâches pour d'autres et lance des initiatives de moyenne à grande échelle dans une gamme de produits. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous entraînerez et dirigerez d'autres ingénieurs, excellerez dans les négociations avec les intervenants et fournirez une orientation pour les objectifs à moyen et à long terme. Vous contribuerez activement aux connaissances techniques au moyen de publications, inspirerez l'innovation et dirigerez la conception de solutions multiservices complexes. Grâce à votre expertise dans les fonctions cloud avancées et Kubernetes, vous promouvoirez la cohérence architecturale, piloterez la stratégie technique pour les composants majeurs et mentorez les ingénieurs seniors pour assurer les plus hautes normes de qualité d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
Description de la zone
Responsabilités professionnelles

• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) & Responsabilisation / Résolution de problèmes: Définit les tâches pour les autres et conduit avec succès des initiatives moyennes à grandes (H/F) à travers une gamme de produits ou de produits. Défis d'autres de façon à favoriser la croissance, exploite efficacement les forces de l'équipe, et agit comme entraîneur et chef de file pour d'autres ingénieurs.

• Gestion des intervenants: Démontre une forte compréhension des écosystèmes des intervenants et de leurs besoins, excellant dans les négociations et les partenariats pour des avantages mutuels. Fournit une orientation claire vers les buts et objectifs à moyen et à long terme.

• Impact/Stratégie: Apporte un soutien mondial aux initiatives technologiques et innovantes. Donner des discours et partager des connaissances lors d'événements mondiaux et internationaux, et animer des universités de technologie, des centres d'excellence et des initiatives de partage des connaissances. Activités liées au chapitre ou au site.

• Complexité / (Taille du produit): Fonctionne au niveau de la gamme de produits, du chapitre, du domaine ou du site, ce qui a un impact direct sur la croissance et l'engagement d'autres membres du chapitre.

• Capacités commerciales et techniques: contribue activement à l'avancement des connaissances techniques sur le terrain au moyen de publications, de présentations et de mentorat (p. ex., en jouant le rôle de propriétaire/héros des capacités). Inspire l'innovation, lance des solutions innovantes conformes aux nouvelles tendances technologiques, et s'engage dans l'élaboration de nouvelles approches des problèmes existants.

Compétences
Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience démontrée définissant les tâches, coachant les ingénieurs et conduisant avec succès des initiatives de moyenne à grande échelle dans une gamme de produits ou de produits.

• Expérience prouvée de la contribution à la stratégie technique pour les principaux composants/services et de la participation à des manifestations mondiales de partage des connaissances.

Compétences techniques

• Expérience approfondie de conception et de mise en œuvre de Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud et/ou Salesforce Health Cloud.

• Une bonne compréhension de la plateforme de base Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud) et de la manière de l'étendre aux services d'assistance aux patients.

• Compétence avec des outils déclaratifs comme Flow Builder, et une connaissance profonde avec OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors) pour construire l'interface utilisateur/UX spécifique à l'industrie.

• Expérience pratique en configurant et en déployant Agentforce pour créer des agents d'IA personnalisés et autonomes pour les sciences de la vie. Capacité de définir les actions de l'agent, d'établir des garde-corps de conformité rigoureux et d'utiliser un constructeur rapide.

• Expérience avec les capacités d'IA d'Einstein pour la prochaine meilleure action ou les perspectives du patient

• Expérience éprouvée dans la mise en oeuvre de Salesforce Shield (encryptage de la plate-forme, piste de vérification sur le terrain, surveillance des événements) pour obtenir des renseignements sensibles sur la santé des patients (ISP)

• Connaissances pratiques de M

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
L'Ingegnere di Piombo Senior definisce i compiti per gli altri e guida iniziative su larga scala attraverso una linea di prodotti o prodotti. In questo ruolo strategico, istruirai e guiderai altri ingegneri, eccellerai nei negoziati con le parti interessate, e fornirai una direzione per obiettivi a medio-lungo termine. Contribuirai attivamente alla conoscenza tecnica attraverso pubblicazioni, ispirare l'innovazione e guidare la progettazione di soluzioni multi-servizio complesse. Con competenze nelle funzioni cloud avanzate e Kubernetes, promuoverete la coerenza architettonica, guidare la strategia tecnica per i principali componenti, e gli ingegneri senior mentor per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità ingegneristica in tutta l'organizzazione.
Descrizione della zona
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Progettare e mantenere soluzioni di dati end-to-end utilizzando AWS assicurando l'allineamento con obiettivi aziendali e requisiti tecnici.

• Sviluppa modelli di dati scalabili ed efficienti, pipeline e flussi di lavoro all'interno dell'ambiente AWS.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder per comprendere le esigenze aziendali e tradurli in requisiti tecnici e soluzioni.

• Come necessario, collaborare con altri membri del team e appaltatori esterni per migliorare le soluzioni tecniche. Coordinare il loro lavoro, fornire indicazioni e garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi del progetto.

• Integrazione dei dati:

• Implementare soluzioni di integrazione dei dati per ingerire, trasformare e gestire grandi set di dati da varie fonti in AWS e Snowflake.

• Assicurare qualità, coerenza e sicurezza dei dati durante il ciclo di vita dei dati.

• Sviluppare la documentazione relativa ai processi di gestione dei dati, alle procedure e ai dizionari di dati.

• Scope / Accountability/Problem Solving: Definisce i compiti per altri e guida con successo iniziative (M/F) di medie e grandi dimensioni su una linea di prodotto o di prodotto. Sfida gli altri in modo che la crescita consenta, sfrutta efficacemente i punti di forza del team, e agisce come allenatore e guida per altri ingegneri.

• Stakeholder Management: dimostra una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze, eccellendo nei negoziati e nelle partnership per i benefici reciproci. Fornisce una direzione chiara a obiettivi e obiettivi a medio-lungo termine.

• Impact/Strategy: fornisce supporto a livello globale per iniziative innovative e tecnologiche. Attivo dà discorsi e condivide la conoscenza a eventi globali e internazionali, e guida università tecnologiche, centri di eccellenza (CoEs), e le iniziative di condivisione della conoscenza. Impegnato nelle attività relative al Capitolo/Sito.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona al livello del prodotto, della linea di prodotto, del dominio o del sito, rendendo un impatto diretto sulla crescita e l'impegno di altri membri del capitolo.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: contribuisce attivamente al progresso della conoscenza tecnica all'interno del campo attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni e mentorship (ad esempio, giocando il ruolo di proprietario/eroe di capacità). Ispira innovazione, spinge soluzioni innovative in linea con le tendenze tecnologiche emergenti, e si impegna a costruire nuovi approcci ai problemi esistenti.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Corso di laurea o master in Informatica, ingegneria del software, o un campo tecnico correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• Esperienza dimostrata leader complesse soluzioni AWS/cloud-native e mentoring ingegneri senior.

• Provato record di contribuire alla strategia tecnica per i principali componenti / servizi e partecipare a eventi di condivisione della conoscenza globale.

Competenze tecniche

• Forte esperienza come Lead Engineer, Tech Lead, Cloud Architect, o simil

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung
Als Senior Business Analyst verwalten Sie selbstständig End-to-End-Workstreams für Geschäftsanalysen und lösen komplexe Geschäftsprobleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten. Sie werden ein starkes Verständnis für die Geschäftsdomäne, verwandte Technologien und ihre Interdependenzen demonstrieren, indem Sie fortschrittliche Werkzeuge und Techniken anwenden, um Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne zu übersetzen. In dieser Rolle fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für funktionsübergreifende Teams, gestalten Stakeholder-Perspektiven, behandeln Prozess-Interdependenzen und tragen wesentlich zur Gestaltung und Validierung effektiver Lösungen bei. Sie werden auch Junior-Analysten betreuen und Teamprozesse, Methoden und Best Practices innerhalb der breiteren Community of Practice aktiv gestalten.
Beschreibung des Gebiets
Arbeit
• Zuständigkeiten
Scope / (Content Leadership): Verwaltet selbstständig End-to-End-Workstreams für Geschäftsanalysen ohne Anleitung und geht Probleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten an. Passt eine Reihe von Standard-Frameworks professionell an, betreut Junior- und Intermediate-BAs und gestaltet proaktiv Arbeitsweisen und Best Practices im Team.
Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von Geschäftsproblemen, führt gründliche Domänenforschung durch und treibt die Ursachenanalyse voran. Verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung umfassender Anforderungen, einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Lösungsauswahl und die proaktive Identifizierung von Bedarfs-Lösungs-Unstimmigkeiten, um kreative Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen.
Stakeholder-Management: Identifiziert eine Vielzahl von funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern und baut Vertrauen durch ein tiefes Geschäftsverständnis auf, um als vertrauenswürdiger Berater zu agieren. Ermöglicht Workshops, löst Konflikte und gestaltet proaktiv Stakeholder-Perspektiven, um Erwartungen strategisch zu managen und an den Projektzielen auszurichten.
Wirkung/Strategie: Liefert Wirkung, die sich auf ein bestimmtes Produkt, eine bestimmte Initiative oder ein bestimmtes Cluster erstreckt und zu den Domänenzielen beiträgt, indem sichergestellt wird, dass Lösungen einen nachweisbaren Geschäftswert bieten. Übersetzt Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne, beeinflusst taktische Entscheidungen und trägt zu langfristigen Lösungs-Roadmaps bei.
Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert auf Lösungs- oder Produktebene mit mehreren Lösungen, behandelt mehrdeutige Anforderungen und interagiert systematisch mit Stakeholdern in einer breiteren Produktumgebung. Bewertet die Auswirkungen von Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung sowohl unmittelbarer als auch langfristiger Geschäftsauswirkungen.
Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Demonstriert ein tiefes Verständnis von Business und technischen Domänen, Technologien und deren Interdependenzen. Wendet Werkzeuge, Prinzipien und Techniken in Bezug auf Anforderungen, Daten, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Prozessanalyse unabhängig an, um Verbindungen zu verwalten und die Gesamteffizienz zu verbessern.
Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung
5+ Jahre Business Analysis / Beratungserfahrung, wobei mindestens 3+ Jahre in Life Sciences / Pharma oder der zugewiesenen Geschäftsfunktion unterstützt werden.
Bewährte Erfahrung in der unabhängigen Verwaltung von End-to-End-BA-Workstreams, der Navigation mehrdeutiger Anforderungen und der Bewertung strategischer Lösungsoptionen.
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Übersetzung von Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne, die sich an den allgemeinen Geschäftszielen orientieren.
Technische Fähigkeiten
Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der Business-Analyse / Beratung Konzepte und Praktiken, mit mittlerer Expertise in mindestens einem BA Fähigkeit.
Starke Kenntnisse in Anforderungserhebung und Dokumentation, die eine umfassende Anforderungsrückverfolgbarkeit und ein konsistentes Change Management gewährleisten.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Workload Orchestration Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be recognised internally as an expert in workload orchestration, owning and advancing our scheduler tech stack across our High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms. With the rapid expansion of our compute infrastructure, your broad expertise will drive the efficient scheduling, policy management, and resource optimization of our multi-node CPU and GPU environments.

In this role, you will use your expertise to bridge traditional scientific computing with modern AI paradigms, while acting as a coach and mentor to help colleagues develop technical expertise. You will solve unique, unprecedented scheduling and infrastructure challenges that directly impact Roche’s compute architecture, ensuring our researchers, data scientists, and engineers can execute compute workloads reliably, efficiently, and successfully.

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premises infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team acts as a center of excellence and delivery for High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping infrastructure consumers optimize for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI to achieve rapid time-to-value.

The Opportunity:

SLURM Architecture & Ecosystem Leadership

• Serve as the internal expert on the SLURM Workload Manager, architecting, scaling, and maintaining SLURM across heterogeneous HPC (and AI environments) to ensure high availability and dynamic resource distribution.

• Design and tune advanced SLURM configurations, including custom plugin integration, topology-aware scheduling, GRES/GPU management, dynamic priority trees, and complex QoS/fair-share policies.

• Bridge HPC and cloud-native ecosystems by evaluating and implementing integrations between SLURM, Kubernetes, and orchestration platforms (e.g., SLURM Slinky or Run:ai) to streamline job submission workflows across architectures.

Hybrid Workload & Kubernetes Integration

• Integrate containerization standards across SLURM (using Singularity/Apptainer) while maintaining operational familiarity with Kubernetes container orchestration to support hybrid AI/HPC workloads.

• Solve unique, unprecedented multi-tenant bottlenecks, such as GPU allocation overhead, MPI/NCCL communication failures, and complex workload failures.

Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Governance

• Lead large, global cross-functional initiatives across ACE, infrastructure, platform, scientific computing, and AI teams to establish workload orchestration standards, policies, and architectural patterns across Roche compute environments.

• Act as a technical mentor and coach for junior and mid-level engineers, driving skill development and continuous learning across the chapter.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Workload Orchestration Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be recognised internally as an expert in workload orchestration, owning and advancing our scheduler tech stack across our High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms. With the rapid expansion of our compute infrastructure, your broad expertise will drive the efficient scheduling, policy management, and resource optimization of our multi-node CPU and GPU environments.

In this role, you will use your expertise to bridge traditional scientific computing with modern AI paradigms, while acting as a coach and mentor to help colleagues develop technical expertise. You will solve unique, unprecedented scheduling and infrastructure challenges that directly impact Roche’s compute architecture, ensuring our researchers, data scientists, and engineers can execute compute workloads reliably, efficiently, and successfully.

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premises infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team acts as a center of excellence and delivery for High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping infrastructure consumers optimize for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI to achieve rapid time-to-value.

The Opportunity:

SLURM Architecture & Ecosystem Leadership

• Serve as the internal expert on the SLURM Workload Manager, architecting, scaling, and maintaining SLURM across heterogeneous HPC (and AI environments) to ensure high availability and dynamic resource distribution.

• Design and tune advanced SLURM configurations, including custom plugin integration, topology-aware scheduling, GRES/GPU management, dynamic priority trees, and complex QoS/fair-share policies.

• Bridge HPC and cloud-native ecosystems by evaluating and implementing integrations between SLURM, Kubernetes, and orchestration platforms (e.g., SLURM Slinky or Run:ai) to streamline job submission workflows across architectures.

Hybrid Workload & Kubernetes Integration

• Integrate containerization standards across SLURM (using Singularity/Apptainer) while maintaining operational familiarity with Kubernetes container orchestration to support hybrid AI/HPC workloads.

• Solve unique, unprecedented multi-tenant bottlenecks, such as GPU allocation overhead, MPI/NCCL communication failures, and complex workload failures.

Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Governance

• Lead large, global cross-functional initiatives across ACE, infrastructure, platform, scientific computing, and AI teams to establish workload orchestration standards, policies, and architectural patterns across Roche compute environments.

• Act as a technical mentor and coach for junior and mid-level engineers, driving skill development and continuous learning across the chapter.

• Partner with Observability Engineers to establish deep telemetry dashboards for SLURM job efficiency, queue wait times, and hardware utilization, utilizing configuration-as-code to deploy policies uniformly.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
En tant que Workload Orchestration Engineer au sein de l'équipe Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE), vous serez reconnu en interne en tant qu'expert dans l'orchestration de la charge de travail, la propriété et l'avancement de notre pile de technologie de programmeur sur nos plateformes de calcul haute performance (HPC). Grâce à l'expansion rapide de notre infrastructure de calcul, votre vaste expertise permettra d'optimiser efficacement la planification, la gestion des politiques et les ressources de nos environnements CPU et GPU multinoeuds.

Dans ce rôle, vous utiliserez votre expertise pour relier l'informatique scientifique traditionnelle aux paradigmes modernes de l'IA, tout en agissant comme coach et mentor pour aider vos collègues à développer leur expertise technique. Vous résoudrez des défis uniques et sans précédent en matière de programmation et d'infrastructure qui ont une incidence directe sur l'architecture de calcul Roches, assurant ainsi à nos chercheurs, à nos data savants et à nos ingénieurs une exécution fiable, efficace et réussie des charges de travail de calcul.

Hébergement et infrastructure (HI) fournit une infrastructure sur site essentielle à la mission, l'hébergement cloud, la connectivité et les produits technologiques qui permettent à toutes les fonctions de chaque site Roche de développer, d'innover, de connecter et de livrer des produits numériques conformes dans l'ensemble de la Roche Enterprise.

Cette équipe facilite l'intégration et l'adoption harmonieuses pour les clients verticaux d'affaires qui ont besoin d'un calcul accéléré, aidant ainsi les consommateurs d'infrastructures à optimiser leur disponibilité, leur transfert de données sans faille, leur flexibilité, leur rapidité et les besoins en évolution rapide de l'IA pour atteindre rapidement la valeur.

La possibilité :

Architecture SLURM et leadership écosystémique

• Servir d'expert interne sur le gestionnaire de charge de travail SLURM, l'architecture, l'échelle et le maintien de SLURM dans les environnements HPC (et AI) hétérogènes afin d'assurer une disponibilité élevée et une distribution dynamique des ressources.

• Concevoir et régler les configurations avancées de SLURM, y compris l'intégration de plugins personnalisés, le planning topologique, la gestion GRES/GPU, les arbres prioritaires dynamiques et les politiques complexes de QoS/fair-share.

• Établir un pont entre le CHP et les écosystèmes cloud-natifs en évaluant et en mettant en œuvre des intégrations entre SLURM, Kubernetes et les plateformes d'orchestration (p. ex., SLURM Slinky ou Run:ai) afin de rationaliser les flux de travail de soumission d'emplois à travers les architectures.

Intégration de la charge de travail hybride & Kubernetes

• Intégrer les normes de containerization dans SLURM (en utilisant Singularity/Apptainer) tout en maintenant une connaissance opérationnelle de l'orchestration de conteneurs Kubernetes pour supporter les charges de travail hybrides AI/HPC.

• Résoudre les goulets d'étranglement uniques et sans précédent, tels que les frais généraux d'allocation des GPU, les pannes de communication MPI/NCCL et les défaillances complexes de la charge de travail.

Leadership technique, mentorat et gouvernance

• Diriger de grandes initiatives interfonctionnelles mondiales à l'échelle de l'ACE, de l'infrastructure, de la plateforme, de l'informatique scientifique et de l'IA afin d'établir des normes d'orchestration de la charge de travail, des politiques et des modèles architecturaux dans les environnements de calcul Roche.

• Agir comme mentor technique et entraîneur pour les ingénieurs subalternes et de niveau intermédiaire, le développement des compétences de conduite et l'apprentissage continu dans tout le chapitre.

• Partenaire avec les ingénieurs d'observation pour établir des tableaux de bord de télémétrie profonde pour l'efficacité de travail SLURM, les temps d'attente et l'utilisation du matériel, en utilisant la configuration comme code pour déployer les politiques uniformément.

Qui vous êtes :

• Licence en informatique, mathématiques appliquées, informatique

The Position
Job description
The Principal Business Analyst possesses in-depth knowledge of the business domain, relevant technologies, and organizational strategy to provide holistic, enterprise-wide consulting advice. In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of interconnected systems, overseeing initiatives with full autonomy and leading analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Oversees initiatives or streams with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale. Defines and leads analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, navigates complex frameworks, and delegates work while managing the quality of business analysis content.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, defining the problem space and driving comprehensive root cause analysis that may span organizational boundaries. Proactively prevents scope creep, manages the complexity of various scopes of change, and is ultimately accountable for business analysis deliverables ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management.

• Impact/Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects and programs by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works typically on a product or product line level, effectively managing highly ambiguous and evolving requirements in dynamic environments. Demonstrates a holistic viewpoint to analyze problems, considering potential micro and macro implications across related domains.

• Business / Technical ability: Uses in-depth knowledge of the business or technical domain and relevant technologies to inform business strategies. Leads the application of tools, principles, and techniques across complex and cross-functional initiatives, anticipating challenges and proactively integrating analysis into broader solution design.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.

• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.

• Proven track record of recommending optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation and working on unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions.

Technical Skills

• Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice.

• Strong capability to extend standard approaches by tailoring methods to fit the problem space, often combining methodologies to create tailored approaches.

• Mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, with the ability to conduct comprehensive root cause analysis and advanced value and risk assessments.

Additional Qualifications

• Exce

Conduce la valutazione delle opzioni di soluzione strategica, tra cui analisi del valore avanzato e valutazione del rischio, e forma attivamente roadmap a lungo termine.

• Risultato record di consigliare soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali per la trasformazione aziendale sostenibile e lavorare su problemi insolitamente complessi con soluzioni altamente innovative.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie das Systemdenken anwenden, um die Komplexität miteinander verbundener Systeme zu steuern, Initiativen mit voller Autonomie zu überwachen und Analysebemühungen in sehr mehrdeutigen Räumen zu leiten. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The ERP Solution Consultant leads independently complex ERP solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced ERP knowledge, in-depth expertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development.

Job Responsibilities

• Backlog Management: Defining, ordering, and refining Product Backlog items to align with business goals.

• Product Strategy: Evaluate existing SD processes to identify optimization opportunities, particularly in the areas of automated order processing and real-time analytics.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating with Supply Chain stakeholders to gather feedback, manage expectations, and communicate product updates.

• Development Collaboration: Working with Scrum teams to define, build, and validate product features during sprints.

• Solution Design & Configuration: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features within S/4HANA .

• Hands-on Core Customizing : Perform independent, hands-on SAP standard configuration and customization within the S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) and Material management (MM) module.

• WRICEF Specification & Design : Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications for custom developments, actively designing and delivering WRICEF items (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from ideation to hypercare.

• Logistics Integration: Act as the functional lead for SD integration touchpoints with Decentralized EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) and Embedded TM (Transportation Management) to ensure seamless flow from Sales Order to TM Integration

Technical & Professional Qualifications

• S/4HANA SD: Minimum of 3 of experience in SAP SD, ideally with full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.

• Familiarity with Solution Manager (SolMan) or SAP Cloud ALM for documentation and transport management.

• Technical Literacy: Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting IDocs/ALE.

Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

• Life Sciences / Pharma Experience: Familiarity with pharmaceutical business models

• Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate comp
