jobs.title: Network and Capabilities Manager

titleByLocale.it: Gestione della rete e delle capacità

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Network and Capability Manager

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
The Clinical Distribution organization’s objective is to cost-effectively ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time every time, such that no patient will go without treatment and no clinical trial will be delayed. The Network & Capabilities Manager ensures organizational readiness for the Clinical Distribution team and our North Star: All patients worldwide, within one day, CO2 neutral.
The Network & Capabilities Manager is a member of the Network & Capabilities Chapter, which is jointly accountable for all elements of clinical supply chain distribution for the global Roche/Genentech portfolio of >500 studies. The global Network & Capability chapter is responsible for the logistic framework and setup to enable optimized and reliable clinical distribution for all studies (more than 100k shipments yearly across >130 countries), through effective use of industry-leading clinical distribution strategies , processes and systems. The Network & Capabilities Manager is a team member in an agile organizational structure, overseeing and supporting the distribution network (more than 23 warehouses and depots) and a spend of more than 50m CHF yearly.

The Opportunity:

• You are responsible for overseeing and optimizing the distribution network (>100k shipments per year) to enable timely, reliable and efficient delivery for all global Roche/Genentech clinical trials. Therefore you partner closely with internal stakeholders (Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality), customers (Clinical Operations) and external partners (3PLs, LSPs, etc.)

• You contribute and execute the network & capabilities chapter strategy, aligning with the overall distribution strategy. This incl. future network and capability readiness, build up of new locations, and a strong emphasis on Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).

• You oversee, manage and optimize distribution costs and spend (>50m CHF/year).

• You drive best practices, standardization, and optimization of distribution network processes in collaboration with Business Capability Leads (BCLs), QA ensuring supply chain reliability.

• You co-create and execute objectives for the global network & capabilities chapter, enabling continuous improvements and cultural transition towards a self-managed team and organization.

• You ensure the overall compliance of the distribution network according to GxP and GCP standards.

Who you are:

We are looking for a senior professional (m/f/d) to join our team with significant expertise and extensive years of professional experience.

• You have a strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain management, including warehouse and transportation management, logistics, and regulatory requirements for clinical trials.

• You bring relevant GXP experience

• You possess excellent knowledge of clinical supply chain distribution processes, Supplier Relationship management incl. negotiations & industry best practices, and the tools and systems needed to enable operational excellence.

• You act as an architect and catalyst in the distribution organization, taking smart risks and streamlining or stopping non-value-adding work.

• You bring excellent communication and presentation skills,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Gestione della rete e della capacità

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.
L'obiettivo dell'organizzazione di distribuzione clinica è quello di garantire economicamente il prodotto giusto è nel posto giusto al momento giusto ogni volta, in modo che nessun paziente andrà senza trattamento e nessuna prova clinica sarà ritardata. Il Network & Capabilities Manager assicura la disponibilità organizzativa per il team di distribuzione clinica e la nostra North Star: Tutti i pazienti in tutto il mondo, entro un giorno, CO2 neutrale.
Il Network & Capabilities Manager è membro del Network & Capabilities Chapter, che è congiuntamente responsabile per tutti gli elementi della distribuzione della supply chain clinica per il portafoglio globale di studi Roche/Genentech. Il capitolo Global Network & Capability è responsabile del quadro logistico e della configurazione per consentire una distribuzione clinica ottimizzata e affidabile per tutti gli studi (oltre 100k spedizioni ogni anno in >130 paesi), attraverso un uso efficace delle strategie di distribuzione clinica leader del settore, processi e sistemi. Il Network & Capabilities Manager è un membro del team in una struttura organizzativa agile, supervisionando e supportando la rete di distribuzione (oltre 23 magazzini e depositi) e una spesa di oltre 50m CHF all'anno.

L'opportunità:

• Sei responsabile della supervisione e dell'ottimizzazione della rete di distribuzione (>100k spedizioni all'anno) per consentire una consegna tempestiva, affidabile ed efficiente per tutti gli studi clinici Roche/Genentech globali. Pertanto si collabora a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne (catena dei fornitori, appalti, qualità), clienti (Operazioni cliniche) e partner esterni (3PL, LSP, ecc.)

• Contribuisci ed esegue la strategia del capitolo delle funzionalità di rete, allineando con la strategia di distribuzione generale. Questo include la disponibilità futura di rete e capacità, la creazione di nuove sedi, e una forte enfasi sulla gestione delle relazioni dei fornitori (SRM).

• Superare, gestire e ottimizzare i costi di distribuzione e spendere (>50m CHF/anno).

• Guida le migliori pratiche, la standardizzazione e l'ottimizzazione dei processi di rete di distribuzione in collaborazione con Business Capability Leads (BCLs), QA garantendo affidabilità della supply chain.

• Co-crea ed esegue obiettivi per il capitolo della rete e delle capacità globali, consentendo continui miglioramenti e transizione culturale verso un team e un'organizzazione autogestite.

• Garantisci la conformità generale della rete di distribuzione secondo gli standard GxP e GCP.

Chi sei:

Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista senior (m/f/d) per unire il nostro team con competenze significative e anni di esperienza professionale.

• Hai una forte comprensione della gestione della supply chain end-to-end, tra cui la gestione del magazzino e dei trasporti, la logistica e i requisiti normativi per gli studi clinici.

• Porti un'esperienza GXP rilevante

• Possiedi un'ottima conoscenza dei processi di distribuzione della supply chain clinica, la gestione delle relazioni del fornitore incl. trattative e migliori pratiche del settore, e gli strumenti e i sistemi necessari per consentire l'eccellenza operativa.

• Lei agisce come architetto e catalizzatore nell'organizzazione di distribuzione, assumendo rischi intelligenti e razionalizzando o arrestando il lavoro di non-valore.

• Porti eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e presentazione,

The Network & Capabilities Manager is a member of the Network & Capabilities Chapter, which is jointly accountable for all elements of clinical supply chain distribution for the global Roche/Genentech portfolio of >500 studies. The global Network & Capability chapter is responsible for the logistic framework and setup to enable optimized and reliable clinical distribution for all studies (more than 100k shipments yearly across >130 countries), through effective use of industry-leading clinical distribution strategies , processes and systems. The Network & Capabilities Manager is a team member in an agile organizational structure, overseeing and supporting the distribution network (more than 23 warehouses and depots) and a spend of more than 50m CHF yearly.

The Opportunity:

• You are responsible for overseeing and optimizing the distribution network (>100k shipments per year) to enable timely, reliable and efficient delivery for all global Roche/Genentech clinical trials. Therefore you partner closely with internal stakeholders (Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality), customers (Clinical Operations) and external partners (3PLs, LSPs, etc.)

• You contribute and execute the network & capabilities chapter strategy, aligning with the overall distribution strategy. This incl. future network and capability readiness, build up of new locations, and a strong emphasis on Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).

• You oversee, manage and optimize distribution costs and spend (>50m CHF/year).

• You drive best practices, standardization, and optimization of distribution network processes in collaboration with Business Capability Leads (BCLs), QA ensuring supply chain reliability.

• You co-create and execute objectives for the global network & capabilities chapter, enabling continuous improvements and cultural transition towards a self-managed team and organization.

• You ensure the overall compliance of the distribution network according to GxP and GCP standards.

Who you are:

We are looking for a senior professional (m/f/d) to join our team with significant expertise and extensive years of professional experience.

• You have a strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain management, including warehouse and transportation management, logistics, and regulatory requirements for clinical trials.

• You bring relevant GXP experience

• You possess excellent knowledge of clinical supply chain distribution processes, Supplier Relationship management incl. negotiations & industry best practices, and the tools and systems needed to enable operational excellence.

• You act as an architect and catalyst in the distribution organization, taking smart risks and streamlining or stopping non-value-adding work.

• You bring excellent communication and presentation skills,
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Netzwerk- und Kapazitätsmanager

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.
Ziel der Organisation Clinical Distribution ist es, kostengünstig sicherzustellen, dass das richtige Produkt jedes Mal zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort ist, so dass kein Patient ohne Behandlung auskommt und keine klinische Studie verzögert wird. Der Network & Capabilities Manager sorgt für die organisatorische Bereitschaft des Clinical Distribution Teams und unseres North Star: Alle Patienten weltweit, innerhalb eines Tages, CO2-neutral.
Der Network & Capabilities Manager ist Mitglied des Network & Capabilities Chapter, das gemeinsam für alle Elemente der klinischen Supply Chain Distribution für das globale Roche/Genentech Portfolio von >500 Studien verantwortlich ist. Das globale Network & Capability-Kapitel ist für den logistischen Rahmen und die Einrichtung verantwortlich, um eine optimierte und zuverlässige klinische Verteilung für alle Studien (mehr als 100.000 Sendungen jährlich in > 130 Ländern) durch den effektiven Einsatz branchenführender klinischer Vertriebsstrategien, -prozesse und -systeme zu ermöglichen. Der Network & Capabilities Manager ist Teammitglied in einer agilen Organisationsstruktur, betreut und unterstützt das Vertriebsnetz (mehr als 23 Lager und Depots) und gibt jährlich mehr als 50 Mio. CHF aus.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Sie sind verantwortlich für die Überwachung und Optimierung des Vertriebsnetzes (>100k Sendungen pro Jahr), um eine zeitnahe, zuverlässige und effiziente Lieferung für alle globalen klinischen Studien von Roche / Genentech zu ermöglichen. Daher arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Stakeholdern (Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality), Kunden (Clinical Operations) und externen Partnern (3PLs, LSPs, etc.) zusammen.

• Sie tragen bei und führen die Netzwerk- und Fähigkeitenkapitelstrategie aus, wobei Sie sich an der Gesamtverteilungsstrategie orientieren. Dies beinhaltet die zukünftige Netzwerk- und Fähigkeitsbereitschaft, den Aufbau neuer Standorte und einen starken Schwerpunkt auf Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).

• Sie überwachen, verwalten und optimieren Vertriebskosten und -ausgaben (> 50 Mio. CHF/Jahr).

• Sie fördern Best Practices, Standardisierung und Optimierung von Vertriebsnetzwerkprozessen in Zusammenarbeit mit Business Capability Leads (BCLs), um die Zuverlässigkeit der Lieferkette zu gewährleisten.

• Sie erstellen und führen Ziele für das globale Netzwerk & Fähigkeiten-Kapitel mit und ermöglichen kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und einen kulturellen Übergang zu einem selbstverwalteten Team und einer selbstverwalteten Organisation.

• Sie stellen die generelle Compliance des Vertriebsnetzes nach GxP und GCP Standards sicher.

Wer du bist:

Wir suchen einen Senior Professional (m/w/d), der sich unserem Team mit erheblicher Expertise und langjähriger Berufserfahrung anschließt.

• Sie haben ein fundiertes Verständnis für das End-to-End-Lieferkettenmanagement, einschließlich Lager- und Transportmanagement, Logistik und regulatorische Anforderungen für klinische Studien.

• Sie bringen relevante GXP-Erfahrung

• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der klinischen Supply Chain Distributionsprozesse, Supplier Relationship Management inkl. Verhandlungen und Best Practices der Branche sowie die Werkzeuge und Systeme, die für operative Exzellenz erforderlich sind.

• Sie agieren als Architekt und Katalysator in der Vertriebsorganisation, gehen intelligente Risiken ein und rationalisieren oder stoppen nicht wertschöpfende Arbeit.

• Sie bringen ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Gestionnaire de réseau et de capacités

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.
L'objectif de l'organisation de distribution clinique est de s'assurer que le bon produit est au bon endroit au bon moment à chaque fois, de sorte qu'aucun patient ne passera sans traitement et qu'aucun essai clinique ne sera retardé. Le gestionnaire de réseau et capacités assure la préparation organisationnelle de l'équipe de distribution clinique et de notre North Star: Tous les patients du monde entier, dans un délai d'un jour, neutralisant le CO2.
Le gestionnaire de réseau et capacités est membre du chapitre Réseau et capacités, qui est responsable conjointement de tous les éléments de la distribution de la chaîne d'approvisionnement clinique pour le portefeuille mondial Roche/Genentech de >500 études. Le chapitre Global Network & Capacity est responsable du cadre logistique et de la mise en place pour permettre une distribution clinique optimisée et fiable pour toutes les études (plus de 100 000 envois par an dans > 130 pays), grâce à l'utilisation efficace de stratégies, processus et systèmes de distribution clinique de pointe. Le Network & Capabilities Manager est un membre de l'équipe dans une structure organisationnelle agile, supervisant et soutenant le réseau de distribution (plus de 23 entrepôts et dépôts) et une dépense de plus de 50 m CHF par an.

La possibilité:

• Vous êtes responsable de la supervision et de l'optimisation du réseau de distribution (> 100k expéditions par année) pour permettre une livraison rapide, fiable et efficace pour tous les essais cliniques mondiaux de Roche/Genentech. Par conséquent, vous collaborez étroitement avec les intervenants internes (chaîne d'approvisionnement, approvisionnement, qualité), les clients (opérations cliniques) et les partenaires externes (3PL, LSP, etc.)

• Vous contribuez et exécutez la stratégie du chapitre réseau et capacités, en s'harmonisant avec la stratégie de distribution globale. Cela inclut l'état de préparation futur du réseau et des capacités, l'établissement de nouveaux emplacements et l'accent mis sur la gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs.

• Vous supervisez, gérez et optimisez les coûts de distribution et les dépenses (>50m CHF/an).

• Vous dirigez les meilleures pratiques, la normalisation et l'optimisation des processus de réseau de distribution en collaboration avec les responsables de capacités d'affaires (BCL), QA assurant la fiabilité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Vous co-créez et exécutez des objectifs pour le chapitre sur le réseau mondial et les capacités, permettant des améliorations continues et une transition culturelle vers une équipe et une organisation autogérées.

• Vous assurez la conformité globale du réseau de distribution selon les normes GxP et GCP.

Qui vous êtes:

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel senior (h/f/d) pour rejoindre notre équipe avec une expertise significative et de longues années d'expérience professionnelle.

• Vous avez une bonne compréhension de la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, y compris la gestion des entrepôts et des transports, la logistique et les exigences réglementaires pour les essais cliniques.

• Vous apportez une expérience GXP pertinente

• Vous possédez une excellente connaissance des processus de distribution de la chaîne d'approvisionnement clinique, gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs, y compris. négociation et les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie, ainsi que les outils et les systèmes nécessaires pour permettre l'excellence opérationnelle.

• Vous agissez en tant qu'architecte et catalyseur dans l'organisation de distribution, prenant des risques intelligents et rationalisant ou arrêtant les travaux sans valeur ajoutée.

• Vous apportez d'excellentes compétences de communication et de présentation,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering & Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~6 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Full-Stack AI Engineer / Data Scientist with a deep sense of ownership. Rather than being a narrowly specialized Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or MLOps Engineer, you will combine these skill sets. You will build agentic generative AI systems and classical ML systems end-to-end, taking accountability from concept and exploratory data analysis all the way to production releases and monitoring.

Core Tech Stack & Scope
This role involves working deeply with multimodal foundation models, advanced agentic workflows (including Agent-to-Agent/A2A communication), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, other emerging AI technologies, and MLOps subsystems. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) alongside vector, graph, and traditional databases to develop scalable and robust AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Agentic & GenAI Application Development:

• Design and build advanced AI agentic systems, state machines, search-based conversational systems that solve complex business problems.

• Develop workflows leveraging Large Foundational Multimodal Models to process and reason across text, audio, and video modalities.

• Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients to standardize context exchange between agents, data sources, and external tools.

• Collaborate with AI Architects, Product Owners, and fellow developers to integrate AI capabilities into scalable, fair, and ethical end-user applications focusing on relevance and real-time performance.
Full-Stack Engineering & Agentic SDLC:

• Leverage AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles, maintaining high productivity across frontend, backend, and infrastructure tasks.

• Take end-to-end accountability for features: write high-quality, production-ready Python (and occasionally TypeScript) code with comprehensive testing and documentation.

• Manage the DevOps/MLOps lifecycle: containerize applications using Docker, configure CI/CD pipelines, and architect high-throughput, reliable cloud-native solutions on AWS/multicloud.
Data Science, EDA & Strategy:

• Perform thorough Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand dataset characteristics, uncover patterns, detect biases, and identify data quality issues.

• Use statistical and visualization techniques to inform feature engineering, model selection, and optimization of foundation model-based applications.

• Design robust data pipelines to curate, preprocess, and structure diverse datasets that maximize LLM effectiveness and reduce bias.
Algorithm Development & Optimization:

• Design, customize, optimize, and fine-tune LLM-based and traditional AI algorithms for specific use cases (e.g., text generation, summarization, AI agents, sequence modeling).

• Lead advanced prompt engineering strategies, utilizing zero-shot, few-shot and other paradigms to optimize model outputs without extensive fine-tuning.

Job description
As an IT Quality Specialist at the SE6 level, you independently manage end-to-end software quality assurance and analysis tasks across various capabilities and contribute to solving moderately complex SDLC and release problems. You will lead the analysis of stakeholder needs, drive root cause analysis, and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability across large-scale initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will champion accountability, mentor junior team members, and drive process improvements that align delivered solutions with overarching business goals.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end software quality tasks across various capabilities and contributes to more complex problems. Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of Quality Specialist best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex business problems, clearly defining the problem scope and driving root cause analysis. Elicits, analyzes, and synthesizes complex stakeholder needs, ensuring comprehensive requirements traceability across large-scale initiatives. Assures the delivery of comprehensive and well-structured requirements, contributing significantly to the design and validation of effective solutions. Analyzes technology fit, proposes effective solutions, and proactively identifies discrepancies and improvement opportunities.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of stakeholders across functional areas, analyzing their influence and impact on project outcomes. Interacts within and across multiple product squads within a domain, facilitating workshops and resolving conflicts to ensure alignment. Proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives, anticipates and strategically manages expectations in complex projects, and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor.

• Impact/Strategy: Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with impact typically extending to a specific product, initiative, or cluster. Contributes to the achievement of a product initiative and potentially domain goals by ensuring that delivered solutions meet business needs and provide demonstrable value. Takes a proactive role in shaping team processes, contributes to Communities of Practice (CoPs), and translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Manages quality activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain. Handles ambiguous requirements and evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and longer-term implications within the domain. Ensures alignment with broader goals, manages interdependencies between related processes, and navigates intricate stakeholder environments.

• Business/Technical ability: Demonstrates a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies. Can independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis. Effectively handles interdependencies, managing the interconnections between various processes to improve overall efficiency and effectiveness.

Education / Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field. Having professional certificat

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description:
The Front End Engineer – Clinical Study Design sits at the intersection of frontend engineering, clinical workflows, and product design, helping build the Study Designer, a digital product transforming how clinical trials are designed. This role combines strong frontend engineering skills, an eye for usability, and technical curiosity to translate complex clinical workflows into intuitive, high-performance user interfaces. The ideal candidate is curious, collaborative, AI-minded, and passionate about crafting interfaces that make smarter, faster, and more effective clinical study design possible for the people who use them every day.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design and build highly interactive, visually distinctive UI components using Angular 14–19+ with standalone architecture

• Build reusable, modular UI components and design systems.

• Translate abstract or ambiguous design concepts into polished, production-ready interfaces

• Write clean, type-safe code in TypeScript , styled with modern CSS/SCSS

• Manage complex asynchronous data flows using RxJS

• Implement secure authentication flows using Angular OAuth2 / OIDC

• Integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL services with front-end applications.

• Build and evolve a reusable component library/design system that balances consistency with creative flexibility

• Ensure applications are optimized for performance, accessibility, and usability.

• Handle asynchronous data flows, error handling, and state management.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with backend engineers ( Python/FastAPI/Django ), product managers, and stakeholders to deliver features end-to-end

• Stay current with emerging front-end technologies and industry trends.

• Recommend improvements to architecture, frameworks, and development processes

Preferred Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 5-8 years of experience building production UI with Angular (Angular 14–19+, standalone component architecture)

• Strong command of TypeScript and modern CSS/SCSS (Grid, Flexbox, animations)

• Solid experience with RxJS for managing asynchronous data streams

• Knowledge of data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, AG-Grid).

• Prior experience working with alternative frameworks (React.js, Vue.js) to support cross-platform modernization initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities:

• Experience with Angular OAuth2/OIDC components for authentication

• Exposure to backend technologies like FastAPI, Django/DRF, or PostgreSQL , enough to collaborate effectively with backend engineers

• Familiarity with AWS core services (S3, IAM) or cloud-based deployments

• Comfort handling data serialization for AI-powered features (e.g., structuring data for AI prompts, working with HTTP clients)

• Understanding of JSON, XML, and HTML parsing structures

• Experience with observability/monitoring tools like Grafana Faro for real-time user monitoring

• Solid Gitlab, GitHub workflow experience (branching, merging, PR reviews)

• Interest or experience working on AI/ML-powered product features

Shift: CET time zone

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche we are here to deliver better outcomes to more patients, faster. Our achievements help to transform the lives of millions of people. We’ve been supporting patients for over 100 years in the UK, building a reputation that we’re intensely proud of. Through this success, we’ve set an incredibly high standard. Those expectations continue to grow. The environment in which we operate changes at an ever-increasing pace. The industry is never going to stand still.

As one united team at Roche UK, we know we need to boldly respond to these changes whilst keeping our customers and our patients at the heart of everything we do. So, we’re shooting for the stars, transforming ourselves into a much more open, dynamic, transparent, inclusive, collaborative and agile business.

Purpose
● You will be responsible for the operational management of all key Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (QMS) processes and supporting the Qualified Persons in fullfiling their company and legal obligations.
● You will be responsible for maximising the potential of the pharmaceutical business by ensuring external and global GxP Quality requirements are translated simply into Roche policies & procedures.
● You will need to be adaptable to change and entrepreneurial in nature in order to identify opportunities, while maintaining a laser focus on ensuring compliance; therefore playing a key role in retaining Roche UK’s Licence to Operate.
● You will utilise skills and capabilities to work exibly as part of an empowered, self-managed, multi-skilled team to ensure Foundational and Squad-prioritised work is delivered in line with Organisational principles.
● You need to be authentic and self-accountable, a creative problem solver, a critical thinker and able to cultivate collaborative relationships across the organisation.

This is a temporary position at Roche (initial 12 months)

Career Opportunities
● You will use broad and comprehensive expertise within the GxP Quality environment to lead “Foundation work” and partner with the business to solve complex quality issues that impact the Chapter and/or wider business.
● You will complete "Foundational work" with continual review of ‘how’ it is done to drive efciency and minimise resources required to do it (without compromising on necessary standards).
● You will act as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the centre of all actions by consistent business behaviour that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct.
● You will collaborate with internal and external parties to anticipate trends and impact to QMS, mitigate GxP compliance risks, address gaps and enable the resolution of unique or unprecedented issues.
● You will own your development to ensure continuous skills and capabilities growth in line with your passion and the needs of the Organisation (present and future).

Qualications and Experience
• ● Bachelor Degree in Science
• ● Experience of:
• o Working in a GxP Quality Assurance role providing quality and compliance expertise in support of Unplanned and Planned Events, CAPA management, Document management, and Quality Risk Management
• o Commercial and/or Clinical Batch Record review for product release
• o Health Authority Inspections
• ● Desirable Experience of:
• o Customer Complaints processing and management system
• o QMS key performance indicators trend analysis and management reporting
• o Internal and Supplier Auditing

Who we are
At

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Senior ERP Platform Engineer - ERP System Reliability Engineer - SAP ABAP- lead reliability and performance management across our SAP Digital Core Platform, including S/4HANA and other tightly integrated enterprise systems. This role requires strong expertise in SAP architecture, modules, and integration points, with a deep understanding of how SAP systems operate within complex enterprise environments.
You will be responsible for cross-application reliability, system performance management, proactive SAP system health monitoring, and performance tuning . Collaborating closely with SAP developers, functional consultants, and business stakeholders, you will help reduce technical debt and ensure seamless, highly reliable ERP platform and business operations.
Applying SRE principles to SAP systems , you will drive improvements in availability, performance, and scalability, ensuring the Digital Core runs smoothly under dynamic business demands. Your work will directly influence system stability, user experience, and platform scalability for mission-critical SAP business processes .

Description of the area
As a key member of the Roche ERP within Enterprise Platforms, Infrastructure & Engineering (EPIE) organization, you will lead within the ERP Systems Management sub-function. Together with a team of professionals you will orchestrate across teams to safeguard, and maintain ERP platforms and solutions. In this role, you will hold ownership of our ASPIRE ERP Systems. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders to shape the strategic roadmap for these essential platforms.
Job Responsibilities
As a System Reliability Engineer, you will be instrumental in:

• ERP Platform capacity planning & system tuning : Conduct detailed capacity planning, ensuring systems scale with evolving business needs. Perform system performance tuning and bottleneck analysis across application layers, databases, and infrastructure components.

• ERP Platform Incident & Operational support : Provide expert-level support for critical incidents affecting core SAP systems. Partner with platform, infrastructure, and operations teams to maintain high system uptime and rapid issue resolution.

• Application Reliability & Performance tuning : Monitor and enhance the reliability, performance, and scalability of SAP systems from a cross-application perspective. Ensure availability and continuity management at the application level across all integrated SAP landscapes. Drive problem management through root cause identification and preventive action, minimizing system downtime.

• Collaboration with Development Teams : Work closely with SAP developers and application specialists to co-design reliable, scalable, and maintainable SAP solutions. Identify and help eliminate technical debt through architectural and code-level improvements.

Qualifications and Technical Skills
You are a dynamic individual who is passionate about delivering customer value through continuous improvement and Agile practices. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a strong customer-centric focus, we would love to hear from you. Your qualifications include:

• Deep technical expertise across the SAP ecosystem, including system architecture, ABAP/SQL tuning, databases, OS/infrastructure, and SAP monitoring tools (e.g., Solution Manager, Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with 8+ years of experience in SAP ERP landscape.

• Proven track record in performance optimization, including bott

The Position
Job description
The Technical Lead for US Targeting, Recommendation, Optimization & Measurement (TROM) provides technical leadership for data, analytics, and technology capabilities that enable more effective targeting, personalized recommendations, optimization, and measurement across the US organization.
This role serves as a bridge between business strategy, data science, engineering, analytics, and technology delivery. The Technical Lead is responsible for translating business needs into scalable technical solutions, establishing sound architecture and engineering practices, coordinating delivery across teams, and ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, maintainable, and measurable.
The successful candidate combines strong technical depth with delivery leadership and stakeholder management. They can operate effectively in a complex, cross-functional environment while providing hands-on technical direction to engineering and analytics teams.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Lead technical design and delivery of targeting, recommendation, optimization, and measurement capabilities.

• Translate business and product requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation plans.

• Provide technical leadership across data pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and analytical/ML solutions.

• Guide engineering teams on architecture, coding standards, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and operational readiness.

• Partner with data scientists to productionize and scale machine learning and recommendation models.

• Identify technical risks, dependencies, performance bottlenecks, and scalability concerns.

• Lead technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex production issues.

• Ensure appropriate data quality, governance, privacy, security, and reliability practices.

• Drive engineering best practices, automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.

• Mentor engineers and influence technical decisions across teams.

• Partner with stakeholders across functional areas and develop comprehensive stakeholder communication plans. Effectively manages relationships to act as a trusted advisor, proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives, and navigates intricate stakeholder environments by resolving conflicts to ensure alignment.

• Independently leads the analysis of moderate to complex delivery problems, driving root cause analysis and eliciting complex stakeholder needs.
Qualifications
Technical Skills

• Minimum 5-7 years of professional experience in data management and Analytics

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

• Strong experience in software engineering, data engineering, or enterprise technology delivery.

• Experience as a Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, Architect, or similar senior technical role.

• Strong hands on exposure to AWS Analytics services particularly Lambda, Step functions, EMR, Athena, Glue, Data-Pipelines

• Strong knowledge of CS fundamentals, system design, REST APIs, databases, data engineering, distributed systems, and cloud architecture.

• Experience with SQL, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, and large-scale data processing.

• Experience with modern engineering practices including Git, automated tes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Das Team
Im modernen Labor der Gruppe erwarten Dich 11 KollegenInnen, welche im engen Austausch untereinander und weiteren Qualitätskontrolle-Gruppen arbeiten. Zur Seite stehen Dir Laborassistenten, die als „rechte Hand“ des Gruppenleiters den Laborbetrieb planen und Fragen rund um die Analytik beantworten können. Über die Gruppen hinaus sind wir mit den Schnittstellen Musterziehung, Planung und Produktion eng vernetzt. Es erwartet Dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es Dir leichtmachen wird, Fuß zu fassen. Wir haben eine gute Mischung aus langjährig erfahrenen und jungen Mitarbeitern. Die gute und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit im Team ist ein wichtiger Baustein unseres Erfolges.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du führst Analytik von Einsatzstoffen und Kits mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich der zell-basierten Methoden (FACS etc.) aber auch im Bereich der Immunologie und Molekularbiologie (MagNA Pure, Cobas, MGPs etc.) selbständig durch

• Du wertest Analytik-Ergebnisse selbständig aus und dokumentierst diese gemäß DIN ISO / GMP bzw. geltenden Arbeitsanweisungen

• Du erkennst, dokumentierst und bearbeitest Abweichungen

• Du führst eigenständig Testmessungen im Rahmen von Validierungen sowie Optimierungen analytischer Testmethoden durch

• Anfallende Zusatzaufgaben sowie Spezialanalysen erledigst Du nach Einweisung durch Deinen Vorgesetzten selbstständig
Die Bereitschaft zum Einsatz in einem biologischen Sonderlabor und dort der Umgang mit infektiösem Material ist für die Position erwünscht.

Dein Profil
Für diese Position bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Dipl., Master, Bachelor) im Bereich Biologie, Biochemie bzw. einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Alternativ bringst du eine naturwissenschaftliche Ausbildung (idealerweise in Biologie) mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung und einer Weiterbildung zum Techniker mit.

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrungen in der zell-basierten und molekularbiologischen Analytik

• Labor-Erfahrungen im Arbeiten nach GMP oder im Bereich Qualitätskontrolle sind von Vorteil

• Du beherrschst die gängigen EDV-Anwendungen (z.B. MS-Office, Google Tools, SAP)

• Mit Deinem Teamgeist und Deiner Einsatzbereitschaft treibst Du Themen voran und hast einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Erreichung der Ziele des Teams. Du bist ein wahrer Teamplayer, auch in Belastungssituationen behältst Du den Überblick und vergisst dabei den Spaß an der Arbeit nicht.

• Selbständiges Arbeiten, Koordination, Sorgfalt und Zuverlässigkeit gehören zu Deinen persönlichen Stärken. Du bist engagiert und flexibel, sehr strukturiert, offen für Neues und bereit Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Diese Position ist befristet auf 24 Monate.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.
Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions hi

Zur Seite stehen Dir Laborassistenten, die als „rechte Hand“ des Gruppenleiters den Laborbetrieb planen und Fragen rund um die Analytik beantworten können. Über die Gruppen hinaus sind wir mit den Schnittstellen Musterziehung, Planung und Produktion eng vernetzt. Es erwartet Dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es Dir leichtmachen wird, Fuß zu fassen. Wir haben eine gute Mischung aus langjährig erfahrenen und jungen Mitarbeitern. Die gute und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit im Team ist ein wichtiger Baustein unseres Erfolges.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du führst Analytik von Einsatzstoffen und Kits mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich der zell-basierten Methoden (FACS etc.) aber auch im Bereich der Immunologie und Molekularbiologie (MagNA Pure, Cobas, MGPs etc.) selbständig durch

• Du wertest Analytik-Ergebnisse selbständig aus und dokumentierst diese gemäß DIN ISO / GMP bzw. geltenden Arbeitsanweisungen

• Du erkennst, dokumentierst und bearbeitest Abweichungen

• Du führst eigenständig Testmessungen im Rahmen von Validierungen sowie Optimierungen analytischer Testmethoden durch

• Anfallende Zusatzaufgaben sowie Spezialanalysen erledigst Du nach Einweisung durch Deinen Vorgesetzten selbstständig
Die Bereitschaft zum Einsatz in einem biologischen Sonderlabor und dort der Umgang mit infektiösem Material ist für die Position erwünscht.

Dein Profil
Für diese Position bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Dipl., Master, Bachelor) im Bereich Biologie, Biochemie bzw. einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Alternativ bringst du eine naturwissenschaftliche Ausbildung (idealerweise in Biologie) mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung und einer Weiterbildung zum Techniker mit.

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrungen in der zell-basierten und molekularbiologischen Analytik

• Labor-Erfahrungen im Arbeiten nach GMP oder im Bereich Qualitätskontrolle sind von Vorteil

• Du beherrschst die gängigen EDV-Anwendungen (z.B. MS-Office, Google Tools, SAP)

• Mit Deinem Teamgeist und Deiner Einsatzbereitschaft treibst Du Themen voran und hast einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Erreichung der Ziele des Teams. Du bist ein wahrer Teamplayer, auch in Belastungssituationen behältst Du den Überblick und vergisst dabei den Spaß an der Arbeit nicht.

• Selbständiges Arbeiten, Koordination, Sorgfalt und Zuverlässigkeit gehören zu Deinen persönlichen Stärken. Du bist engagiert und flexibel, sehr strukturiert, offen für Neues und bereit Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Diese Position ist befristet auf 24 Monate.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.
Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

jobs.title: Customer Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
La posición de Customer Lead, garantiza una ejecución contractual exitosa y la retención a largo plazo de los clientes mediante una gestión integral de cuentas que combine la excelencia operativa con una visión estratégica. Actuando como un punto de contacto confiable, este rol impulsa la satisfacción del cliente a través de una comunicación transparente, respuestas ágiles a necesidades operativas y la identificación proactiva de oportunidades de crecimiento para la organización.

Responsabilidades

• Gestión comercial y cumplimiento de ventas: Garantiza el cumplimiento de las metas de ventas y la gestión integral de sus cuentas asignadas, identificando oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo sostenible.

• Gestión y ejecución contractual: Supervisa el cumplimiento de los contratos en todas sus etapas (entregas, instalaciones, facturación y cierre documental) para asegurar una ejecución fluida y la gestión oportuna de pagos.

• Orquestación y movilización interna: Articula a los equipos multidisciplinarios (Logística, Supply Chain , Soporte Técnico, Servicio y Squads ) para responder oportunamente a los compromisos contractuales del cliente.

• Coordinación operativa y de equipamiento: Asegura la correcta instalación, disponibilidad y funcionamiento de los equipos de diagnóstico en las instalaciones de los clientes.

• Control de inventarios y valor analítico: Monitorea los niveles de inventario, consumo y rotación de productos en el cliente, generando alertas preventivas y alimentando al equipo comercial con insights para nuevos negocios.

• Atención al cliente e indicadores de servicio: Actúa como primer punto de contacto operativo para la gestión de incidencias, quejas y reclamos, monitoreando indicadores de servicio (SLA y satisfacción) para impulsar la mejora continua y mantener actualizada la información en Rexis.

• Cumplimiento normativo e integridad: Promueve y asegura el cumplimiento estricto del Código de Conducta de Roche, las políticas corporativas locales y los estándares de Seguridad, Salud y Medio Ambiente (SHE).

Quién eres

• Título universitario de tercer nivel en Administración, Ingeniería, Ciencias de la Salud o carreras afines, con un nivel de inglés intermedio.

• De 2 a 3 años de experiencia en servicio al cliente corporativo, gestión de contratos, operaciones o atención posventa en el sector salud, diagnóstico (IVD) o industrias similares.

• Experiencia comprobada en coordinación de proyectos operativos y soporte contractual, así como en procesos logísticos, gestión de inventarios e instalación de equipos de laboratorio.

• Manejo de atención a clientes, resolución de incidencias, procesos de reclamos y evaluación de potential risk incidents (PRI) para asegurar la fidelización del cliente.

• Dominio de herramientas de gestión de proyectos (Gantt), sistemas CRM (ej. Salesforce), herramientas de gestión documental, Excel avanzado/Google Suite y comprensión básica del mercado de IVD.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Data Scientist - ML Engineering , you will join the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in San José, Costa Rica . In this role, you will own the end-to-end path from machine learning models to scalable, reliable production systems supporting global Roche affiliates. Operating across the full MLOps and software engineering stack, you will architect cloud-native ML pipelines, build automated testing and CI/CD frameworks, instrument model observability, and set high software craftsmanship standards across the engineering team.

The Opportunity

• ML Systems & Platform Engineering: Architect, deploy, and maintain end-to-end production ML services, training pipelines, containerization, and orchestration (Airflow/Dagster) with strict SLAs for performance and cost.

• MLOps Capability Building: Design reusable MLOps platform components including feature stores, model registries, experiment tracking, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.

• Model Accuracy & Observability: Build automated back-testing frameworks and instrumentation for tracking data/concept drift, feature anomalies, and model performance decay, translating diagnostic findings into root-cause fixes.

• Cloud & Pipeline Automation: Implement cloud-native ML infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP, systematically automating manual tasks and maintaining data synchronization contracts.

• Technical Leadership & Coaching: Establish engineering standards through code reviews, refactoring research code, and mentoring data scientists on production-grade software practices.

• Stakeholder Support: Partner with global affiliate teams to explain predictive model outputs, address business needs, and incorporate feedback into technical roadmaps.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a quantitative discipline.

• 7+ years of relevant experience running and maintaining machine learning systems in production environments.

• Deep proficiency in Python, Linux/Bash, SQL, modern pipeline tools (Spark, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks), and clean API design.

• Hands-on expertise with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), MLOps tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases), orchestration (Airflow), and CI/CD automation.

• Proven experience in cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and core ML frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, time-series forecasting).

• Strong analytical mindset focused on quality control, data contracts, and system observability (experience with LLMOps, streaming/Kafka, or GPU workloads is a plus).

• Must be currently based in Costa Rica or hold valid work authorization for San José.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Clinician Selling Specialist , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en impulsar la adopción de nuestros biomarcadores y soluciones innovadoras dentro de las comunidades clínicas. Construirás relaciones sólidas con líderes de opinión clave (KOLs), investigadores y proveedores de atención médica para avanzar en nuestra misión de mejorar los resultados de los pacientes a través de la medicina personalizada y una mejor gestión de enfermedades crónicas.
En este rol, serás la persona de referencia para aspectos clínicos y técnicos en el área de Leon/Asturias/Galicia . Serás responsable de promover nuestras soluciones con un enfoque técnico-científico, adaptando las estrategias globales a la realidad local de la Atención Primaria y los centros especializados, asegurando que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a los pacientes adecuados en el momento adecuado.

Tus Responsabilidades Clave

• Ventas Estratégicas y Promoción Técnica: Promover productos y servicios con mensajes científicos diferenciadores. Negociarás con centros de salud y hospitales, proporcionando explicaciones técnicas de alto nivel centradas en el tratamiento y la gestión del paciente.

• Enfoque en Atención Primaria y Diabetes: Serás un socio clave para los proveedores de Atención Primaria, especialmente en el contexto de la Diabetes , promoviendo las ventas con un enfoque orientado al tratamiento e identificando nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro de las cuentas existentes.

• Participación de las Partes Interesadas: Identificar y cultivar una red de defensores (KOLs, Líderes Clínicos, Directores Médicos). Adaptarás los planes de ventas para satisfacer sus necesidades y comunicarás las implicaciones de las licitaciones públicas al Gerente de Zona.

• Formación Clínica: Educar al personal de enfermería y a los profesionales de la salud tanto en hospitales como en centros de Atención Primaria sobre el uso del producto, coordinando la participación de las enfermeras en los protocolos de atención al paciente.

• Experiencia Científica: Actuar como el experto local, presentando las soluciones de Roche en foros regionales y simposios. Te mantendrás actualizado sobre las regulaciones IVDR y los algoritmos de gestión de pacientes.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Recopilar y compartir información sobre tendencias del mercado y competencia. Implementarás campañas de marketing y colaborarás con los Gerentes de Producto en actividades promocionales locales (congresos, talleres, etc.).

• Inversión y ROI: Proponer e implementar inversiones en tu territorio basadas en un retorno (ROI) definido y asegurar que se cumplan todos los compromisos con el cliente.

• Movilidad: Este puesto requiere una alta presencia en campo, con viajes esperados dentro del área designada 70+% del tiempo.

Quién Eres

Buscamos un perfil científico con una fuerte enfoque comercial y experiencia en el ecosistema sanitario local.

• Educación: Se necesita Licenciatura. Se valorará altamente la Licenciatura en Ciencias.

• Experiencia: 3 a 5 años de experiencia en la industria de ciencias de la vida. Es esencial una experiencia probada en Atención Primaria.

• Experiencia en la Materia: Se valora profundamente el conocimiento o la experiencia en Diabetes.

• Construcción de Relaciones: Gran capacidad para construir y mantener relaciones con profesionales de la salud a todos los niveles.

• Idiomas: Se valora mucho la fluidez en español ; un dominio sólido del inglés es obligatorio para la colaboración global.

• Ubicación: Debes tener tu base

• Ventas Estratégicas y Promoción Técnica: Promover productos y servicios con mensajes científicos diferenciadores. Negociarás con centros de salud y hospitales, proporcionando explicaciones técnicas de alto nivel centradas en el tratamiento y la gestión del paciente.

• Enfoque en Atención Primaria y Diabetes: Serás un socio clave para los proveedores de Atención Primaria, especialmente en el contexto de la Diabetes , promoviendo las ventas con un enfoque orientado al tratamiento e identificando nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro de las cuentas existentes.

• Participación de las Partes Interesadas: Identificar y cultivar una red de defensores (KOLs, Líderes Clínicos, Directores Médicos). Adaptarás los planes de ventas para satisfacer sus necesidades y comunicarás las implicaciones de las licitaciones públicas al Gerente de Zona.

• Formación Clínica: Educar al personal de enfermería y a los profesionales de la salud tanto en hospitales como en centros de Atención Primaria sobre el uso del producto, coordinando la participación de las enfermeras en los protocolos de atención al paciente.

• Experiencia Científica: Actuar como el experto local, presentando las soluciones de Roche en foros regionales y simposios. Te mantendrás actualizado sobre las regulaciones IVDR y los algoritmos de gestión de pacientes.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Recopilar y compartir información sobre tendencias del mercado y competencia. Implementarás campañas de marketing y colaborarás con los Gerentes de Producto en actividades promocionales locales (congresos, talleres, etc.).

• Inversión y ROI: Proponer e implementar inversiones en tu territorio basadas en un retorno (ROI) definido y asegurar que se cumplan todos los compromisos con el cliente.

• Movilidad: Este puesto requiere una alta presencia en campo, con viajes esperados dentro del área designada 70+% del tiempo.

Quién Eres

Buscamos un perfil científico con una fuerte enfoque comercial y experiencia en el ecosistema sanitario local.

• Educación: Se necesita Licenciatura. Se valorará altamente la Licenciatura en Ciencias.

• Experiencia: 3 a 5 años de experiencia en la industria de ciencias de la vida. Es esencial una experiencia probada en Atención Primaria.

• Experiencia en la Materia: Se valora profundamente el conocimiento o la experiencia en Diabetes.

• Construcción de Relaciones: Gran capacidad para construir y mantener relaciones con profesionales de la salud a todos los niveles.

• Idiomas: Se valora mucho la fluidez en español ; un dominio sólido del inglés es obligatorio para la colaboración global.

• Ubicación: Debes tener tu base

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission
As the GPC Service Performance Lead, you will contribute that Global Patient Care (GPC) business objectives are achieved efficiently by leading a high-performing team of GPC Service Performance Specialists and managing the performance of GPC’s workforce. In this critical management role, you will design and implement staffing and performance models to meet operational demands while aligning performance management with strategic business objectives across an omnichannel environment.
This role involves overseeing detailed volume forecasting, performance planning, and monitoring trends to maximize efficiency and effectiveness across GPC’s global operations.
You will lead a team responsible for designing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) across all supported channels, validating performance data, and identifying early patterns. You will ensure the GPC Leadership Team is proactively informed when course correction is required, managing the balance between accurately forecast volumes and the desired service levels to ensure a consistent customer experience.

Key Accountabilities

• Develop and implement service performance strategies to meet global operational and efficiency goals.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of GPC Service Performance Specialists, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

• Oversee strategic forecasting processes, ensuring accurate volume and capacity planning across all channels.

• Design, maintain, and validate global KPI frameworks to drive improvement and ensure data-driven decision-making.

• Analyze service performance data to identify trends, proactively providing the GPC Leadership Team with insights for operational course correction.

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders to provide channel forecasts and validate partner outcomes align with Roche performance standards (KPIs).

• Strategic Reporting Liaison: Liaise with global reporting teams to drive close collaboration, ensuring that validated, high-quality data is consistently available for GPC Leaders.

• Data Integrity & Governance: Lead the review and validation of reporting outputs to guarantee the highest level of accuracy and integrity across all operational performance metrics.

• Monitor productivity metrics and global performance to identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization.

• Proactive participation in or management of projects to develop infrastructure and administration processes within the performance area.

• Cultivate an inspiring and inclusive team environment that promotes diversity, cross-functional collaboration, and overcomes the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on selecting and retaining top talent while maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance evaluations, compensation reviews, and succession planning.

• Ensure team adherence to all P&C and compliance policies, fostering a culture of integrity and accountability.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting and a multi-channel contact center.

• 3-5 years specialization and in-depth knowledge of Service Performance, Forecasting, and Operational Analytics.

A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Missione
Con il GPC Service Performance Lead, contribuirai al raggiungimento efficiente degli obiettivi aziendali Global Paziente Care (GPC) con un team altamente performante di GPC Service Performance Specialists e alla gestione delle prestazioni della forza lavoro di GPC. In questo ruolo di gestione critica, progetta e implementa modelli di personale e prestazioni per soddisfare le esigenze operative, allineando la gestione delle prestazioni con obiettivi strategici di business in un ambiente omnicanale.
Questo ruolo consiste nel supervisionare le previsioni dettagliate dei volumi, la pianificazione delle prestazioni e le tendenze di monitoraggio per massimizzare l’efficienza e l’efficacia delle operazioni globali di GPC.
Potrai guidare un team responsabile per la progettazione e il monitoraggio degli indicatori chiave di performance (KPI) in tutti i canali supportati, la convalida dei dati sulle prestazioni e l'identificazione dei modelli iniziali. Garantirai che il Team di Leadership GPC sia proattivamente informato quando è richiesta la correzione del corso, gestendo l'equilibrio tra volumi di previsione e livelli di servizio desiderati per garantire una costante esperienza del cliente.

Capacità di contabilità chiave

• Sviluppare e implementare strategie di prestazione dei servizi per soddisfare gli obiettivi operativi ed efficienza globali.

• Guidare e sviluppare un team altamente performante di GPC Service Performance Specialists, promuovendo una cultura di eccellenza e responsabilità.

• Superare i processi di previsione strategica, garantendo una pianificazione accurata del volume e della capacità in tutti i canali.

• Progettare, mantenere e convalidare i framework KPI globali per migliorare e garantire il processo decisionale basato sui dati.

• Analizzare i dati sulle prestazioni del servizio per identificare le tendenze, fornendo in modo proattivo al team di Leadership GPC informazioni per la correzione dei corsi operativi.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per fornire previsioni sui canali e convalidare i risultati dei partner in linea con gli standard di prestazioni Roche (KPI).

• Strategic Reporting Liaison: Liaise con i team di reporting globali per guidare una stretta collaborazione, assicurando che i dati convalidati e di alta qualità siano costantemente disponibili per i Leader GPC.

• Integrità e governance dei dati: guidare la revisione e la convalida dei risultati di report per garantire il più alto livello di accuratezza e integrità in tutte le metriche di performance operative.

• Monitorare le metriche di produttività e le prestazioni globali per identificare e implementare opportunità di miglioramento continuo e ottimizzazione dei processi.

• Partecipazione attiva o gestione dei progetti per sviluppare i processi infrastrutturali e amministrativi nell'area delle prestazioni.

• Coltivare un ambiente di team stimolante e inclusivo che promuove la diversità, la collaborazione interfunzionale e supera le sfide di un setup multi-location.

• Guidare il processo di acquisizione e assunzione di talenti, concentrandosi sulla selezione e il mantenimento dei migliori talenti mantenendo un ambiente di lavoro positivo.

• Fornisci feedback proattivo e coaching ai membri del team, gestione delle valutazioni delle prestazioni, recensioni di compensazione e pianificazione di successione.

• Assicurare l'adesione del team a tutte le politiche di P&C e di conformità, favorendo una cultura di integrità e responsabilità.

Le competenze chiave e l'esperienza

• Corso di laurea o equivalente esperienza professionale.

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Mission
Als GPC Service Performance Lead tragen Sie dazu bei, dass die Geschäftsziele der Global Patient Care (GPC) effizient erreicht werden, indem Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team von GPC Service Performance Specialists leiten und die Leistung der Mitarbeiter von GPC verwalten. In dieser kritischen Führungsrolle entwerfen und implementieren Sie Personal- und Leistungsmodelle, um die operativen Anforderungen zu erfüllen und das Leistungsmanagement an strategischen Geschäftszielen in einer Omnichannel-Umgebung auszurichten.
Diese Rolle umfasst die Überwachung detaillierter Volumenprognosen, die Leistungsplanung und die Überwachung von Trends, um die Effizienz und Effektivität in den globalen Aktivitäten von GPC zu maximieren.
Sie leiten ein Team, das für die Entwicklung und Überwachung von Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) über alle unterstützten Kanäle hinweg verantwortlich ist, Leistungsdaten validiert und frühe Muster identifiziert. • Analysieren Sie Service-Performance-Daten, um Trends zu identifizieren, und geben Sie dem GPC-Führungsteam proaktiv Einblicke für die Korrektur des operativen Kurses.

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, um Kanalprognosen zu erstellen und die Partnerergebnisse nach Roche-Leistungsstandards (KPIs) zu validieren.

• Strategische Berichterstattung: Verbindung mit globalen Berichtsteams, um eine enge Zusammenarbeit zu fördern und sicherzustellen, dass validierte, qualitativ hochwertige Daten für GPC-Führungskräfte konsistent verfügbar sind.

• Überwachen Sie Produktivitätskennzahlen und globale Leistung, um Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Prozessoptimierung zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.
