Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Mission
En tant que responsable du rendement des services de GPC, vous contribuerez à la réalisation efficace des objectifs opérationnels de Global Patient Care (GPC) en dirigeant une équipe hautement performante de spécialistes du rendement des services de GPC et en gérant le rendement de l'effectif de GPC. Dans ce rôle de gestion essentiel, vous concevrez et mettre en oeuvre des modèles de dotation et de rendement pour répondre aux exigences opérationnelles tout en harmonisant la gestion du rendement avec les objectifs opérationnels stratégiques dans un environnement omnicanal.
Ce rôle consiste à superviser les prévisions détaillées du volume, la planification du rendement et les tendances de suivi afin d'optimiser l'efficience et l'efficacité des opérations mondiales de GPC.
Vous dirigerez une équipe chargée de concevoir et de surveiller les indicateurs de rendement clés (ICP) sur tous les canaux pris en charge, de valider les données de rendement et d'identifier les modèles précoces. Vous veillerez à ce que l'équipe de leadership de GPC soit informée de façon proactive lorsque la correction des cours est nécessaire, en gérant l'équilibre entre les volumes de prévisions exactes et les niveaux de service souhaités pour assurer une expérience client cohérente.

Principales responsabilités

• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de rendement des services pour atteindre les objectifs opérationnels et d'efficience mondiaux.

• Diriger et mettre sur pied une équipe de spécialistes de la performance des services de GPC, en favorisant une culture d'excellence et de responsabilisation.

• Superviser les processus de prévision stratégique, en assurant une planification précise du volume et des capacités dans tous les canaux.

• Concevoir, maintenir et valider des cadres mondiaux d'ICK pour favoriser l'amélioration et assurer la prise de décisions fondées sur les données.

• Analyser les données sur le rendement du service afin d'identifier les tendances et de fournir de façon proactive à l'équipe de leadership du CPG des conseils pour la correction des cours opérationnels.

• Établir des partenariats avec les intervenants internes et externes afin de fournir des prévisions sur les canaux et de valider les résultats des partenaires en conformité avec les normes de rendement de Roche.

• Liaison en matière de rapports stratégiques : Assurer la liaison avec les équipes mondiales de rapports afin de favoriser une collaboration étroite, en veillant à ce que des données validées et de haute qualité soient constamment disponibles pour les dirigeants de GPC.

• Intégrité et gouvernance des données : Diriger l'examen et la validation des extrants des rapports afin de garantir le plus haut niveau d'exactitude et d'intégrité pour toutes les mesures du rendement opérationnel.

• Surveiller les paramètres de productivité et les performances mondiales pour identifier et mettre en œuvre les possibilités d'amélioration continue et d'optimisation des processus.

• Participation ou gestion proactive de projets visant à développer des processus d'infrastructure et d'administration dans le domaine du rendement.

• Cultiver un environnement d'équipe inspirant et inclusif qui favorise la diversité, la collaboration interfonctionnelle et qui surmonte les défis d'une installation multilocalisée.

• Diriger le processus d'acquisition et d'embauche des talents, en mettant l'accent sur la sélection et le maintien des meilleurs talents tout en maintenant un milieu de travail positif.

• Fournir une rétroaction proactive et un encadrement aux membres de l'équipe, gérer les évaluations du rendement, les examens de la rémunération et la planification de la relève.

• Assurer le respect par l'équipe de toutes les politiques de P&C et de conformité, en favorisant une culture d'intégrité et de responsabilité.

Compétences et expérience clés

• Baccalauréat ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

• Expérience de leadership éprouvée, de préférence dans un cadre international et un centre de contact multicanaux.

• 3-5 ans de spécialisation et de connaissance approfondie de la performance des services, des prévisions et de l'analyse opérationnelle.

• Compétence méthodologique et compétences analytiques fortes avec une affinité pour des données complexes et

jobs.title: Scrum Master - Freelancer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

We are looking for a Scrum Master who shares our passion for Agile product development and is able to drive it forward, supporting up to two teams in an Agile Release Train (ART). You’ll be working on a chronic care solution, enabling teams to deliver value that really impacts patient care.

We don’t just practice Agile on paper. We constantly reflect, learn, and improve how we work, with the goal of enabling high-performing, focused, and sustainable teams.

You will act as a delivery and team-effectiveness coach, helping teams deliver value, stay focused, improve flow, and collaborate better across the ART.

What you’ll do

• Help teams deliver value by keeping a clear focus on Sprint Goals, the Team Backlog, and ART priorities.

• Facilitate decision-making, remove blockers, and make risks and impediments visible, helping the team resolve them early.

jobs.title: Produktionsangestellter Fermentation (m/w/d, befristet)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist Teil des globalen Produktionsnetzwerks der Diagnostics Division von Roche und als solcher der wichtigste Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen für diagnostische Tests. Wir produzieren monoklonale Antikörper, Antigene, Enzyme und Nukleinsäuren aus Säugerzellkulturen und Mikroorganismen in einem Fermentationsmaßstab von 0,1 – 2.000 L. Die daraus aufgereinigten Produkte werden in vielfältigen diagnostischen Tests, z. B. für den Nachweis von Infektionskrankheiten eingesetzt.

Verantwortlichkeiten
Wir sind als Team besonders stolz auf die gute Mischung aus langjährig erfahrenen und jungen Mitarbeitern, die gerade ihre Ausbildung abgeschlossen haben. Als Upstream-Produktionsbetrieb arbeiten wir mit einer großen Vielfalt an tierischen Zellen, Mikroorganismen und Viren der Risikogruppen 1 und 2 in mehreren Produktionsstätten.
● Du fermentierst tierische Zellen oder Mikroorganismen im Maßstab 0,1 – 2.000 L
● Du kultivierst adhärente Zellen zur Produktion von Viren bzw. viraler Komponenten
● Du führst die prozessbegleitende Analytik mit verschiedenen enzymatischen und molekularbiologischen Methoden durch und dokumentierst gewissenhaft
● Du führst erste Aufreinigungsschritte der Zielproteine und Nukleinsäuren durch
● Du beteiligst dich an der Durchführung von Desinfektions- und Hygienemaßnahmen
● Die Auswertung von Fermentationsansätzen und Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Herstellvorschriften zählt ebenfalls zu deinen
• Aufgaben
● Bei unserer technologischen Vielfalt wird dir nie langweilig – Fermentation in Edelstahl oder Single Use, Dialyse- oder Fed-Batch-Prozess, Cross-Flow-Filtration oder diverse Zentrifugationstechniken
● Darüber hinaus kannst du bei der Verbesserung unseres Technologie-Standards im Produktionsbetrieb mitwirken

Qualifikationen / Das bringst du mit
● Du bringst eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Biologielaborant,
Chemielaborant, Chemikant, BTA, CTA (m/w/d) oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss mit
● Du hast Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Säugerzellen oder mit Mikroorganismen,
Steriltechnik und Fermentationstechnologie
● Erfahrung im Betrieb von biotechnologischen Produktionsanlagen ist von Vorteil
● Du hast Interesse und Verständnis für technische Prozesse und Anlagen
● Du bist bereit zum zeitweiligen Einsatz in versetzten Arbeitszeiten (Früh- und
Mittelschicht) sowie für gelegentliche Wochenendarbeit und Rufbereitschaften. Bei der Planung ist uns deine Gesundheit wichtig und wir achten ebenso auf faire Zulagen
● Flexibilisierung erlaubt es uns, auf schwankende Bedarfe zügig reagieren zu können. Du bist bereit, dein Können und Wissen bedarfsgerecht auch über die Betriebsgrenzen hinweg einzusetzen
● Auch körperliche Herausforderungen machen dir Freude. Diese Tätigkeit erfordert das Heben und Bewegen von Lasten bis zu 25 kg mehrmals wöchentlich.

Diese Position ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Bitte lade hierfür einfach nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch.
Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir keine weiteren Dokumente, wie Motivationsschreiben, Anschreiben oder Ähnliches.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner- Neurology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner- Neurology
Location: All Locations

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are

• You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Neurology

• You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Operations Associate
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Driving sustainable impact
Our responsibility extends beyond innovation. You'll contribute to solutions that improve healthcare by addressing the most pressing health challenges and diseases with the highest social burden, while reducing our impact on the planet. Together, we create a healthier workplace, society, and future for generations to come.

The Opportunity
The Digital Marketing Operations Associate provides executional support for digital marketing activities through a centralized service delivery model in support of affiliate and business needs. Working as part of a hub-based operations team, this role is responsible for completing defined tasks across campaign execution, content support, email, marketing automation, SEO support, social media support, paid media support, sales enablement support, and reporting activities using approved strategies, templates, standards, and processes.

Responsibilities

• Execute assigned digital marketing activities through a centralized operations model in support of affiliate and business requests.

• Support day-to-day campaign execution activities, including setup, updates, coordination, and maintenance of campaign elements in accordance with defined requirements.

• Perform routine website, SEO, social media, paid media support, marketing automation, sales enablement support, and reporting-related tasks as assigned and according to documented processes.

• Assist with marketing automation and campaign workflow tasks, including list handling, journey support, form setup support, and related production activities as applicable.

• Perform quality assurance checks to confirm deliverables are accurate, complete, and aligned with instructions, templates, and governance requirements before release or handoff.

• Support reporting activities by compiling performance inputs, updating templates, preparing recurring reports, and maintaining reporting records.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Digital, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in digital marketing support, campaign execution, shared services, operations, content production, or a related execution-focused environment is preferred.

• Basic familiarity with digital marketing channels and workflows, including campaign execution, content updates, email, social media, reporting, or related operational activities.

• Basic familiarity with digital marketing platforms, content systems, CRM, marketing automation, collaboration tools, or reporting tools is an advantage.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Esta posición se enfoca en la importancia de traer lo externo hacia adentro, trabajando con socios para descubrir todo el potencial de oportunidades para transformar los resultados para los pacientes, más rápido. También aportan de adentro hacia afuera para llevar la experiencia, ciencia y conocimiento de Roche al ecosistema.Actúa como un socio de confianza y es el principal (pero no exclusivo) punto de contacto entre los stakeholders y Roche. Comparte las necesidades de los pacientes y la comunidad de stakeholders internamente, prioriza y asegura recursos y aporta soluciones para entregar resultados más rápido.

Esta posición está ubicada en Cali, Colombia. La persona debe vivir en esta ubicación.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Mapeo, diagnóstico y análisis de la ruta de atención del área terapéutica y su red en los ecosistemas y los SH claves que intervienen éste proceso de atención (pre-diagnóstico, diagnóstico, tratamiento y adherencia) analizando los dolores para generar estrategias individualizadas con un impacto positivo para todos los actores del ecosistema

• Construye con su par HSP y con la network, soluciones alineadas a las necesidades evidenciadas en los ecosistemas y a la ambición de las áreas terapéuticas, con foco en HCP tomadores de decisión y/o influenciadores que intervienen la ruta del paciente, siendo reconocidos como los socios y referentes en el manejo de la enfermedad, ciencia y producto

• Diseño, planeación, registro en las plataformas requeridas, ejecución, asi como la evaluación del impacto y percepción de las actividades/eventos promocionales y no promocionales del área terapéutica a su carg

• Co- crear con las IPS y los SH Modelos de valor clínicos y financieros que busquen impactar los indicadores en salud

• Mediante un plan robusto de engagement, el PJP eleva el conocimiento y posiciona el valor de la innovacion para el manejo de la enfermedad

• Analiza el mercado del área terapéutica, incluyendo los competidores, con el fin de generar estrategias para los ecosistemas alineadas al entorno

• Captar, analizar y registrar toda la informacion de valor de sus interacciones en el ecosistema digital (EpiCx)

Tu perfil:

La persona en esta posición demuestra un propósito personal para mejorar el viaje del paciente, así como una fuerte pasión para generar valor e impacto en el ecosistema. Piensan a nivel empresarial, más allá de límites y fronteras, para lograr los mejores resultados posibles para el ámbito de salud local y más ampliamente, a todo Roche a nivel global. Posee habilidades de autogestión, demuestra integridad y mentalidad de habilitador aprovechando las redes internas y externas para crear valor, compartir y escalar.

• Título universitario en áreas de la salud o similares. Título avanzado en áreas de administración, gestión, MBA es un diferencial.

• Experiencia relevante en el desarrollo y o participación en proyectos de impacto en salud en ecosistemas de aseguramiento y/o prestación

• Experiencia en participación y desarrollo de modelos de gestión clínica y modelos de valor en salud, experiencia en negociaciones y participacion en equipos de alto desempeño

• Comocimiento Intermedio - Avanzado del idioma Inglés

• Habilidad para entender y apalancar herramientas digitales..

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Technical Technology (PTT) within Pharma Technical Operations (PT) is dedicated to enhancing industrialization and product management. This is achieved through the integration of Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) standards, maintenance excellence, performance optimization, and the establishment of scalable processes to improve overall robustness, efficiency, and reliability across the organization.

The global Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) function manages commercial products, spearheads the adoption of new technologies, drives standardization efforts, and ensures risk mitigation.

The Opportunity

The organization is structured into specialized teams focusing on Large Molecule Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP), and Small Molecule operations. This particular role, the Global MSAT DS Senior Process Steward, operates within the Large Molecule DS team and is crucial for connecting global MSAT expertise with manufacturing sites worldwide.

• Support Product Technical Leads and Product Stewards to ensure process industrialization, coordinate and execute process gap assessments, integrate identified risks into the risk log, and develop mitigation strategies.

• Drive systematic process and continuous technical product health and supply improvements based on insights, including second source and change strategies.

• Execute validated state support activities and respond to evolving conditions to ensure compliance (e.g., VICs, RCAs).

• Provide technical expertise for technical and engineering runs and hands-on second-level support for investigations, CAPAs, and troubleshooting in partnership with the internal and external manufacturing network; lead non-product specific RCAs and investigations.

• Leverage the pilot plant team for real-life and scaled experimentation to support process-related projects, including validation studies and process transfer to manufacturing sites.

• Ensure the implementation of network initiatives that are aligned and prioritized with manufacturing site plans, and incorporate portfolio-wide impacting aspects like direct material changes and Health Authority requirements.

• Collaborate closely with global and site functions, leadership, and other gMSAT and PTT teams. Serve as a digital enabler, translating business needs to digital strategy and digital product development teams and driving technical sustainability improvements for product, process, and technology.

Who You Are

• B.S. or M.S. degree in Chemical, Biochemical Engineering, or a related discipline with 7+ years of relevant industrial experience in process development, process engineering, or manufacturing operations; a PhD is advantageous.

• Experience in collaborative, matrix team leadership and decision-making.

• Demonstrated experience in process engineering, technical process development, process validation, or technology transfer (E. coli & CHO processes). Deep expertise in E. coli systems is strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with pharmaceutical quality systems, industry guidelines, regulatory submission, health authority requirements, and platform-specific technology, processes, and equipment.

• Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to define and articulate team deliverables effectively, including towards senior leadership, and a willingness to travel less than 10% as required.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

Who we are

jobs.title: (Senior) Android App Developer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe that every patient deserves the best possible care, supported by innovative science and technology. We are looking for a senior individual contributor to take significant technical ownership of components within our One Diagnostics Platform.

In this role, you won't just build apps; you will design and develop the reusable Android components, frameworks, and libraries that power multiple medical diagnostics ecosystems. Your work will directly impact the reliability, security, and scale of software used globally in life-saving medical environments.

Your responsibilities

• Design, develop and maintain shared Android applications, components, libraries and frameworks using Kotlin and Java.

• Develop clear, stable and well-documented APIs according to the Roche quality processes and regulatory requirements.

• Drive modular Android architecture and establish patterns that support scalability, maintainability and reuse.

• Ensure backward compatibility and manage the lifecycle, versioning and migration of shared components.

• Collaborate with project teams to understand common needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.

• Review technical designs and code, identify architectural risks and promote consistent engineering practices.

• Plan and perform software unit verification tests depending on the role as developer or development tester of a specific component from the One diagnostics Platform

• Develop robust automated tests, including unit, integration and UI tests where appropriate.

• Investigate complex technical issues affecting multiple applications and provide sustainable solutions rather than isolated fixes.

• Contribute to secure software design, protection of sensitive data and appropriate handling of application permissions according to regulatory guidelines.

• Create and maintain the technical documentation and development evidence required in a regulated medical environment.

• Work closely with product owners, system architects, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity and verification teams.

• Raise the Bar: Mentor other engineers through constructive code reviews, design discussions, and championing modern engineering practices.

Who You Are
You combine strong hands-on Android expertise with a systems-thinking mindset. You enjoy solving problems once and making the solution useful for many teams. You care about clear interfaces, maintainable code, reliable tests, and thorough documentation within a quality-driven, compliant environment.

• High proficiency in Kotlin and strong experience in Java .

• Extensive background in building Android applications, shared software components, system-level architecture, and Gradle build systems.

• Practical experience using AI-assisted tools within software development workflows.

• Proven track record designing modular architectures, managing APIs, and using versioning/dependency tools within highly regulated or safety-critical sectors (e.g., Medical Devices/MedTech, Automotive, Aviation, Defense, Railway).

• Strong grasp of the Android SDK, application lifecycles, memory management, clean architecture, and dependency injection.

• Solid experience with unit and integration test automation and pipeline integration (Azure DevOps/GitHub).

• Professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

• You are capable of traveling 5% to 10% of your time to different locations mainly within Europe.

Beneficial Qualifications:

• Familiarity with healthcare/Med

The Position
At Roche, we believe that every patient deserves the best possible care, supported by innovative science and technology. We are looking for a senior individual contributor to take significant technical ownership of components within our One Diagnostics Platform.

In this role, you won't just build apps; you will design and develop the reusable Android components, frameworks, and libraries that power multiple medical diagnostics ecosystems. Your work will directly impact the reliability, security, and scale of software used globally in life-saving medical environments.

Your responsibilities

• Design, develop and maintain shared Android applications, components, libraries and frameworks using Kotlin and Java.

• Develop clear, stable and well-documented APIs according to the Roche quality processes and regulatory requirements.

• Drive modular Android architecture and establish patterns that support scalability, maintainability and reuse.

• Ensure backward compatibility and manage the lifecycle, versioning and migration of shared components.

• Collaborate with project teams to understand common needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.

• Review technical designs and code, identify architectural risks and promote consistent engineering practices.

• Plan and perform software unit verification tests depending on the role as developer or development tester of a specific component from the One diagnostics Platform

• Develop robust automated tests, including unit, integration and UI tests where appropriate.

• Investigate complex technical issues affecting multiple applications and provide sustainable solutions rather than isolated fixes.

• Contribute to secure software design, protection of sensitive data and appropriate handling of application permissions according to regulatory guidelines.

• Create and maintain the technical documentation and development evidence required in a regulated medical environment.

• Work closely with product owners, system architects, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity and verification teams.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Role: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Hyderabad / Chennai
Years of Experience: 6+ years

A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That's what makes us Roche.

Mission
Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics- and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. GATE enables data-led decision-making and innovation across healthcare and biotech operations

You will work closely with the U.S. Strategic Customer Support Consulting team dedicated to Roche's most important diagnostic customers — large reference laboratories, hospital networks, and integrated health systems. The team's mandate is to help these customers run more resilient, efficient, and cost-effective supply chain operations.

Your Opportunity
As the Senior Data Scientist in this team, you will own the forecasting, optimization, and machine learning work that underpins our customer engagements. You will inherit and evolve an existing production forecasting engine, harden it for scale across accounts, and extend it into a broader supply chain optimization framework. You will also provide recommendations and strategic support on other various customer supply chain initiatives, related to forecasting, optimization and machine learning.

This is a hybrid technical–consultative role. Roughly half your impact will come from the depth and rigor of the models you build; the other half will come from your ability to sit across the table from a senior customer stakeholder, understand their operational reality, and convert a model output into a decision they act on.

Experience in Gen AI, LLM, NLP, and ML Ops will be considered an added advantage, supporting Roche's future-ready analytics and AI roadmap.

How You'll Work
You will be part of a wider data and analytics community at Roche, and your best work will happen in partnership with it. You will collaborate closely with our product and visualization teams to make sure the models you build reach business and customer teams as clear, usable views — translating forecasts, inventory recommendations, and risk signals into the reports and interfaces people actually work from. You must operate well with ambiguity and changing priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as the data science lead on strategic consulting engagements for Roche's top diagnostic customers, partnering with consultants and account teams from problem framing through to delivered impact

• Engage directly with business consultants — primarily through virtual forums, to scope problems, test hypotheses, and align on success measures

• Translate customer supply chain pain points — stockouts, over-ordering, bottlenecks, working capital lock-up, erratic consumption, expiry and wastage — into well-posed modelling problems, and then into deployed, usable solutions

• Deliver consumption forecasting and replenishment recommendations at the customer account level, helping customers order the right quantity at the right time, and helping Roche plan against real downstream demand

• Work internally with other technology teams to ensure solutions built can be used throughout the transition to ASPIRE and other similar system changes (i.e. Agility/ARID migration to Snowflake, Google to Microsoft)

•

titleByLocale.en: Senior Data Scientist - Generative AI & Agentic Systems
titleByLocale.it: Senior Data Scientist - Generative AI & Agentic Systems
titleByLocale.de: Senior Data Scientist - Generative AI & Agentic Systems
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Data Scientist - Generative AI & Agentic Systems

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Data Scientist - Generative AI , you will join the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in San José, Costa Rica . In this hands-on, high-impact role, you will design and deploy cutting-edge agentic capabilities and enterprise Generative AI applications. Moving seamlessly across the full product stack—from problem framing and data retrieval to multi-agent flow design, API development, and LLMOps evaluation—you will serve as a subject matter expert driving state-of-the-art AI architectures into production.

The Opportunity
• Agentic Application Design: Architect end-to-end multi-agent applications, retrieval layer solutions, and foundational AI capabilities, taking ideas from prototype to production deployment.

• Advanced RAG & Retrieval: Build and optimize advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, incorporating vector/graph databases, reranking algorithms, chunking strategies, and hybrid retrieval.

• Production-Grade Engineering: Write clean, tested Python code, manage APIs, enforce version control, and set up CI/CD pipelines for Generative AI systems.

• LLMOps & System Observability: Implement evaluation harnesses, prompt/version management, cost/latency optimization, and token economics monitoring for production agents.

• Strategic AI Consulting: Influence technical priorities across global enterprise stakeholders, evaluating when to deploy GenAI versus classical ML or deterministic engineering methods.

• Mentorship & Collaboration: Coach team members on agentic flow design and partner with Product Owners to align technical execution with user experience strategy.

Who You Are
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related quantitative field.

• 7+ years of professional experience, with demonstrated hands-on expertise building enterprise Generative AI products and agentic workflows.

• Deep technical mastery of LLMs, vector databases, graph databases, reranking algorithms, and Agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AWS AgentCore).

• Proven track record in RAG architecture design, chunking optimization, and retrieval quality evaluation.

jobs.title: Global Study Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Global Study Lead is responsible for ensuring that all studies are designed, planned, executed, monitored, closed out and documented in an appropriate manner within the planned timeframe and cost; ensuring that the sponsor responsibilities are fulfilled, while assuring compliance to all applicable regulatory requirements. Responsible for the timeline and budget planning and execution of studies. Assigns and ensures delivery of specific tasks to/from other members of the study team. Provides oversight to outside support including CROs, consultants and/or medical advisors

The Opportunity:
The key accountabilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

• Leads the global study team with full accountability for the study deliverables with respect to quality, budget and timelines, in collaboration with the Study Team and ensures the development of high quality study designs for sponsored studies in collaboration with internal and external experts

• In collaboration with Program Leadership, prepares different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g. study, real-world evidence) in cross-functional collaboration (e.g. with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, CDMA Project Teams) to support global strategies and planning of timeline and costs

• Develops key study documents (i.e., Design Validation Plan, protocol, study training materials, study forms and templates, study report)

• Oversees planning and operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by Pharma partners

• Accountable for study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Adherence to regulations, guidelines and standard operating procedures, and ensures audit/inspection readiness.

• Execution of sponsored studies for assigned areas of focus for registrational and/or non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up. conduct and close-out). Oversees study activities outsourced to a service provider (i.e., CRO).

• Oversees planning and operational aspects of Investigator Initiated Studies and Research Collaboration Studies

• Ensure that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• Oversees projects to ensure completion on-time, within scope and budget; and tracks project performance to analyze the completion of short and long term goals.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders, key internal and external stakeholders and other alliance partners, including CROs, in meeting business goals and ensuring operational excellence.

Who you are:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or related field

• You have 7+ years of experience managing the full lifecycle of sponsored studies, ensuring projects meet performance goals within scope, quality, budget, and timeline.

• You have extensive experience in ensuring that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• You have in-depth knowledge and experience in the role of Clinical Operations in product development and are aware of Roche’s place in the market and our value proposition to patients and customers.

• You have clinical trial management knowledge and experience in the oversight and conduct of clinical trials within the patholo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. As a global healthcare leader operating in over 100 countries, we combine the strengths of our Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions to drive the future of personalized healthcare. We thrive on innovation, scientific excellence, and a shared commitment to delivering sustainable, high-quality medical solutions.
As part of our ambitious 10-year Pharma vision, we are dedicated to delivering more benefits to patients by integrating innovative technology and systems into our lifecycle management processes. By joining Roche, you will be part of a dynamic, diverse, and inspiring environment where your work has a direct, meaningful impact on patients worldwide.

The Learning Design, Development & Operations Lead serves as the operational engine and design authority of the global Pharma Technical (PT) Learning Hub. Positioned at the intersection of instructional innovation and operational excellence, this role holds end-to-end accountability for translating business capability needs into modern, high-impact learning solutions—and ensuring those solutions are delivered seamlessly across the global manufacturing network.

You will lead a dual-pillar team comprising Design & Development Experts (focused on solution design, Learning 4.0 methodologies, and competency frameworks) and Learning Operations Specialists (focused on intake triage, program execution, digital asset management, and operational reporting). By establishing rigorous standards for instructional quality, operational throughput, and content lifecycle management, you ensure that PT moves away from passive "Read & Understand" compliance habits toward scalable, performance-driving Competency-Based Learning (CBL).

The Opportunity

• Provide strategic direction, line management, and coaching across two distinct functional areas: Learning Architecture/Design and Learning Operations.

• Build and maintain the global intake triage, prioritization, and resource allocation model to effectively balance incoming business demand with team bandwidth.

• Establish, track, and optimize operational Service Level Agreements (SLAs), turnaround times, and quality standards across all publishing and program delivery pipelines.

• Serve as the design authority setting standards for modern adult learning methodologies, including Competency-Based Learning (CBL), micro-credentials, experiential on-the-job training (OJT), and performance support.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
We are seeking a Principal Business Systems Analyst to help design, define, and scale technology solutions supporting commercial organizations across the US and global affiliates. You will operate at the intersection of business, product, data, and engineering, translating complex and ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements and scalable solutions. You will partner with product managers, software engineers, data engineers, architects, data scientists, and commercial stakeholders across enterprise applications, data platforms, cloud services, analytics, APIs, and AI/GenAI capabilities. Hands-on software development is not required, but strong technical fluency is essential.
Description of the area
360 Insights Engineering builds and evolves commercial technology, data, analytics, and AI capabilities used across the US and global affiliates. The team partners across markets to identify where capabilities should be globally standardized versus locally configurable, while accounting for differences in processes, data, regulations, and operating models.
Job Responsibilities

• Partner with business and product leaders to understand complex commercial problems, lead discovery, challenge assumptions, and translate needs into clear functional and technical requirements.

• Define user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, data requirements, system behaviors, and traceability from business objectives through implementation and validation.

• Decompose large, ambiguous initiatives into well-defined capabilities and engineering-ready requirements while proactively identifying scope, dependencies, edge cases, data issues, and operational risks.

• Serve as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, participating confidently in discussions on system architecture, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, data pipelines, integrations, authentication/authorization, and AI services.

• Partner with architects and engineers to evaluate solution approaches, technical constraints, dependencies, and trade-offs, and review designs to ensure solutions satisfy business requirements and can scale across markets.

• Use SQL to investigate data, validate assumptions, troubleshoot issues, and support requirements definition, including relational models, joins, aggregations, data quality, and upstream/downstream dependencies.

• Translate analytical and reporting needs into clear data definitions, metrics, business rules, and transformations, partnering with data engineering and analytics teams on models, pipelines, reporting, and commercial analytics capabilities.

• Partner with product, engineering, and data science teams to identify AI/GenAI opportunities, translate them into measurable workflows, requirements, guardrails, and acceptance criteria, and ensure they solve real business problems.

• Apply working knowledge of LLMs, prompting, RAG, agents, model limitations, evaluation, and enterprise AI integration patterns when shaping AI-enabled solutions.

• Support products serving the US, Canada, Brazil, and other global affiliates by coordinating requirements across markets and balancing global standardization with appropriate local configuration.

• Work effectively across distributed teams, functions, and time zones, driving alignment and clear decisions in complex, cross-functional environments.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Technical Business Analy

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
Stiamo cercando un Principal Business Systems Analyst per aiutare a progettare, definire e scalare le soluzioni tecnologiche che supportano le organizzazioni commerciali negli Stati Uniti e le affiliate globali. Potrai operare all'incrocio tra business, prodotto, dati e ingegneria, traducendo problemi aziendali complessi e ambigui in chiare esigenze tecniche e soluzioni scalabili. Potrai collaborare con product manager, ingegneri software, ingegneri di dati, architetti, scienziati di dati e stakeholder commerciali attraverso applicazioni aziendali, piattaforme di dati, servizi cloud, funzionalità di analisi, API e AI/GenAI. Lo sviluppo del software Hands-on non è richiesto, ma la forte fluidità tecnica è essenziale.
Descrizione della zona
360 Insights Engineering costruisce ed evolve le capacità di tecnologia commerciale, dati, analisi e intelligenza artificiale utilizzate negli Stati Uniti e nelle affiliate globali. I partner del team in tutti i mercati per identificare dove le funzionalità dovrebbero essere standardizzate a livello globale rispetto a configurabili localmente, pur tenendo conto delle differenze nei processi, nei dati, nelle normative e nei modelli operativi.
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Partner con i leader di business e prodotti per comprendere complessi problemi commerciali, la scoperta dei lead, le ipotesi di sfida e tradurre le esigenze in chiari requisiti funzionali e tecnici.

• Definire le storie degli utenti, i criteri di accettazione, le regole aziendali, i flussi di processo, i requisiti di dati, i comportamenti di sistema e la tracciabilità dagli obiettivi aziendali attraverso l'implementazione e la validazione.

• Decomporre grandi e ambigue iniziative in capacità ben definite e requisiti di ingegneria-ready mentre identificare proattivamente il campo di applicazione, le dipendenze, i casi di bordo, i problemi di dati e i rischi operativi.

• Servire come ponte principale tra stakeholder aziendali e team tecnici, partecipando con fiducia alle discussioni sull'architettura di sistema, API, database, piattaforme cloud, datadotti, integrazioni, autenticazione/autorizzazione e servizi AI.

• Partner con architetti e ingegneri per valutare approcci di soluzione, vincoli tecnici, dipendenze e trade-off, e rivedere i progetti per garantire soluzioni soddisfano i requisiti aziendali e possono scalare i mercati.

• Utilizzare SQL per indagare i dati, convalidare i presupposti, risolvere i problemi e la definizione dei requisiti di supporto, compresi i modelli relazionali, unisciti, aggregazioni, qualità dei dati e dipendenze upstream/downstream.

• Traduci esigenze analitiche e di reporting in chiare definizioni dei dati, metriche, regole aziendali e trasformazioni, collaborando con team di data engineering e analytics su modelli, pipeline, reporting e funzionalità di analisi commerciale.

• Partner con i team di prodotto, ingegneria e scienza dei dati per identificare le opportunità AI/GenAI, tradurli in flussi di lavoro misurabili, requisiti, guardrails e criteri di accettazione, e assicurarsi che risolvano problemi reali di business.

• Applicare la conoscenza di lavoro di LLM, sollecitazione, RAG, agenti, limitazioni del modello, valutazione e modelli di integrazione AI enterprise quando si modellano soluzioni AI-enabled.

• I prodotti di supporto che servono gli Stati Uniti, il Canada, il Brasile e altri affiliati globali coordinando i requisiti sui mercati e bilanciando la standardizzazione globale con una configurazione locale appropriata.

• Lavorare efficacemente attraverso team, funzioni e fusi orari distribuiti, allineamento di guida e decisioni chiare in ambienti complessi e interfunzionali.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Esperienza come analista dei sistemi aziendali, analisi tecnica

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenbeschreibung
Wir suchen einen Principal Business Systems Analysten, der bei der Entwicklung, Definition und Skalierung von Technologielösungen hilft, die kommerzielle Organisationen in den USA und globalen Tochtergesellschaften unterstützen. Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Business, Produkt, Daten und Engineering und übersetzen komplexe und mehrdeutige Geschäftsprobleme in klare technische Anforderungen und skalierbare Lösungen. Sie arbeiten mit Produktmanagern, Softwareingenieuren, Dateningenieuren, Architekten, Datenwissenschaftlern und kommerziellen Stakeholdern über Unternehmensanwendungen, Datenplattformen, Cloud-Services, Analysen, APIs und AI / GenAI-Funktionen zusammen. Hands-on-Softwareentwicklung ist nicht erforderlich, aber eine starke technische Flüssigkeit ist unerlässlich.
Beschreibung des Gebiets
360 Insights Engineering entwickelt und entwickelt kommerzielle Technologien, Daten, Analysen und KI-Funktionen, die in den USA und globalen Tochtergesellschaften eingesetzt werden. Das Team arbeitet marktübergreifend zusammen, um herauszufinden, wo Kapazitäten global standardisiert und lokal konfigurierbar sein sollten, während Unterschiede in Prozessen, Daten, Vorschriften und Betriebsmodellen berücksichtigt werden.
Aufgabenbereich

• Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmens- und Produktführern, um komplexe kommerzielle Probleme zu verstehen, Entdeckungen zu leiten, Annahmen in Frage zu stellen und Bedürfnisse in klare funktionale und technische Anforderungen umzusetzen.

• Definieren Sie User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, Geschäftsregeln, Prozessabläufe, Datenanforderungen, Systemverhalten und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Geschäftszielen durch Implementierung und Validierung.

• Zerlegen Sie große, mehrdeutige Initiativen in klar definierte Fähigkeiten und ingenieurfähige Anforderungen, während Sie Umfang, Abhängigkeiten, Edge Cases, Datenprobleme und Betriebsrisiken proaktiv identifizieren.

• Dienen Sie als primäre Brücke zwischen Geschäftsbeteiligten und technischen Teams und nehmen Sie selbstbewusst an Diskussionen über Systemarchitektur, APIs, Datenbanken, Cloud-Plattformen, Datenpipelines, Integrationen, Authentifizierung / Autorisierung und KI-Services teil.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Architekten und Ingenieuren, um Lösungsansätze, technische Einschränkungen, Abhängigkeiten und Kompromisse zu bewerten und Designs zu überprüfen, um sicherzustellen, dass Lösungen die Geschäftsanforderungen erfüllen und marktübergreifend skalieren können.

• Verwenden Sie SQL, um Daten zu untersuchen, Annahmen zu validieren, Probleme zu beheben und die Definition von Anforderungen zu unterstützen, einschließlich relationaler Modelle, Verknüpfungen, Aggregationen, Datenqualität und Upstream- / Downstream-Abhängigkeiten.

• Übersetzen Sie Analyse- und Berichtsanforderungen in klare Datendefinitionen, Metriken, Geschäftsregeln und Transformationen und arbeiten Sie mit Data Engineering- und Analyseteams in Bezug auf Modelle, Pipelines, Reporting und kommerzielle Analysefunktionen zusammen.

• Partnerschaft mit Produkt-, Engineering- und Data-Science-Teams, um KI / GenAI-Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, sie in messbare Workflows, Anforderungen, Leitplanken und Akzeptanzkriterien zu übersetzen und sicherzustellen, dass sie echte Geschäftsprobleme lösen.

• Wenden Sie Kenntnisse über LLMs, Aufforderungen, RAG, Agenten, Modellbeschränkungen, Bewertung und Integrationsmuster für Unternehmens-KI an, wenn Sie KI-fähige Lösungen entwickeln.

• Unterstützen Sie Produkte für die USA, Kanada, Brasilien und andere globale Tochtergesellschaften, indem Sie Anforderungen über Märkte hinweg koordinieren und die globale Standardisierung mit einer angemessenen lokalen Konfiguration ausbalancieren.

• Arbeite effektiv über verteilte Teams, Funktionen und Zeitzonen hinweg und treibe die Ausrichtung und klare Entscheidungen in komplexen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebungen.

Qualifikationen
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Erfahrung als Business Systems Analyst, Technical Business Analy

Description de l'emploi

Description de la zone
360 Insights Engineering construit et développe des capacités de technologie commerciale, de données, d'analyse et d'IA utilisées à travers les États-Unis et les filiales mondiales. L'équipe s'associe à tous les marchés pour déterminer où les capacités devraient être normalisées à l'échelle mondiale par rapport aux capacités localement configurables, tout en tenant compte des différences dans les processus, les données, les règlements et les modèles d'exploitation.
Responsabilités professionnelles

• Établir des partenariats avec les chefs de file des entreprises et des produits afin de comprendre les problèmes commerciaux complexes, de découvrir le plomb, de contester les hypothèses et de traduire les besoins en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques claires.

• Définir des histoires d'utilisateurs, des critères d'acceptation, des règles d'entreprise, des flux de processus, des exigences en matière de données, des comportements du système et de la traçabilité à partir des objectifs opérationnels par la mise en œuvre et la validation.

• Décomposer les grandes initiatives ambiguës dans des capacités bien définies et des exigences prêtes à l'ingénierie tout en identifiant de façon proactive la portée, les dépendances, les cas de pointe, les problèmes de données et les risques opérationnels.

• Servir de pont principal entre les intervenants commerciaux et les équipes techniques, participer avec confiance aux discussions sur l'architecture du système, les API, les bases de données, les plateformes cloud, les pipelines de données, les intégrations, l'authentification/autorisation et les services d'IA.

• Établir des partenariats avec des architectes et des ingénieurs pour évaluer les approches de solutions, les contraintes techniques, les dépendances et les compromis, et examiner les conceptions afin de s'assurer que les solutions répondent aux exigences des entreprises et peuvent s'étendre sur tous les marchés.

• Utilisez SQL pour étudier les données, valider les hypothèses, résoudre les problèmes et définir les exigences de support, y compris les modèles relationnels, les jointures, les regroupements, la qualité des données et les dépendances en amont et en aval.

• Traduire les besoins en matière d'analyse et de rapports en définitions claires de données, en mesures, en règles d'affaires et en transformations, en partenariat avec les équipes d'ingénierie et d'analyse des données sur les modèles, les pipelines, les rapports et les capacités d'analyse commerciale.

• Partenaire avec des équipes de produits, d'ingénierie et de sciences des données pour identifier les possibilités d'IA/GenAI, les traduire en flux de travail mesurables, exigences, garde-corps et critères d'acceptation, et s'assurer qu'ils résolvent de vrais problèmes commerciaux.

• Appliquer les connaissances de travail sur les LLM, l'incitation, le RAG, les agents, les limites du modèle, l'évaluation et les modèles d'intégration de l'IA d'entreprise lors de l'élaboration de solutions compatibles avec l'IA.

• Appuyer les produits destinés aux États-Unis, au Canada, au Brésil et à d'autres filiales mondiales en coordonnant les exigences à l'échelle des marchés et en conciliant la normalisation mondiale avec la configuration locale appropriée.

• Travailler efficacement dans les équipes, les fonctions et les fuseaux horaires répartis, conduire l'alignement et des décisions claires dans des environnements complexes et interfonctionnels.

Compétences
Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience en tant qu'analyste de systèmes d'affaires, Analyse technique des affaires

jobs.title: PT Learning Business Partnering Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming healthcare and changing patients lives. As a global leader in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, we focus on driving scientific excellence and delivering innovative solutions that address some of the world’s most complex medical challenges. We believe that doing now what patients need next requires a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment where every individual is empowered to contribute to our shared purpose. Quality is at the heart of everything we do, ensuring that our life-saving treatments meet the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and compliance across the globe.

The Opportunity

Critical senior leadership role in the Pharma Technical (PT) Global Learning Hub, responsible for driving network-wide adoption of Learning solutions based on business needs. Also responsible for PT wide, strategic learning topics, like the transition from our legacy based Read & Understand approach to Competency Based Learning. This position has the direct leadership and operational execution of the PT Learning Business Partners (LBPs) and Learning Experience Architects, and directly partners with the most senior leaders across PT on strategic learning topics.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, aligning long-term organizational capability strategies directly with core business objectives.

• Orchestrate and prioritize global capability needs gathered across diverse manufacturing sites into a unified enterprise delivery pipeline.

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of learning partners and experience architects, fostering expertise in consultative stakeholder management and performance analytics.

• Establish and lead a global Community of Practice to drive knowledge sharing, standardize consulting playbooks, and scale successful capability solutions enterprise-wide.

• Drive the adoption of modern adult learning methodologies—such as Competency-Based Learning, performance support, and experiential training—moving away from legacy text-heavy materials.

• Collaborate closely with Quality and Operations leaders to reframe capability development as a direct driver of operational performance and excellence.

Who You Are

• You possess a Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree in Education, Organizational Psychology, or Human Capital Management preferred) alongside 10-12 + years of progressive leadership experience in strategic capability development or organizational learning.

• You bring extensive domain expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing, technical operations, quality systems, and regulatory standards.

• You hold a proven track record of leading large-scale learning transformations, replacing passive compliance training with modern, performance-centered solutions.

• You excel at root-cause analysis, seamlessly diagnosing performance gaps to differentiate between true learning needs and operational process adjustments.

• You demonstrate exceptional executive presence and consultative skills, with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead matrixed, global teams.

**The role is not eligible for relocation**

We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

jobs.title: Global Clinical Operations Excellence Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche/Genentech Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), we are determined to transform drug development and realize our Pharma Ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2029.

As a Global Clinical Operations Excellence Leader in PDG, you will be pivotal in driving portfolio-wide improvements and boosting clinical trial delivery productivity. This role involves fostering innovative trial execution, tackling critical needs, and collaborating with key stakeholders across PDQ, pRED, gRED, USM, and PDMA. You will lead and shape initiatives to implement new operational models with both internal and external partners, ultimately impacting clinical trial delivery.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the development and execution of program-level strategies in Clinical Finance ensuring alignment with patient and trial needs.

• Provide strategic leadership and subject matter expertise to embed learning, process, and system excellence across PDG while advancing initiatives that accelerate delivery of enterprise-wide priorities.

• Develop and implement strategies for Clinical Operations Excellence initiatives that support our business objectives.

• Oversee the execution and governance of initiatives within global PDG Clinical Operations and with external stakeholders relating to clinical trial Finance including Budgets, Contracts, FMV and Investigator/Site Payments.

• Leads the development and implementation of program-wide clinical finance strategies and standards in collaboration with program leadership. This involves overseeing process management, ensuring compliance, monitoring performance, and streamlining vendor decisions and oversight.

• Provide subject matter expertise on a range of strategic activities to support the execution of our clinical trial infrastructure across different regions.

• Identify and drive continuous improvement and change management activities to solve complex problems and embed change within the organization.

• Participate in or lead vendor identification and build strong relationships to ensure the successful execution of clinical trials and/or enabling projects

Who You Are:

• You bring a bachelors level education with at least 7+ years' of experience in the clinical space.

• Strong working knowledge of clinical trials and drug development, or related expertise.

• Proficient understanding and application of ICH, GCP, and other regulatory guidelines.

• Ability to anticipate and influence the external environment to shape the clinical trial landscape for long-term success.

• Familiarity with other business functions and an understanding of how your decisions impact other parts of the organization.

Relocation is not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936.00 and 179,728.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. À faire progresser continuellement la science et à veiller à ce que chacun(e) ait accès aux soins de santé dont il ou elle a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous et toutes plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. En associant nos forces uniques en diagnostic, médicaments et technologies numériques, nous relevons les défis de santé les plus complexes pour aider chacun-e à vivre plus longtemps et en meilleure santé. Chez Roche, nous vous offrons un environnement stable et tourné vers l'avenir où vous pouvez être vous-même, développer vos compétences grâce à un leadership qui libère votre potentiel, et évoluer au sein d'une culture de diversité et d'appartenance qui stimule l'innovation.

L'opportunité

En tant qu'expert(e) du service client, vous développerez de solides relations de confiance fondées sur votre compréhension de vos comptes et votre capacité à offrir une expérience d'approvisionnement positive. En identifiant de manière proactive les besoins des clients et des clientes et en initiant des références aux membres de l'équipe appropriés, vous contribuerez à améliorer et à personnaliser l'expérience client globale offerte dans l'organisation. Vos solides compétences en leadership et en influence vous permettront de remettre en question le statu quo et de rechercher l'efficacité en proposant des recommandations pour fournir un service fiable et cohérent.

• Gérer les solutions de lots réservés pour l'ensemble de la clientèle à travers le Canada conformément aux politiques et procédures de Roche, tout en collaborant étroitement avec l'équipe de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour garantir l'exactitude des données et assurer un flux de commande efficace.

• Assurer l'analyse et la communication directe avec les clients et clientes pour leurs besoins de lots réservés, et transmettre leurs exigences à l'équipe de planification.

• Gérer tous les comptes de spécialités nécessitant une attention particulière et comportant des exceptions logistiques, tout en maintenant et gérant les « Commandes automatiques » pour tous nos comptes et territoires afin de garantir un niveau élevé de précision.

• Traiter les appels, fournir une assistance, comprendre les plaintes en matière de logistique et apporter des solutions satisfaisantes.

• Collaborer avec les brigades régionales sur les comptes clés afin d'offrir une expérience d'approvisionnement incomparable.

• Identifier et proposer des améliorations ou optimisations des processus manuels et des tâches sans valeur ajoutée du service client.

• Effectuer les ajustements de factures (crédits/débits), gérer les demandes de retour, analyser les rapports quotidiens et communiquer proactivement les retards ou changements de délais aux clients et clientes.

Qui vous êtes

• Titulaire d'un diplôme d'études collégiales ou d'un baccalauréat en administration, en commerce ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Baccalauréat en administration, en commerce ou dans un domaine connexe avec plus de 1 an d'expérience pertinente en service à la clientèle, OU diplôme d'études collégiales (DEC) technique avec plus de 3 ans d'expérience pertinente.

• Possédez de solides compétences en communication en français et en anglais.

• Faites preuve de compétences supérieures en matière d'organisation, de gestion du multitâche et de résolution de pr

jobs.title: Strategic Communications Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Strategic Communications team at Roche Canada Pharma offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a healthier future by driving the strategic development and execution of internal and external communications initiatives. By igniting a passion for Roche Canada among various audiences and sharing impactful stories, the Communications team plays a crucial role in enhancing the corporate reputation and ultimately improving outcomes for patients and healthcare systems.

The opportunity:

• Develop and manage engaging content for the web and social media channels, including LinkedIn, rochecanada.com, and our ‘Stories’ blog, applying social media best practices.

• Create tailored content for internal and external audiences on priority topics.

• Explore and implement new platforms to improve employee engagement and maintain strong writing skills.

• Independently develop and implement digital strategies, including dynamic presentations and digital tools like websites, G-sites, and podcasts.

• Contribute to employee engagement by planning and facilitating social events across the organization.

• Ensure sustainable and efficient implementation of processes and compliance frameworks.

Who you are:

• You are currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, English, graphic design or closely related fields.

• Demonstrate outstanding writing proficiency, bringing creativity and clarity to all forms of communication.

• You have experience or knowledge with news style story writing, social media and digital storytelling.

• You are familiar with Adobe Express or Adobe Creative Cloud.

Preferred :

• A passion for creative communication, whether through blog writing, social media creation, or digital storytelling.

• Technical savvy in video production and editing, helping us bring a fresh, visual perspective to our projects is a plus.

Additional Information:

• Duration: This position is a 6 to 12 month internship.

• Work term: Full-time (35 hours per week) and will begin in January 2027.

• Location: This internship position is located in Mississauga, ON.

• Our team follows a hybrid work structure (majority of time in the office).

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 57 416,00 and 75 358,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
