The Position
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

• Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 10% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside in Rochester, New York, or within a 40-mile radius of the area.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Requirements

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available with this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of New York is $74,600.00 - $138,600.00 USD Annual USD annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Job Summary : The Content Review Operations Coordinator is responsible for managing and executing the end-to-end medical, legal, and regulatory review processes for promotional or medical content within Genentech. This role ensures that content moves efficiently, compliantly, and transparently through the review cycle, supporting timely approvals and audit readiness. The role is critical to ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements while enabling speed to market for high-quality, approved content.

The Opportunity:

• Develop and execute Content Review Operations plans aligned with compliance and product standards, including planning inputs and resource allocation to optimize review processes.

• Lead and manage content review processes, including Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR), ensuring adherence to SOPs, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and Genentech policies.

• Manage material flow through review, including submission validation, agenda preparation, review meeting facilitation, follow-ups, timely decision-making, and issue resolution.

• Validate and steward content metadata and business rules to support modular content product standards and align with campaign or above-campaign business needs; provide resources and ongoing support on evolving content systems, processes, and standards.

• Identify and mitigate process gaps, risks, and compliance issues; escalate as needed, partner with content owners to ensure standards are followed, maintain audit trails and compliance documentation, and support experimentation to improve efficiency and operational outcomes.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 5 years in roles partnering with a variety of stakeholders and 3 years in professional roles focused on content/digital asset management, content or marketing operations, content review/approval, compliance, and/or governance.

• Experience using Veeva Vault PromoMats (VVPM) or similar tools as the primary system for content/digital asset management and review/approval, plus experience with Microsoft Office tools such as Excel, Teams, Word, SharePoint, and others.

• Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other highly regulated industries, with a strong understanding of marketing and medical content lifecycles, digital content strategies, and regulatory compliance in marketing.

• Proven ability to develop operational processes and leverage technology to improve efficiency and compliance, supported by excellent program management and advanced communication skills for collaboration with enterprise stakeholders across functions.

• Additional desired experience includes knowledge of creative development and print/distribution systems, in-depth understanding of brand ecosystems and agency operations, and an adaptive, agile mindset with commitment to continuous process improvement.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione di lavoro.

Riepilogo del lavoro: Il Coordinatore delle operazioni di revisione dei contenuti è responsabile della gestione e dell'esecuzione dei processi di revisione medica, legale e regolamentare per i contenuti promozionali o medici all'interno di Genentech. Questo ruolo assicura che il contenuto si muova in modo efficiente, conforme e trasparente attraverso il ciclo di revisione, supportando le approvazioni tempestive e la disponibilità di audit. Il ruolo è fondamentale per garantire il rispetto delle politiche interne e dei requisiti normativi esterni, consentendo al contempo la velocità di mercato per i contenuti approvati di alta qualità.

L'opportunità:

• Sviluppare ed eseguire i piani di Content Review Operations allineati alle norme di conformità e di prodotto, compresi gli input di pianificazione e l'allocazione delle risorse per ottimizzare i processi di revisione.

• Condurre e gestire i processi di revisione dei contenuti, tra cui Medical, Legal e Regulatory (MLR), assicurando l'adesione a SOP, standard di qualità, requisiti normativi e politiche Genentech.

• Gestisci il flusso materiale attraverso la revisione, tra cui la convalida della presentazione, la preparazione dell'ordine del giorno, la revisione facilitazione delle riunioni, follow-up, il processo decisionale tempestivo e la risoluzione dei problemi.

• Convalida e steward i metadati e le regole aziendali dei contenuti per supportare gli standard modulari dei prodotti dei contenuti e allineare alle esigenze aziendali della campagna o sopra-campagna; fornire risorse e supporto continuo su sistemi, processi e standard di contenuti in evoluzione.

• Identificare e mitigare le lacune di processo, i rischi e i problemi di conformità; escalate se necessario, partner con i proprietari di contenuti per garantire gli standard sono seguiti, mantenere i percorsi di audit e la documentazione di conformità, e sostenere la sperimentazione per migliorare l'efficienza e i risultati operativi.

Chi sei:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza equivalente, con 5 anni di ruoli che collaborano con una varietà di stakeholder e 3 anni di ruoli professionali focalizzati sulla gestione dei contenuti/digital asset, contenuti o operazioni di marketing, recensione/approvazione dei contenuti, conformità e/o governance.

• Esperienza utilizzando Veeva Vault PromoMats (VVPM) o strumenti simili come il sistema primario per la gestione dei contenuti/digital asset e recensione/approvazione, oltre all'esperienza con strumenti Microsoft Office come Excel, Teams, Word, SharePoint e altri.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Job Summary : The Content Review Operations Coordinator is responsible for managing and executing the end-to-end medical, legal, and regulatory review processes for promotional or medical content within Genentech. This role ensures that content moves efficiently, compliantly, and transparently through the review cycle, supporting timely approvals and audit readiness. The role is critical to ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements while enabling speed to market for high-quality, approved content.

The Opportunity:

• Develop and execute Content Review Operations plans aligned with compliance and product standards, including planning inputs and resource allocation to optimize review processes.

• Lead and manage content review processes, including Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR), ensuring adherence to SOPs, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and Genentech policies.

• Manage material flow through review, including submission validation, agenda preparation, review meeting facilitation, follow-ups, timely decision-making, and issue resolution.

• Validate and steward content metadata and business rules to support modular content product standards and align with campaign or above-campaign business needs; provide resources and ongoing support on evolving content systems, processes, and standards.

• Identify and mitigate process gaps, risks, and compliance issues; escalate as needed, partner with content owners to ensure standards are followed, maintain audit trails and compliance documentation, and support experimentation to improve efficiency and operational outcomes.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 5 years in roles partnering with a variety of stakeholders and 3 years in professional roles focused on content/digital asset management, content or marketing operations, content review/approval, compliance, and/or governance.

• Experience using Veeva Vault PromoMats (VVPM) or similar tools as the primary system for content/digital asset management and review/approval, plus experience with Microsoft Office tools such as Excel, Teams, Word, SharePoint, and others.

• Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other highly regulated industries, with a strong understanding of marketing and medical content lifecycles, digital content strategies, and regulatory compliance in marketing.

• Proven ability to develop operational processes and leverage technology to improve efficiency and compliance, supported by excellent program management and advanced communication skills for collaboration with enterprise stakeholders across functions.

• Additional desired experience includes knowledge of creative development and print/distribution systems, in-depth understanding of brand ecosystems and agency operations, and an adaptive, agile mindset with commitment to continuous process improvement.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.
#LI-DC1

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore n

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Umzugsleistungen sind für diese Stellenausschreibung nicht verfügbar.

Der Content Review Operations Coordinator ist für die Verwaltung und Durchführung der end-to-end medizinischen, rechtlichen und regulatorischen Überprüfungsprozesse für Werbe- oder medizinische Inhalte innerhalb von Genentech verantwortlich. Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass sich Inhalte effizient, konform und transparent durch den Überprüfungszyklus bewegen und zeitnahe Genehmigungen und Auditbereitschaft unterstützen. Diese Rolle ist von entscheidender Bedeutung, um die Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und externer regulatorischer Anforderungen sicherzustellen und gleichzeitig die Vermarktung von qualitativ hochwertigen, genehmigten Inhalten zu beschleunigen.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Entwickeln und Ausführen von Content Review Operations-Plänen, die auf Compliance- und Produktstandards ausgerichtet sind, einschließlich Planungseingaben und Ressourcenzuweisung zur Optimierung von Überprüfungsprozessen.

• Führen und verwalten Sie Prozesse zur Überprüfung von Inhalten, einschließlich Medical, Legal und Regulatory (MLR), um die Einhaltung von SOPs, Qualitätsstandards, regulatorischen Anforderungen und Genentech-Richtlinien sicherzustellen.

• Verwalten Sie den Materialfluss durch Überprüfung, einschließlich Einreichungsvalidierung, Agendavorbereitung, Erleichterung von Überprüfungssitzungen, Follow-ups, rechtzeitige Entscheidungsfindung und Problemlösung.

• Validieren und Verwalten von Inhaltsmetadaten und Geschäftsregeln, um modulare Inhaltsproduktstandards zu unterstützen und sich an den Anforderungen von Kampagnen oder über Kampagnen hinausgehenden Geschäftsanforderungen anzupassen; Bereitstellung von Ressourcen und fortlaufender Unterstützung bei sich entwickelnden Inhaltssystemen, -prozessen und -standards.

• Prozesslücken, Risiken und Compliance-Probleme identifizieren und mindern; bei Bedarf eskalieren, mit Content-Eigentümern zusammenarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass Standards eingehalten werden, Audit-Trails und Compliance-Dokumentation pflegen und Experimente unterstützen, um Effizienz und Betriebsergebnisse zu verbessern.

Wer du bist:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Erfahrung, mit 5 Jahren in Rollen, die mit einer Vielzahl von Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, und 3 Jahren in beruflichen Rollen, die sich auf Content / Digital Asset Management, Content- oder Marketing-Operationen, Content-Review / Genehmigung, Compliance und / oder Governance konzentrieren.

• Erfahrung mit Veeva Vault PromoMats (VVPM) oder ähnlichen Tools als primäres System für Content / Digital Asset Management und Überprüfung / Genehmigung sowie Erfahrung mit Microsoft Office-Tools wie Excel, Teams, Word, SharePoint und anderen.

• Erfahrung in den Bereichen Gesundheitswesen, Pharmazie, Biotech oder anderen stark regulierten Branchen mit einem starken Verständnis von Marketing- und medizinischen Inhaltslebenszyklen, Strategien für digitale Inhalte und der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften im Marketing.

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, operative Prozesse zu entwickeln und Technologie zur Verbesserung von Effizienz und Compliance zu nutzen, unterstützt durch exzellentes Programmmanagement und fortschrittliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmensbeteiligten in allen Funktionen.

• Zusätzliche gewünschte Erfahrung umfasst Kenntnisse der kreativen Entwicklung und Druck- / Vertriebssysteme, ein tiefes Verständnis der Markenökosysteme und Agenturbetrieb und eine adaptive, agile Denkweise mit Engagement für kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserung.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation.

Résumé de l'emploi : Le coordonnateur des opérations d'examen du contenu est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution des processus d'examen de bout en bout pour le contenu promotionnel ou médical au sein de Genentech. Ce rôle permet d'assurer que le contenu évolue de façon efficace, conforme et transparente tout au long du cycle d'examen, en appuyant les approbations en temps opportun et la préparation à la vérification. Le rôle est essentiel pour assurer le respect des politiques internes et des exigences réglementaires externes tout en permettant la commercialisation rapide de contenu approuvé de haute qualité.

La possibilité :

• Élaborer et exécuter des plans opérationnels d'examen du contenu conformes aux normes de conformité et de produit, y compris les intrants de planification et l'affectation des ressources pour optimiser les processus d'examen.

• Diriger et gérer les processus d'examen du contenu, y compris les processus médicaux, juridiques et réglementaires, en veillant au respect des SOP, des normes de qualité, des exigences réglementaires et des politiques de Genentech.

• Gérer la circulation du matériel par l'examen, y compris la validation des présentations, la préparation de l'ordre du jour, la facilitation des réunions d'examen, le suivi, la prise de décisions en temps opportun et la résolution des problèmes.

• Valider et gérer les métadonnées de contenu et les règles de fonctionnement pour appuyer les normes modulaires des produits de contenu et s'aligner sur les besoins opérationnels de la campagne ou au-dessus de la campagne; fournir des ressources et un soutien continu à l'évolution des systèmes, des processus et des normes de contenu.

• Déterminer et atténuer les lacunes, les risques et les problèmes de conformité des processus; augmenter au besoin, collaborer avec les propriétaires de contenu pour s'assurer que les normes sont respectées, maintenir les pistes de vérification et la documentation sur la conformité, et appuyer l'expérimentation pour améliorer l'efficacité et les résultats opérationnels.

Qui vous êtes :

• Baccalauréat ou expérience équivalente, avec 5 ans dans des rôles en partenariat avec une variété d'intervenants et 3 ans dans des rôles professionnels axés sur la gestion du contenu/des actifs numériques, le contenu ou les opérations de marketing, l'examen/l'approbation du contenu, la conformité et/ou la gouvernance.

• Expérience de l'utilisation de Veeva Vault PromoMats (VVPM) ou d'outils similaires comme le système principal pour la gestion du contenu/des actifs numériques et l'examen/l'approbation, ainsi que l'expérience des outils Microsoft Office tels qu'Excel, Teams, Word, SharePoint, et d'autres.

• Expérience dans les secteurs des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques, de la biotechnologie ou d'autres secteurs hautement réglementés, avec une bonne compréhension du marketing et du cycle de vie du contenu médical, des stratégies de contenu numérique et de la conformité réglementaire dans le marketing.

• Capacité éprouvée d'élaborer des processus opérationnels et de tirer parti de la technologie pour améliorer l'efficacité et la conformité, appuyée par une excellente gestion de programme et des compétences avancées en communication pour la collaboration avec les intervenants de l'entreprise dans toutes les fonctions.

• L'expérience supplémentaire souhaitée comprend la connaissance des systèmes de développement créatif et d'impression/distribution, une compréhension approfondie des écosystèmes de marque et des opérations des agences, et une attitude agile et adaptative, avec un engagement à l'amélioration continue des processus.

Veuillez noter que les curriculum vitae doivent être soumis en anglais, car notre panel d'entrevues peut inclure des participants de l'extérieur de votre pays local.
#LI-DC1

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

• Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 10% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside in Southern Connecticut, or within a 40-mile radius of the area.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Requirements

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available with this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Connecticut is $71,100.00 - $132,000.00 USD annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts

jobs.title: People Support Associate Specialist (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we named our entry point for all employees and managers the “People Portal” and the enabling team taking care of People & Culture (P&C) work is named “People Support Team”.

People Support Specialist combines the first point of contact for P&C-related enquiries and services for all Roche people (employees, candidates, contingents, retirees, managers, P&C colleagues, etc.) with the execution of Employee Lifecycle Management activities and tasks.

We are a team that works very closely together supporting a country or cluster of countries as part of a region. A high degree of flexibility and proactivity is expected. Being part of the People Support Team you are a member of the People Support Solutions organization. People Support Solutions turns decisions into action and provides employees, senior managers and other stakeholders (such as P&C colleagues and authorities) with all required P&C services – on time and to the agreed standard of quality. We also ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs and proactively develop solutions.

You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the People Support Solutions delivery through analysis of the interactions and collaboration with other P&C functions within and outside of People Support Solutions. You need a broad understanding across global P&C processes and tools, as well as local and global downstream impacts on payroll, time, benefits, finance, procurement, IT, etc. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills and solution orientation.

Responsibilities
Service Delivery

• Provide insight, support and explanation on P&C policies, HR system and administrative activities in support of HR business processes (in the area of recruiting, onboarding, employee movement/changes, terminations, compensation, performance, etc.).

• Deliver consistent and reliable service by use of all available channels (chat, ticketing system, phone calls)

• Execute system data maintenance and administrative activities in support of HR business processes (in the area of recruiting, onboarding, employee movement/changes, terminations, compensation, performance, etc.).

• Provide customer service on People & Culture related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting.

• Supports P&C Chapters with feedback of business usage of HR processes, pain points and knowledge gaps.

• Stay up to date on processes, own the knowledge development on processes, and contribute to the update of relevant documentations (SOPs/Work Instructions).

• Participate in project activities as required

• Embed customer care principles into daily activities

• Comply with data privacy rules and regulations

• Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.

• Align service delivery and quality with overarching objectives of the global People Support Solutions organization. Manage service quality expectations and address customer concerns

• Ensure operations according to defined KPIs and SLAs.

• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships and communications to partner in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Build relationships with HR colleagues within the People Support Solutions organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

• Collaborate with peers within the region and globally to ensure the People Support Solutions ne

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist - Phoenix, AZ
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 20%-30% travel. This person will support Phoenix, AZ (Ideal candidate to live in Phoenix, AZ )

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Arizona is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Enabling Team / Finance and Business Partnering team are driving an affiliate-wide transformation centered on the mission to deliver better outcomes for more patients faster. By fostering an agile environment built on trust, transparency, and customer-centricity, the team provides holistic enterprise guidance through expertise in Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Strategic Insights. As integral partners across the entire value chain, they embrace the roles of Visionary, Architect, Coach, and Catalyst (VACC) to inspire employees and steer key decisions. Ultimately, this joint accountability for new operational methods ensures the long-term sustainability and success of the affiliate as it pursues its North Star.

This role ,Finance Manager (FM), will report directly into the Area Heads/ General Manager while still working part of the Finance Community within the region, you will be a key leader in the affiliate transformation. You will be responsible for managing and overseeing the financial results, as well as the functions of procurement, supply chain, and facility services. Your leadership will be pivotal in translating strategic vision into operational and financial excellence.

The Opportunity

• Oversee the financial results of the affiliate, ensuring adherence to Roche Group Accounting (FGA), local accounting standards, tax, and customs.

• Proactively identify key challenges and opportunities and assess their impact, while stimulating an environment that encourages smart experimentation and rapid iterations.

• Drive a simple and fit-for-purpose business planning process that captures key strategic directions and formulates a local finance strategy balancing global/regional requirements with local imperatives.

• In collaboration with business leaders, define the strategic direction of the organization and contribute to long-term portfolio planning and resourcing strategy.

• Risk & Value Management: Navigate volatile macroeconomic environments to maintain P&L sustainability, mitigate financial risks, and identify emerging growth opportunities.

• Connects affiliate priorities with the regional and global ambition to ensure alignment with enterprise-wide priorities.

• Engage with business partners in crafting and executing value-enhancing decisions through business performance analysis (actuals vs. forecast) and generating meaningful market insights.

• Oversee the affiliate procurement process, focusing on value delivery for Roche while balancing costs, service quality, compliance, and strategic partnerships.

• Actively contributing beyond the affiliate and within the regional Finance Network. This includes Leading or contributing to regional and global work packages.

• Embody VACC (Visionary, Architect, Coach, and Catalyst) leadership principles, shaping and implementing the new ways of working for the team and championing a culture that is inclusive and embraces diversity.

Who You Are

• You have a minimum of 7 years of finance experience and (preferably) holds a professional Accounting qualification (CPA, CA, ACA, CIMA) or a University Degree/MBA.

• An experienced and highly creative leader of demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional and networked teams, with a proven track record of sound fiscal planning and management and ensuring financial governance.

• You possess outstanding business acumen and strategic agility, with a global strategic approach and the ability to contribute to the global Finance Community.

jobs.title: Commercial Contract Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The Opportunity: We are seeking a Commercial Contract Analyst to join our Roche Service Solution (RSS) team in San Jose, Costa Rica. This is a unique opportunity to directly support Genentech’s US-based Channel & Contract Management (CCM) division by managing the complex lifecycle of contract operations and delivering on commitments to managed care customers. As a member of the Contract Strategy Implementation (CSI) team, you will manage end-to-end contract operations for various US customers, including healthcare providers, pharmacies, wholesalers, payers, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), and government accounts. This involves a broad range of responsibilities—from assessing the operational feasibility of contracting strategies and setting up contracts to managing memberships, administering customer payments, and processing chargebacks.

The Opportunity:

• Collaborate regularly with business partners, cross-functional stakeholders, and customers through meetings, initiatives, and strategic projects, bringing strong customer orientation, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Provide key insights and recommendations during the development of contracting, pricing, and distribution strategies, representing the department on strategy, account core, and product launch teams.

• Translate contract terms into operational solutions that fulfill access and financial obligations, assess the operational feasibility of proposed strategies, and develop solutions aligned with strategic objectives.

• Draft, evaluate, and refine contract language as needed; set up and maintain detailed contract information in systems; research and validate customer information for program or pricing eligibility.

• Use systems and tools to calculate, validate, and process customer payments; communicate contract/program details to internal and external stakeholders; develop training on contracting, distribution, obligations, procedures, systems, rebates/discounts, and eligibility; and establish performance metrics and ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and Genentech policies.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years’ experience in commercial functions within pharmaceutical/biotechnology, managed care, or related industries; preferred 4–6 years in managed care and/or government contract operations, contract administration, or financial analysis in pharma/biotech or related industries.

• Proven ability to work in complex, customer-focused environments with tight and frequent deadlines, demonstrating excellent organization, attention to detail, strategic thinking, analytical capability, and solutions-driven problem solving.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to build cross-team partnerships, influence stakeholders effectively in writing and verbally, work with remote US-based stakeholders, and demonstrate curiosity, active listening, openness, inclusion, and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Solid expertise with Microsoft applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and Google Suite, with knowledge of systems and reporting tools that support contract operations preferred.

• Familiarity with US healthcare contracting is preferred, including managed care, the healthcare industry, and government programs such as 340B, FSS, Medicare, and Medicaid.

• Preferred additional experience includes project management and related techniques, plus designing/creat

Stellenbeschreibung

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are:
At Roche, we strive to improve patients' lives through ethical and scientifically rigorous work. We believe good business leads to a better world and work every day to make medical innovations accessible to all.
The Diagnostics Partnering organisation is responsible for managing Roche Diagnostics' partnerships on a global scale. These partnerships cover various aspects such as research & development, technology, biomarkers, digital solutions, and commercial deals. The Diagnostics Strategy and Transactions team is looking for a Global Partnering Lead ( Senior Manager, Director ) for the APAC Subchapter. This position sources opportunities, builds and leads deal and diligence teams to evaluate opportunities, and leads the negotiation of agreements to access promising partnering candidates across our different business and customer areas. You will lead matrix project teams that drive Roche Diagnostics' external growth strategy globally, therefore working outside standard office hours to accommodate time zones are expected.

The Opportunity:
Want - Define external growth strategy:

• Perform and provide expertise & thought leadership as part of the squad teams to proactively generate strategic opportunities (areas/segments) that contribute to the Roche Diagnostics strategy

• Co-create with internal stakeholders strategic partnering WANTs and target product profiles (TPP) in line with the Roche Diagnostics` Strategy.

Find - Identify and prioritize external partnership options:

• Generate and secure a continuous flow of attractive partnership options by maintaining a strong internal ( business & customer areas, Life Cycle teams, R&D, networks, regions and affiliates, and global and group functions) & external network (companies, banks, VCs, academic institutions, etc)

• Proactively conduct in close collaboration with the Science and Technology Team & business stakeholders to systematic screen for suitable technologies, products, digital solutions, and companies

• Perform evaluation (strategic, financial assessment & feasibility assessment, selection of appropriate deal structure) & prioritization against strategic WANTs and TPP of external partnership options with an emphasis on business modeling.

Get & Create - Agree on partnership structure with external partner

• Lead the preparation, structuring, and negotiation of new business partnership and transaction agreements (across the entire range of transaction types incl Licensing, R&D-, Commercial Collaboration agreements) with the external partner - in collaboration with all other team/squad members and internal stakeholders. On M&A transactions, you will be working as a team together with Group Business Development.

• As part and alongside squad members, lead and provide best practice in planning and conducting Due Diligences (external partnership options meets strategic WANTs or TPP)

• Prepare objective, sound, and well-prepared recommendations regarding specific business partnerships to senior management and respective governance bodies

Manage - Ensure transition to internal stakeholders to allow for effective implementation:

• Establish a business relationship and collaborate with Partnering Alliances & Ecosystem Management team members following execution of the partnership or transaction

Who You Are

• Education & Industry Expertise: You hold an advanced degree in science, engineering or a related field (ideally at a PhD or Masters) and possess a solid understanding of the Diagnosti

jobs.title: Team Lead - Workflow Innovation & Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every contribution brings us closer to a healthier tomorrow. As the Team Lead for Workflow Innovation & Management, you will lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our research laboratories. In this strategic role, you will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap to transform scientific and business needs into high-value technology solutions that accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients.

Description of the area

The Team Lead for Workflow Innovation & Management is a strategic role within the Roche Digital Technology DIA R&D Labs organization that is dedicated to transforming how our research laboratories operate. The R&D labs team has a primary mission to drive workflow innovation, enhance efficiency of product development, and safeguard data integrity for research scientists.
As a content leader, you will provide strategic and technical direction for key areas such as human biosample management and laboratory material management. In addition, you will be responsible for the data transition between the bench scientists and the computational researchers.
In this role, you will lead and develop a team of technical experts to deliver high-value and scalable solutions that meet the needs of the DIA organization.

The Opportunity:

• Define Strategy & Vision: Set the strategic direction, roadmap, and features for lab workflow products, proactively integrating relevant AI capabilities to maximize business value and research efficiency.

• Champion Customer-Centricity: Serve as the primary advocate for internal users (scientists, researchers, technicians), translating lab user personas and needs into tangible, high-impact digital solutions.

• Lead Product Lifecycle Management: Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation through scaling while maintaining compliance with GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations.

• Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align multidisciplinary teams across scientific R&D, engineering, and executives around shared roadmaps, clear timelines, and strategic trade-offs.

• Develop High-Performing Teams: Attract, mentor, and empower a talented team of technical experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.

• Optimize Performance & Metrics: Track key performance indicators (KPIs), analyze user behavior, and apply data-driven insights to refine products and measure impact.

• Manage Resources & Business Cases: Formulate detailed business cases and optimize resource allocation across engineering and design to achieve strategic goals.

• Bridge Scientific & Technical Domains: Enable seamless data transitions between bench scientists and computational researchers to streamline instrument workflows and data integrity.

Who you are:

• Education & Core Experience: Holds a Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) with 5+ years of experience in product management or business analysis launching high-value technology products.

• Healthcare Industry Expertise: 2+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry, with a strong understanding of Diagnostics business environments.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every contribution brings us closer to a healthier tomorrow. As the Team Lead for Workflow Innovation & Management, you will lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our research laboratories. In this strategic role, you will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap to transform scientific and business needs into high-value technology solutions that accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients.

Description of the area

The Team Lead for Workflow Innovation & Management is a strategic role within the Roche Digital Technology DIA R&D Labs organization that is dedicated to transforming how our research laboratories operate. The R&D labs team has a primary mission to drive workflow innovation, enhance efficiency of product development, and safeguard data integrity for research scientists.
As a content leader, you will provide strategic and technical direction for key areas such as human biosample management and laboratory material management. In addition, you will be responsible for the data transition between the bench scientists and the computational researchers.
In this role, you will lead and develop a team of technical experts to deliver high-value and scalable solutions that meet the needs of the DIA organization.

The Opportunity:

• Define Strategy & Vision: Set the strategic direction, roadmap, and features for lab workflow products, proactively integrating relevant AI capabilities to maximize business value and research efficiency.

• Champion Customer-Centricity: Serve as the primary advocate for internal users (scientists, researchers, technicians), translating lab user personas and needs into tangible, high-impact digital solutions.

• Lead Product Lifecycle Management: Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation through scaling while maintaining compliance with GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations.

• Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align multidisciplinary teams across scientific R&D, engineering, and executives around shared roadmaps, clear timelines, and strategic trade-offs.

• Develop High-Performing Teams: Attract, mentor, and empower a talented team of technical experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.

• Optimize Performance & Metrics: Track key performance indicators (KPIs), analyze user behavior, and apply data-driven insights to refine products and measure impact.

• Manage Resources & Business Cases: Formulate detailed business cases and optimize resource allocation across engineering and design to achieve strategic goals.

• Bridge Scientific & Technical Domains: Enable seamless data transitions between bench scientists and computational researchers to streamline instrument workflows and data integrity.

Who you are:

• Education & Core Experience: Holds a Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) with 5+ years of experience in product management or business analysis launching high-value technology products.

• Healthcare Industry Expertise: 2+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry, with a strong understanding of Diagnostics business environments.

• Leadership Track Record: 1+ years of leadership experience managing, scaling, and developing multidisciplinary technical teams in fast-paced environments.

• Technical & Domain Proficiency: Deep understanding of lab user workflows

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose
You will manage the end-to-end key accounts of Roche Diagnostics in Central Asia region while ensuring effective stakeholder and customer engagement. You ensure a customer centric approach, by being clear on customer needs, promoting customer propositions at all levels.
Critical to the success of this role is effective project management and ability to spot and create business opportunities.

Countries of responsibility : Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Mongolia. The exact region of responsibility will be defined with the final candidate

Challenges
​ Account Management/ Customer Relationship Management:

• Develop and implement the account and portfolio strategy by understanding customer requirements, working with marketing to develop product strategies, implementing strategies in market segments and securing new clients and/or expanding footprint in existing clients as required

• Identify business opportunities by engaging with customers to understand new product or opportunities, analyzing the opportunity, developing proposals and presenting to customers monthly and as required

• Respond to business related queries by understanding the issue, sourcing the appropriate feedback and providing feedback to clients as required

• Report on financial performance by understanding KPIs, analyzing data daily, identifying trends and patterns, providing feedback on performance, monitoring and achieving profitability and drafting reports monthly and as required

• Achieve business targets by managing opportunities, loading onto the CRM system, engaging with customers, monitoring customer satisfaction in implementation, identifying risks and implementing corrective action daily

• Challenge status quo and drive distributors for ambitioned results, develop the current collaboration and look for new distribution channels where needed

Customer Relationship Development / Prospecting:

• Develop a growth strategy focused on both financial gain and customer satisfaction

• Identify and map business strengths and customer needs

• Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs to expand client base and viable income streams

• Have an in-depth knowledge of business products and value proposition.

• Addressor predict clients’ objectives

• Provide trustworthy feedback and after-sales support

• Build long-term relationships with new and existing customers

• Report on successes and areas needing improvements.

Business Opportunities Creation:

• Ensure a continuous feed of the business funnel pipeline as per opportunities identified

• Track and monitor the opportunity pipeline to ensure success

• Understand win/loss opportunities and potential reasons in order to provide needed improvements

• Ensure collaboration across all departments

• Commit for a promised annual added business to derive the business growth in the managed Accounts.

• Build country level strategies;

Who You Are

• You hold Medicine/Biology/Chemistry degree or similar

• Minimum 3 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical/diagnostics industry is preferrable

• Minimum 3 year experience as a key account/business/market development manager

• You possess a commercial experience in the medical industry with a demonstrated account management experience

• You possess a high strategic mindset

• You are able to communicate effectively with high negotiation skills

• You have the ability of managing complexity and adapting to different sit

The Position
Employee Experience Operations IT Specialist (Japanese speaker)

Introduction

To provide a seamless and positive experience for our customers who contact us via multiple channels, the Employee Experience Operations IT Specialist (Japanese speaker) opens and closes service requests and incidents, as well as manages the classification, assignment, tracking, and completion of requests. Drives overall customer satisfaction through individual and departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) . This job is responsible for providing first-level support and consultancy services for users via phone, chat, email, and Service Portal . The scope includes incident and request management for end users using a variety of software and standard applications, as well as assistance in software package installation and configuration on various types of hardware (e.g., laptops, desktops, tablets, smart devices, printers, network infrastructure) .

The Opportunity

In this role, you will act as a key contact point for IT support, enabling seamless productivity across the region . You will:

• Provide first-level support and consultancy for incidents and requests concerning standard/non-standard software, OS (Windows 11, Apple OS, Adobe), and enterprise applications like Google Suite and Microsoft Office .

• Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of IT tickets, including opening, classifying, prioritizing, tracking, and closing incidents and service requests in the ticketing tool .

• Assist end users with local hardware requests (laptops, desktops, tablets, mobile devices, monitors, printers) and software packages to best fit their operational needs .

• Handle multi-channel user communication—including phone, email, chat, and self-service portal—to troubleshoot issues and manage access rights efficiently .

• Dispatch and escalate complex technical incidents or requests to Level 2 support teams when issues exceed first-level resolution parameters .

• Contribute to building knowledge by writing and reviewing technical articles, posting community updates, and creating end-user guides in cooperation with Adoption Services .

• Guide end users toward autonomous self-service by demonstrating Service Portal capabilities, sharing instruction guides, and training them on Roche tools .

• Invest in continuous self-learning to maintain up-to-date technical expertise in evolving tools, business applications, and SHE (Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental) guidelines .

Who you are

We are looking for a customer-oriented, agile individual eager to grow their career in IT service delivery . To succeed in this role, you bring:

• Experience: 0–1 years of broad-ranging experience in a call center, help desk, or IT desk-side support environment .

• Education: University Bachelor's degree .

• Language Proficiency: Strong communication and written skills in English and Japanese (written and spoken) are essential, with N1 Certification .

• Technical Aptitude: High aptitude for learning, with baseline conceptual skills in IT service delivery, hardware/software troubleshooting, and optional ITIL Foundation awareness .

• Customer Focus & Mindset: Highly customer-oriented, accountable, and results-driven with a growth mindset .

• Communication & Collaboration: Excellent assertive communication skills with the ability to work effectively within a highly team-oriented global environment .

• Problem Solving & Agility: Strong ability to prioritize tasks, guide users through technical workflows, and

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Medicinal Chemistry department in Basel is focused on discovering innovative new medicines to treat major diseases in the areas of neuroscience, ophthalmology, rare diseases, infectious diseases and oncology. The Medicinal Chemistry department is located in world-class facilities with state-of-the-art medicinal chemistry infrastructure. Each year we host ~20 medicinal chemistry internship students from Universities throughout Europe, ensuring a very dynamic and collegial experience.

The Medicinal Chemistry department is composed of synthetic organic medicinal chemists dedicated to the discovery of new medicines of unmet medical need. We are part of Therapeutic Modalities, Small Molecule Research (pRED) and collaborate interactively with colleagues from all scientific and medical disciplines involved in drug discovery.

The Opportunity

As an intern, you will move beyond academic theory to achieve real-world impact by actively synthesising novel, small-molecule candidates for live drug discovery projects within our pRED labs. This hands-on experience allows you to master cutting-edge organic chemistry synthetic methods and purification technologies. Your practical work is complemented by a specialised tutorial program designed to deepen your understanding of medicinal chemistry and sharpen essential soft skills, such as scientific presentation.

You will present your research results to your peers and the department via presentation and poster sessions, and will attend an education program which aims at strengthening your synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry skills.

Who You Are

• A high-performing chemistry student expecting to obtain a 1st class degree who may perform PhD research after their successful undergraduate studies.

• We seek a talent with the ambition to make an impact in healthcare and who thoroughly embraces the challenge of working in a team with a common goal.

• Successful applicants should relish the stimulation of working in an international environment.

• Day-to-day scientific communication is in English, with an active interest in German or French a bonus.

Additional information

• You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor or Master degree program at a university or graduated within the last 12 months prior to the start date.

• For non-EU/EFTA citizens : enrollment at the university for the entire internship is required and a letter from the university stating that the internship is mandatory for your studies. The letter should also specify the required length of the internship. Please upload this mandatory letter and your enrollment certificate along with your CV and motivation letter.

• This is a full-time medicinal chemistry internship.

• Duration : 12 months – starting September 1st, 2027 OR 6 months – starting September 1st, 2027, or March 1st, 2028.

Application process

Your complete application includes the following documents:

• A current CV and a Motivation Letter

• A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying)

• A recommendation letter (academically relevant) must be provided upon application

We look forward to receiving your application!

Check out the following video to learn more:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zCWkn20yaII

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mill

jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
As a Senior ERP Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams within the SAP Sales and Distribution (SD / Market Plan to Cash) functional area. You will tackle complex business problems with emerging ambiguity, demonstrating a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical business domain, related enterprise technologies, and cross-module interdependencies. In this role, you will apply advanced BA tools and techniques to translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans and solution designs. You will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shape stakeholder perspectives, and drive the design, validation, and delivery of scalable SAP solutions. Additionally, you will mentor junior analysts and actively contribute to the ERP Community of Practice (CoP).

Description of the Area
This role supports the Marketing Plan to Cash (MP2C) value stream and is aligned with the ASPIRE roadmap, a multi-year global initiative aiming to define and develop functional ERP roadmaps that simplify, standardize, and automate core business processes leveraging SAP industry best practices. The team focuses on delivering high-impact Order-to-Cash offerings and integrating SAP SD seamlessly across global enterprise platforms.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams for the SAP SD (Market Plan to Cash) domain without guidance. Adapt and adhere to Roche standard frameworks, mentor junior and intermediate BAs, and drive/lead practices in end-to-end process design and optimization. Work in close partnership with business stakeholders to define, design, build, test, and deploy functional ERP solutions based on SAP ECC and S/4 HANA best practices.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Perform root cause analysis on complex business issues and lead Key Design Decisions. Accountable for creating comprehensive documentation (functional and technical specifications, test plans) and configuring, building, testing, and deploying SAP SD solutions alongside implementation partners, as well as coordinating production changes and providing L3 support for live operational systems.

• Stakeholder Management: Build strong, trusted partnerships across business and IT teams. Facilitate design workshops, resolve conflicts, manage expectations, and coordinate changes across cross-functional departments in the Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and gain endorsement across global IT and business teams.

• Impact / Strategy: Translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans and global solution roadmaps that maximize business value and minimize solution duplication. Evaluate solution alternatives and ensure continuous product increments aligned with long-term domain goals.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manage requirements and system interdependencies across complex multi-solution enterprise landscapes. Oversee and ensure integrations between SAP SD and adjacent applications, including SFDC, SAP Hybris, 3PL/4PL integration solutions.

• Business / Technical Ability: Apply deep domain and technical expertise in SAP SD customizing, configuration, and interface monitoring (iDoc, XML, Web Services, RFC, CIF). Ensure strict adherence to Roche IT standards, including security, privacy, IT Quality, GxP compliance, and Computer System Validation (CSV) requirements.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems, Compute

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
As a Senior ERP Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams within the SAP Sales and Distribution (SD / Market Plan to Cash) functional area. You will tackle complex business problems with emerging ambiguity, demonstrating a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical business domain, related enterprise technologies, and cross-module interdependencies. In this role, you will apply advanced BA tools and techniques to translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans and solution designs. You will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shape stakeholder perspectives, and drive the design, validation, and delivery of scalable SAP solutions. Additionally, you will mentor junior analysts and actively contribute to the ERP Community of Practice (CoP).

Description of the Area
This role supports the Marketing Plan to Cash (MP2C) value stream and is aligned with the ASPIRE roadmap, a multi-year global initiative aiming to define and develop functional ERP roadmaps that simplify, standardize, and automate core business processes leveraging SAP industry best practices. The team focuses on delivering high-impact Order-to-Cash offerings and integrating SAP SD seamlessly across global enterprise platforms.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams for the SAP SD (Market Plan to Cash) domain without guidance. Adapt and adhere to Roche standard frameworks, mentor junior and intermediate BAs, and drive/lead practices in end-to-end process design and optimization. Work in close partnership with business stakeholders to define, design, build, test, and deploy functional ERP solutions based on SAP ECC and S/4 HANA best practices.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Perform root cause analysis on complex business issues and lead Key Design Decisions. Accountable for creating comprehensive documentation (functional and technical specifications, test plans) and configuring, building, testing, and deploying SAP SD solutions alongside implementation partners, as well as coordinating production changes and providing L3 support for live operational systems.

• Stakeholder Management: Build strong, trusted partnerships across business and IT teams. Facilitate design workshops, resolve conflicts, manage expectations, and coordinate changes across cross-functional departments in the Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and gain endorsement across global IT and business teams.

• Impact / Strategy: Translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans and global solution roadmaps that maximize business value and minimize solution duplication. Evaluate solution alternatives and ensure continuous product increments aligned with long-term domain goals.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manage requirements and system interdependencies across complex multi-solution enterprise landscapes. Oversee and ensure integrations between SAP SD and adjacent applications, including SFDC, SAP Hybris, 3PL/4PL integration solutions.

• Business / Technical Ability: Apply deep domain and technical expertise in SAP SD customizing, configuration, and interface monitoring (iDoc, XML, Web Services, RFC, CIF). Ensure strict adherence to Roche IT standards, including security, privacy, IT Quality, GxP compliance, and Computer System Validation (CSV) requirements.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor of Science in Computer Systems, Compute

jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / ( Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection , and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / ( Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Qualifications

Education / Experience

• 3 + years of Business Analysis / Consultancy experience, with at least 2 + years in life sciences/pharma or the assigned business function being supported.

• Proven experience independently managing end-to-end BA workstreams, navigating ambiguous requirements, and evaluating strategic solution options.

• Demonstrated experience in translating requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives .

Technical Skills

• Advanced knowledge of Business Analysis/Consultancy concepts and practices, with intermediate expertise in at least one BA capability.

• Strong proficiency in requirements elicitation and documentation, ensuring comprehensive requirements trac
