jobs.title: Clinical Development Lead - Freelancer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster.

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life.

Your upcoming mission

Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare by leading the clinical development strategy for next-generation diagnostic solutions? As a Clinical Development Lead, Cardiovascular and metabolic diseases (CVMD) within our Clinical and Medical Affairs organisation in Diagnostics, you will play a pivotal role in planning and implementing clinical development activities that bring medically-differentiated solutions to patients globally. In this role, you will act as a senior strategic voice and trusted advisor, fostering an environment where science and collaboration thrive.

Key Responsibilities :

• Drive Clinical Strategy : Lead the clinical development strategy for large-scale studies and complex programs, in the CVMD area, defining clinical utility, intended use, and claim extensions across our portfolio.

• Lead Health Authority Interactions : Work closely with Global Regulatory Affairs in the completion and submission of global regulatory filings, authoring critical sections of meeting packages and reviewing clinical documents for international regulatory submissions.

• Forge Stakeholder Partnerships : Act as the medical lead in external interactions with health authorities, build strategic relationships with international Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and drive development partnerships across industry and academia.

• Foster Communication Excellence : Oversee the implementation of communication strategies for clinical studies, representing the organisation at major medical congresses, advisory boards, and in key publications.

• Champion Innovation & Excellence : Act as a key driver for competitive differentiation, innovation, and early pipeline activities while developing intellectual property strategies and optimising clinical processes.

• Coach and Mentor : Act as a dedicated coach for team members, nurturing confidence and helping colleagues develop their skills and expertise.

jobs.title: SW Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is building a next-generation data ecosystem to connect our diagnostic hardware with hospital and laboratory workflows. We need a SW Product Manager who can bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution.

Your main tasks and responsabilities

You will be the "Voice of the Customer" for an Agile Squad, responsible for turning a complex vision into a functional reality.

• Backlog Ownership: Own, refine, and prioritize the team backlog to ensure we’re shipping high-value features.

• Collaboration: Work alongside UX, Architecture, and Security to scope features that are feasible, secure, and user-centric.

• Agile Leadership: Lead refinements and PI planning, ensuring the dev team has clarity on the "What" and the "Why."

• Stakeholder Management: Translate laboratory needs into technical requirements and demo working software to business partners.

Who you are

• Agile Proficiency: Proven experience in Agile environments (SAFe is a plus) using Jira and Confluence.

• Technical Literacy: You can talk to developers from a user’s perspective and aren't afraid of technical requirements.

• Pragmatism: The ability to question established norms to find more efficient ways to deliver results.

• Domain Interest: A background in software dev, healthcare, or biomedical engineering is highly preferred.

The Benefits

• Flexible Environment: A hybrid/flexible working policy that respects your time.

• Professional Growth: Access to global learning platforms and internal career mobility.

• Solid Package: Competitive salary, pension plan, life insurance, and Roche stock options.

Are you ready to apply? We want someone who thinks beyond the job offered - someone who knows that this position can be an outstanding opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics.

Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Therefore, we will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a phenomenal place to work and to innovate for patients.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein Team
Als Nurse Liaison Manager:in (NLM) wirst Du Teil unserer Disease Area Neuroimmunologie. Du liebst es, unterwegs zu sein? Perfekt! In dieser gebietsübergreifenden Außendienstposition nutzt Du Deine Reisetätigkeit, um als Expert:in direkt vor Ort den Unterschied zu machen. Du gestaltest die Zusammenarbeit mit der Nurses-Community sowie unseren Teams in Vertrieb, Medical und Marketing aktiv mit. Wir verstehen uns als verlässliche Partner für Behandelnde, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Versorgung von Patient:innen mit Multipler Sklerose zu ermöglichen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Beratung & Schulung: Du informierst und schulst Nurses und Ärzte zur Anwendung von B-Zell- und IL6-Therapien, inkl. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Komplikationsmanagement.

• Organisationsberatung: Du berätst Praxen und Kliniken bei der Optimierung von Ablauforganisationen rund um unsere Neuroimmunologie-Produkte.

• Digitale Lösungen: Du begleitest die Implementierung unserer CE-zertifizierten Medizinprodukte (z.B. Brisa) zur Therapieunterstützung.

• Eventmanagement: Du planst und gestaltest aktiv lokale Anwendertreffen, Best-Practice-Sharing-Konzepte und moderierst Workshops.

• Netzwerkarbeit: Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse vor Ort und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in das Disease Area Squad ein.

• Crossfunktionale Kooperation: Du arbeitest eng mit allen Vertretern der Customer Pacing Functions, Medical, Marketing und Patient Partnership Bereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Account Plänen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger:in, Medizinische Fachangestellte oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 4 Jahre), idealerweise in der Neurologie.

• Erfahrung in der Therapie der Multiplen Sklerose (MS),insbesondere im Umgang mit MS-Patienten und Erfahrung im Management von Praxisabläufen und der Anleitung von Pflegekräften (Praxisanleiter:in)

• Medizinische Praxis: Sicherer Umgang mit Venenverweilkanülen, Durchführung von Infusionstherapien und Komplikationsmanagement.

• Zusatzqualifikation: Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement (QSM) und Ausbildung als Medizinprodukteberater:in sind von Vorteil.

• Hohe Sozialkompetenz, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist.

• Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace/MS Office sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

• Eine hohe Reisebereitschaft und gültige Fahrerlaubnis.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

• Netzwerkarbeit: Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse vor Ort und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in das Disease Area Squad ein.

• Crossfunktionale Kooperation: Du arbeitest eng mit allen Vertretern der Customer Pacing Functions, Medical, Marketing und Patient Partnership Bereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Account Plänen.

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger:in, Medizinische Fachangestellte oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 4 Jahre), idealerweise in der Neurologie.

jobs.title: ERP Solution Consultant - EHS
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
#Job Description:
The ERP - SAP IT consultant leads independently complex SAP solution delivery from a technical standpoint. This role is responsible for the specification of the architecture and functionality a global or local IT solutions..
In addition, they advise business and IT stakeholders on technical topics and work alongside IT and business colleagues to drive Idea-to-Requirement and Requirement-to-Implementation processes in a technical consulting role.
This IT expert role will work within the ERP Product configuration and Sustainability team. This position includes the below mentioned tasks and responsibilities with main focus on SAP Product and REACH Compliance, SAP Product Safety and/or SAP S/4HANA for Product Compliance Software Solutions.
Job Responsibilities:
Solutions/Services

• Designs and communicates high-level structures to enable and guide the design and development of integrated solutions that meet current and future business needs.

• Demonstrates understanding of requirements gathering and is able to show how agreed requirements are addressed by the proposed solution

• Innovates and optimizes processes and methods within the domain to meet system or user requirements and develop new functionality

• Guides the development of, and modifications to, solution components to ensure that they take account of relevant architectures, strategies, policies, standards and practices and that existing and planned solution components remain compatible

• Leads cross-solution architecture in the SAP environment.

• Coordinates and cooperates with a team of external consultants and developers for support processes, change management and DevOps setup.

• Works and cooperates with a team of external consultants and developers for change and incident management processes in either Waterfall, DevOps or Agile team configurations.

Standards

• Applies and implements process standards and actively participates in their introduction and rollout.

• Observes governance processes, highlights areas for improvement and assists in their implementation

• Implements appropriate framework and processes

• Uses tools and follows Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

• Maintains appropriate documentation of tasks and activities performed as required by project and other authorities.

• Ensures dynamic collaboration with governance & dedicated architecture bodies

• Supports new and established IT solutions by following ITIL rule sets (esp. incident and service management)

Know-how

• Understands business processes governing the application and is able to establish strong links with other technical teams responsible for the application and product delivery.

• Develops business/technical critical knowledge within the area of expertise for the function.

• Ensures alignment to defined technology roadmap among cross functional teams.

• Assists in the development of others by coaching and sharing his/her experiences and knowledge in the field of expertise.

• Supports the implementation of projects within the area of technical expertise, contributes to the implementation planning.

• Where requested supports Maintenance and Support activities e.g. for technical implementations or Change Management processes in a Waterfall, Agile or DevOps setup.

• Acts as IT consultant to Product Owners / Product Manager(s) (e.g. input to technical process flows, requirements, functionality gap analysis).

• Helps in defining testing for System and User Acceptance tests

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
#Job Description:
Il consulente ERP - SAP IT conduce la fornitura di soluzioni SAP indipendentemente complesse da un punto di vista tecnico. Questo ruolo è responsabile per le specifiche dell'architettura e della funzionalità di una soluzione IT globale o locale..
Inoltre, consigliano agli stakeholder aziendali e IT su argomenti tecnici e lavorano insieme ai colleghi IT e business per guidare i processi Idea-to-Requirement e Requirement-to-Implementazione in un ruolo di consulenza tecnica.
Questo ruolo esperto IT lavorerà all'interno del team di configurazione e sostenibilità del prodotto ERP. Questa posizione include le attività e le responsabilità di seguito menzionate con l'attenzione principale su SAP Product e REACH Compliance, SAP Product Safety e/o SAP S/4HANA per le soluzioni software di conformità del prodotto.
Responsabilità del lavoro:
Soluzioni/Servizi

• Progetta e comunica strutture di alto livello per consentire e guidare la progettazione e lo sviluppo di soluzioni integrate che soddisfano le esigenze aziendali attuali e future.

• Dimostra la comprensione dei requisiti di raccolta ed è in grado di mostrare come i requisiti concordati sono affrontati dalla soluzione proposta

• Innova e ottimizza processi e metodi all'interno del dominio per soddisfare i requisiti di sistema o utente e sviluppare nuove funzionalità

• Guida allo sviluppo e alla modifica di componenti di soluzione per garantire che tengano conto di architetture, strategie, politiche, standard e pratiche pertinenti e che i componenti di soluzioni esistenti e pianificati rimangano compatibili

• Conduce l'architettura cross-solution nell'ambiente SAP.

• Coordina e collabora con un team di consulenti esterni e sviluppatori per processi di supporto, gestione dei cambiamenti e configurazione DevOps.

• Lavora e collabora con un team di consulenti esterni e sviluppatori per i processi di gestione dei cambiamenti e degli incidenti nelle configurazioni di Waterfall, DevOps o Agile.

Norme

• Applica e implementa standard di processo e partecipa attivamente alla loro introduzione e rollout.

• Osserva i processi di governance, evidenzia le aree di miglioramento e assiste nella loro attuazione

• Attuazioni quadro e processi appropriati

• Utilizza gli strumenti e segue le procedure operative standard (SOP)

• Mantiene la documentazione appropriata dei compiti e delle attività svolte come richiesto dal progetto e da altre autorità.

• Garantisce una collaborazione dinamica con enti di governance e architettura dedicati

• Supporta nuove e consolidate soluzioni IT seguendo le regole ITIL (esp. incidente e gestione dei servizi)

Know-how

• Comprende i processi aziendali che regolano l'applicazione ed è in grado di stabilire forti legami con altri team tecnici responsabili dell'applicazione e della consegna dei prodotti.

• Sviluppa la conoscenza critica aziendale/tecnica nell'ambito delle competenze per la funzione.

• Garantisce l'allineamento alla roadmap tecnologica definita tra i team funzionali cross.

• Assiste nello sviluppo di altri allenando e condividendo le sue esperienze e conoscenze nel campo delle competenze.

• Supporta l'attuazione di progetti nel settore delle competenze tecniche, contribuisce alla pianificazione dell'implementazione.

• Dove richiesto supporta attività di manutenzione e supporto, ad esempio per implementazioni tecniche o processi di Change Management in una configurazione Waterfall, Agile o DevOps.

• Agisce come consulente IT per Product Owners / Product Manager(s) (ad esempio input per flussi di processo tecnico, requisiti, analisi gap funzionalità).

• Aiuta a definire i test di accettazione di sistema e utente

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
#Job Beschreibung:
Der ERP - SAP IT-Berater führt technisch unabhängig komplexe SAP-Lösungslieferungen. Diese Rolle ist verantwortlich für die Spezifikation der Architektur und Funktionalität einer globalen oder lokalen IT-Lösungen..
Darüber hinaus beraten sie Business- und IT-Stakeholder zu technischen Themen und arbeiten mit IT- und Business-Kollegen zusammen, um Idea-to-Requirement- und Requirement-to-Implementation-Prozesse in einer technischen Beratungsrolle voranzutreiben.
Diese IT-Expertenrolle wird im ERP-Produktkonfigurations- und Nachhaltigkeitsteam funktionieren. Diese Position umfasst die unten genannten Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf SAP Product und REACH Compliance, SAP Product Safety und/oder SAP S/4HANA für Product Compliance Software Solutions.
Verantwortlichkeiten:
Lösungen/Dienstleistungen

• Entwirft und kommuniziert hochrangige Strukturen, um das Design und die Entwicklung integrierter Lösungen zu ermöglichen und zu leiten, die den aktuellen und zukünftigen Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen.

• Demonstriert das Verständnis der Anforderungserfassung und ist in der Lage zu zeigen, wie vereinbarte Anforderungen durch die vorgeschlagene Lösung adressiert werden

• Innoviert und optimiert Prozesse und Methoden innerhalb der Domäne, um System- oder Benutzeranforderungen zu erfüllen und neue Funktionen zu entwickeln

• Leitet die Entwicklung und Modifikation von Lösungskomponenten, um sicherzustellen, dass sie relevante Architekturen, Strategien, Richtlinien, Standards und Praktiken berücksichtigen und dass bestehende und geplante Lösungskomponenten kompatibel bleiben

• Leitet Cross-Solution-Architektur im SAP-Umfeld.

• Koordiniert und kooperiert mit einem Team von externen Beratern und Entwicklern für Supportprozesse, Change Management und DevOps Setup.

• Arbeitet und kooperiert mit einem Team von externen Beratern und Entwicklern für Change- und Incident-Management-Prozesse in Waterfall-, DevOps- oder Agile-Teamkonfigurationen.

Normen

• Wendet und implementiert Prozessstandards und beteiligt sich aktiv an deren Einführung und Rollout.

• Beobachtet Governance-Prozesse, hebt Verbesserungspotenziale hervor und unterstützt bei deren Umsetzung

• Implementiert geeignete Frameworks und Prozesse

• Verwendet Tools und folgt Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

• Führt eine angemessene Dokumentation der von den Projekt- und anderen Behörden geforderten Aufgaben und Tätigkeiten.

• Gewährleistung einer dynamischen Zusammenarbeit mit Governance und dedizierten Architekturgremien

• Unterstützt neue und etablierte IT-Lösungen durch die Einhaltung von ITIL-Regelsätzen (z. B. Incident- und Service-Management)

Knowhow

• Versteht die Geschäftsprozesse der Anwendung und ist in der Lage, starke Verbindungen zu anderen technischen Teams aufzubauen, die für die Anwendung und Produktlieferung verantwortlich sind.

• Entwickelt Business / technische kritische Kenntnisse im Bereich der Expertise für die Funktion.

• Sicherstellt die Ausrichtung auf eine definierte Technologie-Roadmap zwischen funktionsübergreifenden Teams.

• Hilft bei der Entwicklung anderer, indem sie ihre Erfahrungen und ihr Wissen auf dem Gebiet der Expertise coacht und teilt.

• Unterstützt die Umsetzung von Projekten im Bereich der technischen Expertise, trägt zur Umsetzungsplanung bei.

• Auf Wunsch werden Wartungs- und Supportaktivitäten unterstützt, z.B. für technische Implementierungen oder Change Management-Prozesse in einem Waterfall-, Agile- oder DevOps-Setup.

• Funktioniert als IT-Berater für Product Owner / Product Manager (z.B. Input zu technischen Prozessabläufen, Anforderungen, Funktionslückenanalyse).

• Hilft beim Definieren von Tests für System- und Benutzerakzeptanztests

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Description de l'emploi :
Le consultant en informatique ERP - SAP dirige la prestation de solutions SAP complexes d'un point de vue technique. Ce rôle est responsable de la spécification de l'architecture et de la fonctionnalité d'une solution informatique globale ou locale.
De plus, ils conseillent les intervenants du secteur privé et de la TI sur des sujets techniques et collaborent avec des collègues du secteur privé et de la TI afin d'orienter les processus d'Idea to Requirement and Requirement to Implementation dans un rôle de conseil technique.
Ce rôle d'expert en TI travaillera au sein de l'équipe de configuration et de durabilité du produit ERP. Ce poste comprend les tâches et responsabilités mentionnées ci-dessous, en mettant l'accent sur SAP Product et REACH Compliance, SAP Product Safety et/ou SAP S/4HANA pour les solutions logicielles de conformité des produits.
Responsabilités professionnelles :
Solutions/Services

• Concevoir et communiquer des structures de haut niveau pour permettre et orienter la conception et le développement de solutions intégrées qui répondent aux besoins opérationnels actuels et futurs.

• Démontre la compréhension de la collecte des exigences et est en mesure de montrer comment les exigences convenues sont traitées par la solution proposée

• Innove et optimise les processus et les méthodes dans le domaine pour répondre aux besoins des systèmes ou des utilisateurs et développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités

• Guide la mise au point et les modifications de composants de solutions pour s'assurer qu'ils tiennent compte des architectures, stratégies, politiques, normes et pratiques pertinentes et que les composants de solutions existants et prévus demeurent compatibles

• Dirige l'architecture de résolution croisée dans l'environnement SAP.

• Coordonne et coopère avec une équipe de consultants et de développeurs externes pour les processus de soutien, la gestion du changement et la configuration de DevOps.

• Travaille et coopère avec une équipe de consultants et de développeurs externes pour les processus de changement et de gestion des incidents dans les configurations d'équipe Waterfall, DevOps ou Agile.

Normes

• Appliquer et mettre en œuvre les normes de processus et participer activement à leur introduction et à leur déploiement.

• Observe les processus de gouvernance, souligne les domaines à améliorer et aide à leur mise en œuvre

• Mettre en œuvre le cadre et les processus appropriés

• Utilise les outils et suit les procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON)

• Tenir à jour la documentation appropriée sur les tâches et les activités exécutées conformément aux exigences du projet et d'autres autorités.

• Assurer une collaboration dynamique avec les organes de gouvernance et d'architecture dédiés

• Prise en charge des solutions informatiques nouvelles et établies en suivant les règles ITIL (gestion des incidents et des services)

Savoir-faire

• Comprend les processus opérationnels régissant l'application et est en mesure d'établir des liens solides avec d'autres équipes techniques responsables de l'application et de la livraison des produits.

• Développer les connaissances essentielles en affaires et techniques dans le domaine d'expertise de la fonction.

• Assurer l'alignement des équipes interfonctionnelles sur la feuille de route technologique définie.

• Aide au développement d'autres personnes en assurant le coaching et en partageant ses expériences et ses connaissances dans le domaine de l'expertise.

• Appuie la mise en œuvre de projets dans le domaine des compétences techniques, contribue à la planification de la mise en œuvre.

• Sur demande, soutient les activités de maintenance et de soutien, par exemple pour les implémentations techniques ou les processus de gestion du changement dans une installation Waterfall, Agile ou DevOps.

• Fonctionne comme consultant en TI auprès des propriétaires de produits/gestionnaires de produits (p. ex. entrée dans les flux de processus techniques, exigences, analyse des lacunes fonctionnelles).

• Aide à définir les tests d'acceptation du système et de l'utilisateur

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Engineering Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist:

• You will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 55% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside within 50 miles of Tampa, FL.

Who You Are:

• You hold a High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• You hold 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Florida is $71,100 - 132,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED)

WHO ARE WE:

Doing now what patients need next
We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world.
That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.

pRED CLINICAL OPERATIONS:
Our North Star is to increase R&D Productivity and Patient Inclusivity. This is supported by our CO Strategy to deliver value for pRED CO and our portfolio. We aspire to be a leading edge Clinical Operations organisation that drives innovative patient-inclusive approaches in study design and execution, utilises advanced analytics to drive data-driven decisions, and embeds innovative technologies into our ways of working to improve productivity delivery of programs and studies. We strive to create a workplace where team members own their own development and learning and are empowered to create and innovate.

CONTRACT PURPOSE:
As a contract Study Manager you will be assigned to pRED early phase clinical studies, and as part of a cross-functional study team, you will be responsible for delivering study management and clinical operations activities under the direction and leadership of a Study Management Team Leader.
Through your direct study responsibilities you will also contribute to the management of external stakeholder relationships by helping Roche to be the preferred sponsor for sites, patients and other important healthcare providers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO / EXPECTATIONS DURING YOUR ASSIGNMENT:

During your assignment you will participate as a member of the Study Management Team contributing to the delivery and execution of early phase study protocols. You will:
● DELIVER STUDY EXECUTION by providing operational expertise into protocol design and feasibility, country selection, patient centricity and data delivery plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Ensure study quality and integrity by developing and maintaining study systems and documentation (including informed consent forms, communication plan, Trial Monitoring Plan, Trial Master File etc).
● PROVIDE COUNTRY OVERSIGHT, for insourced studies, by supporting or managing feasibility assessments to ensure countries and sites are selected for participation in studies. Provide guidance to country operational representatives during studies to ensure countries start-up on time and deliver on their recruitment commitments.
● MANAGE VENDOR PERFORMANCE by providing direction and actively managing relationships. Ensure vendors and third-party suppliers deliver against contracted scope of work and performance expectations and adhere to all appropriate standards (including ICH/GCP, SOPs and other regulations).
● PLAN DEMAND AND SUPPLY by overseeing the forecasting and maintenance of supplies (including IMP) needed to ensure sites have the necessary resources to run clinical studies.

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Engineering Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist:

• You will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 55% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside within 50 miles of Tampa, FL.

Who You Are:

• You hold a High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• You hold 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Florida is $71,100 - 132,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

jobs.title: Data Steward
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development. We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development.

The Opportunity:
The Data Steward ensures that clinical, real-world, and operational data are properly documented, accessible, and trustworthy throughout the product development lifecycle. You will support the implementation of metadata standards, lineage tracking, and FAIR data practices to enable transparency and reuse across stakeholders. Collaborating closely with governance, IT, and scientific teams, you will help develop and maintain data standards, dictionaries, quality rules, and cataloging systems. This role requires attention to detail, a strong understanding of data lifecycle management, and a commitment to enabling data as a reliable asset across the organization.

• You support the creation and maintenance of data dictionaries, metadata definitions, and lineage documentation for priority data sources

• You assist in routine data quality assessments and support the classification and cataloging of structured and unstructured datasets

• You work within existing stewardship procedures and tools to support transparency, traceability, and reusability of development data

• You build subject matter expertise in data stewardship practices for real-world, clinical, and operational data across Roche’s development landscape

• You collaborate with senior team members to ensure consistent documentation and alignment with data standards

• You contribute to knowledge-sharing activities and informal guidance for team members new to data stewardship practices

• You ensure compliance with data privacy and security regulations such as HIPAA, GDPR, and other relevant standards

• You contribute to a culture of data stewardship by following data governance principles and best practices

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Information Science, Information Management, or a related discipline

• You have a minimum of 3 years of experience working in a data documentation, quality, or metadata-related role, or an advanced degree with 3 years of equivalent work experience

• You understand clinical or real-world data structures and foundational stewardship practices

• You have basic experience with documentation tools, spreadsheets, or version control systems

• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles

• You bring excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain

• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace

• You have excellent verbal and written communication skil

• You understand clinical or real-world data structures and foundational stewardship practices

• You have basic experience with documentation tools, spreadsheets, or version control systems

• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles

• You bring excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain

• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace

• You have excellent verbal and written communication skil

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner/Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Product Owner who combines strong product ownership with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams. You will shape the product vision, own the backlog, and translate business needs into clear priorities and requirements that guide delivery. You will work closely with C#/.NET and Rust engineering teams, Scrum Masters, QA, architects, and stakeholders to ensure outcomes are aligned with business goals, technical feasibility, and delivery expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring features align with business outcomes and the overall product roadmap.

• Act as the primary contact for stakeholders, translating business needs into technical userl stories and actionable requirements.

• Collaborate with engineering teams throughout planning, refinement, design, and delivery to ensure requirements are understood and feasible.

• Define work packages, support estimation and sequencing, and help the team deliver stable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions.

• Support product delivery across C#/.NET and Rust-related initiatives by providing clarity, trade-off decisions, and prioritization.

• Provide transparent work status and issue reporting within the development team and to project management.

• Review solution design, functionality, usability, and performance to drive continuous improvement.

• Work through ambiguity and keep the team moving forward with prioritized decisions.

• Ensure that implemented features follow the agreed architecture, quality standards, and documentation expectations.

• Proactively track, monitor, and mitigate project risks to ensure delivery stability.

• Manage and coordinate external dependencies to prevent roadblocks and ensure alignment across teams.

Who You Are
Qualifications:

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Product Owner experience with proven team leadership.

• Self-organized and highly collaborative personality.

• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent communication.

• Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments is a plus.

• Comfortable working in agile development teams.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency with development and collaboration tools, primarily GitHub. Experience with Visual Studio is beneficial for .NET-related initiatives.

• Familiarity with Rust

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, our Global Product Development Safety & Risk Management (PDS) department aims to enhance healthcare for patients by elucidating and communicating the safety profile of Roche medicines to optimise their benefit-risk profile.

The Opportunity

The Associate Group Director (AGD) for Quantitative Safety Sciences (QSS) provides line leadership to a multidisciplinary team spanning Data Science (including AI/ML), Pharmacoepidemiology, and Pharmacovigilance (PV) Literature. Supporting assets across all Roche lifecycles, the AGD guides the team in establishing data-driven analysis strategies, model-based insights, and literature evidence. These efforts support regulatory deliverables (such as PBRER, DSUR, and SAC) and enhance the characterisation of molecule risk profiles for Clinical Safety, PSI, and other PDS partners.

Combining deep technical expertise in quantitative data science with broad knowledge of disease area strategies, the jobholder drives cross-functional collaboration with groups like PD Data Science, pRED/gRED, and PDMA. The AGD balances team resources, recruits and develops talent, and fosters an agile, high-quality delivery culture. Additionally, the role advances innovative analytical approaches to anticipate, manage, and characterise risk across Roche’s portfolio.

Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Leadership behaviors

• Role models Roche Values and Leadership Commitments while providing effective leadership to an experienced global team of Quantitative Safety Scientists across multiple locations; sets team direction in terms of remit, emphasis, style, behaviours, and culture while driving, embedding, and supporting staff to adhere to agreed organisational models, mindsets, and new ways of working.

• Leads self and others to deliver impactful outcomes, supports team members’ delivery, and brings critical thinking to shape current issues and opportunities into meaningful, deliverable actions while anticipating potential risks and opportunities in the context of the role.

• Focuses on implementing process improvements and adapting the team’s ways of working to achieve continually improving quality and efficiency; sets team and individual goals aligned with the Roche Safety Strategy, holding Quantitative Safety Scientists accountable for their behaviours and actions to encourage optimal mindsets for success.

Functional oversight, delivery & stakeholder relationship management

• Responsible for overseeing the delivery of Quantitative Safety Science—ensuring adherence to defined quality-bound processes and the highest scientific standards—utilising deliverables based on advanced data science, pharmacoepidemiology methodologies, and literature queries across Real World Data, Clinical Trial data, and literature databases while staying abreast of state-of-the-art methodologies and strategies.

• Provides leadership for scientific projects supported by the Quantitative Safety Science team, offering input on strategic and context information for fit-for-purpose solutions and consulting on best methodologies to leverage available data sources for smarter quantitative evidence generation in support of pharmacovigilance and safety risk management.

• Establishes an internal and external connected network to anticipate future opportunities, understand stakeholder needs/ideas, and promote collaborative projects (e.g., PSI, Clinical Safety, PD Data Science, pRED/gRED) while leading/contributing to global cross-functional initiatives and

jobs.title: AI Business Development Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The role
​
You’ll work alongside a dynamic team in a fast paced environment shaping how AI can enhance the strategic capabilities of Business Development. This is an opportunity to blend business insight, creativity, and technical curiosity to help build a next-generation partnership and insights platform within Roche.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across multiple departments to clearly define project requirements, implement use cases, and validate AI-driven applications.

• Design and build lightweight, no-code/medium-code generative AI tools and assistants to automate or enhance internal workflows and processes.

• Develop and refine AI-enhanced solutions that support diverse corporate use cases, enhancing efficiency and strategic decision-making.

• Provide comprehensive training and ongoing support to users and teams to ensure successful adoption and effective use of AI-based applications.

• Troubleshoot and optimize solutions based on continuous user feedback and emerging business requirements.

• Continue to maintain and update AI capabilities within corporate business development applications, maintaining awareness of emerging trends and best practices

• Develop and update documentation and knowledge bases for corporate business development AI tools

Who You Are

• Recent graduate in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field

• Experience using GenAI tools like ChatGPT (Custom GPTs), Gemini (Gems), or other AI assistants, and building data visualizations, such as Tableau dashboards

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for documenting AI use cases and translating between technical tools and business needs

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail

• Collaborative mindset with experience working effectively across multiple teams in a fast-paced, dynamic corporate environment

• Familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud (preferred)

Who We Are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. At Roche, we believe diversity and inclusion are essential values for our success. We have a special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams.

Are you ready to apply?
We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity

• Drive global compliance excellence by planning, executing, and reporting on Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Good Storage & Distribution Practice (GSDP) audits across internal sites, affiliates, suppliers, and service providers.

• Partner cross-functionally to identify global inspection and audit risks, developing strategic mitigation plans to safeguard our operational integrity.

• Lead end-to-end inspection readiness programs and support site inspection management to ensure continuous regulatory readiness across the network.

• Analyze and communicate emerging global regulatory trends and intelligence to proactively mitigate compliance risks and strengthen site-level practices.

• Champion a continuous improvement mindset by contributing to the evolution of our operating model, identifying efficiencies, and streamlining decision-making processes.

• Coach and mentor colleagues across the organization, fostering a culture of continuous learning, open feedback, and shared accountability.

Who You Are

• You bring 7+ years of professional experience in a regulated environment (such as pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or medical device industries), with at least 5 years dedicated to GMP auditing or regulatory inspection management.

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree (BA/BSc) or equivalent in life sciences, pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline.

• You possess a deep understanding of global quality and compliance regulations, including cGMP and GSDP requirements.

• You demonstrate proven capability in coaching, influencing, and guiding cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• You are comfortable with domestic and international business travel as required by operational needs.

Preferred:

• Experience across diverse manufacturing technology platforms and product life-cycle management.

** Relocation benefits not eligible for this positions**

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 105,560.00 and 138,547.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.

jobs.title: Operations Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. Global Product Strategy (GPS) drives the business strategy at Roche from research to commercialization. GPS collaborates closely with teams across the organization to bring new therapies to the market and maximize the launched product portfolio.
As an integral part of GPS, Portfolio Strategy & Insights (PSI) Satellite contributes to delivering our business priorities and advancing product and organizational excellence. We foster a culture of accountability for delivering on commitments and continuous improvement, bring together talented people from diverse backgrounds who foster an inclusive and connected culture, challenge the status quo, and create effective processes that add value and simplify work for ourselves and others.
As a member of the Operations Partner Teams, our focus is to enable business partners to operate at their highest efficiency, being responsive to change and fit for the future. We are growing to be a self-organized team and partnering to deliver better outcomes. We provide tailored business and team operations support to individuals and teams across Portfolio Strategy & Insights Team, ensuring continuity, coordination and effective execution of work. Depending on the functional remit and day-to-day responsibilities, Operations Partners may place greater emphasis on executive partnership, core business operations or operational program support

The Opportunity:

• Project & Task Coordination: Coordinate work packages and projects, including planning, stakeholder alignment, progress tracking and supporting delivery through to completion.

• Operational & Business Support: Manage daily business and administrative activities via established intake channels, covering meeting logistics, recruitment, contract, and compliance processes.

• Agile Practices & Team Facilitation: Contribute to and strengthen agile ways of working within the team, including facilitating team stand-ups, retrospectives and occasional scrum master responsibilities.

• Process Optimization & AI Tools: Proactively identify opportunities to simplify workflows and leverage AI-enabled digital tools to improve operational efficiency and information management.

• Virtual Collaboration & Digital Tools: Enable seamless virtual collaboration across the department by effectively utilizing enterprise platforms and digital solutions.

• Stakeholder Alignment & Follow-Up: Support key business and team priorities by aligning action items, timelines, and cross-functional follow-through across stakeholders.

• Information Synthesis & Decision Support: Prepare, summarize, and present relevant data and updates to support high-level discussions, recommendations, and decision-making.

• Change Management & Culture: Actively contribute to team initiatives, championing new ways of working, continuous improvement and effective adoption of change

Who You Are:

• Professional Experience: You bring 5+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally within a complex, corporate, or global business environment.

• Communication & Languages: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (fluency required); ability to collaborate seamlessly in a diverse organization.

• Tech Savvy & Innovation: Proficient with modern digital tools, highly tech-savvy, and genuinely curious about leveraging AI to drive efficiency.

• Organization & Detail Orientation: Outstanding organizational skills with sharp attention to detail,

jobs.title: PT Learning Technology & Adoption Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming healthcare and changing patients lives. As a global leader in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, we focus on driving scientific excellence and delivering innovative solutions that address some of the world’s most complex medical challenges. We believe that doing now what patients need next requires a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment where every individual is empowered to contribute to our shared purpose. Quality is at the heart of everything we do, ensuring that our life-saving treatments meet the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and compliance across the globe.

The Opportunity:

As the Learning Technology & Adoption Lead , you will serve as the digital architect and innovation driver for the PT Global Learning Hub. In this role, you bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology, human-centered design, and pharmaceutical manufacturing operations. While ensuring current platforms run smoothly, your primary focus will be pioneering next-generation learning technologies to transform training across global manufacturing sites.

• Pioneer Next-Gen EdTech: Act as the strategic scout and lead proof-of-concepts (PoCs) for Generative AI, Spatial Computing (VR/AR/MR), adaptive learning engines, and micro-learning platforms.

• Drive Business Impact & Scalability: Translate successful technology pilots into robust enterprise business cases with clear ROI, validation pathways, and global integration strategies.

• Elevate Digital Learning Experience (LxD): Champion human-centered UI/UX standards across all digital learning tools to ensure intuitive, frictionless, and accessible experiences on the shop floor.

• Empower High-Autonomy Teams: Provide strategic direction, macro guidance, and barrier removal for a lean team of self-sufficient Technology Product Owners managing platforms like Cornerstone LMS and SkillUp LXP.

• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner directly with Design & Operations, Learning Business Partners, Quality Assurance, and Enterprise IT to scale compliant digital solutions in regulated cleanroom and lab environments.

Who You Are

You are an innovative, visionary tech leader who cuts through edtech hype to implement practical, scalable solutions that solve genuine operational gaps.

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Educational Technology, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Instructional Systems Design, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience in edtech architecture).

• Tech & Innovation Leadership: 8+ years of experience leading digital learning technology, edtech innovation, or digital transformation within a global enterprise.

• Emerging Tech Expertise: Hands-on experience piloting or implementing immersive technologies (VR/AR/MR), AI/LLM applications in knowledge management, or adaptive learning algorithms.

• Regulated Industry & Technical Architecture Insight: Strong grasp of tech validation (CSV), data security, 21 CFR Part 11, and how modern learning ecosystems (LMS, LXP, LRS, HRIS) connect via APIs, xAPI, SCORM, and cloud infrastructures.

• Empowering & Collaborative Leader: Skilled at setting outcome-based goals for self-driven technical teams using agile experimentation, while building senior-level alignment with IT and Quality partners.

**Relocaiton no eligible for this position **
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming healthcare and changing patients lives. As a global leader in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, we focus on driving scientific excellence and delivering innovative solutions that address some of the world’s most complex medical challenges. We believe that doing now what patients need next requires a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment where every individual is empowered to contribute to our shared purpose. Quality is at the heart of everything we do, ensuring that our life-saving treatments meet the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and compliance across the globe.

The Opportunity:

As the Learning Technology & Adoption Lead , you will serve as the digital architect and innovation driver for the PT Global Learning Hub. In this role, you bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology, human-centered design, and pharmaceutical manufacturing operations. While ensuring current platforms run smoothly, your primary focus will be pioneering next-generation learning technologies to transform training across global manufacturing sites.

• Pioneer Next-Gen EdTech: Act as the strategic scout and lead proof-of-concepts (PoCs) for Generative AI, Spatial Computing (VR/AR/MR), adaptive learning engines, and micro-learning platforms.

• Drive Business Impact & Scalability: Translate successful technology pilots into robust enterprise business cases with clear ROI, validation pathways, and global integration strategies.

• Elevate Digital Learning Experience (LxD): Champion human-centered UI/UX standards across all digital learning tools to ensure intuitive, frictionless, and accessible experiences on the shop floor.

• Empower High-Autonomy Teams: Provide strategic direction, macro guidance, and barrier removal for a lean team of self-sufficient Technology Product Owners managing platforms like Cornerstone LMS and SkillUp LXP.

• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner directly with Design & Operations, Learning Business Partners, Quality Assurance, and Enterprise IT to scale compliant digital solutions in regulated cleanroom and lab environments.

Who You Are

You are an innovative, visionary tech leader who cuts through edtech hype to implement practical, scalable solutions that solve genuine operational gaps.

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Educational Technology, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Instructional Systems Design, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience in edtech architecture).

• Tech & Innovation Leadership: 8+ years of experience leading digital learning technology, edtech innovation, or digital transformation within a global enterprise.

• Emerging Tech Expertise: Hands-on experience piloting or implementing immersive technologies (VR/AR/MR), AI/LLM applications in knowledge management, or adaptive learning algorithms.

• Regulated Industry & Technical Architecture Insight: Strong grasp of tech validation (CSV), data security, 21 CFR Part 11, and how modern learning ecosystems (LMS, LXP, LRS, HRIS) connect via APIs, xAPI, SCORM, and cloud infrastructures.

• Empowering & Collaborative Leader: Skilled at setting outcome-based goals for self-driven technical teams using agile experimentation, while building senior-level alignment with IT and Quality partners.

**Relocaiton no eligible for this position **
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936

jobs.title: Senior Strategy and Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At the heart of Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) lies a mission to redefine what’s possible in healthcare through data. To achieve this, we need a backbone of strategic discipline and operational agility. As a key member of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, you will do more than manage processes, you will champion an innovation mindset, driving the evolution of our operating model and facilitating the strategies (such as in silico and 3D) that represent the future of medicine. Join us to help harmonize our strategic efforts and turn complex challenges into coordinated progress.

By connecting enterprise priorities with operational realities, BSO drives consistency, clarity, and coordinated progress across PDD and the broader development organization.

The Opportunity:

• You partner with sub-functional leaders to drive connectivity and coordinate planned and ad-hoc PDD-wide and functional strategic efforts in alignment with PDD priorities

• You drive key initiatives impacting the organization’s strategic and operating model, using an enterprise and innovation mindset

• You facilitate structured planning and reporting activities across sub-functions, proactively identifying and resolving issues in a dynamic and fast-paced setting to support the execution of strategies such as in silico and 3D

• You navigate high ambiguity and complexity, proactively driving clarity, alignment, and prioritization across multiple stakeholders and initiatives

• You operate with a continuous improvement mindset to proactively identify process gaps and opportunities for improved alignment, communications, and resource across key planned and ad-hoc efforts with a bias for action

• You independently organize and manage recurring leadership meetings (including Quant Team), develop agendas, and document and support the drive and follow-through of outcomes and next steps

• You maintain tools for initiative tracking, performance monitoring, and cross-functional alignment

• You lead or co-lead preparation of communications and presentations for functional updates, governance forums, senior leadership reviews, and evolving sub-functional or PDD-wide requirements in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, life sciences, public health, or data sciences

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic operations, business planning, or project management in pharma or healthcare settings; or an advanced degree with 5 years of equivalent work experience

• You demonstrate ability to independently lead initiatives, manage planning cycles, and facilitate leadership forums

• You are familiar with data- and R&D-oriented operating models and cross-functional execution

• You have capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles

• You have excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond technical domain

• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace

• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language

Preferred:

• Prior experience managing operational workstreams or planning cycles within life sciences or data-focused environments

• Working knowledg

jobs.title: Estagiário(a) de Eficiência Operacional - Brasilia
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Estagiário(a) em Otimização de Processos, você integrará uma equipe dinâmica focada na melhoria contínua e na redução de custos operacionais da produção laboratorial. Esta função oferece a oportunidade de aplicar seu perfil analítico para identificar gargalos e sugerir melhorias de alto impacto na operação.

A Oportunidade:

• Você apoia a equipe no mapeamento, controle e mitigação de ineficiências na operação dos equipamentos, com foco em plataformas Roche Cobas.

• Você colabora para a diminuição de desperdícios de reagentes, redução de retestes e maximização do rendimento dos insumos.

• Você acompanha o monitoramento do consumo de reagentes on-board nos analisadores, auxiliando no controle de lotes e volumes para evitar perdas por prazo de validade.

• Você auxilia no levantamento de dados sobre os motivos de retestes, desvios no Controle de Qualidade (CQ) e calibrações excessivas, participando da construção de planos de ação.

• Você auxilia na atualização e estruturação de planilhas e métricas (como Consumo Teórico vs. Consumo Real), apoiando a equipe na mensuração financeira das perdas operacionais.

• Você apoia a equipe na elaboração, revisão e formatação de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs) para o manuseio e rotina de reagentes.

Quem você é:

• Você está cursando Ensino Superior em Biomedicina, Farmácia, Biologia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas e tem disponibilidade para estagiar por pelo menos 1 ano.

• Você reside em Brasília ou região metropolitana, tendo disponibilidade para trabalhar no modelo híbrido.

• Você domina o Pacote Office, com destaque para Excel intermediário (alimentação de planilhas, tabela dinâmica e fórmulas básicas para análise de dados).

• Você possui noções teóricas sobre rotinas de Controle de Qualidade em análises clínicas.

• Você tem um perfil analítico, com facilidade e gosto por analisar dados e números, além de proatividade e vontade de aprender.

• Você apresenta boa comunicação e um perfil colaborativo para interagir de forma positiva com os operadores e analistas da rotina.

Diferenciais:

• Você possui conhecimento, vivência acadêmica ou iniciação científica envolvendo plataformas automatizadas de diagnóstico, como a linha Roche Cobas.

• Você possui certificação em metodologias de melhoria contínua (como Lean Healthcare, White/Yellow Belt em Six Sigma) ou em Gestão da Qualidade.

• Você tem conhecimento básico sobre as Regras de Westgard e gestão de estoque.

*Benefícios de realocação estão disponíveis para esta vaga

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
