jobs.title: Community Management & Digital Engagement (10–20h/week, 24+ Months)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you early in your university studies and looking for a long-term, high-impact role at Roche? We are looking for a tech-savvy, proactive Working Student to join the CareRing Core Team. If you love taking initiative, have an entrepreneurial mindset and are excited to master social media and community management from the ground up, this is the opportunity for you.

What is CareRing?

CareRing (part of the Global Patient Network team) is Roche’s global virtual community dedicated to patients and caregivers who are employees. It offers a safe and supportive space for colleagues to connect and share personal stories, while bridging the gap to our daily work—helping us learn from lived experiences to keep empathy and authentic human insights at the heart of Roche’s innovation.

The Opportunity

• Master Social & Digital Community Management: Building skills by managing both front-office member engagement and back-office platform operations for a global internal community of patients and caregivers.

• Long-Term Growth & Mentorship: Work alongside experienced leaders over the next 2+ years, taking on increasing responsibility

• Supercharge Your Professional Profile: Build a network across global sites, working directly with ambassadors, functional teams, and senior leadership.

What You’ll Do (Deliverables & Responsibilities)

Community & Platform Operations (Front & Back Office)

• Platform & Intranet Management: Maintain day-to-day operations of the CareRing platform and oversee our new myRoche intranet presence—keeping content fresh, relevant, and engaging.

• Front & Back-Office Support: Balance user-facing community engagement with essential administrative, content scheduling, and technical maintenance tasks.

• Safe Community Building: Help grow membership while maintaining a safe, welcoming, and collaborative space for members to connect.
Content & Strategic Communications

• Creative Content Creation: Design and roll out engaging posts, event promotions, impact stories, and member spotlight testimonials.

• Campaign Activation: Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate CareRing messaging into company-wide initiatives.
Ambassador & Stakeholder Support

• Ambassador Coordination: Support our global Ambassador Program, providing local leads with the assets and tools they need to champion CareRing.

• Leadership Connections: Assist in preparing updates and materials to showcase the value of CareRing to site leaders and project teams.

Who You Are

• Early-Stage Student Status: Enrolled during the entire period (at least 24 months) in a Bachelor’s program (or early Master’s) in Basel or nearby.

• Entrepreneurial & Eager Mindset: You don't need years of corporate experience—we care about your resourcefulness, common sense, curiosity, and willingness to learn!

• Tech & PC Savvy: Comfortable navigating digital platforms, content management tools, and social media dynamics.

• Strong Communication Skills: Fluent in English (German and any other language is a plus) with a natural ability to connect with people, write clear content, and represent a patient-first mission.

Your application: Please upload your CV and indicate your preferred start date of the internship in your motivation letter.

Start : from November 2026 or upon agreement for at least 24 months

The internship is not suitable for writing a Bachelor’s/ Master’s Thesis.

If you are proud of contributing and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then R

jobs.title: Planned Activity Specialist Maryland/Virginia
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Summary:
This is an exciting time to join Roche Support Network. If you are passionate for problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The opportunity:
This position serves as a resource for the technical maintenance and installation of Roche products for assigned product lines. Performs on-site preventative maintenance, installation, and technical updates (TSB’s) on company product(s). Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures as necessary when performing preventative maintenance, installation, technical updates (TSB’s) activities, and routine reagent conversions. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with company’s quality procedures. Requires specific training and certification. May adapt procedures, processes, tools equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine but may include non-routine tasks. Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.
This role will require roughly 90% travel, our ideal candidate would reside in Maryland or Virginia and be 50 miles from an airport.

Minimum Requirements:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 2 years of experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking or equivalent level of competency attained through appropriate training curriculum OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field.

Preferred Requirements:

• Good written/verbal communication, organization and prioritization skills.

• Knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, and information technology.

• Knowledge of basic chemistry.

• Effective customer service skills, which includes a positive attitude and helpful customer interaction.

• Applies industry acceptable practices and procedures to install, and maintain, Roche Diagnostics equipment. Schedules and performs preventative maintenance, modifications and conversions as required per department policy.

• Responsible for ensuring and maximizing customer satisfaction with Roche equipment and related products. Promotes effective, positive, and productive communication among team to ensure and maximize satisfaction of customer base.

• Completes and documents all service and customer account related reports, updates, and emails in a timely and professional manner, compliant to all company quality procedures and guidelines. * Maintains expenses within departmental guidelines and controls inventory and all company pr

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto Sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
Líder en la generación e implementación de estrategias que permitan conocer, mejorar, optimizar y gestionar el “Patient Journey” para las Áreas Terapéuticas asignadas, orquestando los recursos necesarios para generar valor e impacto en el ecosistema.

Responsabilidades

• Actúa como socio de confianza y punto de contacto principal (no exclusivo) entre las partes interesadas y Roche de las áreas terapéuticas a su cargo.

• Actúa con pensamiento sistémico para asociarse y trabajar estrechamente con los stakeholders clave (HCPs, tomadores de decisión, pagadores, etc.) del patient journey.

• Rol de alto nivel que apoya la toma de decisiones en conjunto con los squads para solicitar recursos de Roche al equipo de finanzas y/o ET con el fin de impactar el outcome.

• Adopta el rol de Product Owner para liderar la gestión de outcomes de corto plazo.

Quién eres

• Profesional de la salud en Medicina o Farmacia.

• Experiencia en roles con responsabilidades que incluyan planes y proyecciones estratégicas de ventas, manejo de clientes. Conocimiento de la experiencia de los pacientes y de los tratamientos.

• Profundo conocimiento general sobre el proceso local de contratación administrativa.

• Pensamiento sistémico, estratégico y escucha activa.

• Comprensión práctica de las metodologías de innovación digital y/o Customer Centricity.

• Conocimiento para interpretar estudios clínicos en inglés.

Deseable

• Experiencia institucional.

• Experiencia en las siguientes áreas terapéuticas: Hematología Maligna & Hemofilia.

• Facilidad de adopción tecnológica.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Field Service Installation Representative – Mass Spectrometry travel to customer laboratories across the United States to lead and execute the physical installation, uncrating, hardware setup, and initial calibration of Roche’s automated mass spectrometry platform, the cobas i601, and its integrated components.

Because clinical mass spectrometry involves ultra-high vacuum (UHV) systems, specialized gas supplies (nitrogen, collision gas), high-pressure LC fluidics, and automated front-end sample preparation, you will play a critical technical role in establishing a flawless hardware foundation for our customer laboratories.

In this role, you will work closely with local Field Engineering Specialists (FES) and Field Applications Specialists (FAS) to hand over fully operational, validated mass spectrometry systems ready for customer assay implementation.

The Opportunity
As a Field Service Installation Representative – Mass Spectrometry, you will:

• Lead & Execute Mass Spec Installations: Perform site pre-inspections, physical installation, assembly, line leveling, and initial setup of cobas i601 mass spectrometry systems and automated liquid-handling front-ends across national customer sites with minimal supervision.

• Mass Spec Hardware & Infrastructure Setup: Install and verify critical mass spec infrastructure, including ultra-high vacuum (UHV) pumps, atmospheric pressure ionization (ESI/APCI) interface modules, nitrogen and carrier gas supply lines, exhaust systems, and high-pressure liquid chromatography (HPLC/UHPLC) fluidic connections.

• Connectivity & Software Integration: Install instrument connectivity solutions, network interfaces, and software drivers as part of the total cobas i601 platform integration.

• Initial System Calibration & TSB Compliance: Perform initial physical alignments, basic vacuum leak checks, fluidic pressure testing, and implement mandatory technical service bulletins (TSBs) and engineering modifications during the installation window.

• Troubleshoot Installation Issues: Identify, analyze, and resolve mechanical, fluidic, gas-line, electronic, and IT connectivity issues during the installation process to ensure on-time project completion.

• Cross-Functional FES/FAS Handover: Partner closely with local FES and FAS teams to ensure seamless transition from physical installation to assay validation and user training, ensuring high customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based national installation role - Ideal candidate must reside in Texas (San Antonio), California, New Jersey (North), Atlanta (Georgia ), and Salt Lake (Utah).

Travel: This position requires 100% travel based on customer needs and demands.

Who You Are

• You hold a High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training (OR equivalent work experience); AND

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Field Service Installation Representative – Mass Spectrometry travel to customer laboratories across the United States to lead and execute the physical installation, uncrating, hardware setup, and initial calibration of Roche’s automated mass spectrometry platform, the cobas i601, and its integrated components.

Because clinical mass spectrometry involves ultra-high vacuum (UHV) systems, specialized gas supplies (nitrogen, collision gas), high-pressure LC fluidics, and automated front-end sample preparation, you will play a critical technical role in establishing a flawless hardware foundation for our customer laboratories.

In this role, you will work closely with local Field Engineering Specialists (FES) and Field Applications Specialists (FAS) to hand over fully operational, validated mass spectrometry systems ready for customer assay implementation.

The Opportunity
As a Field Service Installation Representative – Mass Spectrometry, you will:

• Lead & Execute Mass Spec Installations: Perform site pre-inspections, physical installation, assembly, line leveling, and initial setup of cobas i601 mass spectrometry systems and automated liquid-handling front-ends across national customer sites with minimal supervision.

• Mass Spec Hardware & Infrastructure Setup: Install and verify critical mass spec infrastructure, including ultra-high vacuum (UHV) pumps, atmospheric pressure ionization (ESI/APCI) interface modules, nitrogen and carrier gas supply lines, exhaust systems, and high-pressure liquid chromatography (HPLC/UHPLC) fluidic connections.

• Connectivity & Software Integration: Install instrument connectivity solutions, network interfaces, and software drivers as part of the total cobas i601 platform integration.

• Initial System Calibration & TSB Compliance: Perform initial physical alignments, basic vacuum leak checks, fluidic pressure testing, and implement mandatory technical service bulletins (TSBs) and engineering modifications during the installation window.

• Troubleshoot Installation Issues: Identify, analyze, and resolve mechanical, fluidic, gas-line, electronic, and IT connectivity issues during the installation process to ensure on-time project completion.

• Cross-Functional FES/FAS Handover: Partner closely with local FES and FAS teams to ensure seamless transition from physical installation to assay validation and user training, ensuring high customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based national installation role - Ideal candidate must reside in Texas (San Antonio), California, New Jersey (North), Atlanta (Georgia ), and Salt Lake (Utah).

Travel: This position requires 100% travel based on customer needs and demands.

Who You Are

• You hold a High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training (OR equivalent work experience); AND

• 2 years of progressive experience repairing, servicing, or installing complex electro-mechanical hardware, analytical/diagnostic instrumentation, software, or networking/wireless systems (or equivalent military experience).

• Experience or familiarity with complex laboratory fluidics, pneumatic/gas systems, or high-precision mechanical assemblies.

• Direct experience installing or servicing complex laboratory systems (LC-MS/MS, analytical chemistry equipment, or high-throughput clinical diagnostic instrumentation).

Preferred Requirements

• 2+ years of direct experience installing, servicing, or maintaining mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), chromatography (HPLC/UHPLC),

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab & POC
Location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key Responsibilities
Sales and Market Strategy

• Responsible for planning and executing business plans to achieve sales targets for the Mass Spec product line.

• Formulate and execute customized sales strategies for key customers.

• Coordinate sales activities in conjunction with clinical chemistry/immunoassay equipment and pioneer new markets for TDM, Vitamin D, and High Medical Value Assays.

• Deliver differentiated value by achieving customer retention, expansion, and new acquisition through opportunity identification, solution proposal, and execution.

Customer Management

• Build relationships and establish long-term business connections with key decision-makers and KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders).

• Maximize the value of integrated solutions and customer satisfaction through KAM (Key Account Management).

• Utilize specialized knowledge to resolve technical inquiries and provide professional customer support.

• Provide necessary support and solutions to customers in a timely manner by collaborating with various organizations such as Marketing, Application Specialist, Service Engineer, and Medical Affairs.

Collaboration and Accountability

• Drive business success through close cooperation with relevant departments (Marketing, Finance, Service, etc.).

• Enhance overall diagnostic business performance through collaboration with other business units, including the Digital Business Unit, Molecular Diagnostics Business Unit, and Automation-related departments.

• Responsible for sales forecasting, contract management, and sales reporting.

Competency Development

• Practice continuous learning and internal sharing of Mass Spec technology, market trends, and competitor information.

• Strengthen expertise in automation systems, LC-MS/MS analysis principles, and Total laboratory automation integration technology.

• Continuously develop sales competencies (negotiation, strategic thinking, communication).

Who You Are

Education and Experience

• Major in a related field such as Life Science, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or Clinical Chemistry

• 5+ years of experience in the diagnostics, biotech, life science instruments, or analytical equipment sectors

Required and Preferred Experience

• Sales experience with LC-MS/MS or Mass Spec equipment portfolio

• Experience with LC-MS/MS reagent application (overall operation)

• Experience and understanding of clinical application of High Medical Value Assays, Vitamin D, Immunosuppressants, etc

• Understanding of the central laboratory operating environment, including Clinical Laboratory Automation Workflow, Laboratory Information System/Total laboratory automation, Clinical Chemistry/Immunoassay, or CBC

• Essential in English for technical communication and information sharing with Global/APAC teams

• Native-level proficiency in Korean is required

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Affiliata: Roche Diagnostics Corea
Divisione: Core Lab e POC
Luogo: Seul, Corea del Sud

Le tue responsabilità chiave
Strategia di vendita e di mercato

• Responsabile della pianificazione e dell'esecuzione dei piani aziendali per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita per la linea di prodotti Mass Spec.

• Formulare ed eseguire strategie di vendita personalizzate per i clienti chiave.

• Coordinare le attività di vendita insieme alle apparecchiature per chimica clinica/immunoanalisi e aprire la strada a nuovi mercati per TDM, vitamina D e test ad alto valore medico.

• Fornire valore differenziato ottenendo fidelizzazione, espansione e nuove acquisizioni dei clienti attraverso l'identificazione di opportunità, la proposta di soluzioni e l'esecuzione.

Gestione dei clienti

• Costruire relazioni e stabilire connessioni commerciali a lungo termine con i principali decisori e KOL (Key Opinion Leader).

• Massimizzare il valore delle soluzioni integrate e la soddisfazione del cliente attraverso il KAM (Key Account Management).

• Utilizzare conoscenze specializzate per risolvere domande tecniche e fornire assistenza professionale ai clienti.

• Fornire il supporto e le soluzioni necessarie ai clienti in modo tempestivo collaborando con varie organizzazioni come marketing, specialisti di applicazioni, tecnici dell'assistenza e affari medici.

Collaborazione e responsabilità

• Promuovere il successo aziendale attraverso una stretta collaborazione con i dipartimenti competenti (marketing, finanza, servizi, ecc.).

• Migliorare le prestazioni aziendali diagnostiche complessive attraverso la collaborazione con altre unità aziendali, tra cui la Business Unit Digitale, la Business Unit Diagnostica Molecolare e i dipartimenti relativi all'automazione.

• Responsabile delle previsioni di vendita, della gestione dei contratti e del reporting sulle vendite.

Sviluppo delle competenze

• Praticare l'apprendimento continuo e la condivisione interna della tecnologia Mass Spec, delle tendenze di mercato e delle informazioni sulla concorrenza.

• Rafforzare l'esperienza nei sistemi di automazione, nei principi di analisi LC-MS/MS e nella tecnologia di integrazione totale dell'automazione del laboratorio.

• Sviluppare continuamente le competenze di vendita (negoziazione, pensiero strategico, comunicazione).

Chi sei

Formazione ed esperienza

• Specializzazione in un campo correlato come scienze della vita, chimica, biochimica o chimica clinica

• Oltre 5 anni di esperienza nei settori della diagnostica, delle biotecnologie, degli strumenti per le scienze della vita o delle apparecchiature analitiche

Esperienza richiesta e preferibile

• Esperienza di vendita con portafoglio di apparecchiature LC-MS/MS o spettrometria di massa

• Esperienza con l'applicazione dei reagenti LC-MS/MS (funzionamento generale)

• Esperienza e comprensione dell'applicazione clinica di test ad alto valore medico, vitamina D, immunosoppressori, ecc

• Comprensione dell'ambiente operativo del laboratorio centrale, compreso il flusso di lavoro di automazione del laboratorio clinico, il sistema informativo di laboratorio/automazione totale del laboratorio, chimica clinica/test immunologico o CBC

• Essenziale in inglese per la comunicazione tecnica e la condivisione delle informazioni con i team globali/APAC

• È richiesta una conoscenza madrelingua del coreano

Sottomissione

Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Kontakte, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Tochterunternehmen: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Abteilung: Core Lab & POC
Standort: Seoul, Südkorea

Ihre Hauptaufgaben
Vertriebs- und Marktstrategie

• Verantwortlich für die Planung und Ausführung von Geschäftsplänen zur Erreichung der Verkaufsziele für die Mass Spec-Produktlinie.

• Formulieren und implementieren Sie maßgeschneiderte Vertriebsstrategien für Schlüsselkunden.

• Koordinieren Sie Vertriebsaktivitäten in Verbindung mit Geräten für die klinische Chemie/Immunoassay und erschließen Sie neue Märkte für TDM, Vitamin D und Assays mit hohem medizinischem Wert.

• Bieten Sie einen differenzierten Mehrwert, indem Sie durch die Identifizierung von Chancen, Lösungsvorschläge und deren Umsetzung Kundenbindung, -erweiterung und Neuakquise erreichen.

Kundenmanagement

• Bauen Sie Beziehungen auf und bauen Sie langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern und KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) auf.

• Maximieren Sie den Wert integrierter Lösungen und die Kundenzufriedenheit durch KAM (Key Account Management).

• Nutzen Sie Fachwissen, um technische Anfragen zu lösen und professionellen Kundensupport zu bieten.

• Bereitstellung der erforderlichen Unterstützung und Lösungen für Kunden zeitnah durch Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Organisationen wie Marketing, Anwendungsspezialisten, Servicetechnikern und medizinischen Angelegenheiten.

Zusammenarbeit und Verantwortung

• Steigern Sie den Geschäftserfolg durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Abteilungen (Marketing, Finanzen, Service usw.).

• Verbessern Sie die Gesamtleistung des Diagnostikgeschäfts durch die Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Geschäftsbereichen, einschließlich der Digital Business Unit, der Molecular Diagnostics Business Unit und automatisierungsbezogenen Abteilungen.

• Verantwortlich für Verkaufsprognosen, Vertragsmanagement und Verkaufsberichte.

Kompetenzentwicklung

• Üben Sie kontinuierliches Lernen und den internen Austausch von Mass Spec-Technologie, Markttrends und Wettbewerbsinformationen.

• Stärkung des Fachwissens in Automatisierungssystemen, LC-MS/MS-Analyseprinzipien und Integrationstechnologie für die vollständige Laborautomatisierung.

• Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Vertriebskompetenzen (Verhandlung, strategisches Denken, Kommunikation).

Wer du bist

Ausbildung und Erfahrung

• Hauptfach in einem verwandten Bereich wie Biowissenschaften, Chemie, Biochemie oder klinische Chemie

• Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Diagnostik, Biotechnologie, Life-Science-Instrumente oder Analysegeräte

Erforderliche und bevorzugte Erfahrung

• Vertriebserfahrung mit dem LC-MS/MS- oder Mass Spec-Geräteportfolio

• Erfahrung mit der Anwendung von LC-MS/MS-Reagenzien (Gesamtbetrieb)

• Erfahrung und Verständnis der klinischen Anwendung von Tests mit hohem medizinischem Wert, Vitamin D, Immunsuppressiva usw

• Verständnis der Betriebsumgebung des zentralen Labors, einschließlich Workflow für klinische Laborautomatisierung, Laborinformationssystem/vollständige Laborautomatisierung, klinische Chemie/Immunoassay oder CBC

• Unverzichtbar in Englisch für die technische Kommunikation und den Informationsaustausch mit globalen/APAC-Teams

• Kenntnisse der koreanischen Sprache auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sind erforderlich

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GPC Training and Service Quality Lead
Department: Global Patient Care (GPC)
Area: Global Customer Support (GCS)
Reports to: GPC Support Lead
Location: Sant Cugat, Spain

About the Role
The Training and Service Quality Lead for Global Patient Care (GPC) plays a pivotal role in shaping service excellence across Roche Diagnostics' customer support network. Leading a dedicated team of Training and Service Quality Specialists, this role ensures the development and implementation of robust training programs and quality assurance frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality, patient-centered care.

Collaborating closely with GPC leadership, you will drive strategies that enhance skill development, align with global service standards, and foster a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards. Through effective leadership and data-driven insights, you will strengthen the quality and efficiency of interactions with patients and customers, advancing Roche's mission to deliver transformative healthcare solutions.

Your Responsibilities
Strategic Program Development:

• Identify training and service quality improvement opportunities by collaborating with regional Customer Support hubs, Business Implementation Specialists, and other GPC functions to ensure services evolve with business needs

• Design, enhance, or discontinue training and quality programs to uphold service excellence while ensuring compliance with auditable training standards

• Lead projects related to improvements and changes within Global Patient Care to meet evolving business needs

Customer Experience & Operational Excellence:

• Establish and continuously improve a global training and service quality framework to deliver consistent, high-standard customer and patient experiences

• Define and implement operational standards to ensure excellence in Training and Service Quality across all regions

• Implement a robust quality monitoring framework for external Customer Support operations

• Utilize customer satisfaction metrics, feedback, and operational data to identify trends and improvement areas

Training Program Design and Delivery:

• Lead the development and execution of training programs tailored to enhance competencies of frontline teams and specialists

• Ensure training initiatives align with global service delivery objectives and support achievement of organizational KPIs

• Work with external partners to define and implement global training standards

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

• Implement a robust quality assurance framework to monitor and improve interactions with patients and customers

• Report directly to GPC Leadership to guarantee consistent, high-standard experiences while supporting delivery of Roche's innovative products and digital solutions

È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Responsabile della formazione e della qualità del servizio GPC
Dipartimento: Global Patient Care (GPC)
Area: Assistenza clienti globale (GCS)
Riporta a: Responsabile del supporto GPC
Luogo: Sant Cugat, Spagna

Informazioni sul ruolo
Il responsabile della formazione e della qualità del servizio per Global Patient Care (GPC) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel plasmare l'eccellenza del servizio in tutta la rete di assistenza clienti di Roche Diagnostics. Alla guida di un team dedicato di specialisti della formazione e della qualità del servizio, questo ruolo garantisce lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di solidi programmi di formazione e quadri di garanzia della qualità che consentono un'assistenza coerente, di alta qualità e incentrata sul paziente.

Collaborando a stretto contatto con la leadership di GPC, guiderai strategie che migliorano lo sviluppo delle competenze, si allineano agli standard di servizio globali e promuovono una cultura di miglioramento continuo garantendo al contempo la conformità agli standard normativi e di qualità. Attraverso una leadership efficace e approfondimenti basati sui dati, rafforzerai la qualità e l'efficienza delle interazioni con pazienti e clienti, portando avanti la missione di Roche di fornire soluzioni sanitarie trasformative.

Le tue responsabilità
Sviluppo del programma strategico:

• Identificare opportunità di formazione e miglioramento della qualità del servizio collaborando con gli hub regionali di assistenza clienti, gli specialisti di implementazione aziendale e altre funzioni GPC per garantire che i servizi evolvano con le esigenze aziendali

• Progettare, migliorare o interrompere programmi di formazione e qualità per sostenere l'eccellenza del servizio garantendo al tempo stesso la conformità a standard di formazione verificabili

• Condurre progetti relativi a miglioramenti e cambiamenti all'interno di Global Patient Care per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali in evoluzione

Esperienza del cliente ed eccellenza operativa:

• Stabilire e migliorare continuamente un quadro globale di formazione e qualità del servizio per offrire esperienze coerenti e di alto livello a clienti e pazienti

• Definire e implementare standard operativi per garantire l'eccellenza nella formazione e nella qualità del servizio in tutte le regioni

• Implementare un solido quadro di monitoraggio della qualità per le operazioni di assistenza clienti esterne

• Utilizzare parametri di soddisfazione del cliente, feedback e dati operativi per identificare tendenze e aree di miglioramento

Progettazione ed erogazione del programma di formazione:

• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di programmi di formazione su misura per migliorare le competenze dei team e degli specialisti in prima linea

• Garantire che le iniziative di formazione siano in linea con gli obiettivi di fornitura di servizi globali e supportino il raggiungimento dei KPI organizzativi

• Collaborare con partner esterni per definire e implementare standard di formazione globali

Garanzia di qualità e conformità:

• Implementare un solido quadro di garanzia della qualità per monitorare e migliorare le interazioni con pazienti e clienti

• Garantire la conformità agli standard globali per i sistemi CRM, le operazioni dei contact center e i requisiti normativi

• Riportare direttamente alla leadership di GPC per garantire esperienze coerenti e di alto livello, supportando al contempo la fornitura di prodotti innovativi e soluzioni digitali di Roche

Gestione e analisi dei KPI:

• Monitorare, analizzare e segnalare gli indicatori chiave di prestazione relativi all'efficacia della formazione e alla qualità del servizio

• Fornire informazioni utili ai team di leadership e alle operazioni regionali per favorire il miglioramento continuo

Leadership e sviluppo del team:

• Promuovere una cultura di eccellenza, inclusività e collaborazione guidando al tempo stesso le prestazioni del team e dei singoli individui

Die Position
GPC-Leiter für Schulung und Servicequalität
Abteilung: Globale Patientenversorgung (GPC)
Bereich: Globaler Kundensupport (GCS)
Berichtet an: GPC-Supportleiter
Standort: Sant Cugat, Spanien

Über die Rolle
Der Leiter für Schulung und Servicequalität für die globale Patientenversorgung (GPC) spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung der Servicequalität im gesamten Kundensupportnetzwerk von Roche Diagnostics. Diese Rolle leitet ein engagiertes Team von Schulungs- und Servicequalitätsspezialisten und stellt die Entwicklung und Umsetzung robuster Schulungsprogramme und Qualitätssicherungsrahmen sicher, die eine konsistente, qualitativ hochwertige und patientenzentrierte Versorgung ermöglichen.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der GPC-Führung treiben Sie Strategien voran, die die Kompetenzentwicklung verbessern, sich an globalen Servicestandards orientieren und eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung fördern und gleichzeitig die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und Qualitätsstandards sicherstellen. Durch effektive Führung und datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse stärken Sie die Qualität und Effizienz der Interaktionen mit Patienten und Kunden und treiben die Mission von Roche voran, transformative Gesundheitslösungen bereitzustellen.

Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten
Strategische Programmentwicklung:

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Schulung und Verbesserung der Servicequalität, indem Sie mit regionalen Kundensupportzentren, Spezialisten für Geschäftsimplementierung und anderen GPC-Funktionen zusammenarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass sich die Services entsprechend den Geschäftsanforderungen weiterentwickeln

• Entwerfen, verbessern oder beenden Sie Schulungs- und Qualitätsprogramme, um die Servicequalität aufrechtzuerhalten und gleichzeitig die Einhaltung überprüfbarer Schulungsstandards sicherzustellen

• Leitung von Projekten im Zusammenhang mit Verbesserungen und Änderungen innerhalb der globalen Patientenversorgung, um den sich entwickelnden Geschäftsanforderungen gerecht zu werden

Kundenerfahrung und betriebliche Exzellenz:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.

Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:

Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.

Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.

Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.

Qualifications

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.

• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.

• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings

• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.

• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.

• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders

• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il Solution Architect per i processi, il framework e gli strumenti del ciclo di vita delle applicazioni ERP (ALM) è la principale autorità tecnica responsabile dell'architettura della transizione dal SAP Solution Manager legacy a un ecosistema ALM moderno e a prova di futuro. In questo ruolo, guiderai la progettazione strategica e l'eccellenza operativa del processo globale "Requisiti per l'implementazione", assicurando che la nostra pipeline di consegna rimanga solida durante un periodo di significativo cambiamento tecnologico.

La tua missione principale è esplorare le complessità dell'offerta Cloud ALM di SAP mantenendo la flessibilità necessaria per creare soluzioni proprietarie personalizzate quando gli strumenti standard non hanno la necessaria influenza sulla progettazione o sulla profondità funzionale. Come parte del tuo impegno quotidiano, dovrai:

Architetta il pivot: valuta attivamente le lacune funzionali all'interno di SAP Cloud ALM e decidi dove l'organizzazione deve "costruire" anziché "acquistare". Sarai responsabile della progettazione di alto livello di moduli ALM personalizzati (potenzialmente su SAP BTP o altre piattaforme native del cloud) per garantire che i nostri requisiti aziendali specifici siano soddisfatti.

Progettare il ciclo di vita dei "Requisiti per la distribuzione" e guidare le decisioni tecniche: orchestrerai il framework end-to-end, inclusa la modellazione dei processi aziendali, i requisiti, le modifiche, il trasporto, il rilascio, i test, i difetti e la gestione della documentazione di sistema. Non sei solo un utente di strumenti; tu sei il progettista del framework che abilita questi processi.

Governare paesaggi ibridi: definirai i modelli di integrazione richiesti per collegare i componenti ALM specifici di SAP con la più ampia catena di strumenti DevOps aziendale, garantendo una strategia "nucleo pulito" gestendo allo stesso tempo lo smantellamento degli ambienti SolMan/ChaRM legacy.

Qualifiche

• Padronanza della transizione ALM e dei set di strumenti: conoscenza approfondita dell'ALM legacy (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) abbinata alla capacità di progettare migrazioni a SAP Cloud ALM.

• Oltre 8 anni di esperienza in creazione personalizzata ed estensibilità: esperienza comprovata nella progettazione di software aziendale personalizzato o estensioni affiancate. È necessario dimostrare una "mentalità architettonica" in grado di creare strumenti su misura quando i prodotti SaaS offrono un'influenza progettuale limitata.

• Competenza SDLC e DevOps: conoscenza approfondita della gestione delle modifiche ERP e dei livelli di trasporto, con un approccio moderno alla progettazione API-first, pipeline CI/CD e orchestrazione automatizzata dei rilasci.

• Competenza avanzata nell'utilizzo di strumenti di ingegneria potenziati dall'intelligenza artificiale (ad esempio, GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule o equivalenti) per migliorare la qualità del codice, automatizzare la documentazione e progettare estensioni intelligenti che colmino le lacune funzionali nelle offerte SaaS standard

• Gestione del ciclo di vita: comprovata esperienza nella gestione di almeno 2-3 cicli di vita di implementazione o aggiornamento ERP su vasta scala, concentrandosi in particolare sui compromessi architetturali tra soluzioni "Standard" e "Personalizzate".

• Conformità strategica: solida esperienza nella gestione dei servizi IT/ITIL, insieme all'esperienza nella convalida di sistemi computerizzati (CSV) e ICFR, garantendo che gli strumenti ALM personalizzati soddisfino gli standard normativi globali.

• Leadership architettonica globale: esperienza di lavoro in una grande azienda globale, dimostrando la capacità di creare consenso tra le diverse parti interessate

• Comunicazione in inglese: una padronanza approfondita della lingua inglese (sia scritta che verbale) è essenziale per collaborare con le parti interessate globali e presentare complesse strategie ALM alla leadership.

• Una laurea in Informatica o equ

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Kontakte, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Der Solution Architect für ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Prozesse, Frameworks und Tools ist die wichtigste technische Autorität, die für die Architektur des Übergangs vom alten SAP Solution Manager zu einem modernen, zukunftssicheren ALM-Ökosystem verantwortlich ist. In dieser Rolle leiten Sie das strategische Design und die operative Exzellenz des globalen „Requirements to Deploy“-Prozesses und stellen sicher, dass unsere Lieferpipeline in einer Zeit bedeutender technologischer Veränderungen stabil bleibt.

Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, die Komplexität des Cloud ALM-Angebots von SAP zu bewältigen und gleichzeitig die Flexibilität zu bewahren, kundenspezifische proprietäre Lösungen zu erstellen, wenn Standardtools nicht den nötigen Einfluss auf Design oder Funktionstiefe haben. Im Rahmen Ihrer täglichen Aufgaben werden Sie:

Architect the Pivot: Bewerten Sie aktiv die Funktionslücken innerhalb von SAP Cloud ALM und entscheiden Sie, wo das Unternehmen „bauen“ und nicht „kaufen“ muss. Sie sind für das High-Level-Design benutzerdefinierter ALM-Module (möglicherweise auf SAP BTP oder anderen Cloud-nativen Plattformen) verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere spezifischen Geschäftsanforderungen erfüllt werden.

Entwerfen Sie den „Requirements to Deploy“-Lebenszyklus und leiten Sie technische Entscheidungen: Sie orchestrieren das End-to-End-Framework einschließlich Geschäftsprozessmodellierung, Anforderungs-, Änderungs-, Transport-, Release-, Test-, Fehler- und Systemdokumentationsmanagement. Sie sind nicht nur ein Werkzeugbenutzer; Sie sind der Designer des Frameworks, das diese Prozesse ermöglicht.

Verwalten Sie Hybridlandschaften: Sie definieren die Integrationsmuster, die erforderlich sind, um SAP-spezifische ALM-Komponenten mit der breiteren DevOps-Toolchain des Unternehmens zu verknüpfen, um eine „Clean Core“-Strategie sicherzustellen und gleichzeitig die Stilllegung älterer SolMan/ChaRM-Umgebungen zu verwalten.

Qualifikationen

• Beherrschung von ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expertenwissen über Legacy-ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, Migrationen zu SAP Cloud ALM zu planen.

• Mehr als 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Custom Build und Erweiterbarkeit: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Entwerfen maßgeschneiderter Unternehmenssoftware oder paralleler Erweiterungen. Sie müssen eine „architektonische Denkweise“ nachweisen, die in der Lage ist, maßgeschneiderte Tools zu entwickeln, wenn SaaS-Produkte nur begrenzten Designeinfluss bieten.

• SDLC- und DevOps-Kenntnisse: Tiefes Verständnis des ERP-Änderungsmanagements und der Transportschichten mit einem modernen Ansatz für API-First-Design, CI/CD-Pipelines und automatisierte Release-Orchestrierung.

• Fortgeschrittene Kompetenz im Einsatz von KI-gestützten Engineering-Tools (z. B. GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule oder gleichwertig) zur Verbesserung der Codequalität, Automatisierung der Dokumentation und Entwicklung intelligenter Erweiterungen, die funktionale Lücken in Standard-SaaS-Angeboten schließen

• Lebenszyklusmanagement: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung von mindestens zwei bis drei vollständigen ERP-Implementierungs- oder Upgrade-Lebenszyklen mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf den architektonischen Kompromissen zwischen „Standard“- und „kundenspezifischen“ Lösungen.

• Strategische Compliance: Solides Hintergrundwissen im IT-Service-Management/ITIL sowie Erfahrung in Computerized System Validation (CSV) und ICFR, um sicherzustellen, dass maßgeschneiderte ALM-Tools globale regulatorische Standards erfüllen.

• Global Architectural Leadership: Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem großen globalen Unternehmen, die die Fähigkeit demonstriert, einen Konsens zwischen verschiedenen Interessengruppen herzustellen

• Englische Kommunikation: Hervorragende Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache (sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich) sind für die Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Stakeholdern und die Präsentation komplexer ALM-Strategien gegenüber Führungskräften unerlässlich.

• Ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder gleichwertiger Abschluss

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le poste
L'architecte de solutions pour les processus, le cadre et les outils du cycle de vie des applications ERP (ALM) est la principale autorité technique responsable de l'architecture de la transition de l'ancien SAP Solution Manager vers un écosystème ALM moderne et évolutif. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la conception stratégique et l'excellence opérationnelle du processus mondial « Exigences de déploiement », garantissant que notre pipeline de livraison reste robuste pendant une période de changement technologique important.

Votre mission principale est de naviguer dans les complexités de l'offre Cloud ALM de SAP tout en conservant la flexibilité nécessaire pour créer des solutions propriétaires personnalisées lorsque les outils standard n'ont pas l'influence nécessaire sur la conception ou la profondeur fonctionnelle. Dans le cadre de vos missions quotidiennes, vous :

Architectez le pivot : évaluez activement les lacunes fonctionnelles au sein de SAP Cloud ALM et décidez où l'organisation doit « construire » plutôt que « acheter ». Vous serez responsable de la conception de haut niveau de modules ALM personnalisés (potentiellement sur SAP BTP ou d'autres plateformes cloud natives) afin de garantir que nos exigences commerciales spécifiques sont satisfaites.

Concevoir le cycle de vie des « exigences de déploiement » et diriger les décisions techniques : vous orchestrerez le cadre de bout en bout, y compris la modélisation des processus métier, les exigences, les modifications, le transport, la version, les tests, les défauts et la gestion de la documentation système. Vous n’êtes pas seulement un utilisateur d’outils ; vous êtes le concepteur du cadre qui permet ces processus.

Gouverner les paysages hybrides : vous définirez les modèles d'intégration requis pour relier les composants ALM spécifiques à SAP à la chaîne d'outils DevOps d'entreprise plus large, garantissant ainsi une stratégie de « noyau propre » tout en gérant le déclassement des environnements SolMan/ChaRM existants.

Qualifications

• Maîtrise de la transition ALM et des ensembles d'outils : connaissance de niveau expert de l'ALM existant (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) associée à la capacité d'architecturer les migrations vers SAP Cloud ALM.

• Plus de 8 ans d'expertise en matière de création et d'extensibilité personnalisées : expérience avérée dans la conception de logiciels d'entreprise sur mesure ou d'extensions côte à côte. Vous devez démontrer un « état d'esprit architectural » capable de créer des outils sur mesure lorsque les produits SaaS offrent une influence limitée sur la conception.

• Maîtrise du SDLC et du DevOps : compréhension approfondie de la gestion des changements et des couches de transport de l'ERP, avec une approche moderne de la conception axée sur les API, des pipelines CI/CD et de l'orchestration automatisée des versions.

• Compétence avancée dans l'utilisation d'outils d'ingénierie augmentés par l'IA (par exemple, GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule ou équivalent) pour améliorer la qualité du code, automatiser la documentation et concevoir des extensions intelligentes qui comblent les lacunes fonctionnelles des offres SaaS standard.

• Gestion du cycle de vie : expérience avérée dans la gestion d'au moins 2 à 3 cycles de vie de mise en œuvre ou de mise à niveau d'un ERP à grande échelle, en se concentrant spécifiquement sur les compromis architecturaux entre les solutions « standard » et « personnalisées ».

jobs.title: Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a visionary Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer to shape the future of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this hybrid leadership role, you will be the driving force behind the user interfaces and complex dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

Operating at the intersection of UX design and high-performance frontend engineering, you will translate complex bioinformatics, PCR, and sequencing data into intuitive, lightning-fast web applications. If you are passionate about building scalable UI architectures and graphing millions of data points to drive scientific innovation, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture:

• Act as the bridge between UX, Frontend, and Backend teams, driving architecture and design discussions to establish robust technical solutions and API designs (REST/GraphQL).

• Lead the end-to-end frontend implementation of enterprise-scale business applications deployed on AWS.

• Mentor and guide junior frontend engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, code quality, and continuous learning.

UX Engineering & System Design:

• Own the user experience for highly complex data tools, ensuring seamless workflows for data scientists and researchers.

• Champion, maintain, and expand our internal component library (R-Design System) to ensure visual consistency across all products.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/SCRUM environment to map out user journeys and interface requirements.

Advanced Frontend & Data Visualization:

• Build scalable, responsive, and highly interactive frontends using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS.

• Architect high-performance data visualization solutions capable of rendering millions of data points smoothly in the browser using D3.js.

• Interface directly with AWS cloud services and help shape backend interface requirements.

Who You Are
You are an engineering champion and a collaborative technical leader who is passionate about leveraging technology to transform medicine. You thrive when navigating ambiguity, enjoy solving complex data challenges, and excel at empowering your team through technical mentorship.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript MVC frameworks, with deep, proven expertise in Vue.js.

• Strong practical experience with D3.js, including optimizin

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La posizione

Chi siamo
In Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), la nostra missione è chiara: diagnosticare precocemente, sviluppare più rapidamente e personalizzare il trattamento perché ogni paziente è unico. Nell'ambito della scienza computazionale e dell'informatica (CSI), siamo il ponte tra la nostra origine e il nostro futuro, dando forma alla prossima era della salute umana attraverso una diagnostica precisa e basata sui dati e una medicina di precisione.

Eccelliamo nel fornire analisi dei dati rigorose e clinicamente utilizzabili in tutto il nostro portafoglio di prodotti diagnostici, ritenendo che il progresso dei metodi computazionali e delle soluzioni informatiche sia essenziale per sfruttare i dati dinamici sulla salute umana. Ascoltando attentamente pazienti e medici e sfruttando la digitalizzazione e le tecnologie all’avanguardia, lavoriamo in modo collaborativo per trasformare le conoscenze in impatto.

Questo spirito condiviso crea un ambiente in cui le idee crescono, nuovi approcci vengono sperimentati e i prodotti competitivi raggiungono i pazienti più velocemente, realizzando in definitiva la visione decennale di DIA e le nostre ambizioni One Roche in modo che tutti possano accedere a soluzioni sanitarie personalizzate.

L'opportunità
Cerchiamo un visionario Lead UX Designer e Frontend Engineer per dare forma al futuro dei nostri prodotti digitali nel settore delle scienze della vita. In questo ruolo di leadership ibrida, sarai la forza trainante dietro le interfacce utente e i dashboard complessi che potenziano i nostri team di machine learning e data science.

Operando all'intersezione tra progettazione UX e ingegneria frontend ad alte prestazioni, tradurrai bioinformatica complessa, PCR e dati di sequenziamento in applicazioni web intuitive e velocissime. Se sei appassionato di creare architetture dell'interfaccia utente scalabili e rappresentare graficamente milioni di punti dati per promuovere l'innovazione scientifica, questo è il ruolo che fa per te.

Responsabilità chiave

Leadership tecnica e architettura:

• Fungere da ponte tra i team UX, frontend e backend, guidando le discussioni sull'architettura e sulla progettazione per stabilire solide soluzioni tecniche e progetti API (REST/GraphQL).

• Guidare l'implementazione del frontend end-to-end delle applicazioni aziendali su scala aziendale distribuite su AWS.

• Mentore e guida degli ingegneri frontend junior, promuovendo una cultura di eccellenza tecnica, qualità del codice e apprendimento continuo.

Ingegneria UX e progettazione di sistemi:

• Gestire l'esperienza utente per strumenti dati altamente complessi, garantendo flussi di lavoro ininterrotti per data scientist e ricercatori.

• Sostenere, mantenere ed espandere la nostra libreria di componenti interni (R-Design System) per garantire la coerenza visiva tra tutti i prodotti.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali in un ambiente Agile/SCRUM per mappare i percorsi degli utenti e i requisiti dell'interfaccia.

Frontend avanzato e visualizzazione dei dati:

• Crea frontend scalabili, reattivi e altamente interattivi utilizzando Vue.js e Tailwind CSS.

• Progettare soluzioni di visualizzazione dei dati ad alte prestazioni in grado di eseguire il rendering di milioni di punti dati senza problemi nel browser utilizzando D3.js.

• Interfaccia direttamente con i servizi cloud AWS e aiuta a definire i requisiti dell'interfaccia backend.

Chi sei
Sei un campione dell'ingegneria e un leader tecnico collaborativo con la passione di sfruttare la tecnologia per trasformare la medicina. Hai successo quando esplori l'ambiguità, ti diverti a risolvere sfide complesse relative ai dati ed eccelli nel potenziare il tuo team attraverso il tutoraggio tecnico.

Qualifiche e competenze

I must-have:

• Oltre 5 anni di esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di software utilizzando i moderni framework JavaScript MVC, con una competenza profonda e comprovata in Vue.js.

• Forte esperienza pratica con D3.js, inclusa l'ottimizzazione

Wir zeichnen uns durch die Bereitstellung strenger, klinisch umsetzbarer Datenanalysen in unserem gesamten Diagnostikportfolio aus und sind davon überzeugt, dass die Weiterentwicklung von Computermethoden und Informatiklösungen für die Nutzung dynamischer Daten zur menschlichen Gesundheit von entscheidender Bedeutung ist. Indem wir Patienten und Ärzten genau zuhören und die Digitalisierung und modernste Technologien nutzen, arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, Erkenntnisse in Wirkung umzusetzen.

Dieser gemeinsame Geist schafft ein Umfeld, in dem Ideen wachsen, neue Ansätze erprobt werden und wettbewerbsfähige Produkte Patienten schneller erreichen – und letztendlich die 10-Jahres-Vision von DIA und unsere „One Roche“-Ambitionen verwirklichen, damit jeder Zugang zu personalisierten Gesundheitslösungen hat.

Wir suchen einen visionären Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer, der die Zukunft unserer digitalen Produkte im Life-Science-Bereich gestaltet. In dieser hybriden Führungsrolle sind Sie die treibende Kraft hinter den Benutzeroberflächen und komplexen Dashboards, die unsere Teams für maschinelles Lernen und Data Science unterstützen.

Wenn Sie sich für den Aufbau skalierbarer UI-Architekturen und die grafische Darstellung von Millionen von Datenpunkten begeistern, um wissenschaftliche Innovationen voranzutreiben, ist dies die richtige Stelle für Sie.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Engineer/Scientist in Electrochemical Method Development , you will be the primary owner of analytical performance specifications for Blood Gas and Electrolyte (BGE) parameters. You will work at the intersection of electrochemistry, advanced mathematics, and medical technology to ensure our diagnostic systems deliver clinical excellence.

• Innovate Measurement Methods: Define and optimize electrochemical and optical measurement methods, collaborating across sensor, hardware, and software teams to push the boundaries of diagnostic precision.

• Master Mathematical Modeling: Create robust models for measurement and calibration, translating complex physical principles into precise signal interpretation algorithms.

• Drive Algorithmic Progress: Apply modern development techniques, including model-based design and machine learning, to continuously improve data workflows and diagnostic accuracy.

• Solve Issues: Conduct deep-dive scientific investigations into product issues, developing innovative remedial solutions to maintain peak performance.

• Engineer Performance: Manage tolerance budgets and control all influence factors on analytical results, ensuring strict traceability to global reference materials.

• Lead System Validation: Spearhead the planning and execution of functional and stability tests, using statistical characterization to evaluate system-wide results.

• Solve Complex Challenges: Conduct deep-dive scientific investigations into real-world product issues, developing innovative remedial solutions to maintain peak performance.

Who You Are
You are a scientifically driven expert who values technical rigor and thrives in interdisciplinary environments. You are passionate about applying your expertise to solve challenges that directly impact patient health.

• Experience: You ​have 7+ years of professional industry related experience.

• Standards Expert: You are experienced in working within international guidelines such as ISO 13485, CLSI guidelines for analytical performance, and Risk Management (FMEA).

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Chi siamo
In Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), la nostra missione è chiara: diagnosticare precocemente, sviluppare più rapidamente e personalizzare il trattamento perché ogni paziente è unico. Nell'ambito della scienza computazionale e dell'informatica (CSI), siamo il ponte tra la nostra origine e il nostro futuro, dando forma alla prossima era della salute umana attraverso una diagnostica precisa e basata sui dati e una medicina di precisione.

Eccelliamo nel fornire analisi dei dati rigorose e clinicamente utilizzabili in tutto il nostro portafoglio di prodotti diagnostici, ritenendo che il progresso dei metodi computazionali e delle soluzioni informatiche sia essenziale per sfruttare i dati dinamici sulla salute umana. Ascoltando attentamente pazienti e medici e sfruttando la digitalizzazione e le tecnologie all’avanguardia, lavoriamo in modo collaborativo per trasformare le conoscenze in impatto.

Questo spirito condiviso crea un ambiente in cui le idee crescono, nuovi approcci vengono sperimentati e i prodotti competitivi raggiungono i pazienti più velocemente, realizzando in definitiva la visione decennale di DIA e le nostre ambizioni One Roche in modo che tutti possano accedere a soluzioni sanitarie personalizzate.

L'opportunità
In qualità di ingegnere/scienziato senior nello sviluppo di metodi elettrochimici, sarai il principale proprietario delle specifiche delle prestazioni analitiche per i parametri dei gas nel sangue e degli elettroliti (BGE). Lavorerai all'intersezione tra elettrochimica, matematica avanzata e tecnologia medica per garantire che i nostri sistemi diagnostici forniscano l'eccellenza clinica.

• Innovare i metodi di misurazione: definire e ottimizzare i metodi di misurazione elettrochimici e ottici, collaborando tra team di sensori, hardware e software per ampliare i confini della precisione diagnostica.

• Modellazione matematica avanzata: crea modelli robusti per la misurazione e la calibrazione, traducendo principi fisici complessi in algoritmi precisi di interpretazione del segnale.

• Promuovere il progresso algoritmico: applicare moderne tecniche di sviluppo, tra cui la progettazione basata su modelli e l'apprendimento automatico, per migliorare continuamente i flussi di lavoro dei dati e l'accuratezza diagnostica.

• Risolvere i problemi: condurre indagini scientifiche approfondite sui problemi dei prodotti, sviluppando soluzioni correttive innovative per mantenere le massime prestazioni.

• Prestazioni degli ingegneri: gestione dei budget di tolleranza e controllo di tutti i fattori di influenza sui risultati analitici, garantendo una rigorosa tracciabilità rispetto ai materiali di riferimento globali.

• Convalida del sistema principale: guidare la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di test funzionali e di stabilità, utilizzando la caratterizzazione statistica per valutare i risultati a livello di sistema.

• Risolvere sfide complesse: condurre indagini scientifiche approfondite su problemi reali dei prodotti, sviluppando soluzioni correttive innovative per mantenere le massime prestazioni.

Chi sei
Sei un esperto guidato scientificamente che apprezza il rigore tecnico e prospera in ambienti interdisciplinari. Hai la passione di applicare la tua esperienza per risolvere sfide che hanno un impatto diretto sulla salute dei pazienti.

• Eccellenza accademica: possiedi un master in un settore scientifico o ingegneristico pertinente (ad esempio, elettrochimica, ingegneria chimica, fisica)

• Esperienza: hai più di 7 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore.

• Specialista IVD: apporterai una conoscenza approfondita della diagnostica in vitro (IVD) e dei requisiti specifici per l'analisi dei campioni biologici.

• Esperto di standard: hai esperienza nel lavorare nell'ambito delle linee guida internazionali come ISO 13485, linee guida CLSI per prestazioni analitiche e gestione del rischio (FMEA).

• Pensatore basato sui dati: possiedi forti capacità nell'analisi matematica e statistica, con un atteggiamento proattivo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Kontakte, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

Wer wir sind
Bei Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) ist unsere Mission klar: Frühere Diagnosen stellen, schnellere Entwicklungen durchführen und die Behandlung personalisieren, denn jeder Patient ist einzigartig. Innerhalb von Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) sind wir die Brücke zwischen unserem Ursprung und unserer Zukunft und gestalten die nächste Ära der menschlichen Gesundheit durch präzise, ​​datengesteuerte Diagnostik und Präzisionsmedizin.

Wir zeichnen uns durch die Bereitstellung strenger, klinisch umsetzbarer Datenanalysen in unserem gesamten Diagnostikportfolio aus und sind davon überzeugt, dass die Weiterentwicklung von Computermethoden und Informatiklösungen für die Nutzung dynamischer Daten zur menschlichen Gesundheit von entscheidender Bedeutung ist. Indem wir Patienten und Ärzten genau zuhören und die Digitalisierung und modernste Technologien nutzen, arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, Erkenntnisse in Wirkung umzusetzen.

Dieser gemeinsame Geist schafft ein Umfeld, in dem Ideen wachsen, neue Ansätze erprobt werden und wettbewerbsfähige Produkte Patienten schneller erreichen – und letztendlich die 10-Jahres-Vision von DIA und unsere „One Roche“-Ambitionen verwirklichen, damit jeder Zugang zu personalisierten Gesundheitslösungen hat.

Die Gelegenheit
Als leitender Ingenieur/Wissenschaftler in der Entwicklung elektrochemischer Methoden sind Sie der Hauptverantwortliche für analytische Leistungsspezifikationen für Blutgas- und Elektrolytparameter (BGE). Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Elektrochemie, fortgeschrittener Mathematik und Medizintechnik, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Diagnosesysteme klinische Spitzenleistungen erbringen.

• Innovative Messmethoden: Definieren und optimieren Sie elektrochemische und optische Messmethoden und arbeiten Sie dabei mit Sensor-, Hardware- und Softwareteams zusammen, um die Grenzen der diagnostischen Präzision zu erweitern.

• Mathematische Modellierung beherrschen: Erstellen Sie robuste Modelle für Messung und Kalibrierung und übersetzen Sie komplexe physikalische Prinzipien in präzise Signalinterpretationsalgorithmen.

• Algorithmischen Fortschritt vorantreiben: Wenden Sie moderne Entwicklungstechniken an, einschließlich modellbasiertem Design und maschinellem Lernen, um Datenabläufe und Diagnosegenauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Probleme lösen: Führen Sie tiefgreifende wissenschaftliche Untersuchungen zu Produktproblemen durch und entwickeln Sie innovative Abhilfemaßnahmen, um die Spitzenleistung aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Ingenieurleistung: Verwalten Sie Toleranzbudgets und kontrollieren Sie alle Einflussfaktoren auf Analyseergebnisse, um eine strikte Rückverfolgbarkeit auf globale Referenzmaterialien sicherzustellen.

• Führende Systemvalidierung: Führen Sie die Planung und Durchführung von Funktions- und Stabilitätstests durch und verwenden Sie statistische Charakterisierung zur Bewertung systemweiter Ergebnisse.

• Lösen Sie komplexe Herausforderungen: Führen Sie tiefgreifende wissenschaftliche Untersuchungen zu realen Produktproblemen durch und entwickeln Sie innovative Abhilfemaßnahmen, um die Spitzenleistung aufrechtzuerhalten.

Wer du bist
Sie sind ein wissenschaftlich motivierter Experte, der technische Genauigkeit schätzt und in interdisziplinären Umgebungen erfolgreich ist. Es ist Ihnen eine Leidenschaft, Ihr Fachwissen zur Lösung von Herausforderungen einzusetzen, die sich direkt auf die Gesundheit der Patienten auswirken.

• Akademische Exzellenz: Sie verfügen über einen Master-Abschluss in einem relevanten wissenschaftlichen oder technischen Bereich (z. B. Elektrochemie, Chemieingenieurwesen, Physik).

• Erfahrung: Sie verfügen über mehr als 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Branche.

• IVD-Spezialist: Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse der In-vitro-Diagnostik (IVD) und der spezifischen Anforderungen bei der Analyse biologischer Proben mit.

• Normungsexperte: Sie haben Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit internationalen Richtlinien wie ISO 13485, CLSI-Richtlinien für analytische Leistung und Risikomanagement (FMEA).

• Datengesteuerter Denker: Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der mathematischen und statistischen Analyse und sind proaktiv
