La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Roche Kaiseraugst è una pietra angolare della rete globale di produzione e logistica di Roche. Oltre 1900 persone sono impiegate qui. Il sito ospita le più grandi e innovative operazioni di imballaggio di Roche in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la cooperazione indipendente in diverse squadre, perseguiamo la nostra visione: la migliore assistenza possibile ai pazienti a basso costo per la società!

Nell'unità di produzione Solids DP ci occupiamo della produzione e dell'imballaggio di varie forme di farmaco solido nei siti di produzione di Kaiseraugst e Basilea. Questi includono compresse di film, capsule e granuli per la produzione di sospensioni orali.

La possibilità

Nella Manufacturing Unit Solids DP, offriamo uno stage nel Technical Asset Care Group (workshop), che si rivolge principalmente agli studenti dei settori della tecnologia farmaceutica, ingegneria meccanica, scienze della vita o ingegneria. Durante lo stage, supporterete l'Unità Tecnica presso lo stabilimento di produzione Kaiseraugst. Imparerai a gestire e implementare le ampie normative GMP dell'industria farmaceutica.

In questa posizione:

• Lavoro indipendente su progetti più piccoli (problemi tecnici e procedurali).

• Stabilire e rivedere le procedure operative standard nell'area di manutenzione, risoluzione dei problemi.

• Supporta l'ottimizzazione di diversi processi.

• Lavorare con SAP per ricreare, regolare ed eliminare i piani di manutenzione e le liste delle attività.

• Chiarire le domande sulla manutenzione di vari impianti.

• Sostenere il team nei cambiamenti e nelle misure (azioni correttive) e nelle attività di routine.

• Sii la persona di contatto per diverse interfacce e persone di contatto.

Chi sei

Le seguenti competenze completano il tuo profilo:

• Sei attualmente iscritto a un'università o università di scienze applicate, o hai completato la laurea entro 12 mesi prima dell'inizio dello stage, nel campo dell'ingegneria farmaceutica, ingegneria meccanica, scienze della vita, ingegneria, gestione farmaceutica e produzione o direzioni correlate.

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese.

• Un alto grado di iniziativa e metodi di lavoro indipendenti e una comprensione rapida.

• Interessato alla cooperazione costruttiva con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni e al lavoro in un team dinamico.

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e capacità di presentazione.

• Buona conoscenza IT nelle applicazioni di ufficio.

Ulteriori informazioni

• La durata dello stage è di 6 - 12 mesi e si svolge nella località Kaiseraugst.

• Si prega di indicare chiaramente nella lettera motivazione la data di inizio desiderata e la durata dello stage. Le domande devono includere un CV e una lettera di motivazione, entrambe riassunte in un documento, così come una panoramica delle prestazioni aggiornate.

• Si prega di indicare chiaramente nella lettera di motivazione o CV in cui data hai completato l'università, se questo è già accaduto.

• A causa di regolamenti, i cittadini al di fuori dell'UE/EFTA devono dimostrare con un documento della loro università che è uno stage obbligatorio, specificare la sua lunghezza esatta e presentare un certificato di iscrizione.

• Questo tirocinio non è adatto per una tesi di laurea o master.

Pronti per il prossimo passo? Siamo lieti
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Kaiseraugst is a cornerstone of Roche’s global production and logistics network. Over 1900 people are employed here. The site is home to Roche’s largest and most innovative packaging operations worldwide. Through independent cooperation in diverse teams, we pursue our vision: the best possible patient care at low cost for society!

In the Solids DP manufacturing unit, we take care of the production and packaging of various solid drug forms at the production sites in Kaiseraugst and Basel. These include film tablets, capsules and granules for the production of oral suspensions.

The possibility

In the Manufacturing Unit Solids DP, we offer an internship in the Technical Asset Care Group (workshop), which is primarily aimed at students from the fields of pharmaceutical technology, mechanical engineering, life sciences or engineering. During the internship, you will support the Technical Unit at the Kaiseraugst production plant. You will learn how to handle and implement the extensive GMP regulations of the pharmaceutical industry.

In this position, you will:

• Independently work on smaller projects (technical and procedural issues).

• Establish and revise the standard operating procedures in the area of maintenance, troubleshooting.

• Support the optimization of different processes.

• Working with SAP to recreate, adjust and delete maintenance plans and task lists.

• Clarify questions about the maintenance of various plants.

• Support the team in changes and measures (corrective actions) as well as in routine activities.

• Be the contact person for various interfaces and contact persons.

Who you are

The following competencies round off your profile:

• You are currently enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences, or you have completed your degree within 12 months before the start of the internship, in the field of pharmaceutical engineering, mechanical engineering, life sciences, engineering, pharmaceutical management & production or related directions.

• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English.

• A high degree of initiative and independent working methods as well as fast comprehension.

• Interested in constructive cooperation with internal and external stakeholders as well as working in a dynamic team.

• Good communication skills and presentation skills.

• Good IT knowledge in office applications.

Additional information

• The duration of the internship is 6 - 12 months and takes place at the Kaiseraugst location.

• Please clearly indicate in your motivation letter the desired start date and the duration of the internship. Applications must include a CV and a letter of motivation, both of which are summarized in one document, as well as an up-to-date performance overview.

• Please state clearly in your motivation letter or CV on which date you completed the university, if this has already happened.

• Due to regulations, citizens outside the EU/EFTA have to prove with a document from their university that it is a mandatory internship, specify its exact length and present a certificate of enrollment.

• This internship is not suitable for a bachelor's or master's thesis.

Ready for the next step? We are delighted

• Intéressé par une coopération constructive avec les acteurs internes et externes ainsi que par une équipe dynamique.

titleByLocale.it: Consigliere legale senior. Sviluppo legale delle imprese e Corporate
titleByLocale.en: Senior Legal Counsel – Legal Business Development & Corporate
titleByLocale.de: Leitender Rechtsberater – Legal Business Development & Corporate
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Legal Counsel – Legal Business Development & Corporate

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are offering an exciting legal role that will help us to shape the future for patients across the globe. We focus on making a difference with cutting-edge technologies in research, development and commercialization of innovative therapeutic products. To that end, we are looking for an experienced transactional attorney. You have a global mindset and are capable of communicating at ease across cultures. You will be part of our global Legal Business Development & Corporate team, supporting Roche’s business development transactions (licensing, mergers and acquisitions, venture investments). You are curious and have an outstanding ability to build and maintain relationships both locally and globally.

You will be based at Roche headquarters in Basel and work with a team of outstanding local and global legal experts.

The Opportunity

• Lead, structure, and negotiate complex global licensing transactions and support a growing portfolio of alliances

• Act as a trusted legal advisor to key business partners, assessing and managing legal risks appropriately and pragmatically

• Collaborate closely within a global team of legal experts in Switzerland, the USA, and China.

• Design and deliver targeted legal training programs to support evolving business needs and strategy.

• Drive cross-functional solutions while operating seamlessly across global time zones.

Who You Are

• A qualified attorney with a Swiss bar admission (or foreign equivalent) and at least 5 years of post-bar experience, ideally with training or practice in an English-speaking country.

• Experienced in licensing and corporate law, IP/technology law within an in-house or specialized law firm setting.

• A skilled negotiator capable of translating complex legal issues into clear, actionable advice for diverse stakeholders.

• A collaborative relationship-builder with a strong affinity for tech/AI and a curiosity to learn.

• An open-minded communicator fluent in English who thrives in global, multicultural team settings.

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Who You Are

• A qualified attorney with a Swiss bar admission (or foreign equivalent) and at least 5 years of post-bar experience, ideally with training or practice in an English-speaking country.

• Experienced in licensing and corporate law, IP/technology law within an in-house or specialized law firm setting.

• A skilled negotiator capable of translating complex legal issues into clear, actionable advice for diverse stakeholders.

• A collaborative relationship-builder with a strong affinity for tech/AI and a curiosity to learn.

• An open-minded communicator fluent in English who thrives in global, multicultural team settings.

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Wir bieten eine spannende rechtliche Rolle, die uns helfen wird, die Zukunft für Patienten auf der ganzen Welt zu gestalten. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, mit innovativen Technologien in der Forschung, Entwicklung und Kommerzialisierung innovativer therapeutischer Produkte einen Unterschied zu machen. • Enge Zusammenarbeit in einem globalen Team von Rechtsexperten in der Schweiz, den USA und China.

• Konzipieren und liefern Sie gezielte juristische Schulungsprogramme, um die sich entwickelnden Geschäftsanforderungen und -strategien zu unterstützen.

• Fahren Sie funktionsübergreifende Lösungen, während Sie nahtlos über globale Zeitzonen hinweg arbeiten.

Wer du bist

• Ein qualifizierter Rechtsanwalt mit einem Schweizer Anwaltszugang (oder ausländischem Äquivalent) und mindestens 5 Jahren Post-Bar-Erfahrung, idealerweise mit Ausbildung oder Praxis in einem englischsprachigen Land.

• Erfahrung in Lizenz- und Gesellschaftsrecht, IP / Technologierecht in einer internen oder spezialisierten Anwaltskanzlei.

• Ein erfahrener Verhandlungsführer, der in der Lage ist, komplexe rechtliche Fragen in klare, umsetzbare Ratschläge für verschiedene Interessengruppen zu übersetzen.

• Ein kollaborativer Beziehungsbauer mit einer starken Affinität zu Tech / AI und einer Neugierde zu lernen.

• Ein aufgeschlossener Kommunikator, der fließend Englisch spricht und in globalen, multikulturellen Teamumgebungen lebt.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Vous êtes curieux et avez une capacité exceptionnelle de construire et maintenir des relations à la fois localement et à l'échelle mondiale.

Vous serez basé au siège de Roche à Bâle et travaillerez avec une équipe d'experts juridiques locaux et mondiaux exceptionnels.

L'opportunité

• Diriger, structurer et négocier des transactions complexes de licences mondiales et appuyer un portefeuille croissant d'alliances

• Agir en tant que conseiller juridique de confiance auprès des principaux partenaires commerciaux, évaluer et gérer les risques juridiques de façon appropriée et pragmatique

• Collaborer étroitement avec une équipe mondiale d'experts juridiques en Suisse, aux États-Unis et en Chine.

• Concevoir et offrir des programmes de formation juridique ciblés pour appuyer l'évolution des besoins et de la stratégie des entreprises.

• Conduire des solutions interfonctionnelles tout en fonctionnant de manière transparente dans les fuseaux horaires mondiaux.

Qui vous êtes

• Expérience en matière de licences et de droit des sociétés, de droit de la propriété intellectuelle et de droit de la technologie dans un cabinet d'avocats interne ou spécialisé.

• Un négociateur compétent capable de traduire des questions juridiques complexes en conseils clairs et concrets à l'intention de divers intervenants.

• Une relation-constructeur collaborative avec une forte affinité pour la technologie/AI et une curiosité à apprendre.

• Un communicateur ouvert d'esprit qui parle couramment l'anglais et qui se développe dans des équipes mondiales et multiculturelles.

Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature!

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

jobs.title: Head of Supply Chain – Africa
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
The Head of Supply Chain – Africa provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for end-to-end supply chain operations across the African continent. This senior role bridges regional and global teams, functioning as part of the regional Core Team and Extended Leadership Team. The position is responsible for co-crating the supply chain strategy, architecting resilient distribution networks, and implementing standardized digital solutions.
By transforming complex logistics, customs, and infrastructure hurdles into core
competitive advantages, the role guarantees business continuity and delivers an exceptional customer experience.

Major Responsibilities
You will transition Africa's supply chain network to the next level by leading the following major areas of responsibility:
- Strategic Leadership & S&OP: Co-create and implement the EMEA-LATAM and Africa Network Supply Chain strategy.
Establish and govern a unified Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) framework to bridge operations, countries, and networks, aligning commercial demands with regional capabilities.
- End-to-End Fulfillment & Logistics: Oversee multi-modal freight (air, sea, road), warehousing, and Regional Distribution Centers. Drive process optimizations across Order Management, Demand Planning, and distribution to drastically reduce order lead times.
- Customer Experience & Digital Innovation: Implement a customer-centric local Care model, spearheading digital strategy (e-ordering, predictive tracking, and customer inventory management) to build real-time pipeline visibility and customer experience excellence.
- Partner Governance & Distribution: Negotiate and manage high-performing 3PL/4PL partnerships, freight forwarders, and clearing agents. Optimize distributor logistics to secure reliable and cost-effective product access across diverse territories.
- Compliance, Risk & Continuity: Partner with Regulatory and Quality teams to enforce strict GxP, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), and cold-chain compliance. Formulate robust business continuity plans and agile mitigation strategies for port congestion, forex limits, and policy shifts.
- Team Leadership & Transition coaching: Build, coach, and empower a high-performing supply chain team. Support the setup of new legal entities, acting as a transition architect, local talent coach, and stakeholder catalyst.

Key Performance Metrics:
- Service Quality: Target On-Time In-Full (OTIF) score ≥ 95% across core operating markets.
- Operational Velocity: Measurable reduction in end-to-end shipment transit and customs clearance times.
- Efficiency & Cost Control: Optimized days of inventory on hand (DIOH), zero write-offs of expired products, and year- over-year freight unit cost reductions through distributor and 3PL optimizations.

Who you are?
- Managerial Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of senior supply chain leadership experience, demonstrating a strong track record in regional supply chain operations (OM, planning, distribution, and customer care).
- Industry Expertise: Solid background in Diagnostics or Medical Devices, with deep market knowledge of African healthcare and commercial landscapes.
- Logistics & Compliance Mastery: Proven expertise in cold-chain management, GxP/GDP compliance, 3PL/4PL governance, and regional trade frameworks (AfCFTA, EAC, SADC, ECOWAS).
- Transformation & Project Skills: Demonstrated ability in leading structural setups, managing transition projects, and implementing digital platforms.

L'opportunità
The Head of Supply Chain – Africa fornisce una leadership strategica e una supervisione operativa per le operazioni di supply chain end-to-end in tutto il continente africano. Questo ruolo senior collega le squadre regionali e globali, funzionando come parte del Core Team regionale e del Team di Leadership estesa. La posizione è responsabile della co-crating della strategia della supply chain, dell'architettura delle reti di distribuzione resilienti e dell'implementazione di soluzioni digitali standardizzate.
Trasformando complessi ostacoli logistici, doganali e infrastrutturali in core
vantaggi competitivi, il ruolo garantisce la continuità aziendale e offre un'esperienza clienti eccezionale.

Responsabilità maggiori
Trasferirai la rete di supply chain dell'Africa al livello successivo, portando le seguenti principali aree di responsabilità:
- Leadership strategica & S&OP: Co-creare e implementare la strategia EMEA-LATAM e Africa Network Supply Chain.
Stabilire e governare un quadro unificato per la pianificazione delle vendite e delle operazioni (S&OP) per il ponte di operazioni, paesi e reti, allineando le richieste commerciali con le capacità regionali.
- End-to-End Fulfillment & Logistics: Oversee multi-modal cargo (aria, mare, strada), warehousing e Centri di distribuzione regionali. Ottimizzazione del processo di trasmissione attraverso la gestione dell'ordine, la pianificazione della domanda e la distribuzione per ridurre drasticamente i tempi di piombo dell'ordine.
- Customer Experience & Digital Innovation: implementare un modello di Care locale orientato al cliente, testare la strategia digitale (e-ordering, monitoraggio predittivo e gestione dell'inventario del cliente) per costruire la visibilità in tempo reale della pipeline e l'eccellenza dell'esperienza del cliente.
- Governance & Distribution: Negoziare e gestire partnership 3PL/4PL, spedizionieri e agenti di compensazione. Ottimizzare la logistica dei distributori per garantire un accesso affidabile e conveniente ai prodotti in diversi territori.
- Compliance, Risk & Continuity: Partner con i team di regolamentazione e qualità per far rispettare la rigida conformità GxP, Good Distribution Practice (GDP) e a catena fredda. Formulare robusti piani di continuità aziendale e strategie di mitigazione agile per la congestione portuale, limiti forex e cambiamenti politici.
- Team Leadership & Transition coaching: Costruisci, coach e potenzia un team di supply chain ad alto rendimento. Sostenere la configurazione di nuove entità legali, agendo come architetto di transizione, allenatore di talento locale e catalizzatore di stakeholder.

Metriche di prestazione chiave:
- Qualità del servizio: Target On-Time In-Full (OTIF) punteggio ≥ 95% sui mercati operativi principali.
- VelocitÃ operativa: Riduzione misurabile dei tempi di transito e sdoganamento delle spedizioni end-to-end.
- Efficienza e controllo dei costi: giorni ottimizzati di inventario a portata di mano (DIOH), zero scritture di prodotti scaduti, e le riduzioni dei costi delle unità di trasporto anno-anno-anno attraverso il distributore e le ottimizzazioni 3PL.

Chi sei?
- Esperienza manageriale: minimo 5+ anni di esperienza di leadership della supply chain senior, dimostrando un forte record di traccia nelle operazioni della supply chain regionale (OM, pianificazione, distribuzione e assistenza clienti).
- Competenza del settore: Sfondo solido in Diagnostica o Dispositivi Medici, con profonda conoscenza del mercato della salute africana e dei paesaggi commerciali.
- Logistica & Compliance Mastery: comprovata esperienza nella gestione della catena a freddo, conformità GxP/GDP, governance 3PL/4PL e quadri commerciali regionali (AfCFTA, EAC, SADC, ECOWAS).
- Transformation & Project Skills: Capacità dimostrata nelle principali configurazioni strutturali, gestione dei progetti di transizione e realizzazione di piattaforme digitali.

La position
L'opportunité
Le chef de la chaîne d'approvisionnement – Afrique assure le leadership stratégique et le contrôle opérationnel des opérations de bout en bout de la chaîne d'approvisionnement sur le continent africain. Ce rôle de haut niveau relie les équipes régionales et mondiales, qui font partie de l'équipe de base régionale et de l'équipe de leadership élargie. Le poste est chargé de co-créer la stratégie de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'élaborer des réseaux de distribution résilients et de mettre en œuvre des solutions numériques normalisées.
En transformant les obstacles complexes à la logistique, aux douanes et à l'infrastructure
avantages concurrentiels, le rôle garantit la continuité des activités et offre une expérience client exceptionnelle.

Principales responsabilités
Vous allez faire passer le réseau de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en Afrique au niveau suivant en dirigeant les grands domaines de responsabilité suivants :
- Leadership stratégique & S&OP: Co-créer et mettre en œuvre la stratégie EMEA-LATAM et Africa Network Supply Chain.
Établir et gérer un cadre unifié de planification des ventes et des opérations (S&OP) pour relier les opérations, les pays et les réseaux, en alignant les demandes commerciales sur les capacités régionales.
- Réalisation et logistique de bout en bout : Surveiller le fret multimodal (air, mer, route), l'entreposage et les centres régionaux de distribution. Conduire des optimisations de processus à travers la gestion des commandes, la planification de la demande et la distribution pour réduire considérablement les délais de commande.
- Expérience client et innovation numérique : Mettre en place un modèle local de soins axé sur le client, en dirigeant la stratégie numérique (commande électronique, suivi prédictif et gestion des stocks de clients) pour créer une visibilité en temps réel et une expérience client d'excellence.
- Gouvernance et distribution des partenaires : Négocier et gérer des partenariats 3PL/4PL performants, des transitaires et des agents de compensation. Optimiser la logistique des distributeurs pour assurer un accès fiable et rentable aux produits dans divers territoires.
- Conformité, risques et continuité : S'associer à des équipes de réglementation et de qualité pour faire respecter la stricte norme GxP, les bonnes pratiques de distribution (PIB) et la chaîne du froid. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Bei Roche glauben wir, dass jeder Patient Zugang zu lebensverändernden Innovationen verdient. Als globaler Marktführer im Gesundheitswesen, der in den Bereichen Pharmazie und Diagnostik tätig ist, kombinieren wir Spitzenwissenschaft, fortschrittliche Technologie und die Leidenschaft für die Verbesserung des Lebens, um einige der weltweit anspruchsvollsten medizinischen Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen. Angetrieben von unserem Engagement für Forschung und nachhaltige Gesundheitslösungen fördern wir ein integratives, kollaboratives Umfeld, in dem verschiedene Teams in der Lage sind, den Status quo zu hinterfragen, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und neu zu definieren, was in der modernen Medizin möglich ist.

Als Account Executive sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, den Verkaufszyklus von (Diagnostic Sub Specialty) Produkten in Krankenhauslabors, unabhängigen Referenzlabors und definierten medizinischen Forschungszentren zu fördern und zu steuern. Con fiducia e passione, avrete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali, e sarete in grado di comunicare con il massimo impatto.
Resiliente, tenace, si sforzano sotto pressione, lavorando efficacemente come parte di un team di primo piano in un ambiente veloce e sensibile al tempo con priorità di spostamento e scadenze multiple. Con forti competenze analitiche, si sta lavorando a proprio agio con informazioni tecniche e scientifiche.

jobs.title: Packaging Technology Strategy Project Leader

titleByLocale.it: Leader del progetto di strategia per la tecnologia dell'imballaggio
titleByLocale.fr: Chef de projet de la stratégie technologique en matière d'emballage

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche’s demanding and changing Small Molecules, Bio and Cell & Gene Therapy product portfolio requires shaping the manufacturing network of the future, driving global investments across different production sites.

As an integral part of part of Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) plays a key role in leading a seamless industrialization and thorough technical product management through integrating SHE, proactive maintenance, facility fitness, performance optimization and scalable manufacturing processes and technologies in support of the manufacturing network. Product and process robustness, efficiency and reliability are key performance indicators, PTT owns and drives continuous improvement.

As a senior matrix leader within PTT, the Packaging Technology Strategy Project Leader acts as a primary architect for the industrialization and long-term management of Roche’s technology portfolio. This role is responsible for bridging the gap between innovative technology development and global manufacturing excellence, ensuring that the manufacturing networks remain robust, efficient, and scalable.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Head of Technology Strategy and Standards, you lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives to develop and implement technology strategies and roadmaps that enable the realization of our pipeline and the stable supply of marketed products.

• Lead the development of the strategic technological roadmap for Finished Goods/packaging technologies, focusing on technical innovation and alignment with PT's long-term business objectives.

• Interface with Pharma Technical Development, global MSAT, Engineering and Site Manufacturing teams to ensure technical innovations are aligned with global product & technology strategy and that network standards are consistently met.

• Together with the asset lifecycle management team, define the technology lifecycle and identify critical milestones for re-evaluating standards to reflect evolving business and operational needs.

• Represent the technological needs of the Packaging network in senior stakeholder interactions and key technical governance forums such as the Technology Portfolio Committee and One PT Board.

• Identify and assess technological innovations, translating them into actionable projects that improve product and process robustness, manufacturability, and sustainability, and o versee a complex portfolio of strategic projects aimed at delivering systematic efficiency gains and achieving supply chain resilience across the organization.

• Lead the concept and pilot of significant new packaging technology selections towards the definition of technology standards by evaluating feasibility, scalability, and implementation readiness. Support the scaling of those technology standards as needed.

• Provide strong leadership in monitoring and ensuring adherence to technological standards across the finished goods networks, c hampion a culture of innovation, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancements globally, and a ct as a senior coach for technical team members across Global MSAT, engineering and site teams, fostering growth in emerging technologies and advanced leadership skills.

Who you are
You are a recognized expert in manufacturing technologies, driving the evaluation and selection of novel solutions, using competitive intelligence, portfolio and user needs as guidance.

• BS/MS/PhD in Chemical/Biochemical Engineering or Life Sciences

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il portafoglio di prodotti di Roche esigente e mutevole Small Molecules, Bio e Cell & Gene Therapy richiede di modellare la rete di produzione del futuro, portando investimenti globali in diversi siti produttivi.

Come parte integrante di una parte di Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) svolge un ruolo chiave nella conduzione di un'industrializzazione senza soluzione di continuità e una gestione approfondita dei prodotti tecnici attraverso l'integrazione di SHE, la manutenzione proattiva, il fitness delle strutture, l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni e processi produttivi scalabili e tecnologie a supporto della rete di produzione. La robustezza del prodotto e del processo, l'efficienza e l'affidabilità sono indicatori chiave delle prestazioni, PTT possiede e guida il miglioramento continuo.

In qualità di leader di matrice senior all'interno del PTT, il Packaging Technology Strategy Project Leader funge da architetto primario per l'industrializzazione e la gestione a lungo termine del portafoglio tecnologico di Roche. Questo ruolo è responsabile del colmare il divario tra lo sviluppo tecnologico innovativo e l'eccellenza manifatturiera globale, garantendo che le reti di produzione rimangano robuste, efficienti e scalabili.

L'opportunità
Segnalando al responsabile della strategia e degli standard tecnologici, si conducono iniziative ad alto impatto, interfunzionali per sviluppare e implementare strategie tecnologiche e roadmap che permettono la realizzazione della nostra pipeline e la fornitura stabile di prodotti commercializzati.

• Condurre lo sviluppo della roadmap tecnologica strategica per le tecnologie Finished Goods/packaging, focalizzandosi sull'innovazione tecnica e sull'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali a lungo termine di PT.

• Interfaccia con i team di Pharma Technical Development, MSAT globale, Engineering e Site Manufacturing per garantire che le innovazioni tecniche siano allineate con la strategia globale di prodotto e tecnologia e che gli standard di rete siano costantemente soddisfatti.

• Insieme al team di gestione del ciclo di vita degli asset, definire il ciclo di vita della tecnologia e identificare le pietre miliari critiche per la rivalutazione degli standard per riflettere le esigenze aziendali e operative in evoluzione.

• Rappresentare le esigenze tecnologiche della rete di imballaggio nelle interazioni degli stakeholder senior e forum di governance tecnica chiave come il Comitato Portfolio Technology e One PT Board.

• Identificare e valutare le innovazioni tecnologiche, traducendole in progetti attuabili che migliorano la robustezza del prodotto e del processo, la manufacturability e la sostenibilità, e o verso un complesso portafoglio di progetti strategici finalizzati a fornire guadagni di efficienza sistematici e a raggiungere la resilienza della supply chain in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Condurre il concetto e il pilota di significative nuove selezioni tecnologiche di packaging verso la definizione di standard tecnologici valutando la fattibilità, la scalabilità e la disponibilità di implementazione. Sostenere la scalatura di tali standard tecnologici come necessario.

• Fornire una forte leadership nel monitoraggio e garantire l'adesione a standard tecnologici in tutte le reti di beni finiti, c hampion una cultura dell'innovazione, magra produzione e miglioramenti della produttività a livello globale, e un ct come allenatore senior per i membri del team tecnico in tutto il mondo MSAT, team di ingegneria e sito, favorendo la crescita nelle tecnologie emergenti e competenze di leadership avanzate.

Chi sei
Sei un esperto riconosciuto nelle tecnologie di produzione, guidando la valutazione e la selezione di nuove soluzioni, utilizzando intelligenza competitiva, portafoglio e bisogni degli utenti come guida.

• BS/MS/PhD in Ingegneria chimica/biochimica o Scienze della vita

Die Position
Das anspruchsvolle und sich verändernde Produktportfolio von Roche für kleine Moleküle, Bio sowie Zell- und Gentherapie erfordert die Gestaltung des Produktionsnetzwerks der Zukunft und die Förderung globaler Investitionen an verschiedenen Produktionsstandorten.

Als integraler Bestandteil von Pharma Technical Operations (PT) spielt PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Führung einer nahtlosen Industrialisierung und eines gründlichen technischen Produktmanagements durch die Integration von SHE, proaktiver Wartung, Facility Fitness, Leistungsoptimierung und skalierbaren Fertigungsprozessen und Technologien zur Unterstützung des Fertigungsnetzwerks. Produkt- und Prozessrobustheit, Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit sind wichtige Leistungsindikatoren, die PTT besitzt und vorantreibt.

Als Senior Matrix Leader bei PTT fungiert der Packaging Technology Strategy Project Leader als primärer Architekt für die Industrialisierung und das langfristige Management des Technologieportfolios von Roche. Diese Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, die Lücke zwischen innovativer Technologieentwicklung und globaler Fertigungsqualität zu schließen und sicherzustellen, dass die Fertigungsnetzwerke robust, effizient und skalierbar bleiben.

Die Chance
Berichterstattung an den Head of Technology Strategy and Standards, leiten Sie hochwirksame, funktionsübergreifende Initiativen zur Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Technologiestrategien und Roadmaps, die die Realisierung unserer Pipeline und die stabile Versorgung mit vermarkteten Produkten ermöglichen.

• Führen Sie die Entwicklung der strategischen technologischen Roadmap für Fertigwaren/Verpackungstechnologien mit Schwerpunkt auf technischer Innovation und Ausrichtung auf die langfristigen Geschäftsziele von PT.

• Schnittstelle mit den Teams für Pharma Technical Development, Global MSAT, Engineering und Site Manufacturing, um sicherzustellen, dass technische Innovationen an der globalen Produkt- und Technologiestrategie ausgerichtet sind und dass Netzwerkstandards konsequent eingehalten werden.

• Definieren Sie zusammen mit dem Asset Lifecycle Management-Team den Technologielebenszyklus und identifizieren Sie wichtige Meilensteine für die Neubewertung von Standards, um den sich ändernden Geschäfts- und Betriebsanforderungen Rechnung zu tragen.

• Repräsentieren Sie die technologischen Anforderungen des Verpackungsnetzwerks in hochrangigen Stakeholder-Interaktionen und wichtigen technischen Governance-Foren wie dem Technology Portfolio Committee und dem One PT Board.

• Identifizieren und bewerten Sie technologische Innovationen und übersetzen Sie sie in umsetzbare Projekte, die die Robustheit, Herstellbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit von Produkten und Prozessen verbessern, sowie ein komplexes Portfolio strategischer Projekte, die darauf abzielen, systematische Effizienzgewinne zu erzielen und die Widerstandsfähigkeit der Lieferkette im gesamten Unternehmen zu erreichen.

• Führen Sie das Konzept und den Pilotversuch bedeutender neuer Verpackungstechnologieauswahlen zur Definition von Technologiestandards durch die Bewertung der Machbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Implementierungsbereitschaft. Unterstützung der Skalierung dieser Technologiestandards nach Bedarf.

• Eine starke Führungsrolle bei der Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung technologischer Standards in den Fertigwarennetzwerken, c eine Kultur der Innovation, Lean Manufacturing und Produktivitätsverbesserungen weltweit und ein ct als Senior Coach für technische Teammitglieder in Global MSAT, Engineering und Standortteams, um das Wachstum in neuen Technologien und fortgeschrittenen Führungsqualitäten zu fördern.

Wer du bist
Sie sind ein anerkannter Experte für Fertigungstechnologien, der die Bewertung und Auswahl neuartiger Lösungen vorantreibt und Wettbewerbsintelligenz, Portfolio und Benutzeranforderungen als Orientierung verwendet.

• BS/MS/PhD in Chemical/Biochemical Engineering oder Life Sciences

En tant que partie intégrante de Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) joue un rôle clé dans la direction d'une industrialisation transparente et d'une gestion technique approfondie des produits en intégrant SHE, maintenance proactive, aptitude à l'installation, optimisation des performances et procédés et technologies de fabrication évolutives à l'appui du réseau de fabrication. La robustesse, l'efficacité et la fiabilité des produits et des procédés sont des indicateurs de performance clés, PTT possède et favorise l'amélioration continue.

En tant que chef principal de la matrice au sein de PTT, le chef de projet de stratégie technologique en matière d'emballage est l'architecte principal de l'industrialisation et de la gestion à long terme du portefeuille technologique Roche. Ce rôle est chargé de combler le fossé entre le développement de technologies innovantes et l'excellence mondiale de la fabrication, en veillant à ce que les réseaux de fabrication restent robustes, efficaces et évolutifs.

L'opportunité
Sous l'autorité du responsable de la stratégie et des normes technologiques, vous dirigez des initiatives interfonctionnelles à impact élevé pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies et des feuilles de route technologiques qui permettent la réalisation de notre pipeline et l'offre stable de produits commercialisés.

• En collaboration avec l'équipe de gestion du cycle de vie des biens, définir le cycle de vie de la technologie et déterminer les étapes critiques pour la réévaluation des normes en fonction de l'évolution des besoins opérationnels et opérationnels.

• Représenter les besoins technologiques du réseau Packaging dans les interactions avec les principaux intervenants et les forums de gouvernance technique clés, comme le comité du portefeuille de la technologie et le conseil d'administration d'un PT.

• Identifier et évaluer les innovations technologiques, les traduire en projets réalisables qui améliorent la robustesse des produits et des procédés, la fabrication et la durabilité, ainsi qu'un portefeuille complexe de projets stratégiques visant à réaliser des gains d'efficacité systématiques et à assurer la résilience de la chaîne d'approvisionnement dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

• Diriger le concept et la mise à l'essai d'importantes nouvelles technologies d'emballage vers la définition de normes technologiques en évaluant la faisabilité, l'évolutivité et l'état de préparation à la mise en oeuvre. Appuyer la mise à niveau de ces normes technologiques au besoin.

• Assurer un leadership solide dans le suivi et le respect des normes technologiques dans l'ensemble des réseaux de produits finis, c hampion une culture d'innovation, de fabrication maigre et d'amélioration de la productivité à l'échelle mondiale, et ct comme entraîneur principal pour les membres de l'équipe technique à l'échelle mondiale MSAT, les équipes d'ingénierie et de site, en favorisant la croissance des technologies émergentes et des compétences avancées en leadership.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology.
In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.
You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.

Description of the area
As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.
Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.

• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications.

• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.

• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management

• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve

• Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours

• Occasional international travel is required

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.

• 4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry

Technical Skills

• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.

• Powershell Scripting skills will be required

• Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios

• Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology.
In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.
You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.

Description of the area
As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.
Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.

• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications.

• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.

• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management

• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve

• Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours

• Occasional international travel is required

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.

• 4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry

Technical Skills

• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.

• Powershell Scripting skills will be required

• Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios

• Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance

Additional Qualifications

• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures

• Willingness to continually evolve, acquire and maintain the technical and soft skills appropriate to the requirements of this position

• Committing to operational ex

• Robuste Erfahrung in einer großen globalen Organisation, vorzugsweise in einer regulierten Branche

The Position
About the Role
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI (with a strong focus on Generative AI) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services and applications. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering & Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, genAI agents and agentic foundations.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on AI Software Architect to design and help implement end-to-end GenAI and non-Gen AI applications, with a particular focus on agentic systems. You will not simply be drawing diagrams; you will be expected to remain deeply entrenched in the code, acting as a full-stack technical anchor whose workload for rigorous code review and architecture enforcement is critical to our high-velocity teams.
Core Tech Stack & Scope
This role will involve working deeply with multimodal foundation models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, advanced agentic workflows, vector, graph and traditional databases, APIs, MCPs, A2A, MLOps subsystems, new emerging technologies and other solution components. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) to develop scalable and robust AI solutions. Beyond AI components, the architect must ensure that the entire system's software ecosystem - from frontend and backend services to data pipelines, integrations, authentication, observability, and infrastructure - is well-designed, scalable, and maintainable.

Key Responsibilities
End-to-End System Architecture & Hands-On Engineering:

• Define and design AI (with focus on genAI and agentic) and non-AI components of software systems, ensuring modularity, scalability, and security.

• Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems while ensuring seamless interoperability with backend services, APIs, MCPs, databases, and user interfaces.

• Ensure adherence to cloud-native best practices across AWS and multicloud deployments, including containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure as code.

• Evaluate the best fit for purpose technologies.

• Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of particular RDT and Business functions, and that they strictly fol low architectural patterns and standards used across RDT.

Agentic AI Model Integration & Optimization:

• Define robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal models, and RAG, agentic systems and other emerging AI technologies.

• Design efficient model-serving pipelines, integrating AI capabilities into existing business workflows.

• Ensure that AI applications follow software engineering best practices, including version control, CI/CD, MLOps, automated testing, and code quality assurance.

• Conduct rigorous code reviews for agent-assisted and human-generated code to maintain high enterprise standards.

• Architect secure and scalable integrations to facilitate seamless communication between AI models, databases, and user interfaces.

• Design data pipelines that efficiently handle structured and unstructured data, ensuring AI models receive high-quality input data.

• Architect secure and scalable integrations to facilitate seamless communication between AI models, databases, and user interfaces.

• Design data pipelines that efficiently handle structured and unstructured data, ensuring AI models receive high-quality input data.

• Te interesa la tecnología y disfrutas entendiendo cómo funcionan los equipos y resolviendo problemas técnicos.

• Tienes orientación al cliente y te gusta trabajar en equipo.

• Dispones de permiso de conducir B .

• Cuentas con flexibilidad horaria en función de las necesidades del servicio.

• Contrato laboral de prácticas remunerado de 1 año , con posibilidad de ampliación por un año adicional .

jobs.title: Instrument Manufacturing Technician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary：

The job holder ensures to meet / perform：

• Daily operation required by SOP requirement. Ensure that daily work complies with Chinese regulations and Roche Diagnostics compliance requirements.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities：

• Performs functions associated with all manufacturing operations, including working with engineers in setup and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components, subassemblies and final assemblies.

• Uses sophisticated programs to collect and evaluate operating data to conduct on-line adjustments to products, instruments or equipment.

• Determines and assists in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.

• Works with engineers in conducting experiments. Works autonomously within defined technical procedures and practices. Oversight focused only on complex new assignments.

• Independently complete the installation, commissioning and basic troubleshooting according to the manufacture work instructions.

• Fulfill daily output ensuring production targets are met also meets the quality request and delivery date committed to the planning. Zero defects in all products; and escalate any issue to department supervisor or manager.

• Daily inspection and maintenance of test equipment and so on.

• Comprehensive understanding of related production SOP and strictly implement them.

• Proficiently use tools such as safety testers and so on ,and improve the installation and commissioning skills by continuous learning.

• According to the actual operation, put forward the rationalization of production improvement suggestions, and constantly optimize the production process to improve production efficiency.

• Collaborate with technical support, PQE and other personnel to solve problems, speed up the analysis of the root cause of non-conformities in production line and complete the repair of the instrument.

• Complete production records on time and support on review, conduct mutual review of production records if needed.

• Daily monitoring, cooperate with the Manager or Supervisor to investigate issues in order to reduce down time and ensure smooth production and meet productivity and quality targets.

• Responsible for line clearance and re-check of equipment.

• Follow SHE Policy in workshop to ensure compliance with company regulation.

• On time complete companies' relative training.

• Complete other tasks from the manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Job Summary：

The job holder ensures to meet / perform：

• Daily operation required by SOP requirement. Ensure that daily work complies with Chinese regulations and Roche Diagnostics compliance requirements.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities：

• Performs functions associated with all manufacturing operations, including working with engineers in setup and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components, subassemblies and final assemblies.

• Uses sophisticated programs to collect and evaluate operating data to conduct on-line adjustments to products, instruments or equipment.

• Determines and assists in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.

• Works with engineers in conducting experiments. Works autonomously within defined technical procedures and practices. Oversight focused only on complex new assignments.

• Independently complete the installation, commissioning and basic troubleshooting according to the manufacture work instructions.

• Fulfill daily output ensuring production targets are met also meets the quality request and delivery date committed to the planning. Zero defects in all products; and escalate any issue to department supervisor or manager.

• Comprehensive understanding of related production SOP and strictly implement them.

• Proficiently use tools such as safety testers and so on ,and improve the installation and commissioning skills by continuous learning.

• According to the actual operation, put forward the rationalization of production improvement suggestions, and constantly optimize the production process to improve production efficiency.

• Collaborate with technical support, PQE and other personnel to solve problems, speed up the analysis of the root cause of non-conformities in production line and complete the repair of the instrument.

• Complete production records on time and support on review, conduct mutual review of production records if needed.

• Daily monitoring, cooperate with the Manager or Supervisor to investigate issues in order to reduce down time and ensure smooth production and meet productivity and quality targets.

• Responsible for line clearance and re-check of equipment.

• Follow SHE Policy in workshop to ensure compliance with company regulation.

• On time complete companies' relative training.

• Complete other tasks from the manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Web Access Management Engineer specializing in Authentication, you will be a core member of our Identity and Access Management product team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining secure and seamless authentication experiences for our enterprise on-prem and SaaS platforms. You will play a crucial role in integrating and implementing various authentication and authorization protocols, ensuring our applications are protected against evolving cyber threats while delivering a frictionless user experience.

The Opportunity

Responsibilities

Authentication & Authorization Implementation

• Design, test, and deploy reusable authentication and authorization components across the enterprise while adhering to security best practices and architectural guidelines

• Implement enterprise IAM solutions and integrate with identity providers (IdPs) using protocols like SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) to support Single Sign-On (SSO)

• Implement and manage secure MFA mechanisms, including exploring and deploying passwordless authentication solutions to enhance user security

• Develop hands-on experience with token-based authentication (JWT), session management, and secure communication via RESTful APIs and HTTP/HTTPS

API Security & Backend Integration

• Collaborate with backend developers to define and implement robust API security measures, including token validation and authorization mechanisms

• Ensure secure integration across authentication flows and establish security standards for token handling and authorization frameworks

Production Support & Incident Management

• Apply ITIL principles to troubleshoot authentication issues in production environments and participate in change management processes

• Work with security teams to mitigate authentication vulnerabilities and perform root-cause analysis on authentication-related incidents

• Investigate security incidents and perform vulnerability assessments on authentication systems

Continuous Learning & Evolution

• Stay updated on cutting-edge authentication technologies, security threats, and industry best practices to continuously improve security systems

• Demonstrate a mindset of continuous improvement with a proactive approach to identifying solution-level issues, gaps, or inefficiencies

• Contribute to minor process improvements within your immediate scope and identify opportunities for technical refinement

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

• Work closely with product managers, security engineers, and developers to create secure and user-friendly authentication flows that meet business and technical requirements

• Identify key business, technical, and security stakeholders for assigned tasks, analyzing their needs and interests regarding security posture and risk

• Develop and deliver tailored communication for security tasks and incident updates

• Facilitate meetings and proactively engage with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate security requirements

Feature Development & Reliability

• Develop and maintain reliable and scalable authentication and authorization features to ensure the adoption of security best practices across the organization

• Contribute to projects by providing well-analyzed requirements and supporting the design of solutions that align with business objectives

• Translate requirements into strategic plans with appropriate oversight and demonstrate growing autonomy within your domain

Who You Are

Experience & Education

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In qualità di Web Access Management Engineer specializzato nell'autenticazione, sarai un membro fondamentale del nostro team di prodotti Identity and Access Management, responsabile della progettazione, della costruzione e del mantenimento di esperienze di autenticazione sicure e senza soluzione di continuità per le nostre piattaforme enterprise on-prem e SaaS. Potrai svolgere un ruolo cruciale nell'integrazione e nell'implementazione di vari protocolli di autenticazione e autorizzazione, assicurando che le nostre applicazioni siano protette contro le minacce informatiche in evoluzione, fornendo un'esperienza utente senza attrito.

L'opportunità

responsabilità

Attuazione di autenticazione e autorizzazione

• Progettazione, test e distribuzione di componenti di autenticazione e autorizzazione riutilizzabili in tutta l'azienda, aderiscendo alle best practice di sicurezza e alle linee guida architettoniche

• Implementare le soluzioni IAM aziendali e integrare con i provider di identità (IdPs) utilizzando protocolli come SAML, OAuth e OpenID Connect (OIDC) per supportare Single Sign-On (SSO)

• Implementare e gestire meccanismi MFA sicuri, tra cui esplorare e distribuire soluzioni di autenticazione senza password per migliorare la sicurezza degli utenti

• Sviluppa l'esperienza pratica con l'autenticazione basata su gettoni (JWT), la gestione delle sessioni e la comunicazione sicura tramite API RESTful e HTTP/HTTPS

API Sicurezza e integrazione backend

• Collabora con gli sviluppatori di backend per definire e implementare misure di sicurezza API robuste, inclusi i meccanismi di convalida e autorizzazione dei gettoni

• Assicurare l'integrazione sicura attraverso i flussi di autenticazione e stabilire standard di sicurezza per i quadri di gestione e autorizzazione dei gettoni

Supporto di produzione e gestione degli incidenti

• Applicare i principi ITIL per risolvere i problemi di autenticazione negli ambienti di produzione e partecipare ai processi di gestione dei cambiamenti

• Lavorare con i team di sicurezza per mitigare le vulnerabilità di autenticazione ed eseguire analisi root-cause sugli incidenti correlati all'autenticazione

• Indagare incidenti di sicurezza e eseguire valutazioni di vulnerabilità sui sistemi di autenticazione

L'apprendimento continuo e l'evoluzione

• Resta aggiornato sulle tecnologie di autenticazione all'avanguardia, sulle minacce di sicurezza e sulle best practice del settore per migliorare continuamente i sistemi di sicurezza

• Dimostrare una mentalità di miglioramento continuo con un approccio proattivo per identificare problemi, lacune o inefficienze a livello di soluzione

• Contribuisci ai miglioramenti dei processi minori all'interno della tua portata immediata e identifica le opportunità di perfezionamento tecnico

Collaborazione e comunicazione degli stakeholder

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i product manager, gli ingegneri della sicurezza e gli sviluppatori per creare flussi di autenticazione sicuri e facili da usare che soddisfano i requisiti aziendali e tecnici

• Identificare le principali parti interessate di business, tecnico e di sicurezza per i compiti assegnati, analizzando le loro esigenze e interessi in materia di postura e rischio di sicurezza

• Sviluppare e fornire una comunicazione personalizzata per le attività di sicurezza e gli aggiornamenti degli incidenti

• Facilitare le riunioni e impegnarsi proattivamente con gli stakeholder per sollecitare, chiarire e convalidare i requisiti di sicurezza

Sviluppo e affidabilità

• Sviluppare e mantenere affidabili e scalabili le funzionalità di autenticazione e autorizzazione per garantire l'adozione delle migliori pratiche di sicurezza in tutta l'organizzazione

• Contribuire ai progetti fornendo requisiti ben analizzati e sostenendo la progettazione di soluzioni che si allineano agli obiettivi aziendali

• Traduci i requisiti in piani strategici con un'adeguata supervisione e dimostra una crescente autonomia nel tuo dominio

Chi sei

Esperienza e istruzione

• 3-5 anni

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Roche is a company with a 125 year history and our ongoing success is based on our strong focus on delivering meaningful value for our customers and society, and we will need to evolve our offering and approach in order to do so.
In response to the increasingly dynamic world we live in, Roche Pharma International began a wide scale transformation process - changing our ways of working to be more agile, less hierarchical, highly collaborative.

Reporting to the (Chapter Lead) Head of Government Relations, Policy, & Healthcare Ecosystem, the Policy Impact & Effectiveness leads the alignment and implementation of strategic health policy and health system shaping priorities, acts as the interface with the GR team, leaders across the organization.

The Opportunity:

• Collaborate with the GR team, Communications and Senior Leaders to understand needs, identify common challenges, and work to deliver aligned cross-country approaches and health policy enablement across the team, division and GR team. Engage team members to scale solutions rapidly, prevent duplication, and identify synergies.

• Accountable for realizing country strategies and supporting outcomes-based plans, including initiating and executing work packages (STOs) to address prioritized outcomes and ensuring alignment with local guidance, market insights, and data.

• Supports and enables affiliates by integrating local stakeholder insights and patient needs into the team's broader policy strategy and facilitating operational enablement. They steward resources, leveraging network expertise and work with the chapter lead to support allocating resources for impact.

Who you are:

• Experience and Expertise: 5-7 + years of experience in Life Sciences, Communications, Government Relations with a proven track record in strategic policy development, stakeholder management, advocacy, public affairs, and government relations.

• University degree in communications, political sciences, business administration, health sciences

• Industry Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of the drug development and commercialization process in Canada, industry regulations (e.g., IMC and PAAB), and the therapeutics development & market access processes.

• Skills and Abilities: Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal skills, project and time management skills, and the ability to leverage digital technology and tools for network support and engagement.

• Strategic and Systems Thinking: Expertise in direct government relations, stakeholder engagement, strategic collaboration, and proven track record in building actionable cross-functional integrated plans and policy positions; ability to promote and role-model integrity and compliance

• Excellent communication, influencing, and strategic thinking and planning skills are essential. Experience in matrix-environment people leadership, including building high performing teams, is required.strong leadership with proven impact in senior Policy & HSS roles.

Essi guidano le risorse, sfruttando le competenze di rete e lavorare con il capitolo portano a sostenere l'assegnazione di risorse per l'impatto.

Chi sei:

• Laurea in comunicazione, scienze politiche, economia aziendale, scienze della salute

• Conoscenza dell'industria: conoscenza approfondita del processo di sviluppo e commercializzazione della droga in Canada, regolamenti del settore (ad esempio, IMC e PAAB), e dei processi di sviluppo e accesso al mercato terapeutico.

• Competenze e AbilitÃ: Forte comunicazione scritta e verbale, competenze interpersonali, capacitÃ di project e time management, e la capacitÃ di sfruttare la tecnologia digitale e gli strumenti per il supporto e l'impegno della rete.

• Strategic and Systems Thinking: Competenza nelle relazioni governative dirette, coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, collaborazione strategica e comprovata esperienza nella costruzione di piani integrati e posizioni politiche attuabili; capacità di promuovere e modellare l'integrità e la conformità

• Ottima comunicazione, influenza e capacità di pensiero e pianificazione strategiche sono essenziali. L'esperienza nella leadership di persone matrice-ambiente, tra cui la costruzione di squadre ad alte prestazioni, è necessaria. forte leadership con comprovato impatto nei ruoli di policy & HSS senior.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Siamo medici. Stiamo trasformando insieme la pratica medica. Siamo sostenitori per i pazienti, per il progresso medico e per l'accesso globale che fornisce assistenza sanitaria ottimale e personalizzata. Siamo un partner affidabile e un'interfaccia centrale con la comunità di stakeholder medici esterni. Collaboriamo e ci sforziamo in un ambiente di lavoro integrato con le affiliate, lo sviluppo globale e la strategia globale. Aiutiamo a guidare lo sviluppo, l'introduzione, l'assunzione e l'uso informato dei nostri farmaci e servizi innovativi nella pratica clinica e nella cura dei pazienti in tutto il mondo. Creiamo ed evolviamo competenze, capacità e opportunità per la nostra rete medica globale.

L'opportunità
Questo tirocinio di 12 mesi offre l'opportunità di acquisire esperienza pratica delle attività mediche globali in una società farmaceutica globale innovativa e paziente-centrica. Si lavorerà su un progetto nell'area Oftalmologia, Cardiovascolare/Renale/Metabolismo, Respiratorio, Neuroscienze o Oncologia che mira a promuovere lo scambio scientifico tra Roche e medici professionisti, operatori sanitari e pazienti. Attraverso questo ruolo, si prenderanno specifiche responsabilità del progetto per aiutare a trasformare le pratiche cliniche in tutto il mondo con farmaci innovativi. Questa opportunità vi permetterà di stabilire una solida rete per la costruzione e l'espansione della vostra carriera futura.

Responsabilità primaria:

• Prendere la responsabilità di specifiche attività mediche globali e contribuire a obiettivi di progetto, imparando e comprendere l’impatto delle questioni mediche sugli obiettivi di sviluppo e commercializzazione dei prodotti dell’azienda

• Sostenere le attività quotidiane come membro completo del team di progetto

• Proattivamente costruire la conoscenza e aumentare la comprensione dell'industria farmaceutica e dell'ecosistema sanitario

Si tratta di un riassunto di alto livello di tutti i compiti che potrebbero essere eseguiti durante lo stage, con la varietà di compiti a seconda del progetto specifico.

Chi sei
Attualmente state perseguendo il vostro MD, PharmD, Master (MSc) o PhD in Scienze della vita o altre scienze; o avete completato i vostri studi entro i 12 mesi e mostrate un interesse dimostrato nello sviluppo della droga. Competenze o esperienze nelle scienze digitali e/o innovazione sono un vantaggio.

Inoltre, portate le seguenti competenze, conoscenze ed esperienza:

• Forte Etica & Relationship Building – elevati standard etici e capacità di promuovere relazioni sostenibili con gli stakeholder.

• Efficace comunicazione & collaborazione – Eccellente interpersonale, presentazione e inglese competenze linguistiche in un ambiente internazionale.

• Abilità analitiche e problem-solving – pensiero critico, processo decisionale, creatività e capacità di elaborare le informazioni in modo efficace.

• Crescita Mindset & Impact-Driven – La voglia di imparare, adattare e contribuire significativamente all'ecosistema sanitario.

• Adaptability & Organizational Awareness – Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente matrice con responsabilità condivise; la conoscenza dello sviluppo della droga e della gestione del progetto è un vantaggio.

• Si prega di notare che, a causa di regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EFTA devono includere una conferma dalla loro università che lo stage è una parte obbligatoria del loro curriculum con i loro documenti di applicazione.

Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando a tutti l’accesso al Healthcar
