Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
DIA Senior Compliance Expert
A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti, e siamo coraggiosi sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Roche è fortemente impegnata in un luogo di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo. Ci sforziamo di costruire squadre che rappresentano una gamma di sfondi, prospettive e competenze. Abbracciare la diversità ci permette di creare un ottimo posto di lavoro e di innovare per i pazienti.

L'opportunità:
In qualità di Senior Compliance Expert, progetta, architetto e guida il quadro globale di conformità e sostenibilità aziendale per Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) e i principali siti diagnostici degli Stati Uniti. Segnalando il Leader di Compliance dell'Area Clienti DIA, promuoverai una cultura di integrità e miglioramento continuo, fornendo un approccio proattivo e orientato al business. Il tuo scopo copre le operazioni di conformità principali, tra cui monitoraggio, auditing, sviluppo delle politiche, trasparenza, impegni HCP/HCO e indagini.
Lavorando a stretto contatto con la rete di conformità diagnostica, gli ufficiali di conformità locali e i cavi regionali, vi assicurerete l'esecuzione senza soluzione di continuità dei piani di formazione e comunicazione strategici in tutta l'organizzazione. In questo ruolo, si porterà iniziative di conformità ad alto impatto, consentire la maturità del programma, e ottimizzare l'allocazione delle risorse per sostenere la crescita aziendale sostenibile, soddisfando tutti gli obblighi di regolamentazione e di garanzia globali.

Ruoli e responsabilità chiave:

• Esecuzione strategica: implementare iniziative di conformità globali, divisionali e RDS allineate alle decisioni di Leadership di Compliance di Gruppo e agli obiettivi di business.

• Framework & Assurance: Progettare e mantenere un quadro di conformità robusto per proteggere la licenza di Roche per operare durante i miglioramenti del processo di guida.

• Audit & Risk Mitigation: guidare il piano di controllo e monitoraggio annuale basato sui rischi, supervisionare i risultati, le azioni correttive e i follow-up tempestivi tra le parti interessate.

• Formazione & Comunicazione: Partner attraverso RDS per sviluppare, fornire e comunicare programmi di compliance curricula, policy e sensibilizzazione al rischio.

• Compliance Oversight: Supportare le aree operative chiave, comprese le indagini interne, la manutenzione delle politiche, gli impegni HCP/HCO, FMV e la segnalazione della trasparenza.

• Executive Reporting: Preparare e presentare aggiornamenti strategici regolari sulle operazioni del programma di conformità e i progressi verso la leadership senior.

• Decisioni Data-Driven: Identificare e sfruttare le informazioni sui dati per guidare le strategie di conformità e sostenere le iniziative aziendali di seconda linea.

• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: Partner con lead regionali e funzioni di seconda linea per integrare senza soluzione di continuità la conformità tra i progetti aziendali in corso.

• Standardizzazione "OneRoche": Allineare con Gruppo e Compliance Divisionale per semplificare i processi, guidare sinergie e standardizzare le pratiche aziendali.

• Agilità di rete: Proattivamente promuovere una mentalità moderna e agile all'interno della rete di conformità diagnostica per costruire partnership forti e collaborative.

Chi sei?

• Corso di laurea e 8-10 anni di relativa esperienza OR 12-15 anni di esperienza

Preferiti:

• Istruzione e Esperienza: Laurea Avanzata (MBA, JD, o Master) in Diritto, Finanza, o Business, con 7+ anni in Compliance, Audit, Rischio, o Legale all'interno della sanità, diagnostica, o medtech.

• Reg.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
DIA Senior Compliance Expert
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

The Opportunity:
As a Senior Compliance Expert, you will design, architect, and drive the global compliance and business sustainability framework for Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) and key US Diagnostics sites. Reporting to the DIA Customer Area Compliance Lead, you will foster a culture of integrity and continuous improvement while delivering a proactive, business-oriented approach. Your scope spans core compliance operations, including monitoring, auditing, policy development, transparency, HCP/HCO engagements, and investigations.
Working closely with the Diagnostics Compliance Network, local Compliance Officers, and regional leads, you will ensure the seamless execution of strategic training and communication plans across the organization. In this role, you will lead high-impact compliance initiatives, enable program maturity, and optimize resource allocation to support sustainable business growth while meeting all global regulatory and assurance obligations.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Strategic Execution: Implement global, divisional, and RDS compliance initiatives aligned with Group Compliance Leadership decisions and business goals.

• Framework & Assurance: Design and maintain a robust compliance framework to protect Roche’s license to operate while driving process enhancements.

• Audit & Risk Mitigation: Lead the risk-based annual audit and monitoring plan, overseeing findings, corrective actions, and timely follow-ups across stakeholders.

• Training & Communication: Partner across RDS to develop, deliver, and communicate compliance curricula, policies, and risk awareness programs.

• Core Compliance Oversight: Support key operational areas, including internal investigations, policy maintenance, HCP/HCO engagements, FMV, and transparency reporting.

• Executive Reporting: Prepare and present regular strategic updates on compliance program operations and progress to senior leadership.

• Data-Driven Decisions: Identify and leverage data insights to guide compliance strategies and support second-line business initiatives.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with regional leads and second-line functions to seamlessly integrate compliance across ongoing business projects.

• "OneRoche" Standardization: Align with Group and Divisional Compliance to streamline processes, drive synergies, and standardize practices enterprise-wide.

• Network Agility: Proactively foster a modern, agile mindset within the Diagnostics Compliance Network to build strong, collaborative partnerships.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree and 8-10 years of related experience OR 12-15 years of related experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Education & Experience: Advanced degree (MBA, JD, or Master's) in Law, Finance, or Business, with 7+ years in Compliance, Audit, Risk, or Legal within healthcare, diagnostics, or medtech.

• Reg
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
DIA Senior Compliance Expert
Bei Roche sind wir leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern, und wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Handeln - wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unangreifbarer Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun dies heute, um ein besseres Morgen zu schaffen. Roche setzt sich stark für einen vielfältigen und inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir bemühen uns, Teams aufzubauen, die eine Reihe von Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten repräsentieren. Die Vielfalt ermöglicht es uns, einen großartigen Ort für die Arbeit und Innovation für Patienten zu schaffen.

Die Gelegenheit:
Als Senior Compliance Expert entwerfen, gestalten und steuern Sie den globalen Compliance- und Business-Nachhaltigkeitsrahmen für Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) und wichtige US-Diagnosestandorte. Wenn Sie an den DIA Customer Area Compliance Lead berichten, fördern Sie eine Kultur der Integrität und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und liefern gleichzeitig einen proaktiven, geschäftsorientierten Ansatz. Ihr Anwendungsbereich umfasst zentrale Compliance-Operationen, einschließlich Überwachung, Auditierung, Politikentwicklung, Transparenz, HCP / HCO-Engagements und Untersuchungen.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Diagnostics Compliance Network, lokalen Compliance Officers und regionalen Leitern stellen Sie die nahtlose Durchführung strategischer Schulungs- und Kommunikationspläne im gesamten Unternehmen sicher. In dieser Funktion leiten Sie wirkungsvolle Compliance-Initiativen, ermöglichen die Programmreife und optimieren die Ressourcenzuweisung, um ein nachhaltiges Geschäftswachstum zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig alle globalen regulatorischen und zusicherungstechnischen Verpflichtungen zu erfüllen.

Schlüsselrollen und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Strategische Umsetzung: Implementieren Sie globale, divisionale und RDS-Compliance-Initiativen, die auf Entscheidungen und Geschäftsziele der Group Compliance Leadership ausgerichtet sind.

• Framework & Assurance: Konzipieren und pflegen Sie ein robustes Compliance-Framework, um die Betriebslizenz von Roche zu schützen und gleichzeitig Prozessverbesserungen voranzutreiben.

• Audit & Risk Mitigation: Führen Sie den risikobasierten jährlichen Audit- und Monitoringplan, überwachen Sie die Ergebnisse, Korrekturmaßnahmen und zeitnahe Follow-ups zwischen den Stakeholdern.

• Training & Kommunikation: Partner bei RDS zur Entwicklung, Bereitstellung und Kommunikation von Compliance-Curricula, Richtlinien und Risikobewusstseinsprogrammen.

• Core Compliance Oversight: Unterstützung wichtiger operativer Bereiche, einschließlich interner Untersuchungen, Richtlinienpflege, HCP/HCO-Engagements, FMV und Transparenzberichterstattung.

• Executive Reporting: Bereiten Sie regelmäßige strategische Updates zum Compliance-Programmbetrieb und zum Fortschritt für die Führungsebene vor.

• Datengesteuerte Entscheidungen: Identifizieren und nutzen Sie Dateninformationen, um Compliance-Strategien zu leiten und Second-Line-Geschäftsinitiativen zu unterstützen.

• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Partner mit regionalen Leads und Second-Line-Funktionen, um Compliance nahtlos in laufende Geschäftsprojekte zu integrieren.

• „OneRoche-Standardisierung: Angleichung an Gruppen- und Divisions-Compliance, um Prozesse zu rationalisieren, Synergien zu fördern und unternehmensweite Praktiken zu standardisieren.

• Netzwerk-Agilität: Fördern Sie proaktiv eine moderne, agile Denkweise innerhalb des Diagnostics Compliance Network, um starke, kooperative Partnerschaften aufzubauen.

Wer Du bist:

• Bachelor-Abschluss und 8-10 Jahre verwandte Erfahrung ODER 12-15 Jahre verwandte Erfahrung

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Ausbildung und Erfahrung: Fortgeschrittener Abschluss (MBA, JD oder Master) in Recht, Finanzen oder Business, mit mehr als 7 Jahren in Compliance, Audit, Risiko oder Recht im Gesundheitswesen, Diagnostik oder Medtech.

• Reg.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
DIA Expert principal en conformité
Chez Roche, nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients, et nous sommes audacieux tant dans la décision que dans l'action - nous croyons que la bonne entreprise signifie un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler tous les jours. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inattaquable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Roche est fermement engagée dans un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif. Nous nous efforçons de créer des équipes qui représentent un éventail d'horizons, de perspectives et de compétences. Faire place à la diversité nous permet de créer un endroit idéal pour travailler et innover pour les patients.

La possibilité :
En tant qu'expert principal en conformité, vous concevez, architectez et pilotez le cadre mondial de conformité et de durabilité des entreprises pour Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) et les principaux sites de diagnostic américains. Rendre compte au responsable de la conformité du secteur client de la DIA, vous favoriserez une culture d'intégrité et d'amélioration continue tout en offrant une approche proactive et axée sur l'entreprise. Votre champ d'application couvre les principales opérations de conformité, y compris la surveillance, la vérification, l'élaboration de politiques, la transparence, les engagements du HCP/HCO et les enquêtes.
En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le Réseau de conformité aux diagnostics, les agents de conformité locaux et les responsables régionaux, vous assurerez l'exécution transparente des plans stratégiques de formation et de communication dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des initiatives de conformité à impact élevé, vous permettreez la maturité du programme et optimiserez l'allocation des ressources pour soutenir la croissance durable des entreprises tout en respectant toutes les obligations de réglementation et d'assurance mondiales.

Rôles et responsabilités clés :

• Exécution stratégique : Mettre en oeuvre des initiatives de conformité globales, divisionnaires et des SDR alignées sur les décisions de leadership en matière de conformité de groupe et les objectifs opérationnels.

• Cadre et assurance : Concevoir et maintenir un cadre de conformité solide pour protéger les permis Roches pour fonctionner pendant la conduite des améliorations de processus.

• Vérification et atténuation des risques : Diriger le plan annuel de vérification et de surveillance axé sur les risques, superviser les constatations, les mesures correctives et les suivis opportuns auprès des intervenants.

• Formation et communication : Partenaire à l'échelle du SDR pour élaborer, exécuter et communiquer des programmes de conformité, des politiques et des programmes de sensibilisation aux risques.

• Surveillance de base de la conformité : Appuyer les principaux domaines opérationnels, y compris les enquêtes internes, l'entretien des politiques, les engagements du HCP/HCO, la FMV et les rapports sur la transparence.

• Rapports de la haute direction : Préparer et présenter régulièrement des mises à jour stratégiques sur les activités du programme de conformité et les progrès accomplis par les cadres supérieurs.

• Décisions fondées sur les données : Identifier et tirer parti des données pour orienter les stratégies de conformité et appuyer les initiatives opérationnelles de deuxième ligne.

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : S'associer à des chefs régionaux et à des fonctions de deuxième ligne afin d'intégrer la conformité à tous les projets opérationnels en cours.

• Normalisation « OneRoche » : Aligner avec le Groupe et la Conformité divisionnaire pour rationaliser les processus, stimuler les synergies et normaliser les pratiques à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• Agilité du réseau : Favoriser proactivement un état d'esprit moderne et agile au sein du Réseau de conformité au diagnostic afin de bâtir des partenariats solides et collaboratifs.

Qui vous êtes :

• Baccalauréat et 8-10 ans d'expérience connexe OU 12-15 ans d'expérience connexe

Qualifications préférées :

• Éducation et expérience: Diplôme avancé (MBA, JD, ou maîtrise) en droit, finance, ou affaires, avec 7+ ans en conformité, audit, risque, ou juridique dans les soins de santé, diagnostics, ou medtech.

• Rég.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
International Product Manager
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity:
The International Product Manager, Sequencing Sample Preparation, is responsible for driving the global strategy for the sample prep solutions, specifically RNA-Seq portfolio, and for delivering on its execution.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

The key accountabilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

• Acts as a facilitator and integrator across all stakeholders in order to ensure that the library prep solutions are developed and commercially available in scope, time and budget.

• Working with the sequencing global business team, drives the systematic commercial development of the Roche RNA sample prep products from concept to launch, on-market support and obsolescence

• Provides on-market product support and provides guidance to the affiliates

• Collaborates with other commercial colleagues to execute on global commercialization strategy incl. clear positioning, messaging, value proposition, training, marketing materials, among other deliverables as product SME

• Gathers, refines, analyses and prioritizes customer requirements from existing and potential customers across all markets and identifies portfolio gaps. Generates resulting product requirements and an aligned multi-year product roadmap.

• Leads, manages and monitors product-specific competitor activities and development of actions to address them

• Leads strong team spirit and motivates team members across the system team and related teams towards shared goals

Who you are:

• University Degree in Marketing, Science or related technical discipline

• Preferably brings 8+ years of marketing/sales experience in the life sciences, diagnostics and/or pharmaceutical industry. Experience with sequencing products, specifically RNA-Seq library prep, will be a huge plus

• Strong preference for candidates who have broad experience in NGS space and have undergone multiple cycles of product iteration or new product development

• Brings excellent leadership & communication skills, ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams within a complex global matrix environment

Location: Remote – United States (Preferred) or South Africa.
Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Pleasanton, CA is $155,400- $288,600. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, toge

Responsabile del prodotto internazionale
Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.

L'International Product Manager, Sequencing Sample Preparation, è responsabile della guida della strategia globale per le soluzioni di prep del campione, in particolare del portafoglio RNA-Seq, e per la consegna della sua esecuzione.

Ruoli e responsabilità chiave:

Le principali responsabilità di questa posizione includono, ma non sono limitate a:

• Agisce come facilitatore e integratore di tutte le parti interessate al fine di garantire che le soluzioni di prep della biblioteca siano sviluppate e disponibili commercialmente in ambito, tempo e budget.

• Lavorare con il team aziendale globale di sequenziamento, spinge lo sviluppo commerciale sistematico dei prodotti di prep campione Roche RNA dal concetto al lancio, supporto on-market e obsolescenza

• Fornisce il supporto del prodotto sul mercato e fornisce una guida agli affiliati

• Collabora con altri colleghi commerciali per l'esecuzione della strategia di commercializzazione globale incl. posizionamento chiaro, messaggistica, proposizione di valore, formazione, materiali di marketing, tra gli altri materiali consegnabili come prodotto PMI

• Raccogliere, affinare, analizzare e privilegiare i requisiti del cliente da clienti esistenti e potenziali in tutti i mercati e identifica le lacune del portafoglio. Genera i requisiti di prodotto e una roadmap di prodotto multi-anno allineato.

• conduce, gestisce e monitora le attività dei concorrenti specifici per il prodotto e lo sviluppo di azioni per affrontarle

• Guida forte spirito di squadra e motiva i membri del team in tutto il team di sistema e i team correlati verso obiettivi condivisi

Chi sei:

• Laurea in Marketing, Scienza o disciplina tecnica correlata

• Preferibilmente porta 8+ anni di esperienza di marketing/vendita nelle scienze della vita, diagnostica e/o industria farmaceutica. L'esperienza con i prodotti di sequenziamento, in particolare RNA-Seq prep biblioteca, sarà un enorme plus

• Forte preferenza per i candidati che hanno una vasta esperienza nello spazio NGS e hanno subito più cicli di iterazione del prodotto o nuovo sviluppo del prodotto

• Porta eccellenti capacità di leadership e comunicazione, capacità di guidare e influenzare le squadre interfunzionali all'interno di un complesso ambiente di matrice globale

Posizione: Stati Uniti (Preferito) o Sud Africa.
Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione.

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione principale di Pleasanton, CA è di $155,400- $288,600. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione si qualifica anche per i benefici dettagliati al link sottostante.
Vantaggi

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, toge

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Internationaler Produktmanager
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben.

Die Gelegenheit:
Der internationale Produktmanager, Sequencing Sample Preparation, ist dafür verantwortlich, die globale Strategie für die Probenvorbereitungslösungen, insbesondere das RNA-Seq-Portfolio, voranzutreiben und die Umsetzung zu gewährleisten.

Schlüsselrollen und Verantwortlichkeiten:

Die wichtigsten Rechenschaftspflichten für diese Position umfassen, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Funktioniert als Moderator und Integrator für alle Stakeholder, um sicherzustellen, dass die Bibliotheksvorbereitungslösungen in Umfang, Zeit und Budget entwickelt und kommerziell verfügbar sind.

• In Zusammenarbeit mit dem globalen Sequencing-Business-Team treibt die systematische kommerzielle Entwicklung der Roche-RNA-Probevorbereitungsprodukte vom Konzept bis zur Markteinführung, On-Market-Unterstützung und Obsoleszenz voran.

• Bietet On-Market-Produkt-Support und bietet Unterstützung für die Affiliates

• Arbeitet mit anderen kaufmännischen Kollegen zusammen, um die globale Kommerzialisierungsstrategie umzusetzen, einschließlich klarer Positionierung, Messaging, Wertversprechen, Schulungen, Marketingmaterialien, unter anderem als Produkt-KMU

• Sammelt, verfeinert, analysiert und priorisiert Kundenanforderungen bestehender und potenzieller Kunden in allen Märkten und identifiziert Portfoliolücken. Generiert daraus resultierende Produktanforderungen und eine abgestimmte mehrjährige Produkt-Roadmap.

• Leitet, verwaltet und überwacht produktspezifische Mitbewerberaktivitäten und entwickelt Maßnahmen zu deren Bewältigung

• Führt starken Teamgeist und motiviert Teammitglieder im gesamten Systemteam und verwandten Teams zu gemeinsamen Zielen

Wer du bist:

• Universitätsabschluss in Marketing, Wissenschaft oder verwandter technischer Disziplin

• Vorzugsweise bringt 8+ Jahre Marketing- / Verkaufserfahrung in den Biowissenschaften, Diagnostik und / oder Pharmaindustrie. Erfahrung mit Sequenzierungsprodukten, insbesondere RNA-Seq Library Prep, wird ein großes Plus sein

• Starke Präferenz für Kandidaten, die eine breite Erfahrung im NGS-Bereich haben und mehrere Zyklen der Produkt-Iteration oder der Entwicklung neuer Produkte durchlaufen haben

• Bringt ausgezeichnete Führungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams in einer komplexen globalen Matrixumgebung zu führen und zu beeinflussen

Standort: Remote - Vereinigte Staaten (bevorzugt) oder Südafrika.
Umzugsvorteile sind für diese Position nicht verfügbar.

Diese Position qualifiziert sich auch für die unter dem unten angegebenen Link aufgeführten Vorteile.
Vorteile

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen, toge

titleByLocale.fr: Conseiller en solutions D2P - Approvisionnement indirect/direct

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
As a Senior D2P Solution Consultant, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis
workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will
demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their
interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into
strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to
cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process
interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective
solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes,
methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.
Description of the area
The Demand to Pay (D2P) Value Stream is responsible for driving the end-to-end Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense Management Data & AI strategies, by translating Functional strategies into measurable business outcomes.
The role is part of ERP Source to Procure Team within ERP Demand to Pay(D2P) value stream.
As a Senior D2P Solution Consultant and subject matter expert of indirect & Direct procurement focusing on the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle, you will bridge the gap between complex procurement business requirements and technical IT solutions translating business needs into technical solutions.
You will be responsible for optimizing the end-to-end process—from strategic sourcing and contract management to requisitioning, purchasing and receiving, decomposition into Features/User Stories using SAFe, Jira, and ServiceNow. Leveraging your SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement or similar procurement platform expertise, you will ensure global system stability and drive innovative enhancements across the enterprise.
Your goal is to develop sustainable IT solutions to enhance operational efficiency, ensure data integrity, and drive the digital transformation of our procurement landscape.

Job Responsibilities

• Process Optimization: Analyze, document, and redesign "as-is" and "to-be" business processes across the S2P lifecycle (Sourcing, Contracting, Supplier Management, Purchasing, and Invoicing).

• Requirements Engineering: Lead discovery workshops with stakeholders to elicit high-quality business requirements. Translate these into functional specifications, user stories, and technical workflows.

• Solution Design: Act as the functional/technical expert for S2P platforms (e.g., Smart by GEP, ORO, SAP S4HANA, GEP Nexxe and others). Oversee system configurations and enhancement requests.Write and review functional and technical specifications (incl. WRICEFs), perform testing and cut-over/ deployment activities.

• Integration Management: Collaborate with technical teams to manage integrations between S2P tools and ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), ensuring seamless data flow for master data and financial records.Lead the design of complex WRICEFs, specifically focusing on Interfaces (I) using SAP Integration Suite (BTP/CPI), Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG), or Middleware (e.g MuleSoft).

• Data Mapping & Transformation: Define and document detailed field-level mapping (IDOC, API, cXML, OData) for critical procurement objects such as Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Invoices, and Supplier Master Data.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
Come consulente senior della soluzione D2P, gestirete in modo indipendente l'analisi end-to-end
workstreams, affrontare problemi di business complessi con ambiguità emergente. Lo farai.
dimostrare una forte comprensione del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie correlate e della loro
interdipendenze, applicazione di strumenti e tecniche avanzate per tradurre i requisiti in
piani di attuazione strategici. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente di fiducia a
team interfunzionali, modellare le prospettive degli stakeholder, gestire il processo
interdipendenze, e contribuire significativamente alla progettazione e validazione di efficace
soluzioni. Potrai anche mentore analisti junior e modellare attivamente i processi del team,
metodologie e migliori pratiche all'interno della più ampia Comunità di pratica.
Descrizione della zona
La richiesta di pagamento (D2P) Value Stream è responsabile per la guida delle strategie di gestione dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale, traducendo strategie funzionali in risultati aziendali misurabili.
Il ruolo fa parte del flusso di valore ERP Source to Procure Team all'interno di ERP Demand to Pay(D2P).
In qualità di consulente senior della soluzione D2P e esperto in materia di approvvigionamento indiretto e diretto che si concentra sul ciclo di vita Procure-to-Pay (P2P), collaborerai il divario tra i complessi requisiti aziendali di approvvigionamento e le soluzioni IT tecniche che traducono le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni tecniche.
Sarete responsabili dell'ottimizzazione del processo end-to-end, dal supporto strategico e dalla gestione dei contratti alla requisizione, all'acquisto e alla ricezione, alla decomposizione in Caratteristiche/User Stories utilizzando SAFe, Jira e ServiceNow. Grazie all'esperienza di SAP S/4HANA Sourcing e Procurement o simili piattaforme di approvvigionamento, garantirai stabilità del sistema globale e guiderai miglioramenti innovativi in tutta l'azienda.
Il vostro obiettivo è quello di sviluppare soluzioni IT sostenibili per migliorare l'efficienza operativa, garantire l'integrità dei dati e guidare la trasformazione digitale del nostro paesaggio di approvvigionamento.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Ottimizzazione dei processi: Analizzare, documentare e ridisegnare processi aziendali "as-is" e "to-be" attraverso il ciclo di vita S2P (Sourcing, Contracting, Gestione dei fornitori, Acquisizione e Fatturazione).

• Ingegneria dei requisiti: laboratori di scoperta di piombo con le parti interessate per suscitare requisiti aziendali di alta qualità. Traduci questi in specifiche funzionali, storie utente e flussi di lavoro tecnici.

• Solution Design: agire come esperto funzionale/tecnico per piattaforme S2P (ad esempio, Smart by GEP, ORO, SAP S4HANA, GEP Nexxe e altri). Controllare le configurazioni di sistema e le richieste di miglioramento. Scrivere e rivedere le specifiche funzionali e tecniche (incl. WRICEFs), eseguire attività di test e cut-over/implementazione.

• Gestione dell'integrazione: collaborare con i team tecnici per gestire le integrazioni tra gli strumenti S2P e i sistemi ERP (ad esempio, SAP S/4HANA), garantendo un flusso di dati senza soluzione di continuità per i dati master e i record finanziari. Guidare la progettazione di WRICEF complessi, in particolare focalizzandosi su Interfaces (I) utilizzando SAP Integration Suite (BTP/CPI), Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG), o Middleware (ad esempio MuleSoft).

• Data Mapping & Transformation: Definire e documentare la mappatura a livello di campo dettagliata (IDOC, API, cXML, OData) per oggetti di approvvigionamento critico come ordini di acquisto, ricevute di merci, fatture e dati master del fornitore.

• Gestione degli errori & Monitoraggio: Stabilire dei framework di monitoraggio robusti (utilizzando AIF - SAP Application Interface Framework o simili) per evidenziare

Ce rôle fait partie de la source ERP à l'équipe Procure au sein du flux de valeur de la demande de PGI à payer (D2P).
En tant que consultant principal en solutions D2P et expert en matière d'approvisionnement indirect et direct axé sur le cycle de vie Procure-to-Pay (P2P), vous comblerez l'écart entre les exigences complexes en matière d'approvisionnement et les solutions techniques informatiques transformant les besoins en solutions techniques.
Vous serez responsable de l'optimisation du processus de bout en bout, de l'approvisionnement stratégique et de la gestion des contrats à la demande, à l'achat et à la réception, à la décomposition en fonctionnalités/histoires d'utilisateurs en utilisant SAFe, Jira et ServiceNow. Grâce à votre expertise SAP S/4HANA pour l'approvisionnement et l'approvisionnement ou une plateforme d'approvisionnement similaire, vous assurerez la stabilité du système mondial et générerez des améliorations innovantes dans toute l'entreprise.
Votre objectif est de développer des solutions TI durables pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, assurer l'intégrité des données et stimuler la transformation numérique de notre paysage d'approvisionnement.

Responsabilités professionnelles

• Optimisation des processus : Analyser, documenter et remanier les processus opérationnels « tels quels » et « futurs » tout au long du cycle de vie de S2P (sourçage, passation de marchés, gestion des fournisseurs, achats et facturation).

• Ingénierie des exigences : Ateliers de découverte du plomb avec les intervenants afin de susciter des exigences opérationnelles de haute qualité. Traduisez-les en spécifications fonctionnelles, en histoires d'utilisateurs et en workflows techniques.

• Conception de solutions : agir en tant qu'expert fonctionnel/technique pour les plateformes S2P (par exemple Smart by GEP, ORO, SAP S4HANA, GEP Nexxe et autres). Surveiller les configurations du système et les demandes d'amélioration. Rédiger et examiner les spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques (y compris les WRICEF), effectuer des essais et des travaux de découpage et de déploiement.

• Gestion de l'intégration : Collaborer avec des équipes techniques pour gérer les intégrations entre les outils S2P et les systèmes ERP (p. ex. SAP S/4HANA), en assurant un flux de données transparent pour les données principales et les dossiers financiers. Diriger la conception de WRICEF complexes, en se concentrant spécifiquement sur les interfaces (I) utilisant SAP Integration Suite (BTP/CPI), Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG), ou Middleware (par exemple MuleSoft).

• Cartographie et transformation des données : Définir et documenter la cartographie détaillée au niveau du champ (IDOC, API, cXML, OData) pour les objets d'approvisionnement essentiels tels que les commandes, les reçus de marchandises, les factures et les données de base du fournisseur.

• Gestion et surveillance des erreurs : Établir des cadres de surveillance robustes (en utilisant le cadre d'interface d'application SAP ou similaire) pour agir

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Software Deliveries and Operations Leader (DOL)

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Who We Are At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.
Role Purpose The Deliveries and Operations Leader (DOL) acts as the operational backbone of the A&SE CIx & DDS organization, serving as a servant-leader who shields product teams from administrative bureaucracy and operational overhead. Partnering with group RTEs and Leadership, the DOL ensures strategic traceability by maintaining a clear link between portfolio goals and team execution. The role is dedicated to driving operational excellence, harmonizing reporting, and providing "decision-ready" visibility to executive stakeholders to ensure the organization remains focused on delivering value.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Alignment & Traceability: Ensure a continuous link between organization OKRs and product delivery, providing the strategic context necessary for teams to make autonomous, high-quality decisions.

• Operational Excellence & Governance: Lead the operations of services and products to achieve fit-for-purpose service levels in productivity, quality, and cost, while driving the adoption of standardized operating models.

• Executive Visibility & Reporting: Act as the single source of truth for tracking investments, capacity, and risks, absorbing ad-hoc reporting requests to protect delivery teams from distraction.

• Risk & Dependency Mitigation: Identify and resolve structural bottlenecks and cross-team impediments, coordinating critical integration points across different product lifecycles.

• Vendor & Stakeholder Management: Manage business partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring vendors adhere to stated Service Level Agreements and Statements of Work.

Who You Are:

Here’s what we’re looking for: We are looking for an experienced, motivated RTE/PL/Software Delivery Lead who thrives in guiding and coaching the Clinical Insights and DDS engineering teams (~300 people). Someone who is passionate abo

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Software e le operazioni Leader (DOL)

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Chi Siamo a Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti, e siamo coraggiosi sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Roche è fortemente impegnata in un luogo di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo. Ci sforziamo di costruire squadre che rappresentano una gamma di sfondi, prospettive e competenze. Abbracciare la diversità ci permette di creare un ottimo posto di lavoro e di innovare per i pazienti.
Role Final The Deliveries and Operations Leader (DOL) funge da spina dorsale operativa dell'organizzazione A&SE CIx & DDS, che funge da servo-leader che protegge i team di prodotto dalla burocrazia amministrativa e dalla sovraccarica operativa. Partner con RTE di gruppo e Leadership, il DOL garantisce una tracciabilità strategica mantenendo un chiaro legame tra gli obiettivi del portafoglio e l'esecuzione del team. Il ruolo è dedicato alla guida dell'eccellenza operativa, all'armonizzazione delle relazioni, e alla visibilità "pronta decisione" agli stakeholder esecutivi per garantire che l'organizzazione rimanga concentrata sulla fornitura di valore.

L'opportunità

• Allineamento strategico & Traceability: Garantire un legame continuo tra organizzazione OKRs e consegna dei prodotti, fornendo il contesto strategico necessario per i team di prendere decisioni autonome e di alta qualità.

• Eccellenza Operativa & Governance: Guida le operazioni di servizi e prodotti per raggiungere livelli di servizio adatti a produttività, qualità e costi, guidando l'adozione di modelli operativi standardizzati.

• Executive Visibility & Reporting: Agite come unica fonte di verità per tracciare investimenti, capacità e rischi, assorbendo le richieste di report ad-hoc per proteggere i team di consegna dalla distrazione.

• Risk & Dependency Mitigation: Identificare e risolvere strozzature strutturali e impedimenti cross-team, coordinando i punti di integrazione critici in diversi cicli di vita del prodotto.

• Gestione dei fornitori e degli stakeholder: Gestisci i partenariati aziendali con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, assicurando ai fornitori di aderire agli Accordi di livello di servizio e alle Dichiarazioni di lavoro dichiarati.

Chi sei?

Ecco cosa stiamo cercando: stiamo cercando un esperto, motivato RTE/PL/Software Delivery Lead che prospera nella guida e nella formazione dei team di ingegneria Clinical Insights e DDS (~300 persone). Qualcuno che è appassionato abo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Software-Lieferungen und Operations Leader (DOL)

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch innovative digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial freisetzt und Durchbrüche vorantreibt, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Wer wir bei Roche sind, wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern, und wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Handeln - wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unangreifbarer Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun dies heute, um ein besseres Morgen zu schaffen. Roche setzt sich stark für einen vielfältigen und inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir bemühen uns, Teams aufzubauen, die eine Reihe von Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten repräsentieren. Die Vielfalt ermöglicht es uns, einen großartigen Ort für die Arbeit und Innovation für Patienten zu schaffen.
Der Liefer- und Operations Leader (DOL) fungiert als operatives Rückgrat der A & SE CIx & DDS-Organisation und dient als Servig-Leader, der Produktteams vor Verwaltungsbürokratie und operativem Overhead schützt. In Zusammenarbeit mit Gruppen-RTEs und Leadership stellt das DOL die strategische Rückverfolgbarkeit sicher, indem es eine klare Verbindung zwischen Portfoliozielen und Teamausführung aufrechterhält. Die Rolle ist darauf ausgerichtet, die operative Exzellenz zu fördern, die Berichterstattung zu harmonisieren und den Exekutivbeteiligten eine "entscheidungsfähige" Sichtbarkeit zu bieten, um sicherzustellen, dass sich das Unternehmen weiterhin auf die Bereitstellung von Wert konzentriert.

Die Chance

• Strategische Ausrichtung und Rückverfolgbarkeit: Gewährleistung einer kontinuierlichen Verbindung zwischen Organisations-OKRs und Produktlieferung und Bereitstellung des strategischen Kontexts, der für Teams erforderlich ist, um autonome, qualitativ hochwertige Entscheidungen zu treffen.

• Operational Excellence & Governance: Führen Sie den Betrieb von Dienstleistungen und Produkten, um ein angemessenes Serviceniveau in Bezug auf Produktivität, Qualität und Kosten zu erreichen, während Sie die Einführung standardisierter Betriebsmodelle vorantreiben.

• Executive Visibility & Reporting: Handeln Sie als einzige Quelle der Wahrheit, um Investitionen, Kapazitäten und Risiken zu verfolgen, und absorbieren Sie Ad-hoc-Berichtsanforderungen, um Lieferteams vor Ablenkung zu schützen.

• Risiko- und Abhängigkeitsminderung: Identifizieren und beheben Sie strukturelle Engpässe und teamübergreifende Hindernisse, indem Sie kritische Integrationspunkte über verschiedene Produktlebenszyklen hinweg koordinieren.

• Vendor & Stakeholder Management: Verwalten Sie Geschäftspartnerschaften mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, um sicherzustellen, dass die Anbieter die festgelegten Service Level Agreements und Arbeitserklärungen einhalten.

Wer Du bist:

Hier ist, was wir suchen: Wir suchen einen erfahrenen, motivierten RTE / PL / Software Delivery Lead, der die Clinical Insights- und DDS-Engineering-Teams (~ 300 Mitarbeiter) leitet und coacht. Jemand, der leidenschaftlich abo ist

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Chef des livraisons et des opérations de logiciels (DOL)

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force centrale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde entier.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins opérationnels, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements de collaboration.

Qui sommes-nous Chez Roche, nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients, et nous sommes audacieux tant dans la décision que dans l'action - nous croyons que les bonnes affaires signifient un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler tous les jours. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inattaquable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Roche est fermement engagée dans un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif. Nous nous efforçons de créer des équipes qui représentent un éventail d'horizons, de perspectives et de compétences. Faire place à la diversité nous permet de créer un endroit idéal pour travailler et innover pour les patients.
Rôle But Le chef des livraisons et des opérations (DLO) est l'épine dorsale opérationnelle de l'organisation A&SE CIx & DDS, servant de chef de service qui protège les équipes de produits de la bureaucratie administrative et des frais généraux opérationnels. En partenariat avec les ETR du groupe et le leadership, le DOL assure la traçabilité stratégique en maintenant un lien clair entre les objectifs du portefeuille et l'exécution par l'équipe. Le rôle est de stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle, d'harmoniser les rapports et d'offrir une visibilité « prête à prendre des décisions » aux intervenants de la direction pour s'assurer que l'organisation demeure axée sur la prestation de valeur.

L'opportunité

• Alignement et traçabilité stratégiques : assurer un lien continu entre les OKR et la livraison des produits, en fournissant le contexte stratégique nécessaire aux équipes pour prendre des décisions autonomes et de haute qualité.

• Excellence opérationnelle et gouvernance : Diriger le fonctionnement des services et des produits pour atteindre des niveaux de service adaptés à l'usage en termes de productivité, de qualité et de coûts, tout en favorisant l'adoption de modèles d'exploitation normalisés.

• Visibilité de la direction et rapports : agir comme une seule source de vérité pour le suivi des investissements, de la capacité et des risques, en absorbant les demandes ponctuelles de rapports afin de protéger les équipes de prestation contre la distraction.

• Atténuation des risques et de la dépendance: Identifier et résoudre les goulets d'étranglement structurels et les obstacles entre les équipes, en coordonnant les points d'intégration critiques pour différents cycles de vie des produits.

• Gestion des fournisseurs et des intervenants : Gérer les partenariats commerciaux avec les intervenants internes et externes, en veillant à ce que les fournisseurs respectent les ententes sur les niveaux de service et les énoncés de travail.

Voici ce que nous recherchons : Nous recherchons un chef expérimenté et motivé de livraison de RTE/PL/Logiciel qui prospère en guidant et coachant les équipes d'ingénierie Clinical Insights et DDS (~300 personnes). Quelqu'un qui est passionné

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner- Ophthalmology
Location: Kolkata

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are

• You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Ophthalmology preferred

• You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Portano anche l'interno fuori, per portare Roche competenze, scienza e conoscenza all'ecosistema.

La tua opportunità

• Sarete responsabili della gestione finale di Top Therapy Area Relazioni di esperti e bisogni legittimi attraverso la giusta identificazione di sfide, credenze, motivatori

• Sarete un punto di contatto per i conti principali dello stato. • Si sarà la costruzione di relazione con i decisori chiave nel conto Identificare e risolvere i problemi di business in top account e strategie di implementazione e guidare i risultati per migliorare l'accesso alle innovazioni Roche

• Sarete la collaborazione leader in campo attraverso la co-creazione di soluzioni per account chiave

Chi sei

• Sei qualcuno che ha una laurea / laurea in Scienze. Da un punto di vista di esperienza che ha più di 8 anni di esperienza con 4+ anni in Oftalmologia preferito

• È necessario esporre forti capacità di collaborazione e networking, orientamento di processo e gestione delle alleanze

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner- Ophthalmology
Location: Kolkata

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are

• You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Ophthalmology preferred

• You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Patient Journey Partner-Ophthalmologie

Die Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. • Sie bauen eine Beziehung zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern im Konto auf Identifizieren und Beheben von Geschäftsproblemen in Top-Accounts und Implementieren von Strategien und treiben Ergebnisse zur Verbesserung des Zugangs zu Roche-Innovationen

• Sie werden die Zusammenarbeit vor Ort durch die gemeinsame Erstellung von Lösungen für Key Accounts leiten

Wer du bist

• Sie sind jemand, der einen relevanten Diplom- / Post-Graduate-Abschluss in Science hat. Aus Erfahrungssicht mit mehr als 8 Jahren Erfahrung mit 4+ Jahren in der Augenheilkunde bevorzugt

• Sie müssen starke Zusammenarbeit und Netzwerkfähigkeiten, Prozessorientierung und Allianzmanagement aufweisen

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly curious, and analytical Associate Analyst to join our growing analytics team. In this role, you will leverage technical capabilities such as SQL and Python to extract, manipulate, and analyze datasets to solve real-world problems.
This role is ideal for an early-career professional (0–2 years of experience) who combines strong logical thinking and data interpretation skills with an eagerness to dive into the Pharmaceutical & Life Sciences domain . You will work closely with stakeholders to translate complex data into compelling visual stories, while actively leveraging Generative AI tools to optimize workflows and drive data innovation.

Key Responsibilities
Data Analysis & Problem Solving

• Extract, clean, and analyze structured and unstructured data using SQL and Python .

• Apply logical thinking and structured analytical frameworks to break down complex business questions into actionable insights.

• Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy and integrity across reporting outputs.
AI Integration & Innovation

• Understand and apply Generative AI tools and techniques (e.g., prompt engineering, LLM-driven analysis, automated documentation) to streamline analytical workflows and enhance productivity.
Data Visualization & Storyboarding

• Translate raw analytical outputs into intuitive dashboard wireframes, visual reports, and data-driven narratives.

• Design clear, impactful presentations/storyboards that communicate key insights and strategic recommendations to non-technical business partners.
Domain Learning & Collaboration

• Rapidly build subject-matter expertise in the Pharmaceutical domain (e.g., healthcare datasets, commercial analytics, clinical metrics).

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, domain specialists, and senior leadership to support key project deliverables.

• Communicate findings effectively through clear oral presentations and concise written documentation.
Qualifications & Skills

• Experience: 0–2 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative role.

• Technical Proficiency: Strong foundational skills in SQL & Python .Working knowledge or practical understanding of GenAI capabilities .

• Analytical Mindset: Excellent quantitative data interpretation skills with a structured, logical approach to problem-solving.

• Data Storytelling: Proven ability or aptitude for data visualization and storyboarding

• Domain Eagerness: Strong enthusiasm and willingness to learn the intricacies of the global pharmaceutical and healthcare market.

• Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Education: Bachelor’s/Master's degree in Pharma, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.

Posizione Panoramica
Siamo alla ricerca di un analizzatore associato dettagliato, altamente curioso e analitico per unirsi al nostro team di analisi in crescita. Principali responsabilità
Analisi dei dati & Problem Solving

• Estrarre, pulire e analizzare i dati strutturati e non strutturati utilizzando SQL e Python .

• Applicare il pensiero logico e le strutture analitiche strutturate per abbattere complesse questioni aziendali in insight attuabili.

• Eseguire la convalida dei dati e i controlli di qualità per garantire l'accuratezza e l'integrità delle uscite di report.
Integrazione e innovazione AI

• Progettare presentazioni/storyboard chiari e impattanti che comunicano intuizioni chiave e raccomandazioni strategiche ai partner commerciali non tecnici.
Imparare il dominio e la collaborazione

• Rapidamente costruire competenze di soggetto-materia nel dominio farmaceutico (ad esempio, set di dati sanitari, analisi commerciale, metriche cliniche).

• Collabora con team interfunzionali, specialisti di dominio e leadership senior per supportare i principali responsabili del progetto.

• Comunicare i risultati efficacemente attraverso chiare presentazioni orali e concisa documentazione scritta.
Qualifiche e competenze

• Esperienza: 0-2 anni di esperienza professionale nell'analisi dei dati, nell'intelligenza aziendale o in un ruolo quantitativo relativo.

• Technical Proficiency: Forte capacità di base in SQL & Python . Conoscenza di lavoro o comprensione pratica delle capacità GenAI .

• Mindset analitico: eccellenti capacità di interpretazione dei dati quantitativi con un approccio strutturato e logico alla risoluzione dei problemi.

• Data Storytelling: comprovata capacità o attitudine per la visualizzazione e lo storyboard dei dati

• Speranza di dominio: forte entusiasmo e volontà di imparare le complessità del mercato farmaceutico e sanitario globale.

• Comunicazione: Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta con la fiducia per spiegare i concetti tecnici al pubblico non tecnico.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

La position
